PATO:0001273.definition: A color consisting of grey color and high saturation.

PATO:0001274.label: obsolete pale grey
PATO:0001274.definition: A color consisting of grey color and low saturation.

PATO:0001275.label: saturated magenta
PATO:0001275.definition: A color consisting of magenta color and high saturation.

PATO:0001276.label: desaturated magenta
PATO:0001276.definition: A color consisting of magenta color and low saturation.

PATO:0001277.label: saturated orange
PATO:0001277.definition: A color consisting of orange hue and high saturation.

PATO:0001278.label: desaturated orange
PATO:0001278.definition: A color consisting of orange hue and low saturation.

PATO:0001280.label: dark pale pink
PATO:0001280.definition: Pink color having medium brightness and low saturation.

PATO:0001281.label: saturated purple
PATO:0001281.definition: A color consisting of purple color and high saturation.

PATO:0001282.label: desaturated purple
PATO:0001282.definition: A color consisting of purple color and low saturation.

PATO:0001283.label: saturated red
PATO:0001283.definition: A color consisting of red hue and high saturation.

PATO:0001284.label: desaturated red
PATO:0001284.definition: A color consisting of red hue and low saturation.

PATO:0001285.label: saturated yellow
PATO:0001285.definition: A color consisting of yellow hue and high saturation.

PATO:0001286.label: desaturated yellow
PATO:0001286.definition: A color consisting of yellow hue and low saturation.

PATO:0001287.label: red brown
PATO:0001287.definition: A color whose Munsell coordinates fall within the continuous ISCC-NBS reddish-brown sector represented by color-name blocks 40 through 47; moderate reddish brown (block 43, centroid 9.6R 3.4/5.2) is a central prototype.

PATO:0001288.label: dark red brown
PATO:0001288.definition: A color consisting of red and brown hue and low brightness.

PATO:0001289.label: light red brown
PATO:0001289.definition: A color consisting of red and brown hue and high brightness.

PATO:0001290.label: fluorescent
PATO:0001290.definition: A fluorescence quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of emitting light during exposure to radiation from an external source.

PATO:0001291.label: obsolete electromagnetic (EM) radiation quality
PATO:0001291.definition: OBSOLETE A radiation quality that inheres in a bearer by virtue of how that bearer interacts with electromagnetic radiation.

PATO:0001292.label: full-spectrum EM radiation quality
PATO:0001292.definition: An EM radiation quality that is independent of the EM wavelength range.

PATO:0001293.label: absorption quality
PATO:0001293.definition: A scalar EM radiation quality which obtains by the capacity of the bearer to retain radiation.

PATO:0001294.label: radiation reflective quality
PATO:0001294.definition: A scalar EM radiation quality which obtains by the capacity of the bearer to scatter or reflect radiation.

PATO:0001295.label: albedo
PATO:0001295.definition: A reflective quality restricted to a particular wavelength.

PATO:0001296.label: luminous flux
PATO:0001296.definition: A scalar optical quality which obtains by the magnitude of the light emitted by the bearer.

PATO:0001297.label: reflectivity
PATO:0001297.definition: A radiation reflective quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the ratio of the energy of a wave reflected from its surface to the energy possessed by the wave striking the bearer's surface.

PATO:0001298.label: phosphorescence
PATO:0001298.definition: A fluorescence in which the emittence continues after the absorption has ceased.

PATO:0001299.label: radiation emitting quality
PATO:0001299.definition: A scalar EM radiation quality which obtains by the capacity of the bearer to emit radiation.

PATO:0001300.label: optical quality
PATO:0001300.definition: An EM radiation quality in which the EM radiation is within the fiat range of the spectrum visible deemed to be light.

PATO:0001301.label: chromatic property
PATO:0001301.definition: An optical quality that is the mixture, purity or pattern of wavelengths of light perceived by the observer.

PATO:0001302.label: vermilion
PATO:0001302.definition: A color consisting of red and orange hue with a slight amount of gray.

PATO:0001303.label: variability
PATO:0001303.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to varying or changing.

PATO:0001304.label: variability of temperature
PATO:0001304.definition: A variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits temperature variation or change.

PATO:0001305.label: increased temperature
PATO:0001305.definition: A temperature which is relatively high.

PATO:0001306.label: decreased temperature
PATO:0001306.definition: A temperature which is relatively low.

PATO:0001307.label: decreased variability of temperature
PATO:0001307.definition: A variability of temperature which is relatively low.
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0001308 ! increased variability of temperature

PATO:0001308.label: increased variability of temperature
PATO:0001308.definition: A variability of temperature which is relatively high.
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0001307 ! decreased variability of temperature

PATO:0001309.label: duration
PATO:0001309.definition: A process quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's magnitude of the temporal extent between the starting and ending point.

PATO:0001310.label: duration of temperature
PATO:0001310.definition: A duration quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's duration of exhibition of thermal energy.

PATO:0001311.label: decreased duration of temperature
PATO:0001311.definition: A duration of temperature which is lesser relative to the normal or average enduring or continuing in time.
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0001312 ! increased duration of temperature

PATO:0001312.label: increased duration of temperature
PATO:0001312.definition: A duration of temperature which is greater relative to the normal or average in respect to the quality of temperature of enduring or continuing in time.
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0001311 ! decreased duration of temperature

PATO:0001313.label: invariant temperature
PATO:0001313.definition: A variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking or not exhibiting variation of temperature.

PATO:0001314.label: variant temperature
PATO:0001314.definition: A variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or exhibiting variation of temperature.

PATO:0001315.label: mild increased temperature
PATO:0001315.definition: A temperature which is increased by a low degree.

PATO:0001316.label: moderate increased temperature
PATO:0001316.definition: A temperature which is increased by a medium degree.

PATO:0001317.label: severe increased temperature
PATO:0001317.definition: A temperature which is increased by a high degree.

PATO:0001318.label: indiscriminate
PATO:0001318.definition: A discrimination quality in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being incapable perceiving differences between two or more stimuli.

PATO:0001319.label: discriminate
PATO:0001319.definition: A discrimination quality in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable of perceiving differences between two or more stimuli.

PATO:0001320.label: pubescent hair
PATO:0001320.definition: A pilosity quality of being covered with short hairs or soft down.

PATO:0001321.label: right angle to
PATO:0001321.definition: An angle which is 90 degrees to another entity.

PATO:0001322.label: straight angle to
PATO:0001322.definition: An angle which is 180 degrees to another entity.

PATO:0001323.label: area
PATO:0001323.definition: A 2-D extent quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's two dimensional extent.

PATO:0001324.label: bilateral symmetry
PATO:0001324.definition: A symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being symmetric about a plane running from its frontal end to its caudal end (head to tail), and has nearly identical right and left halves.

PATO:0001325.label: radial symmetry
PATO:0001325.definition: A symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having equal proportion around a central point or axis.

PATO:0001327.label: zygomorphic
PATO:0001327.definition: A symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable of division into symmetrical halves by only one longitudinal plane passing through the axis.

PATO:0001328.label: actinomorphic
PATO:0001328.definition: A symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable of division into symmetrical halves by any longitudinal plane passing through the axis.

PATO:0001329.label: flavourful
PATO:0001329.definition: A flavor quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having flavour.

PATO:0001330.label: flavourless
PATO:0001330.definition: A flavor quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking flavour.

PATO:0001331.label: odorous
PATO:0001331.definition: An odor quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having odour.

PATO:0001332.label: amorphous
PATO:0001332.definition: A morphology quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lack of distinct morphology.

PATO:0001333.label: temporally extended
PATO:0001333.definition: A quality of a process which ends later than the natural end time.

PATO:0001334.label: diameter
PATO:0001334.definition: A length quality which is equal to the length of any straight line segment that passes through the center of a circle and whose endpoints are on the circular boundary.

PATO:0001335.label: bacterial mating type
PATO:0001335.definition: A mating type that indicates whether the F plasmid has integrated into the chromosome.

PATO:0001336.label: obsolete unknown sex
PATO:0001336.definition: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual whose sex is unknown.

PATO:0001338.label: mixed sex
PATO:0001338.definition: A biological sex quality inhering in a population of multiple sexes.

PATO:0001339.label: biomaterial purity
PATO:0001339.definition: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's homogeneity of a biomaterial.

PATO:0001340.label: hermaphrodite
PATO:0001340.definition: A biological sex quality inhering in an organism or a population with both male and female sexual organs in one individual.

PATO:0001341.label: a mating type (yeast)
PATO:0001341.definition: A S. cerevisiae mating type cells that secrete a pheromone that in alpha haploids stimulates processes that lead to mating.

PATO:0001343.label: Schizosaccharomyces pombe mating type
PATO:0001343.definition: A S. pombe mating type determined by the gene configuration on the mat1 locus.

PATO:0001344.label: alpha mating type (yeast)
PATO:0001344.definition: A S. cerevisiae mating type cells that secrete a pheromone that stimulates a haploids.

PATO:0001345.label: h minus
PATO:0001345.definition: A S. pombe mating type determined by the mat1-Mc and mat1-Mi on the mat1 locus.

PATO:0001346.label: h plus
PATO:0001346.definition: A S. pombe mating type determined by the mat1-Pc and mat1-Pi on the mat1 locus.

PATO:0001347.label: F mating type
PATO:0001347.definition: A bacterial mating type indicating the presence of F plasmid in a bacterial cell.

PATO:0001348.label: F minus mating type
PATO:0001348.definition: A bacterial mating type indicating the absence of F plasmid in a bacterial cell.

PATO:0001349.label: high frequency recombinant
PATO:0001349.definition: A mating type that indicates that the F plasmid has integrated into the chromosome.

PATO:0001350.label: angular acceleration
PATO:0001350.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the rate of change of the bearer's angular velocity.

PATO:0001351.label: area density
PATO:0001351.definition: A density quality which inheres in a bearer by virtue of some influence exerted by the bearer's mass on a given area.

PATO:0001352.label: linear density
PATO:0001352.definition: A density quality which is equal to the mass exerting an influence on a one-dimensional object.

PATO:0001353.label: volumetric density
PATO:0001353.definition: A density quality which inheres in a bearer by virtue of some influence exerted by the bearer's mass on a given volume.

PATO:0001354.label: translucent
PATO:0001354.definition: A optical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting low opacity.

PATO:0001355.label: convex
PATO:0001355.definition: A shape quality that obtains by virtue of the bearer having inward facing edges; having a surface or boundary that curves or bulges outward, as the exterior of a sphere.

PATO:0001356.label: pleomorphic
PATO:0001356.definition: A shape quality inhering in a cell by virtue of the bearer's ability to take on two or more different shapes during its life cycle.

PATO:0001357.label: pulvinate
PATO:0001357.definition: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a cushion or has a marked convex cushion-like form.

PATO:0001358.label: umbonate
PATO:0001358.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a knob or knoblike protuberance.

PATO:0001359.label: rugose
PATO:0001359.definition: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having many wrinkles or creases on the surface.

PATO:0001360.label: filamentous
PATO:0001360.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having thin filamentous extensions at its edge.

PATO:0001361.label: warty
PATO:0001361.definition: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being covered with warts or projections that resemble warts resulting in a hard rough surface.

PATO:0001362.label: fragile
PATO:0001362.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being easily damaged or destroyed.

PATO:0001364.label: rhizoidal
PATO:0001364.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having root like extensions radiating from its center.

PATO:0001365.label: spiny
PATO:0001365.definition: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having spines, thorns or similar thin projections on its surface.

PATO:0001366.label: punctiform
PATO:0001366.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being small and resembling a point.

PATO:0001367.label: lobate
PATO:0001367.definition: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having deeply undulating edges forming lobes.

PATO:0001368.label: erose
PATO:0001368.definition: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an irregularly toothed edge.

PATO:0001369.label: raised
PATO:0001369.definition: A shape quality inhering in a colony by virtue of the bearer's appearing above the medium surface with terraced edges.

PATO:0001370.label: viscid
PATO:0001370.definition: A coating quality which is sticky or clammy.

PATO:0001371.label: mucoid
PATO:0001371.definition: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's consistency of mucus.

PATO:0001372.label: refractivity
PATO:0001372.definition: A physical quality that inheres in propagating wave (light or sound) virtue of the bearer's change in direction when passing from one medium to another.

PATO:0001373.label: glistening
PATO:0001373.definition: A reflectivity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's reflecting lots of light.

PATO:0001374.label: ploidy
PATO:0001374.definition: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's number of homologous sets of chromosomes in the nucleus or primary chromosome-containing compartment of the cell, each set essentially coding for all the biological traits of the organism.

PATO:0001375.label: haploid
PATO:0001375.definition: A ploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing a single set of homologous chromosomes.

PATO:0001376.label: monoploid
PATO:0001376.definition: A ploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing a single set of unique homologous chromosomes.

PATO:0001377.label: polyploid
PATO:0001377.definition: A ploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing more than two homologous sets of chromosomes.

PATO:0001378.label: autopolyploid
PATO:0001378.definition: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing chromosomes derived from a single species.

PATO:0001379.label: allopolyploidy
PATO:0001379.definition: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing chromosomes derived from different species.

PATO:0001380.label: paleopolyploid
PATO:0001380.definition: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an ancient polyploid ancestor.

PATO:0001381.label: triploid
PATO:0001381.definition: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing three homologous sets of chromosomes.

PATO:0001382.label: tetraploid
PATO:0001382.definition: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing four homologous sets of chromosomes.

PATO:0001383.label: pentaploid
PATO:0001383.definition: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing five homologous sets of chromosomes.

PATO:0001384.label: hexaploid
PATO:0001384.definition: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing six homologous sets of chromosomes.

PATO:0001385.label: aneuploid
PATO:0001385.definition: A ploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing a non-integral multiple of the monoploid number, due to extra or missing chromosomes.

PATO:0001386.label: monosomy
PATO:0001386.definition: An aneuploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing only one chromosome from a pair in a cell's nucleus.

PATO:0001387.label: disomy
PATO:0001387.definition: An aneuploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing only two chromosome from a pair in a cell's nucleus.

PATO:0001388.label: uniparental disomy
PATO:0001388.definition: A disomy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing two copies of the chromosome from one of the parents (with no contribution from the other parent).

PATO:0001389.label: trisomy
PATO:0001389.definition: An aneuploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing three, instead of two, chromosomes of a particular numbered type in an organism.

PATO:0001390.label: partial trisomy
PATO:0001390.definition: A trisomy quality inhering in a bearer when part of the bearer's extra chromosome is attached to one of the other chromosomes, or if one of the bearer's chromosomes has two copies of part of its chromosome.

PATO:0001391.label: mosaic trisomy
PATO:0001391.definition: A trisomy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having extra chromosomal material in only some of it's cells.

PATO:0001392.label: endopolyploid
PATO:0001392.definition: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's chromosome number being increased by endomitosis and for which the degree of ploidy is proportional to the number of times that endomitosis has taken place.

PATO:0001393.label: euploid
PATO:0001393.definition: A ploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing an integral multiple of the monoploid number, possibly excluding the sex-determining chromosomes.

PATO:0001394.label: diploid
PATO:0001394.definition: A ploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two copies (homologs) of each chromosome, usually one from the mother and one from the father.

PATO:0001395.label: haplodiploid
PATO:0001395.definition: A diploidy quality inhering in a bearer in by virtue of belonging in a species whose one of the sexes has haploid cells and the other has diploid cells.

PATO:0001396.label: cellular quality
PATO:0001396.definition: A monadic quality of continuant that exists at the cellular level of organisation.

PATO:0001397.label: cellular potency
PATO:0001397.definition: A cellular quality that arises by virtue of whether the bearer's disposition to differentiate into one or more mature cell types.

PATO:0001398.label: self-renewal
PATO:0001398.definition: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having the ability to go through numerous cycles of cell division while maintaining the undifferentiated state.

PATO:0001399.label: totipotent
PATO:0001399.definition: A cellular potency that is the capacity to produce differentiated cell types of all three primary germ layers and extraembryonic cell types.

PATO:0001400.label: unipotent
PATO:0001400.definition: A cellular potency that is the capacity to produce only one differentiated cell type.

PATO:0001401.label: oligopotent
PATO:0001401.definition: A cellular potency that is the capacity to form multiple differentiated cell types of a specific lineage and lack self renewing capacity.

PATO:0001402.label: multipotent
PATO:0001402.definition: A cellular potency that is the capacity to form multiple differentiated cell types.

PATO:0001403.label: pluripotent
PATO:0001403.definition: A cellular potency that is the capacity to produce differentiated cell types of all three primary germ layers but not extraembryonic cell types.

PATO:0001404.label: nucleate quality
PATO:0001404.definition: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's number of nuclei.

PATO:0001405.label: anucleate
PATO:0001405.definition: A nucleate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having no nucleus.

PATO:0001406.label: binucleate
PATO:0001406.definition: A nucleate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two nuclei.

PATO:0001407.label: mononucleate
PATO:0001407.definition: A nucleate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having one nucleus.

PATO:0001408.label: ciliated
PATO:0001408.definition: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having one or more cilia as a part.

PATO:0001409.label: spindle-shaped
PATO:0001409.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a long tapered rod.

PATO:0001410.label: striated
PATO:0001410.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by narrow lines or grooves, usually parallel.

PATO:0001411.label: structured
PATO:0001411.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having distinct structure.

PATO:0001412.label: unstructured
PATO:0001412.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking distinct structure.

PATO:0001413.label: angular velocity
PATO:0001413.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the rate of the bearer's angular movement about an axis; the angle rotated in a given time.

PATO:0001414.label: catalytic activity
PATO:0001414.definition: A physical quality inhering in a catalyst by virtue of the amount of the catalyst's action.

PATO:0001415.label: morbidity
PATO:0001415.definition: A quality inhering in a population by virtue of the proportion of its members that are ill at a given time.

PATO:0001416.label: regular duration
PATO:0001416.definition: A duration which has regular start and/or end times.

PATO:0001417.label: irregular duration
PATO:0001417.definition: A duration quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's duration which has irregular start and/or end times.

PATO:0001418.label: lethargic
PATO:0001418.definition: A behavioral quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being deficient in alertness or activity.

PATO:0001419.label: sharp
PATO:0001419.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's terminating in a point or edge.

PATO:0001420.label: buoyancy
PATO:0001420.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to rise or float in a fluid medium such as water or air.

PATO:0001421.label: alive
PATO:0001421.definition: A viability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's condition before death.

PATO:0001422.label: dead
PATO:0001422.definition: A viability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the cessation of the bearer's life.

PATO:0001423.label: refractile
PATO:0001423.definition: A reflectivity quality inhering in the bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to refract light.

PATO:0001424.label: violet
PATO:0001424.definition: A color hue with very low wavelength of that portion of the visible spectrum lying between reddish blue or bluish purple, evoked in the human observer by radiant energy with wavelengths of approximately 420 to 380 nanometers.

PATO:0001425.label: rosy
PATO:0001425.definition: A color hue consisting of red hue and yellow hue and high brightness.

PATO:0001426.label: maroon
PATO:0001426.definition: A color consisting of purple and brown hue.

PATO:0001427.label: compound acidity
PATO:0001427.definition: A concentration quality inhering in compound by virtue of the bearer's tendency to act as a hydron donor.

PATO:0001428.label: medium acidity
PATO:0001428.definition: A concentration quality inhering in a medium by virtue of the bearer's tendency to hydronate a specific reference base.

PATO:0001429.label: acidic
PATO:0001429.definition: An medium acidity quality inhering in a solution by virtue of the bearer's a high concentration of H+ ions.

PATO:0001430.label: alkaline
PATO:0001430.definition: An medium acidity quality inhering in a solution by virtue of the bearer's a low concentration of H+ ions.

PATO:0001431.label: adhesivity
PATO:0001431.definition: An emergent molecular quality that arises by virtue of the bearer's disposition to exhibit molecular attraction to another entity in contact.

PATO:0001432.label: decayed
PATO:0001432.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's decomposition into component parts.

PATO:0001433.label: growth quality of occurrent
PATO:0001433.definition: A quality of a single process which describes the growth of an organism, structure, or group of organisms.

PATO:0001434.label: reproductive quality
PATO:0001434.definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to produce new life or offspring.

PATO:0001435.label: attachment quality
PATO:0001435.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having connection or association with another entity.

PATO:0001436.label: sessile (sensu botany)
PATO:0001436.definition: An attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking a stalk and being attached directly by its base, as in flowers or leaves that grow directly from the stem.

PATO:0001437.label: sessile (sensu zoology)
PATO:0001437.definition: A attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's inability to move about.

PATO:0001438.label: pedicellate
PATO:0001438.definition: A attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or being supported by a pedicel or pedicle.

PATO:0001439.label: tonicity
PATO:0001439.definition: A contractile quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's elastic tension that facilitate response to stimuli.

PATO:0001440.label: homophilic
PATO:0001440.definition: A cellular adhesivity quality inhering in a molecule in one cell by virtue of the bearer's attachment to an identical molecule in an adjacent cell.

PATO:0001441.label: heterophilic
PATO:0001441.definition: A cellular adhesivity quality inhering in a molecule in one cell by virtue of the bearer's attachment to an nonidentical molecule in an adjacent cell.

PATO:0001442.label: wholeness
PATO:0001442.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer includes all its components.

PATO:0001444.label: broken
PATO:0001444.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's components no longer being in a single contiguous unit.

PATO:0001445.label: disassembled
PATO:0001445.definition: A wholeness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being taken apart into its constituent parts.

PATO:0001446.label: whole
PATO:0001446.definition: A wholeness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's including all its components.

PATO:0001447.label: calcified
PATO:0001447.definition: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's being encrusted or impregnated with calcium carbonate (CHEBI:3311).

PATO:0001448.label: ossified
PATO:0001448.definition: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's being hardened by the deposition of calcium into bone.

PATO:0001449.label: cartilaginous
PATO:0001449.definition: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's cartilage quantities.

PATO:0001450.label: edematous
PATO:0001450.definition: A structural quality which is held by a bearer when the latter exhibits an excessive accumulation of extracellular fluid.

PATO:0001451.label: obsolete edematous (sensu botany)
PATO:0001451.definition: An extended swelling in plant organs caused primarily by an excessive accumulation of water.

PATO:0001453.label: detached from
PATO:0001453.definition: An attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking connection or association with another entity.

PATO:0001454.label: sensitivity to oxygen
PATO:0001454.definition: A sensitivity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's dependence on oxygen.

PATO:0001455.label: aerobic
PATO:0001455.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's dependence on oxygen.

PATO:0001456.label: anaerobic
PATO:0001456.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's independence on oxygen.

PATO:0001457.label: sensitivity of a process
PATO:0001457.definition: A quality of a process inhering in bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to respond to stimulation.

PATO:0001458.label: sensitivity of a process to oxygen
PATO:0001458.definition: A sensitivity of a process quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's unfolding in a location with or without oxygen.

PATO:0001459.label: aerobic (for occurrence)
PATO:0001459.definition: A sensitivity of a process inhering in a biological process by virtue of the process unfolding in a location with oxygen.

PATO:0001460.label: anaerobic (for occurrence)
PATO:0001460.definition: A sensitivity of a process inhering in a biological process by virtue of the process unfolding in a location without oxygen.

PATO:0001461.label: surface tension
PATO:0001461.definition: A physical quality inhering in a liquid by virtue of the bearer's ability to attraction of molecules at its surface as a result of unbalanced molecular cohesive forces.

PATO:0001462.label: membrane potential
PATO:0001462.definition: A quality inhering in a cell's plasma membrane by virtue of the electrical potential difference across it.

PATO:0001463.label: action potential
PATO:0001463.definition: A quality inhering in a cell's plasma membrane by virtue of a brief fluctuation in the bearer's potential caused by the rapid opening and closing of voltage-gated ion channels.

PATO:0001464.label: electric potential
PATO:0001464.definition: A quality that is equal to the potential energy per unit charge associated with a static (time-invariant) electric field, also called the electrostatic potential.

PATO:0001465.label: monstrous
PATO:0001465.definition: A malformed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's all-encompassing, grotesque morphological defects.

PATO:0001466.label: curved rostral
PATO:0001466.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the front of an organism.

PATO:0001467.label: curved caudal
PATO:0001467.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the part of the body from which the tail arises.

PATO:0001468.label: curved dorsal
PATO:0001468.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the back or upper surface of an organism.

PATO:0001469.label: curved ventral
PATO:0001469.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the abdomen of an organism.

PATO:0001470.label: ratio
PATO:0001470.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's magnitude in proportion to the magnitude of another entity.

PATO:0001472.label: decreased depth
PATO:0001472.definition: A depth which is relatively low.

PATO:0001473.label: duplicated
PATO:0001473.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being present in two copies.

PATO:0001474.label: anteverted
PATO:0001474.definition: An oriented quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's axis being positioned forward.

PATO:0001475.label: increased position
PATO:0001475.definition: A position which is relatively high.

PATO:0001476.label: decreased position
PATO:0001476.definition: A positional which is relatively low.

PATO:0001477.label: retracted
PATO:0001477.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being drawn in or pulled back from any given point.

PATO:0001478.label: collapsed
PATO:0001478.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being broken down; caved in.

PATO:0001480.label: spongy
PATO:0001480.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a sponge in elasticity, absorbency, or porousness.

PATO:0001481.label: sloped
PATO:0001481.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an oblique or slanted direction.

PATO:0001482.label: prominent
PATO:0001482.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's standing out or projecting beyond a surface or line.

PATO:0001483.label: aplastic
PATO:0001483.definition: Absence of an organ, tissue or cell due to failure to develop from a primordium or precursor cell.

PATO:0001484.label: recent
PATO:0001484.definition: A quality of a process which occurs near to or not long before the present.

PATO:0001485.label: condensed
PATO:0001485.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being thicker or more closely packed together; pressed tightly together.

PATO:0001486.label: chronological age
PATO:0001486.definition: An age quality that exists by virtue of the time (years and months) that the bearer has existed.

PATO:0001487.label: senescent
PATO:0001487.definition: A time quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's growing old; aging.

PATO:0001488.label: cellular motility
PATO:0001488.definition: A cellular quality inhering in a cell by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits the ability to move spontaneously.

PATO:0001490.label: heterochronic growth
PATO:0001490.definition: A growth quality of a process inhering in an organism, structure, or group of organisms by virtue of the bearer's reduced or increased growth.

PATO:0001491.label: neotenous growth
PATO:0001491.definition: A paedomorphic growth quality which is due to a reduced rate.

PATO:0001492.label: growth rate
PATO:0001492.definition: The rate or speed of the change in size of an individual entity or change in number of a population.

PATO:0001495.label: notched
PATO:0001495.definition: A concave quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape being a V-shaped cut.

PATO:0001496.label: brood quality
PATO:0001496.definition: A reproductive quality inhering in the young of an animal by virtue of the bearer's being cared for at one time.

PATO:0001497.label: brood viability
PATO:0001497.definition: A reproductive quality inhering in the young of an animal by virtue of the bearer's disposition to survive and develop normally.

PATO:0001499.label: spherical
PATO:0001499.definition: A spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a ball (a sphere whose equatorial diameter is equal to the polar diameter).
relationships: RO:0015011 PATO:0000411 ! has cross section circular

PATO:0001500.label: tapered
PATO:0001500.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being gradually narrower or thinner toward one end.

PATO:0001501.label: immature
PATO:0001501.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking complete growth, differentiation, or development.

PATO:0001502.label: complexity
PATO:0001502.definition: A monadic quality of continuant inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being intricate and compounded.

PATO:0001503.label: simple
PATO:0001503.definition: A complexity quality in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having few parts or being complicated or compound.

PATO:0001504.label: complex
PATO:0001504.definition: A complexity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being intricate and compounded.

PATO:0001505.label: separated from
PATO:0001505.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not being in contact with another entity, or of no longer being connected or joined with another entity.

PATO:0001506.label: diastatic
PATO:0001506.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's separation of normally joined parts, such as the separation of adjacent bones without fracture or of certain abdominal muscles during pregnancy.

PATO:0001507.label: disrupted
PATO:0001507.definition: A quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being interrupted of its normal course.

PATO:0001509.label: functionality
PATO:0001509.definition: A quality of a single physical entity that arises by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits the ability to perform a regular function(s).

PATO:0001510.label: functional
PATO:0001510.definition: A functionality quality held by the bearer when the latter is able to perform a regular function(s).

PATO:0001511.label: non-functional
PATO:0001511.definition: A disfunctional quality held by the bearer when the latter is unable to perform a regular function(s).

PATO:0001512.label: punctate
PATO:0001512.definition: A pattern inhering in a surface by virtue of the bearer's being marked by the presence of dots, punctures, points or pits.

PATO:0001514.label: delaminated
PATO:0001514.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking some outer layer.

PATO:0001515.label: variable color
PATO:0001515.definition: A color quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being uneven in color.

PATO:0001516.label: focus
PATO:0001516.definition: An optical quality where light rays originating from a point on the object converge.

PATO:0001517.label: focused
PATO:0001517.definition: An optical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having focus.

PATO:0001518.label: blurry
PATO:0001518.definition: An optical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking focus.

PATO:0001519.label: sound quality
PATO:0001519.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of vibration, as perceived by the sense of hearing.

PATO:0001521.label: sound amplitude
PATO:0001521.definition: A physical quality inhering in a sound wave by virtue of the maximum magnitude (value without regard to sign) of its disturbance.

PATO:0001522.label: sound speed
PATO:0001522.definition: A physical quality inhering in sound by virtue of the bearer's travelling speed in a given medium under specified conditions.

PATO:0001523.label: sound wavelength
PATO:0001523.definition: A physical quality which is equal to the quotient of the speed of a sound wave divided by its wavelength.

PATO:0001524.label: intrasonic
PATO:0001524.definition: A sound frequency in the range of 0-20 Hz.

PATO:0001525.label: sonic
PATO:0001525.definition: A sound frequency in the range of 20 to 20.000 Hz.

PATO:0001526.label: ultrasonic
PATO:0001526.definition: A sound frequency in the range of 20 000 + Hz.

PATO:0001527.label: quiet
PATO:0001527.definition: A sound amplitude which is relatively low.

PATO:0001528.label: loud
PATO:0001528.definition: A sound amplitude which is relatively high.

PATO:0001529.label: cellular spatiotemporal quality
PATO:0001529.definition: A spatiotemporal quality inhering in a cell.

PATO:0001530.label: behavioral quality of a process
PATO:0001530.definition: A quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's behavior.

PATO:0001531.label: cellular adhesivity
PATO:0001531.definition: A cellular quality that exists by virtue of the disposition of the cell to adhere to other cells and molecules, through the emergent action of the molecular parts of the cell surface.

PATO:0001532.label: mono-colored
PATO:0001532.definition: A color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having one hue.

PATO:0001533.label: multi-colored
PATO:0001533.definition: A color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's having two or more hues or degrees of saturation.

PATO:0001534.label: motley
PATO:0001534.definition: A color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's having 3 or more hues or degrees of saturations.

PATO:0001535.label: dappled
PATO:0001535.definition: A color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's being marked with small spots, patches, or specks of hue or degree of saturation differing from that of the background.

PATO:0001536.label: solubility
PATO:0001536.definition: A molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the bearer's disposition to dissolve in a liquid.

PATO:0001537.label: soluble in
PATO:0001537.definition: A solubility quality inhering in a substance by virtue of the bearer's disposition to dissolve in a liquid.

PATO:0001538.label: insoluble in
PATO:0001538.definition: A solubility quality inhering in a substance by virtue of the bearer's inability of a substance to dissolve in a liquid.

PATO:0001539.label: amylose composition
PATO:0001539.definition: A compositional quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's quantities or relative ratios of amylose of the inhering entity.

PATO:0001540.label: glutinous
PATO:0001540.definition: An amylose composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's having negligible or no amylose content.

PATO:0001541.label: non-glutinous
PATO:0001541.definition: An amylose composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's having high amount of amylose content.

PATO:0001542.label: delayed phase
PATO:0001542.definition: A phase which starts later than natural start point.

PATO:0001543.label: flexibility
PATO:0001543.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being turned, bowed, or twisted without breaking.

PATO:0001544.label: flexible
PATO:0001544.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability of being turned, bowed, or twisted without breaking.

PATO:0001545.label: inflexible
PATO:0001545.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's inability of being turned, bowed, or twisted without breaking.

PATO:0001546.label: quality of a solid
PATO:0001546.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting the physical characteristics of an entity characterized by particles arranged such that their shape and volume are relatively stable.

PATO:0001547.label: quality of a gas
PATO:0001547.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting the physical characteristics of an entity consisting of particles that have neither a defined volume nor defined shape.

PATO:0001548.label: quality of a liquid
PATO:0001548.definition: A physical quality inhering in an entity exhibiting the physical characteristics of an amorphous (non-crystalline) form of matter between a gas and a solid that has a definite volume, but no definite shape.

PATO:0001549.label: increased sensitivity toward
PATO:0001549.definition: A sensitivity toward an external stimulus which is higher than normal/average.

PATO:0001550.label: decreased sensitivity toward
PATO:0001550.definition: A sensitivity toward an external stimulus which is lower than normal/average.

PATO:0001551.label: increased sensitivity of a process
PATO:0001551.definition: A sensitivity of a process which is higher than normal or average.
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0001552 ! decreased sensitivity of a process

PATO:0001552.label: decreased sensitivity of a process
PATO:0001552.definition: A sensitivity of a process which is lower than normal or average.
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0001551 ! increased sensitivity of a process

PATO:0001553.label: increased sensitivity of a process to oxygen
PATO:0001553.definition: A sensitivity of occurrent to oxygen which is higher than normal or average.

synonyms.label: high sensitivity of occurrent to oxygen

relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0001554 ! decreased sensitivity of a process to oxygen

PATO:0001554.label: decreased sensitivity of a process to oxygen
PATO:0001554.definition: A sensitivity of a process to oxygen which is lower than normal or average.

synonyms.label: low sensitivity of occurrent to oxygen

relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0001553 ! increased sensitivity of a process to oxygen

PATO:0001555.label: has number of
PATO:0001555.definition: The number of parts of a particular type that the bearer entity has. This is a relational quality, and thus holds between two entities: the bearer of the quality, and the type of parts.

synonyms.label: extra or missing physical or functional parts
has or lacks parts of type

PATO:0001558.label: lacking processual parts
PATO:0001558.definition: A quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking a processual part as specified by the additional entity.

PATO:0001559.label: having extra function
PATO:0001559.definition: A functionality quality which is held by the bearer when the latter is able to perform additional or different function(s).

PATO:0001561.label: having extra processual parts
PATO:0001561.definition: A quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having additional processual parts.

PATO:0001562.label: decreased mass
PATO:0001562.definition: A mass which is lower than normal or average.

PATO:0001563.label: increased mass
PATO:0001563.definition: A mass which is higher than normal or average.

PATO:0001564.label: extra or missing processual parts
PATO:0001564.definition: A quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's processual parts.

PATO:0001566.label: distributed
PATO:0001566.definition: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being spread out or scattered about or divided up.

PATO:0001567.label: undistributed
PATO:0001567.definition: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not being spread out or scattered about or divided up.

PATO:0001570.label: having decreased processual parts
PATO:0001570.definition: A quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having fewer processual parts.

PATO:0001571.label: dilated
PATO:0001571.definition: A size quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being made wider or larger in all dimensions.

PATO:0001573.label: isometrical
PATO:0001573.definition: A symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having equal dimensions or measurements.

PATO:0001574.label: flow rate
PATO:0001574.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's motion characteristic.

PATO:0001575.label: decreased pressure
PATO:0001575.definition: A pressure which is relatively low.

PATO:0001576.label: increased pressure
PATO:0001576.definition: A pressure which is relatively high.

PATO:0001577.label: increased permeability
PATO:0001577.definition: A permeability which is relatively high.

PATO:0001578.label: decreased permeability
PATO:0001578.definition: A permeability which is relatively low.

PATO:0001579.label: contractility
PATO:0001579.definition: A physical quality that is the ability to contract or shrink.

PATO:0001580.label: increased contractility
PATO:0001580.definition: A contractility which is relatively high.

PATO:0001581.label: decreased contractility
PATO:0001581.definition: A contractility which is relatively low.

PATO:0001582.label: obsolete relaxational quality
PATO:0001582.definition: A spatial quality inhering in an inactive muscle or muscle fibers by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting gradual lengthening.

PATO:0001583.label: decreased variability
PATO:0001583.definition: A variability which is relatively low.

PATO:0001584.label: increased variability
PATO:0001584.definition: A variability which is relatively high.

PATO:0001585.label: conductivity
PATO:0001585.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to transmit of an entity through a medium.

PATO:0001586.label: variability of rate
PATO:0001586.definition: A variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits rate variation or change.

PATO:0001587.label: increased variability of rate
PATO:0001587.definition: A variability of rate which is relatively high.
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0001588 ! decreased variability of rate

PATO:0001588.label: decreased variability of rate
PATO:0001588.definition: A variability of rate which is relatively low.
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0001587 ! increased variability of rate

PATO:0001590.label: overlap with
PATO:0001590.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's coinciding spatially, partially or wholly with another entity.

PATO:0001591.label: curvature
PATO:0001591.definition: A surface shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a degree of bending.

PATO:0001592.label: increased curvature
PATO:0001592.definition: A curvature which is relatively high.

PATO:0001593.label: decreased curvature
PATO:0001593.definition: A curvature which is relatively low.

PATO:0001594.label: arched
PATO:0001594.definition: A concave quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's forming or resembling an arch.

PATO:0001595.label: depth
PATO:0001595.definition: A 1-D extent quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's downward or backward or inward dimension.

PATO:0001596.label: increased depth
PATO:0001596.definition: A depth quality which is relatively high.

PATO:0001597.label: everted
PATO:0001597.definition: An oriented quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being turned outward in placement.

PATO:0001598.label: protruding
PATO:0001598.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's extending out above or beyond a surface or boundary.

PATO:0001599.label: rotated
PATO:0001599.definition: An oriented quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being relocated around an axis.

PATO:0001600.label: posteriorly rotated
PATO:0001600.definition: A rotation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of being rotated towards the rear of organism.

PATO:0001601.label: anteriorly rotated
PATO:0001601.definition: A rotation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of being rotated towards the front of an organism.

PATO:0001602.label: distended
PATO:0001602.definition: A size quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being abnormally expanded or increased in size.

PATO:0001603.label: increased life span
PATO:0001603.definition: A life span which is relatively high.

PATO:0001604.label: decreased life span
PATO:0001604.definition: A life span which is relatively low.

PATO:0001605.label: disheveled
PATO:0001605.definition: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being in disarray; extremely disorderly.

PATO:0001606.label: greasy
PATO:0001606.definition: A coating which is oily and slippery.

PATO:0001607.label: matted
PATO:0001607.definition: A tangled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being not possible to unravel.

PATO:0001608.label: patchy
PATO:0001608.definition: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by, consisting of, or diversified with patches.

PATO:0001609.label: sparse
PATO:0001609.definition: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being scattered; spread irregularly, and at a distance from each other.

PATO:0001611.label: variability of color
PATO:0001611.definition: A variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits color variation or change.

PATO:0001612.label: increased variability of color
PATO:0001612.definition: A variability of color which is relatively high.
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0001613 ! decreased variability of color

PATO:0001613.label: decreased variability of color
PATO:0001613.definition: A variability of color which is relatively low.
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0001612 ! increased variability of color

PATO:0001614.label: invariant color
PATO:0001614.definition: A variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking or not exhibiting variation of color.

PATO:0001615.label: variant color
PATO:0001615.definition: A variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or exhibiting variation of colour.

PATO:0001617.label: deformed
PATO:0001617.definition: A morphological quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being distorted in form.

PATO:0001618.label: increased tonicity
PATO:0001618.definition: A tonicity which is relatively high.

PATO:0001619.label: decreased tonicity
PATO:0001619.definition: A tonicity which is relatively low.

PATO:0001620.label: turgor
PATO:0001620.definition: A structural quality inhering in a cell or blood vessel or capillary by virtue of the bearer's being in a rigid state of fullness resulting from pressure of the contents against the wall or membrane.

PATO:0001621.label: decreased turgor
PATO:0001621.definition: A turgor which is relatively low.

PATO:0001622.label: increased turgor
PATO:0001622.definition: A turgor which is relatively high.

PATO:0001623.label: atrophied
PATO:0001623.definition: A size quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of a part or parts of the bearer's being decreased in size due to reduction in tissue mass through wasting.

PATO:0001624.label: decreased functionality
PATO:0001624.definition: A functionality quality held by the bearer when the latter exhibits decreased ability to perform a regular function(s).

PATO:0001625.label: increased functionality
PATO:0001625.definition: A functional quality held by the bearer when the latter exhibits increased ability to perform a regular function(s).

PATO:0001626.label: sufficiency
PATO:0001626.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer has enough functionality.

PATO:0001627.label: sufficient
PATO:0001627.definition: A wholeness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's has enough functionality.

PATO:0001628.label: insufficient
PATO:0001628.definition: A wholeness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacks enough functionality.

PATO:0001629.label: aggregated
PATO:0001629.definition: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being gathered or tending to gather into a mass or whole.

PATO:0001630.label: dispersed
PATO:0001630.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being distributed or spread over a considerable extent.

PATO:0001632.label: anterior to
PATO:0001632.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the front of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001633.label: posterior to
PATO:0001633.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the rear of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001845.definition: A rhythm quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking rhythm lacking pattern.

PATO:0001846.label: tangled
PATO:0001846.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being entwined and difficult to unravel.

PATO:0001847.label: constricted
PATO:0001847.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being drawn together, compressed or squeezed physically.

PATO:0001848.label: asymmetrically curved
PATO:0001848.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved asymmetrically.

PATO:0001849.label: abrased
PATO:0001849.definition: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of a portion of the bearer's surface being scraped away.

PATO:0001850.label: scarred
PATO:0001850.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being fibrous tissue that replaces normal tissue destroyed by injury or disease.

PATO:0001851.label: swollen
PATO:0001851.definition: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting transient abnormal enlargement, not due to cell proliferation.

PATO:0001852.label: dislocated
PATO:0001852.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being out of its usual or proper place, or position due to it being physically moved from the normal location.

PATO:0001853.label: hydrocephalic
PATO:0001853.definition: A structural quality which is held by a bearer when the latter exhibits an excessive accumulation of cerebral spinal fluid.

PATO:0001854.label: vertical
PATO:0001854.definition: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being situated at right angles to the horizon.

PATO:0001855.label: horizontal
PATO:0001855.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being in the plane of the horizon.

PATO:0001856.label: introverted
PATO:0001856.definition: An oriented quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being turned inward upon itself.

PATO:0001857.label: concave
PATO:0001857.definition: A shape quality in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's curving inward.

PATO:0001858.label: partially paralysed
PATO:0001858.definition: A functionality quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of being not completely paralysed.

PATO:0001859.label: increased coordination
PATO:0001859.definition: A coordination which is relatively high.

PATO:0001860.label: decreased coordination
PATO:0001860.definition: A coordination which is relatively low.

PATO:0001861.label: fasciculated
PATO:0001861.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's forming a bundle of aligned anatomical fibers, as of muscle or nerve.

PATO:0001862.label: lack of fertility in offspring
PATO:0001862.definition: A fertility quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to make its offspring sterile.

PATO:0001863.label: chronic
PATO:0001863.definition: A duration quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having slow progressive course of indefinite duration.

PATO:0001865.label: spheroid
PATO:0001865.definition: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a quadric surface in three dimensions obtained by rotating an ellipse about one of its principal axes. Includes spheres and oblate/prolate spheroids.

PATO:0001866.label: prolate
PATO:0001866.definition: A spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a polar diameter longer than its equatorial diameter.

PATO:0001867.label: rectangular
PATO:0001867.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of it being a quadrilateral polygon in which all four angles are right angles.

PATO:0001868.label: autofluorescence
PATO:0001868.definition: A fluorescence quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting fluorescence which is self-induced.

PATO:0001869.label: pathological
PATO:0001869.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being abnormal and having a destructive effect on living tissue.

PATO:0001870.label: crescent-shaped
PATO:0001870.definition: A shape quality inhering in a circular disk by virtue of the bearer's having a segment of another circle removed from its edge, so that what remains is a shape enclosed by two circular arcs of different diameters which intersect at two points (usually in such a manner that the enclosed shape does not include the center of the original circle).

PATO:0001871.label: reniform
PATO:0001871.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having the shape of a kidney.

PATO:0001872.label: cuboid
PATO:0001872.definition: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resemblance to a cube (a 3-D shape with a square cross section).
relationships: RO:0015011 PATO:0000413 ! has cross section square

PATO:0001873.label: cylindrical
PATO:0001873.definition: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a consistently-sized round cross section.
relationships: RO:0015011 PATO:0000411 ! has cross section circular

PATO:0001874.label: discoid
PATO:0001874.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being cylindrical, in which the height is less than the diameter.

PATO:0001875.label: triangular
PATO:0001875.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having three angles.

PATO:0001876.label: dumbbell-shaped
PATO:0001876.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two parts, roughly spherical and of equal size, connected by a bar.

PATO:0001877.label: lanceolate
PATO:0001877.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a lance-head, considerably longer than wide, tapering towards the tip from below the middle; attached at the broad end.

PATO:0001878.label: sigmoid
PATO:0001878.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of two curves, in opposite directions. S-shaped.

PATO:0001879.label: U-shaped
PATO:0001879.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped in the form of the letter U.

PATO:0001880.label: caudate
PATO:0001880.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a tail or tail-like projection.

PATO:0001881.label: arrow-shaped
PATO:0001881.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's forming two equal obtuse triangles with a short side in common.

PATO:0001882.label: limaciform
PATO:0001882.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a slug.

PATO:0001883.label: clavate
PATO:0001883.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gradually becoming thicker towards the end.

PATO:0001884.label: hydrophobicity
PATO:0001884.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue the bearer's disposition to being water-repellent; tending to repel and not absorb water.

PATO:0001885.label: hydrophobic
PATO:0001885.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking affinity for water; tending to repel and not absorb water; tending not to dissolve in or mix with or be wetted by water.

PATO:0001886.label: hydrophilicity
PATO:0001886.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue the bearer's disposition to having an affinity for water; it is readily absorbing or dissolving in water.

PATO:0001887.label: hydrophilic
PATO:0001887.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to having a strong affinity for water; tending to dissolve in, mix with, or be wetted by water.

PATO:0001888.label: miscibility
PATO:0001888.definition: A quality of a liquid inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to mix with (dissolve in) another liquid.

PATO:0001889.label: scalloped
PATO:0001889.definition: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having the border, edge, or outline cut into a series of segments of circles resembling a scallop-shell.

PATO:0001890.label: tripartite
PATO:0001890.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being divided into three branches.

PATO:0001891.label: ovate
PATO:0001891.definition: A spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a continuous convex surface with an axis of symmetry and one axis longer than the other; egg-shaped.
relationships: RO:0015011 PATO:0000946 ! has cross section oblong

PATO:0001892.label: decreased odor
PATO:0001892.definition: An odor quality of having decreased odor.

PATO:0001893.label: increased odor
PATO:0001893.definition: An odor quality of having increased odor.

PATO:0001894.label: phenotypic sex
PATO:0001894.definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's physical expression of sexual characteristics.

PATO:0001895.label: mating type
PATO:0001895.definition: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population that undergo sexual reproduction.

PATO:0001896.label: unlumenized
PATO:0001896.definition: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking of a three dimensional space surrounded by one or more anatomical structures and containing one or more anatomical substances.

PATO:0001897.label: lumenized
PATO:0001897.definition: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a three dimensional space surrounded by one or more anatomical structures and containing one or more anatomical substances.

PATO:0001898.label: increased circumference
PATO:0001898.definition: A circumference which is relatively high.

PATO:0001899.label: decreased circumference
PATO:0001899.definition: A circumference which is relatively low.

PATO:0001900.label: front
PATO:0001900.definition: A directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's direction that is similar to the direction of an object to the south when it faces north.

PATO:0001901.label: back
PATO:0001901.definition: A directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's direction that is similar to the direction of an object to the north when it faces south.

PATO:0001902.label: unidirectional
PATO:0001902.definition: A directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having one direction only.

PATO:0001903.label: bi-directional
PATO:0001903.definition: A directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two directions.

PATO:0001904.label: circling direction
PATO:0001904.definition: A directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's direction approximating the shape of a circle.

PATO:0001905.label: has normal numbers of parts of type
PATO:0001905.definition: The bearer of this quality has_part = n, where n is the normal amount for a comparable organism. Note that the bearer of the quality is the whole, not the part.
relationships: RO:0015012 PATO:0002050 ! reciprocal of normal amount

PATO:0001906.label: movement quality
PATO:0001906.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's participation in movement.

PATO:0001907.label: botryoidal
PATO:0001907.definition: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being like the surface of a compact mass of grapes.

PATO:0001908.label: multinucleate
PATO:0001908.definition: A nucleate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having more than one nucleus.

PATO:0001909.label: trinucleate
PATO:0001909.definition: A nucleate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having three nuclei.

PATO:0001910.label: folded
PATO:0001910.definition: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's one part being layered over another connected part.

PATO:0001911.label: circling
PATO:0001911.definition: A behavioral quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting movement in a circular course.

PATO:0001912.label: physiological state
PATO:0001912.definition: A quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the state of bearer's mechanical, physical, and biochemical processes.

PATO:0001913.label: ictal
PATO:0001913.definition: A physiological state which is characterized by periods of high-frequency high amplitude electrical activity in neuronal tissue.

PATO:0001914.label: non-ictal
PATO:0001914.definition: A physiological state which is characterized by normal electrical activity in neuronal tissue.

PATO:0001915.label: anterodorsal to
PATO:0001915.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the front and upper surface of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001916.label: posterodorsal to
PATO:0001916.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the rear and upper surface of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001917.label: anteroventral to
PATO:0001917.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the front and abdomen of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001918.label: posteroventral to
PATO:0001918.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the rear and abdomen of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001919.label: mislocalised dorsally
PATO:0001919.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the back or upper surface of an organism.

PATO:0001920.label: mislocalised ventrally
PATO:0001920.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the abdomen of an organism.

PATO:0001921.label: mislocalised anteriorly
PATO:0001921.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the front of an organism.

PATO:0001922.label: mislocalised posteriorly
PATO:0001922.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the rear of an organism.

PATO:0001923.label: mislocalised laterally
PATO:0001923.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the side of an organism.

PATO:0001924.label: mislocalised medially
PATO:0001924.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the middle of an organism.

PATO:0001925.label: surface feature shape
PATO:0001925.definition: A surface shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape of features present on its surface or outer shell.

PATO:0001926.label: increased fluorescence
PATO:0001926.definition: A fluorescence which is higher than normal.

PATO:0001927.label: decreased fluorescence
PATO:0001927.definition: A fluorescence which is lower than normal.

PATO:0001928.label: blistered
PATO:0001928.definition: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of a local accumulation of fluid underneath the surface of the bearer.

PATO:0001929.label: variability of shape
PATO:0001929.definition: A variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits shape variation or change.

PATO:0001930.label: variant shape
PATO:0001930.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue the bearer's having or exhibiting variation its shape.

PATO:0001931.label: invariant shape
PATO:0001931.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking or not exhibiting variation of shape.

PATO:0001932.label: alternate placement
PATO:0001932.definition: A pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being placed alternately one above the other.

PATO:0001933.label: opposite
PATO:0001933.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned on opposite sides on the same plane.

PATO:0001934.label: orbicular
PATO:0001934.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being perfectly circular.

PATO:0001935.label: obtuse
PATO:0001935.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being roundish, a little inclining to be oblong.

PATO:0001936.label: obovate
PATO:0001936.definition: A spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being egg-shaped and flat, with the narrow end attached to the base.

PATO:0001937.label: spatulate
PATO:0001937.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being oblong, with the lower end very much attenuated.

PATO:0001938.label: rhomboid
PATO:0001938.definition: A spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being oval and a little angular in the middle.

PATO:0001940.label: gigantic
PATO:0001940.definition: A size quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being many folds greater relative to the normal average.

PATO:0001941.label: yellow green
PATO:0001941.definition: A color whose Munsell coordinates fall within the continuous ISCC-NBS yellow-green sector represented by color-name blocks 115 through 122; moderate yellow green (block 120, centroid 5.0GY 6.0/5.2) is a central prototype.

PATO:0001942.label: brown green
PATO:0001942.definition: A color consisting of brown and green hues.

PATO:0001943.label: lilac
PATO:0001943.definition: A purple color which has low saturation and low brightness.

PATO:0001944.label: yellow orange
PATO:0001944.definition: A color consisting of yellow and orange hue.

PATO:0001945.label: ochre
PATO:0001945.definition: A moderate yellow-orange to orange color.

PATO:0001946.label: banded
PATO:0001946.definition: A color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's exhibiting transverse stripes of one hue or degree of saturation crossing another.

PATO:0001947.label: netted
PATO:0001947.definition: A color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's being covered with reticulated lines of a different hue or degree of saturation.

PATO:0001948.label: furrowed
PATO:0001948.definition: A grooved texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by two or more parallel channels.

PATO:0001949.label: pointleted
PATO:0001949.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's terminating abruptly in a little point.

PATO:0001950.label: blunt
PATO:0001950.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's terminating gradually in a rounded end.

PATO:0001951.label: whorled
PATO:0001951.definition: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being in opposition round a common axis.

PATO:0001952.label: distichous
PATO:0001952.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being arranged in two opposite rows (and hence in the same plane).

PATO:0001953.label: decussate
PATO:0001953.definition: A pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of paired parts that alternately cross each other.

PATO:0001954.label: subulate
PATO:0001954.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being linear, very narrow, tapering to a very fine point from a narrow base.

PATO:0001955.label: cuneate
PATO:0001955.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being narrowly triangular, wider at the apex and tapering toward the base.

PATO:0001956.label: variability of size
PATO:0001956.definition: A variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits size variation or change.

PATO:0001957.label: decreased variability of size
PATO:0001957.definition: A variability of size which is relatively low.
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0001958 ! increased variability of size

PATO:0001958.label: increased variability of size
PATO:0001958.definition: A variability of size which is relatively high.
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0001957 ! decreased variability of size

PATO:0001959.label: defasciculated
PATO:0001959.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's in which bundles of aligned anatomical fibers have become separated.

PATO:0001960.label: interdigitated
PATO:0001960.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's parts or projections being interlocked; for example, the fingers of two hands that are clasped.

PATO:0001961.label: in contact with
PATO:0001961.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's touching another entity.

PATO:0001962.label: involute
PATO:0001962.definition: A curled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's edges of its surface being rolled inwards spirally on each side.

PATO:0001963.label: revolute
PATO:0001963.definition: A curled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's edges of its surface being rolled backwards spirally on each side.

PATO:0001964.label: circinate
PATO:0001964.definition: A curled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's edges of its surface being rolled spirally downwards.

PATO:0001965.label: reclinate
PATO:0001965.definition: A curled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's edges of its surface being bent down upon their stalk.

PATO:0001966.label: convolute
PATO:0001966.definition: A curled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's one edge of its surface being wholly rolled up in another.

PATO:0001967.label: actinodromous
PATO:0001967.definition: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having three or more primary branches diverging radially from a single point.

PATO:0001968.label: parallelodromous
PATO:0001968.definition: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two or more parallel primary branches originate beside each other and converge apically.

PATO:0001969.label: craspedodromous
PATO:0001969.definition: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having secondary branches terminating at the margin.

PATO:0001970.label: brochidodromous
PATO:0001970.definition: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having secondary branches joined together in a series of prominent arches.

PATO:0001971.label: cladodromous
PATO:0001971.definition: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having secondary branches freely branching toward the margin.

PATO:0001972.label: reticulodromous
PATO:0001972.definition: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having secondary branches branching into a reticulum toward the margin.

PATO:0001973.label: cuspidate
PATO:0001973.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being tapering gradually into a rigid point.

PATO:0001974.label: retuse
PATO:0001974.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's terminating in a round end, the centre of which is depressed.

PATO:0001975.label: unserrated
