PATO:0001975.definition: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking sharp straight-edged teeth pointing to the apex.

PATO:0001976.label: serration
PATO:0001976.definition: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or lacking sharp straight-edged teeth pointing to the apex.

PATO:0001977.label: angular
PATO:0001977.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having at least one salient angle on the margin.

PATO:0001978.label: cut
PATO:0001978.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being regularly divided by deep incisions.

PATO:0001979.label: lobed
PATO:0001979.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being partly divided into a determinate number of regions.

PATO:0001980.label: digitate
PATO:0001980.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having distinct parts arising from a common point or center.

PATO:0001981.label: auriculate
PATO:0001981.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape resembling an ear.

PATO:0001982.label: attenuate
PATO:0001982.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gradually tapering to a slender point.

PATO:0001983.label: perfoliate
PATO:0001983.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's two basal lobes being united together.

PATO:0001984.label: decurrent
PATO:0001984.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being prolonged below the point of insertion.

PATO:0001985.label: frozen
PATO:0001985.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being kept below its freezing point.

PATO:0001986.label: dissolved
PATO:0001986.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's passing into solution.

PATO:0001987.label: saccular
PATO:0001987.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a three dimensional cavity with a narrow or no opening, and often containing an anatomical substance.

PATO:0001988.label: quadrangular
PATO:0001988.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having four angles and four sides.

PATO:0001989.label: sinuous
PATO:0001989.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having many curves and turns.

PATO:0001990.label: duration of disease
PATO:0001990.definition: A duration quality of a process inhering in a disease by virtue of the bearer's duration of an impairment of health or of a condition of abnormal functioning.

PATO:0001991.label: immortal
PATO:0001991.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being capable of indefinite growth or division.

PATO:0001992.label: cellularity
PATO:0001992.definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting cells.

PATO:0001993.label: multicellular
PATO:0001993.definition: A cellularity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of more than one cell.

PATO:0001994.label: unicellular
PATO:0001994.definition: A cellularity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of exactly one cell.

PATO:0001995.label: organismal quality
PATO:0001995.definition: A quality that inheres in an entire organism or part of an organism.

PATO:0001997.label: decreased amount
PATO:0001997.definition: An amount which is relatively low.

synonyms.label: present in fewer numbers in organism

PATO:0001998.label: conspicuousness
PATO:0001998.definition: A characteristic inhering in a bearer by virtue of its visibility.

PATO:0001999.label: lacks parts or has fewer parts of type
PATO:0001999.definition: The bearer of this quality has_part < n of the indicated entity type, where n is the normal amount for a comparable organism. Note that the bearer of the quality is the whole, not the part. Formally: If a bearer entity e has fewer parts of type X at time t, then the number of instances x of X at t such that x part_of e is < n, where n is either the normal number for comparable entities, or n is stated explicitly. This case includes the limit case, where the bearer lacks all parts of the specified type.

PATO:0002000.label: lacks all parts of type
PATO:0002000.definition: A quality of physical entities inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking a physical part as specified by the additional entity.

synonyms.label: lacks all physical parts of type

PATO:0002001.label: has fewer parts of type
PATO:0002001.definition: The bearer of this quality has_part < n AND has_part > 0 of the indicated entity type, where n is the normal amount for a comparable organism. Note that the bearer of the quality is the whole, not the part. Formally: If a bearer entity e has fewer parts of type X at time t, then the number of instances x of X at t such that x part_of e is < n, where n is either the normal number for comparable entities, or n is stated explicitly.

synonyms.label: has fewer physical parts of type

relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0002002 ! has extra parts of type

PATO:0002002.label: has extra parts of type
PATO:0002002.definition: The bearer of this quality has_part > n of the indicated entity type, where n is the normal amount for a comparable organism. Note that the bearer of the quality is the whole, not the part.
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0002001 ! has fewer parts of type

PATO:0002003.label: population quality
PATO:0002003.definition: A quality that inheres in an entire population or part of a population.

PATO:0002004.label: obsolete surface shape
PATO:0002004.definition: A shape that inheres in a part of a surface. An object can have different surface shapes on different parts of its surface.

PATO:0002005.label: concavity
PATO:0002005.definition: Surface shape that refers to the inward or outward curvature of the surface.

PATO:0002006.label: 2-D shape
PATO:0002006.definition: A shape that inheres in a 2 dimensional entity, such as a cross section or projection of a 3 dimensional entity.

PATO:0002007.label: convex 3-D shape
PATO:0002007.definition: A complete three dimensional shape in which for every line connecting pair of points on the object is within the object. Or: a shape lacking cavities. Contrast: concave.
relationships: RO:0015011 PATO:0002006 ! has cross section 2-D shape

PATO:0002008.label: concave 3-D shape
PATO:0002008.definition: A complete three dimensional shape in which there is a line connecting pair of points on the object that lies outside the object. Or: a shape with cavities. Contrast: concave.

PATO:0002009.label: branchiness
PATO:0002009.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the degree to which there are subdivisions or offshoots in a bearer entity.

PATO:0002010.label: looseness
PATO:0002010.definition: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's bing full of small openings or gaps.

PATO:0002011.label: neoplastic
PATO:0002011.definition: A structural quality which is held by a bearer when the latter's disposition the presence of abnormally proliferating masses of cells.

PATO:0002012.label: coating
PATO:0002012.definition: A texture quality that exists through a liquid cover on the surface of the bearer.

PATO:0002013.label: fasciculation
PATO:0002013.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer forms a bundle of anatomical fibers, as of muscle or nerve.

PATO:0002014.label: structure, cavities
PATO:0002014.definition: A structural quality that inheres in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing hollow areas.

PATO:0002019.label: aplastic growth
PATO:0002019.definition: A growth quality of occurrent in which the growth of an organism, structure or group of organisms does not occur.

PATO:0002020.label: pale pink
PATO:0002020.definition: Pink color having high brightness and low saturation.

PATO:0002021.label: conical
PATO:0002021.definition: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a cone (a 3-D shape with a round cross section that tapers).

PATO:0002022.label: villiform
PATO:0002022.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a minute projection (villus).

PATO:0002023.label: apical-basal polarity
PATO:0002023.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's location of features or characteristics along an apical-basal axis.

PATO:0002024.label: anterior-posterior polarity
PATO:0002024.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's location of features or characteristics along the anterior-posterior axis.

PATO:0002025.label: external angle
PATO:0002025.definition: A convex angle that is formed by one side of a polygon and a line extended from an adjacent side.

PATO:0002026.label: non-progressive
PATO:0002026.definition: A quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not increasing over time.

PATO:0002027.label: osmolality
PATO:0002027.definition: A concentration quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's amount of osmoles of solute per kilogram of solvent.

PATO:0002028.label: decreased osmolality
PATO:0002028.definition: An osmolality which is relatively low.

PATO:0002029.label: increased osmolality
PATO:0002029.definition: An osmolality which is relatively high.

PATO:0002030.label: specificity to
PATO:0002030.definition: A molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits the ability of a probe to react precisely with a specific target molecule.

PATO:0002031.label: upturned
PATO:0002031.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved or tilted such that the tip points upwards.

PATO:0002032.label: forward scatter
PATO:0002032.definition: A reflectivity quality inhering in light by virtue of the bearer's scattering occurring at small angle to the incident beam.

PATO:0002033.label: side scatter
PATO:0002033.definition: A reflective quality that is the light scattering occurring at wide angle (around 90 degrees) to the incident beam.

PATO:0002034.label: undivided
PATO:0002034.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being unseparated into parts or divisions.

PATO:0002035.label: ipsilateral to
PATO:0002035.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being on the same side in relation to another structure.

PATO:0002036.label: axial to
PATO:0002036.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located towards the central axis of the organism or an extremity.

PATO:0002037.label: degeneration
PATO:0002037.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer exhibiting deterioration of its structure.

PATO:0002038.label: non-degenerate
PATO:0002038.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer whose structure which does not deteriorate.

PATO:0002039.label: biconcave
PATO:0002039.definition: A concave quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's curving inward on both sides or surfaces.

PATO:0002040.label: biconvex
PATO:0002040.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being convex on both sides or surface.

PATO:0002041.label: anterior-posterior diameter
PATO:0002041.definition: A diameter that is along the anterior-posterior axis.

PATO:0002042.label: decreased anterior-posterior diameter
PATO:0002042.definition: An anterior-posterior diameter quality which is relatively small.

PATO:0002043.label: increased anterior-posterior diameter
PATO:0002043.definition: An anterior-posterior diameter quality which is relatively large.

PATO:0002044.label: trapezoid
PATO:0002044.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being a quadrilateral with two parallel sides.

PATO:0002045.label: dendritic
PATO:0002045.definition: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having smaller branches arising from larger branches. Resembling a tree in branching structure.

PATO:0002046.label: abaxial to
PATO:0002046.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being away from or on the opposite side of the central axis.

PATO:0002047.label: adaxial to
PATO:0002047.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located on the side nearest to the axis of an organ or organism.

PATO:0002048.label: mosaicism
PATO:0002048.definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two or more cell populations that differ in genetic makeup. This situation can affect any type of cell, including blood cells, gametes (egg and sperm cells), and skin.

PATO:0002049.label: lateral and rotional curvature
PATO:0002049.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved around an axis and towards the side.

PATO:0002050.label: normal amount

synonyms.label: present in normal numbers in organism

relationships: RO:0015012 PATO:0001905 ! reciprocal of has normal numbers of parts of type

PATO:0002051.label: increased occurrence
PATO:0002051.definition: An occurrence which is relatively high.

PATO:0002052.label: decreased occurrence
PATO:0002052.definition: An occurrence which is relatively low.

PATO:0002053.label: dorso-ventrally flattened
PATO:0002053.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being flattened along dorso-ventral axis.

PATO:0002054.label: laterally compressed
PATO:0002054.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being flattened along transverse axis.

PATO:0002055.label: increased fragility
PATO:0002055.definition: A fragility which is relatively high.

PATO:0002056.label: decreased fragility
PATO:0002056.definition: A fragility which is relatively low.

PATO:0002057.label: increased area
PATO:0002057.definition: An area which is relatively high.

PATO:0002058.label: decreased area
PATO:0002058.definition: An area which is relatively low.

PATO:0002059.label: emmision wavelength
PATO:0002059.definition: The specific wavelength of light emitted by a fluorescent molecule, such as a labelled probe, upon absorption of light at the (higher) excitation wavelength.

PATO:0002060.label: absorption wavelength
PATO:0002060.definition: The specific wavelength of radiation that can be retained by a bearer.

PATO:0002063.label: columnar
PATO:0002063.definition: A shape inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being elongated and cylindrical.

PATO:0002064.label: fenestrated
PATO:0002064.definition: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's delimited by a surface with holes.

PATO:0002065.label: star shaped
PATO:0002065.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being arranged like rays or radii; radiating from a common center.

PATO:0002066.label: crystal configuration
PATO:0002066.definition: A solid configuration inhering in a material entity by virtue of its constituent atoms, molecules, or ions being arranged in an orderly repeating pattern extending in all three spatial dimensions.

PATO:0002067.label: stratification
PATO:0002067.definition: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's layered configuration.

PATO:0002068.label: stratified
PATO:0002068.definition: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a layered configuration.

PATO:0002069.label: unstratified
PATO:0002069.definition: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking a layered configuration.

PATO:0002070.label: affinity
PATO:0002070.definition: A molecular quality that arises from the molecular attraction exerted between two atoms or compounds.

PATO:0002071.label: increased affinity
PATO:0002071.definition: An affinity which is relatively high.

PATO:0002072.label: decreased affinity
PATO:0002072.definition: An affinity which is relatively low.

PATO:0002073.label: avidity
PATO:0002073.definition: A molecular quality that arises from the synergistic strength of bond affinities between multiple bond interactions.

PATO:0002074.label: increased avidity
PATO:0002074.definition: An avidity which is relatively high.

PATO:0002075.label: decreased avidity
PATO:0002075.definition: An avidity which is relatively low.

PATO:0002076.label: movement behavioral quality
PATO:0002076.definition: A behavioral quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's movement.

PATO:0002077.label: stacked
PATO:0002077.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned with multiple entities of the same type above and below.

PATO:0002078.label: hollow
PATO:0002078.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an empty space or cavity within.

PATO:0002080.label: broken into two pieces
PATO:0002080.definition: A broken quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being separated into two contiguous wholes.

PATO:0002081.label: shattered
PATO:0002081.definition: A broken quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being broken into multiple contiguous wholes.

PATO:0002082.label: partially broken
PATO:0002082.definition: A broken quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being still one contiguous whole but structurally damaged such that in danger of become two or more.

PATO:0002084.label: obsolete post-mortem
PATO:0002084.definition: The period after death of the organism.

PATO:0002085.label: obsolete pre-mortem
PATO:0002085.definition: The period before death of the organism.

PATO:0002087.label: bullet-shaped
PATO:0002087.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being short and wide and tapered distally.

PATO:0002088.label: monocystic
PATO:0002088.definition: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's body containing one cyst - a formation of a sac-like closed membranous structure not associated with neoplasia.

PATO:0002089.label: polycystic
PATO:0002089.definition: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's body containing more than one cyst - formations of sac-like closed membranous structures not associated with neoplasia.

PATO:0002090.label: adenomatous
PATO:0002090.definition: A morphology quality inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting the morphological characteristics of a glandular epithelial cell.

PATO:0002091.label: subacute
PATO:0002091.definition: A quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an onset and time course between acute and chronic.

PATO:0002092.label: anaplastic
PATO:0002092.definition: A morphology quality inhering in a neoplastic cell by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting breakdown of cell-cell interaction maintaining tissue architecture, proliferative dysregulation and bizarre modification to nucleus size and shape.

PATO:0002093.label: ballooning
PATO:0002093.definition: A volume quality inhering in a degenerating cell by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting an increase in volume associated with cytoplasmic abnormalities.

PATO:0002094.label: basophilic
PATO:0002094.definition: An affinity inhering in an anatomical structure by virtue of the bearer exhibiting a molecular interaction for basic dyes under specific pH conditions.

PATO:0002095.label: obsolete neoplasm disposition
PATO:0002095.definition: A disposition inhering in a tumour to progress or fail to progress during it's life time.

PATO:0002096.label: neoplastic, non-malignant
PATO:0002096.definition: A disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition not to progress, invade surrounding tissues or metastasize.

PATO:0002097.label: neoplastic, malignant
PATO:0002097.definition: A disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition to progress, invade surrounding tissues or metastasize.

PATO:0002098.label: neoplastic, metastatic
PATO:0002098.definition: A disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition to spread and invade distant tissues.

PATO:0002099.label: differentiated
PATO:0002099.definition: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its stable specialization to a particular cell type.

PATO:0002100.label: undifferentiated
PATO:0002100.definition: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of having not yet acquired a special structure of function.

PATO:0002101.label: metaplastic
PATO:0002101.definition: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of having changed from one fully differentiated state into another.

PATO:0002102.label: proliferative
PATO:0002102.definition: A cellular quality inhering in a cell that arises by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits the ability to grow and proliferate in number through cell division.

PATO:0002103.label: infiltrative
PATO:0002103.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's penetrating or permeating another substance or area.

PATO:0002104.label: inflamed
PATO:0002104.definition: A compositional quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's infiltration by leukocytes, local edema and accumulation of plasma proteins.

PATO:0002105.label: hemorrhagic
PATO:0002105.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting excessive discharge of blood from the blood vessels.

PATO:0002106.label: poorly differentiated
PATO:0002106.definition: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its lacking most of the cellular characteristics which would allow it to be fully differentiated.

PATO:0002107.label: peripheral
PATO:0002107.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being at the edge or boundary of a related entity.

PATO:0002108.label: papillary
PATO:0002108.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling small nipple like projection.

PATO:0002109.label: caseous
PATO:0002109.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling cheese.

PATO:0002110.label: well differentiated
PATO:0002110.definition: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its having most of the cellular characteristics of the tissue of origin.

PATO:0002111.label: moderately well differentiated
PATO:0002111.definition: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its lacking few of the cellular characteristics which would allow it to be fully differentiated.

PATO:0002112.label: perforate
PATO:0002112.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a hole or holes, especially a row or array of small holes.

PATO:0002114.label: fatty
PATO:0002114.definition: A composition quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing excess lipid.

PATO:0002115.label: fibrinoid
PATO:0002115.definition: A composition quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing fibrin.

PATO:0002116.label: fibrinopurulent
PATO:0002116.definition: A composition quality inhering in exudate by virtue of the bearer's containing fibrin.

PATO:0002117.label: glandular
PATO:0002117.definition: A morphology quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhbiting the morphological characteristics of a gland.

PATO:0002118.label: multiple
PATO:0002118.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being present in more than two copies.

PATO:0002119.label: hydropic
PATO:0002119.definition: A structural quality which is held by a bearer when the latter exhibits an excessive accumulation of intracellular fluid.

PATO:0002120.label: suppurative
PATO:0002120.definition: A quality inhering a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to generate pus.

PATO:0002121.label: trabecular
PATO:0002121.definition: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's structure resembling an irregular meshwork with cross-linking struts.

PATO:0002122.label: mixed
PATO:0002122.definition: A composition quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being composed of more than one identifiable entities.

PATO:0002123.label: minimal
PATO:0002123.definition: Being smallest in amount, extent or degree.

PATO:0002124.label: laminar
PATO:0002124.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's processing the form of a thin plate sheet or layer.

PATO:0002125.label: nodular
PATO:0002125.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting a knot-like mass.

PATO:0002126.label: osseous
PATO:0002126.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing bone.

PATO:0002127.label: scirrhous
PATO:0002127.definition: A hardness quality of being rigid and resistant to pressure and fibrous.

PATO:0002128.label: serous
PATO:0002128.definition: A quality inhering a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing or resembling serum.

PATO:0002129.label: neoplastic, invasive
PATO:0002129.definition: A disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition to invade surrounding tissues.

PATO:0002130.label: neoplastic, deeply invasive
PATO:0002130.definition: A disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition to invade surrounding tissues to a large extend.

PATO:0002131.label: abduction
PATO:0002131.definition: A displaced angular placement quality inhering in a body part by virtue of the bearer's movement away from the medial plane of the body.

PATO:0002132.label: neoplastic, non-invasive
PATO:0002132.definition: A disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition not to invade surrounding tissues.

PATO:0002133.label: adduction
PATO:0002133.definition: A displaced angular placement quality inhering in a body part by virtue of the bearer's movement closer the medial plane of the body.

PATO:0002134.label: fibrillary
PATO:0002134.definition: A composition quaity inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing of or pertaining to fibrils, or nanoscale fibers.

PATO:0002135.label: delayed closure
PATO:0002135.definition: A duration quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's delay to complete the closure of the opening of an anatomical entity.

PATO:0002136.label: radiopacity
PATO:0002136.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's relative inability of electromagnetism to pass through a particular material, particularly X-rays.

PATO:0002137.label: radiopaque
PATO:0002137.definition: A radiopacity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's prevention of the passage of electromagnetic radiation.

PATO:0002138.label: edibility
PATO:0002138.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being fit to be eaten.

PATO:0002139.label: edible
PATO:0002139.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being suitable for use as food.

PATO:0002140.label: inedible
PATO:0002140.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer not being suitable for use as food.

PATO:0002141.label: irregular density
PATO:0002141.definition: A density quality which lacks pattern.

PATO:0002144.label: increased radiopacity
PATO:0002144.definition: A radiopacity that is relatively high.

PATO:0002145.label: decreased radiopacity
PATO:0002145.definition: A radiopacity that is relatively low.

PATO:0002146.label: virulence
PATO:0002146.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the severity of infectious disease caused by the bearer in a target organism.

PATO:0002147.label: reduced virulence
PATO:0002147.definition: A virulence that is relatively low.

PATO:0002148.label: increased virulence
PATO:0002148.definition: A virulence that is relatively high.

PATO:0002149.label: ivory
PATO:0002149.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer exhibiting increased density resulting in exhibiting increased degree of radiopacity (in X-rays).

PATO:0002150.label: splayed caudal
PATO:0002150.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outwards from the part of the body from which the tail arises.

PATO:0002151.label: splayed dorsal
PATO:0002151.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outwards from the back or upper surface of an organism.

PATO:0002152.label: splayed lateral
PATO:0002152.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outwards from the side.

PATO:0002153.label: splayed rostral
PATO:0002153.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outwards the front of an organism.

PATO:0002154.label: splayed ventral
PATO:0002154.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outwards the abdomen of an organism.

PATO:0002155.label: medially rotated
PATO:0002155.definition: A rotation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of being rotated towards the middle of an organism.

PATO:0002156.label: laterally rotated
PATO:0002156.definition: A rotation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of being rotated towards the side of an organism.

PATO:0002157.label: partially dislocated
PATO:0002157.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being slightly out of its usual or proper place, or position.

PATO:0002161.label: bicornuate
PATO:0002161.definition: Having two horns or horn-shaped branches.

PATO:0002162.label: high-arched
PATO:0002162.definition: A concave quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's forming or resembling an arch of an increased apical height.

PATO:0002163.label: herniated into
PATO:0002163.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's bodily structure that has protruded through an abnormal opening in the wall that contains it into the surface or boundary of another entity.

PATO:0002164.label: curved medial
PATO:0002164.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the middle.

PATO:0002165.label: drooping
PATO:0002165.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's bending or hanging downwards.

PATO:0002166.label: premature closure
PATO:0002166.definition: A duration quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's premature completion of the closure of the opening of an anatomical entity.

PATO:0002167.label: herniated out of
PATO:0002167.definition: A protruding quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's bodily structure that has protruded out of the surface or boundary of another entity.

PATO:0002168.label: displaced to
PATO:0002168.definition: An angular placement quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being changed in position in relation to another entity.

PATO:0002169.label: split medially
PATO:0002169.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being split along the median axis.

PATO:0002170.label: split laterally
PATO:0002170.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being split asymmetrically on one side.

PATO:0002171.label: split bilaterally
PATO:0002171.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being split on two side.

PATO:0002172.label: split radially
PATO:0002172.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being split along the radial axis.

PATO:0002173.label: misaligned towards
PATO:0002173.definition: An alignment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being in a improper spatial positioning towards an additional entity.

PATO:0002174.label: misaligned away from
PATO:0002174.definition: An alignment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being in a improper spatial positioning away from an additional entity.

PATO:0002175.label: spatial deviation
PATO:0002175.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's changed direction of position towards another entity.

PATO:0002176.label: deviation towards the lateral side
PATO:0002176.definition: A deviation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's changed direction of position towards the side.

PATO:0002177.label: deviation towards the medial side
PATO:0002177.definition: A deviation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's changed direction of position towards the middle.

PATO:0002178.label: mislocalised radially
PATO:0002178.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being out of its usual or proper place, or position around a central point or axis.

PATO:0002179.label: mislocalised proximally
PATO:0002179.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards to point of attachment or origin.

PATO:0002180.label: straight
PATO:0002180.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being free of curves, bends, or angles.

PATO:0002181.label: displaced
PATO:0002181.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue the bearer's being changed in position.

PATO:0002182.label: molecular quality
PATO:0002182.definition: A quality which inheres in a molecular entity, a single molecule, atom, ion, radical etc.

PATO:0002183.label: cyclicity
PATO:0002183.definition: A molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of whether that there is a presence of cycles in the connection of the atoms within the molecular entity.

PATO:0002184.label: cyclic cyclicity
PATO:0002184.definition: Cyclic cyclicity inheres in a molecule when the atoms of the molecule do contain at least one cycle in the atom-atom connection paths (through bonds).

PATO:0002185.label: acyclic cyclicity
PATO:0002185.definition: Acyclic cyclicity inheres in a molecule when the atoms within the molecule do not contain at least one cycle in the atom-atom connection paths (through the bonds).

PATO:0002186.label: polarity
PATO:0002186.definition: A molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of whether or not the molecular entity has a separation of electric charge which leads to the molecule having an electric dipole.

PATO:0002187.label: polar polarity
PATO:0002187.definition: Polar polarity is a quality that inheres in a molecular entity when the molecular entity is polar, i.e. does possess an electric dipole.

PATO:0002188.label: nonpolar polarity
PATO:0002188.definition: A molecular quality which inheres in a molecular entity when the molecular entity does not possess an electrical dipole.

PATO:0002189.label: electric polarizability
PATO:0002189.definition: The ease of distortion of the electron cloud of a molecular entity by an electric field.

PATO:0002190.label: aromaticity
PATO:0002190.definition: A molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the presence of a conjugated ring of unsaturated bonds, lone pairs, or empty orbitals that exhibit a stabilization stronger than would be expected by the stabilization of conjugation alone.

PATO:0002191.label: aromatic
PATO:0002191.definition: A molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity when it possesses at least one ring that is aromatic, i.e. A conjugated ring of unsaturated bonds, lone pairs, or empty orbitals that exhibit a stabilization stronger than would be expected by the stabilization of conjugation alone.

PATO:0002192.label: non-aromatic
PATO:0002192.definition: A quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the molecule possessing no rings that are aromatic.

PATO:0002193.label: electric charge
PATO:0002193.definition: A molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the overall electric charge of the molecule, which is due to a comparison between the total number of electrons and the total number of protons.

PATO:0002194.label: neutral charge
PATO:0002194.definition: A quality which inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the molecular entity possessing the same amount of electrons overall as protons, thus having an overall neutral charge.

PATO:0002195.label: positive charge
PATO:0002195.definition: A quality which inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the molecular entity possessing more protons overall than electrons, thus having an overall positive charge.

PATO:0002196.label: negative charge
PATO:0002196.definition: A quality which inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the molecular entity possessing more electrons overall than protons, thus having an overall negative charge.

PATO:0002197.label: electronegativity
PATO:0002197.definition: A quality that describes the power of an atom to attract electrons to itself .

PATO:0002198.label: quality of a substance
PATO:0002198.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its constitution.

PATO:0002199.label: meltability
PATO:0002199.definition: A quality which inheres in a substance by virtue of the ease with which the substance can be changed from a solid to a liquid state especially by the application of heat.

PATO:0002200.label: vaporizability
PATO:0002200.definition: A quality which inheres in a substance by virtue of the ease with which the substance can be changed into a gaseous state.

PATO:0002201.label: handedness
PATO:0002201.definition: A behavioral quality inhering ina bearer by virtue of the bearer's unequal distribution of fine motor skill between its left and right hands or feet.

PATO:0002202.label: left handedness
PATO:0002202.definition: Handedness where the organism preferentially uses the left hand or foot for tasks requiring the use of a single hand or foot or a dominant hand or foot.

PATO:0002203.label: right handedness
PATO:0002203.definition: Handedness where the organism preferentially uses the right hand or foot for tasks requiring the use of a single hand or foot or a dominant hand or foot.

PATO:0002204.label: ambidextrous handedness
PATO:0002204.definition: Handedness where the organism exhibits no overall dominance in the use of right or left hand or foot in the performance of tasks that require one hand or foot or a dominant hand or foot.

PATO:0002205.label: capacitance
PATO:0002205.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to hold an electrical charge.

PATO:0002206.label: neonatal
PATO:0002206.definition: A maturity quality inhering to a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being at the point or short after birth.

PATO:0002207.label: insertion depth
PATO:0002207.definition: A quality that is the distance between the end of the inserted object and the surface of the object into which it penetrates.

PATO:0002208.label: spoon-shaped
PATO:0002208.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped in the form of a spoon.

PATO:0002209.label: incisiform
PATO:0002209.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having the shape of an incisor tooth.

PATO:0002210.label: bulbous
PATO:0002210.definition: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a teardrop.

PATO:0002211.label: recurved
PATO:0002211.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved backward or inward.

PATO:0002212.label: slender
PATO:0002212.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being small or narrow in circumference or width in proportion to length or height.

PATO:0002213.label: obclavate
PATO:0002213.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape being inversely clavate.

PATO:0002214.label: bilobed
PATO:0002214.definition: A lobed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being divided into or having two lobes.

PATO:0002215.label: falciform
PATO:0002215.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having the shape of a scythe or sickle.

PATO:0002216.label: ubiquinated
PATO:0002216.definition: A molecular quality that pertains to the post-translational modification of a protein by the covalent attachment of one or more ubiquitin monomer.

PATO:0002217.label: nitrated
PATO:0002217.definition: A molecular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being combined, or impregnated, with nitric acid, or some of its compounds.

PATO:0002218.label: demyelinated
PATO:0002218.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's loss of myelin sheath.

PATO:0002219.label: fan-shaped
PATO:0002219.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer that is shaped in the form of a fan.

PATO:0002220.label: phosphorylated
PATO:0002220.definition: A quality inhering in a protein or a molecule by virtue of the bearer's having a phosphate (PO4) group.

PATO:0002221.label: increased phosphorylation
PATO:0002221.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being phosphorylated to a more than normal extent, or fully saturated with phosphate groups.

PATO:0002222.label: decreased phosphorylation
PATO:0002222.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being phosphorylated to a lesser than normal extent, or less than fully.

PATO:0002223.label: oxidized
PATO:0002223.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having reacted with oxygen, or been modified by oxidation (the reaction in which the atoms of an element lose electrons and the valence of the element increases).

PATO:0002224.label: V-shaped
PATO:0002224.definition: An angular shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a single angle in its length giving the bearer the form of the letter V.

PATO:0002225.label: L-shaped
PATO:0002225.definition: An angular shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a single angle in its length giving the bearer the form of the letter L.

PATO:0002226.label: subcylindrical
PATO:0002226.definition: A cylindrical shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being imperfectly cylindrical or approximately cylindrical.

PATO:0002227.label: cup-shaped
PATO:0002227.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape form resembling the shape of a cup.

PATO:0002228.label: acuminate
PATO:0002228.definition: A tapered shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's tapering gradually to a sharp point.

PATO:0002229.label: subrectangular
PATO:0002229.definition: A quadrangular shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being approximately rectangular.

PATO:0002230.label: subtriangular
PATO:0002230.definition: A triangular shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being nearly, but not perfectly, triangular.

PATO:0002231.label: multifid
PATO:0002231.definition: A split shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or being divided into many lobes or similar segments.

PATO:0002232.label: semicircular
PATO:0002232.definition: A 2-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having shape or form of half a circle.

PATO:0002233.label: far from
PATO:0002233.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located far (not close to) in space in relation to another entity.

PATO:0002234.label: emarginate
PATO:0002234.definition: A notched shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a notched tip or edge.

PATO:0002235.label: blade-like
PATO:0002235.definition: A tapered shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being flat, slender, and tapering to a point.

PATO:0002236.label: aliform
PATO:0002236.definition: Shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a wing.

PATO:0002237.label: retrorse
PATO:0002237.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved backward or downward.

PATO:0002238.label: antrorse
PATO:0002238.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved forward or upward.

PATO:0002239.label: hourglass-shaped
PATO:0002239.definition: A concave 3-D shape that inheres in the bearer by virtue of the bearer's nearly) symmetric shape wide at its ends and narrow in the middle, resembling the figure of number 8.

PATO:0002240.label: teardrop-shaped
PATO:0002240.definition: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape resembling falling drop.

PATO:0002241.label: trilobed
PATO:0002241.definition: A lobed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being divided into or having three lobes.

PATO:0002242.label: velocity
PATO:0002242.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's rate of change of the position.

PATO:0002243.label: fluid flow rate
PATO:0002243.definition: A physical quality inhering in a fluid (liquid or gas) by virtue of the amount of fluid which passes through a given surface per unit time.

PATO:0002244.label: mass flow rate
PATO:0002244.definition: A flow rate quality inhering in a substance by virtue of the mass of substance which passes through a given surface per unit time.

PATO:0002246.label: decreased force
PATO:0002246.definition: A force which is relative low.

PATO:0002247.label: degree of pigmentation
PATO:0002247.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or lacking of substances produced by living organisms that have a color resulting from selective color absorption.

PATO:0002248.label: pigmented
PATO:0002248.definition: A degree of pigmentation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having substances produced by living organisms that have a color resulting from selective color absorption.

PATO:0002249.label: unpigmented
PATO:0002249.definition: A degree of pigmentation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking substances produced by living organisms that have a color resulting from selective color absorption.

PATO:0002250.label: increased pigmentation
PATO:0002250.definition: A degree of pigmentation quality that is relatively high.

PATO:0002251.label: decreased pigmentation
PATO:0002251.definition: A degree of pigmentation quality that is relative low.

PATO:0002252.label: antero-posteriorly flattened
PATO:0002252.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being flattened along the antero-posterior axis.

PATO:0002253.label: platelike
PATO:0002253.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being roundish, flattish shape, possibly with a slightly angled edge.

PATO:0002254.label: flattened
PATO:0002254.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's surface becoming more extended in a plane.

PATO:0002255.label: grooved
PATO:0002255.definition: Texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked with one or more channels.

PATO:0002256.label: tricuspidate
PATO:0002256.definition: A cuscpidate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer possessing three cusps.

PATO:0002257.label: multicuspidate
PATO:0002257.definition: A cuscpidate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer possessing more than one cusp.

PATO:0002258.label: pointed
PATO:0002258.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a point.

PATO:0002259.label: adjacent to
PATO:0002259.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located near in space in relation to another entity.

PATO:0002260.label: semi erect
PATO:0002260.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being partially upright in position or posture.

PATO:0002261.label: located in
PATO:0002261.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's location within another entity.

PATO:0002262.label: phosphorylation
PATO:0002262.definition: A quality inhering in a protein or a molecule by virtue of the addition of a phosphate (PO4) group to the bearer.

PATO:0002263.label: dephosphorylated
PATO:0002263.definition: A quality inhering in a protein or a molecule by virtue of the bearer's lacking a phosphate (PO4) group.

PATO:0002264.label: organization quality
PATO:0002264.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being arranged in a systematic fashion.

PATO:0002265.label: behavioural activity
PATO:0002265.definition: A behavioral quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to exhibit marked activity.

PATO:0002266.label: 3-D shape
PATO:0002266.definition: A shape that inheres in a 3 dimensional entity.

PATO:0002268.label: centered
PATO:0002268.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located in a position equidistant from edges.

PATO:0002269.label: accumulation
PATO:0002269.definition: A structural quality of the collection or massing of one physical object within another physical object.

PATO:0002270.label: increased accumulation
PATO:0002270.definition: An increased number of physical objects that are accumulated within another physical object usually as a result of a failure to break down or remove objects in a timely manner.

PATO:0002271.label: decreased accumulation
PATO:0002271.definition: An accumulation which is relative low.

PATO:0002272.label: parallel to
PATO:0002272.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located at the same continuous distance relative to another object.

PATO:0002273.label: marbled
PATO:0002273.definition: Multicolored quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being colored with a variegated pattern resembling marble,.

PATO:0002274.label: mottled
PATO:0002274.definition: Multicolored quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being dappled with spots, patches, or blotches of different colors.

PATO:0002275.label: high contrast color pattern
PATO:0002275.definition: A color pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's color pattern in which light and dark colors (for example white and black) are codistributed to create a visual impression.

PATO:0002276.label: barred
PATO:0002276.definition: A color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's exhibiting vertical bars of one hue or degree of saturation crossing another.

PATO:0002277.label: iridescent
PATO:0002277.definition: A quality of certain surfaces which appear to change colour as the angle of view changes.

PATO:0002278.label: articulated with
PATO:0002278.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's participating in a joint with another entity.

PATO:0002279.label: tightly articulated with
PATO:0002279.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being strongly articulated with another entity.

PATO:0002280.label: broadly articulated with
PATO:0002280.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's possessing a broad surface in articulation with another entity.

PATO:0002281.label: biscupidate
PATO:0002281.definition: A cuscpidate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer possessing two cusps.

PATO:0002282.label: increased mobility
PATO:0002282.definition: A mobility which is relative high.

PATO:0002283.label: decreased mobility
PATO:0002283.definition: A mobility which is relative low.

PATO:0002284.label: tension
PATO:0002284.definition: A physical quality that pertains by virtue of a pulling force that is directed away from the bearer and attempts to stretch or elongate the bearer.

PATO:0002285.label: increased branchiness
PATO:0002285.definition: Branchiness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of increasing the degree to which there are subdivisions or offshoots in a bearer entity.

PATO:0002286.label: decreased branchiness
PATO:0002286.definition: Branchiness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of decreasing the degree to which there are subdivisions or offshoots in a bearer entity.

PATO:0002287.label: increased elasticity
PATO:0002287.definition: An elasticity which is relatively high.

PATO:0002288.label: decreased elasticity
PATO:0002288.definition: An elasticity which is relatively low.

PATO:0002289.label: setose
PATO:0002289.definition: A hairy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being covered with setae.

PATO:0002290.label: aplastic/hypoplastic
PATO:0002290.definition: Decreased size or absence of organ, tissue or cell due to a reduction in cell numbers.

PATO:0002291.label: agenesis
PATO:0002291.definition: Absence of a tissue or organ due to failure to develop.

PATO:0002292.label: transient
PATO:0002292.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's underlying structure being capable of change.

PATO:0002293.label: permanent
PATO:0002293.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's underlying structure not changing over time.

PATO:0002294.label: scrobiculate
PATO:0002294.definition: A texture that is uniformly covered in short, oblong, or trench-like depressions.

PATO:0002295.label: areolate
PATO:0002295.definition: A surface feature shape inhering in a surface by virtue of the bearer's being divided by ridge-like structures into a number of small, irregular spaces.

PATO:0002296.label: foveate
PATO:0002296.definition: A texture quality inhering in a surface by virtue of the bearer's being marked by the presence of small, shallow, regular depressions called fovae.

PATO:0002297.label: decreased cellular motility
PATO:0002297.definition: A cellular motility which is lower relative to the normal or average.

PATO:0002298.label: increased cellular motility
PATO:0002298.definition: A cellular motility which is higher relative to the normal or average.

PATO:0002299.label: tubular
PATO:0002299.definition: A cylindrical shape that is hollow.

PATO:0002300.label: obsolete increased quality
PATO:0002300.definition: OBSOLETE. A characteristic that has a value that is increased compared to normal or average.

PATO:0002301.label: obsolete decreased quality
PATO:0002301.definition: OBSOLETE. A characteristic that has a value that is decreased compared to normal or average.

PATO:0002302.label: decreased process quality
PATO:0002302.definition: A quality of a process that has a value that is decreased compared to normal or average.
relationships: RO:0015008 PATO:0000461 ! decreased in magnitude relative to normal

PATO:0002303.label: decreased object quality
PATO:0002303.definition: A quality of an object that has a value that is decreased compared to normal or average.
relationships: RO:0015008 PATO:0000461 ! decreased in magnitude relative to normal

PATO:0002304.label: increased process quality
PATO:0002304.definition: A quality of a process that has a value that is increased compared to normal or average.
relationships: RO:0015007 PATO:0000461 ! increased in magnitude relative to normal

PATO:0002305.label: increased object quality
PATO:0002305.definition: A quality of an object that has a value that is increased compared to normal or average.
relationships: RO:0015007 PATO:0000461 ! increased in magnitude relative to normal

PATO:0002306.label: equilateral triangular
PATO:0002306.definition: A triangular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having all sides of the same length.

PATO:0002307.label: isosceles triangular
PATO:0002307.definition: A triangular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two sides have the same length.

PATO:0002308.label: scalene triangular
PATO:0002308.definition: A triangular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having all sides of unequal length.

PATO:0002309.label: fiber shaped
PATO:0002309.definition: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a consistently sized and approximately round cross-section along its length, which is many times larger than its diameter.

PATO:0002310.label: robust
PATO:0002310.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being strong, thick or sturdy.

PATO:0002311.label: fimbriated
PATO:0002311.definition: Having a fringe or border of hairlike or fingerlike projections.

PATO:0002312.label: segmented
PATO:0002312.definition: Consisting of segments or similar parts arranged in a longitudinal series.

PATO:0002313.label: telescopic
PATO:0002313.definition: Having or resembling the shape of a telescope.

PATO:0002314.label: ligamentous
PATO:0002314.definition: Having the nature or characteristic of, a ligament; composed of the tissue proper to ligaments.

PATO:0002315.label: brush-like shape
PATO:0002315.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling the end of a brush with a multitude of bristles.

PATO:0002316.label: autogenous
PATO:0002316.definition: Being separate or discrete from other skeletal elements.

PATO:0002317.label: parallelogram
PATO:0002317.definition: A convex quadrilateral is a parallelogram if and only if any one of the following statements are true:n1. Each diagonal divides the quadrilateral into two congruent triangles with the same orientation.n2. The opposite sides are congruent in pairs.n3. The diagonals bisect each other.n4. The opposite angles are congruent in pairs.n5. The sum of the squares of the sides equals the sum of the squares of the diagonals. (This is the parallelogram law)n6.It possesses rotational symmetry.n7.One pair of opposite sides are parallel and congruent.n8.Two pairs of adjacent angles are supplementary.

PATO:0002318.label: superelliptic
PATO:0002318.definition: A shape constituting a transition between a rectangle and a circle; a closed curve, of which the circle and ellipse are special cases, whose parametric equation is x = a.cos2/rt, y = b.cos2/rt

PATO:0002319.label: squircle
PATO:0002319.definition: A shape with properties between those of a square and those of a circle.

PATO:0002320.label: diamond shaped
PATO:0002320.definition: A superelliptic shape inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape resembling a diamond.

PATO:0002323.label: temporal distribution quality
PATO:0002323.definition: A temporal distribution pattern of process occurrences within a regulation/reference process.

PATO:0002324.label: offset quality
PATO:0002324.definition: The temporal relation between the end of the process with respect to a reference process.

PATO:0002325.label: onset quality
PATO:0002325.definition: The temporal relation between the start of the process with respect to a reference process.

PATO:0002326.label: angle
PATO:0002326.definition: An orientation inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's placement at an angle.

PATO:0002327.label: increased angle to
PATO:0002327.definition: An angle which is relatively high.

PATO:0002328.label: decreased angle to
PATO:0002328.definition: An angle which is relatively low.

PATO:0002329.label: hyponastic
PATO:0002329.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a upward bending of its leaves or other plant parts.

PATO:0002330.label: oblanceolate
PATO:0002330.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being extended along a straight line, and is shaped like a reversed lance-point, with the tapering point attached to the leafstalk.

PATO:0002331.label: adhesive
PATO:0002331.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer exhibiting molecular attraction to another entity in contact.

PATO:0002332.label: non-adhesive
PATO:0002332.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer not exhibiting molecular attraction to another entity in contact.

PATO:0002333.label: increased adhesivity
PATO:0002333.definition: A adhesivity which is relatively high.

PATO:0002334.label: decreased adhesivity
PATO:0002334.definition: A adhesivity which is relatively low.

PATO:0002335.label: tholiform
PATO:0002335.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being dome-shaped.

PATO:0002336.label: pyramidal
PATO:0002336.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having triangular faces that meet at a common point and containing a polygonal shaped base.

PATO:0002337.label: lance-ovate
PATO:0002337.definition: A spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a continuous convex surface with an axis of symmetry and one axis longer than the other; characterized with an egg-shaped form crossed with a lance-head shaped form.

PATO:0002338.label: lanceolate-triangular
PATO:0002338.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a lance-head, considerably longer than wide, tapering towards the tip from below the middle together forming three angles; attached at the broad end.

PATO:0002339.label: hispid
PATO:0002339.definition: A quality of being covered with stiff or rough hairs.

PATO:0002340.label: hispidulous
PATO:0002340.definition: A quality of being minutely hispid.

PATO:0002341.label: tomentose
PATO:0002341.definition: A quality of being covered with short, dense, matted hairs.

PATO:0002342.label: cupulate
PATO:0002342.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being a cupule, with a structure similar to a cup that also encloses the ovule in partiality.

PATO:0002343.label: decumbent
PATO:0002343.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lying or growing on the ground but with erect or rising tips.

PATO:0002344.label: arachnose
PATO:0002344.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being characterized by fine, entangled hairs giving the appearance of cobweb.

PATO:0002345.label: lemon-shaped
PATO:0002345.definition: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a quadric surface in three dimensions obtained by rotating less than half of a circular arc about an axis passing through the endpoints of the arc

PATO:0002346.label: snowman-shaped
PATO:0002346.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two connected parts, roughly spherical, of different sizes.

PATO:0002347.label: obconical
PATO:0002347.definition: A conical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a cone, with the pointed end attached to an organism.

PATO:0002348.label: ligneous
PATO:0002348.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer resembling wood.

PATO:0002349.label: basal to
PATO:0002349.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the base of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0002350.label: cauline to
PATO:0002350.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the stalk of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0002351.label: fleshy
PATO:0002351.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer resembling or containing flesh.

PATO:0002352.label: herbaceous
PATO:0002352.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's upper parts die back to the rootstock at the end of the growing season.

PATO:0002353.label: activation quality
PATO:0002353.definition: A quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its realizing one of its functions.

PATO:0002354.label: active
PATO:0002354.definition: A quality of an physical object that is currently realizing one of its functions.

PATO:0002355.label: inactive
PATO:0002355.definition: A quality of a physical object that is currently realizing none of its functions.

PATO:0002356.label: constitutively active
PATO:0002356.definition: A quality of a physical object that has been constantly realizing some of its functions.

PATO:0002357.label: D-shaped
PATO:0002357.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a strait side and an arched side giving the bearer the form of the letter D.

PATO:0002358.label: ridged
PATO:0002358.definition: An elongated raised margin or border.

PATO:0002359.label: broad
PATO:0002359.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's width being notably higher than its length.

PATO:0002360.label: tendency
PATO:0002360.definition: A disposition that can be compared on a linear scale - that is that it can be increased or decreased.

PATO:0002361.label: increased tendency
PATO:0002361.definition: A tendency which is relatively high.

PATO:0002362.label: decreased tendency
PATO:0002362.definition: A tendency which is relatively low.

PATO:0002363.label: bronze
PATO:0002363.definition: A medium brown color with a metallic sheen, resembles the actual alloy bronze.

PATO:0002364.label: shortened
PATO:0002364.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's length being notably lower than its width.

PATO:0002365.label: intact female
PATO:0002365.definition: Female quality of having complete, unaltered reproductive organs

PATO:0002366.label: intact male
PATO:0002366.definition: Male quality of having complete, unaltered reproductive organs.

PATO:0002367.label: castrated male
PATO:0002367.definition: Male quality of being incapable to reproduce because of functional loss of the testicles from surgical removal or chemical means.

PATO:0002368.label: nulliparous
PATO:0002368.definition: A viviparous organism having never given birth.

PATO:0002369.label: multiparous
PATO:0002369.definition: A viviparous organism that has given birth two or more times.

PATO:0002370.label: parity
PATO:0002370.definition: The number of time that a viviparous organism has given birth.

PATO:0002371.label: primiparous
PATO:0002371.definition: A viviparous organism having given birth one time.

PATO:0002372.label: grand multiparous
PATO:0002372.definition: A viviparous organism that has given birth five or more times.

PATO:0002373.label: mediolateral polarity
PATO:0002373.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's location of features or characteristics along the mediolateral axis.

PATO:0002374.label: fluctuating
PATO:0002374.definition: Recurrent and often more or less cyclic alteration.

PATO:0002375.label: trumpet-shaped
PATO:0002375.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape form resembling the shape of a trumpet.

PATO:0002376.label: inflated
PATO:0002376.definition: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being filled with air.

PATO:0002377.label: uninflated
PATO:0002377.definition: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being not filed with air.

PATO:0002378.label: acinus
PATO:0002378.definition: Having a shape that resembles a many-lobed "berry," such as a raspberry.

PATO:0002379.label: ovariohysterectomized female
PATO:0002379.definition: A female fertility quality inhering in a female by virtue of the bearer's not being capable of reproducing because of surgical removal of ovaries and uterus.

PATO:0002380.label: ovariectomized female
PATO:0002380.definition: A female fertility quality inhering in a female by virtue of the bearer's not being capable of reproducing because of surgical removal of ovaries.

PATO:0002381.label: waxiness
PATO:0002381.definition: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the presence of long chain aliphatic lipids on the surface of an organism.

PATO:0002382.label: increased waxiness
PATO:0002382.definition: A waxiness which is relatively high.

PATO:0002383.label: decreased waxiness
PATO:0002383.definition: A waxiness which is relatively low.

PATO:0002384.label: waxy
PATO:0002384.definition: Presence of long chain aliphatic lipids on the surface of an organism.

PATO:0002385.label: striate-angular
PATO:0002385.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by narrow lines, usually parallel, with at least one salient angle on the margin

PATO:0002386.label: anvil
PATO:0002386.definition: A concave 3-D shape that inheres in the bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape that is wider at one end and narrow in the middle.

PATO:0002387.label: peracute
PATO:0002387.definition: Extremely acute and aggressive onset of a pathological process.

PATO:0002388.label: pedunculate
PATO:0002388.definition: Being supported by a peduncle or stalk.

PATO:0002389.label: procumbent
PATO:0002389.definition: Growing horizontal to the ground without setting roots.

PATO:0002390.label: radius
PATO:0002390.definition: A length quality which is equal to the length of any straight line segment that passes from the center of a circle to any endpoint on the circular boundary. The radius is half of the diameter.

PATO:0002391.label: triradiate
PATO:0002391.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having three rays or radiating branches.

PATO:0002392.label: diagonal to
PATO:0002392.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located on a sloping line joining two nonconsecutive points of an entity relative to another entity.

PATO:0002393.label: increased tolerance to
PATO:0002393.definition: A tolerance quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's increased ability to endure a stimulus.

PATO:0002394.label: decreased tolerance to
PATO:0002394.definition: A tolerance quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's decreased ability to endure a stimulus.

PATO:0002395.label: mislocalized abaxially
PATO:0002395.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned away from the axis of an organism.

PATO:0002396.label: mislocalized adaxially
PATO:0002396.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the axis of an organism.

PATO:0002397.label: subcircular
PATO:0002397.definition: A circular shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being nearly, but not perfectly, circular.

PATO:0002399.label: anteromedially rotated
PATO:0002399.definition: A rotation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of being rotated towards the front and the middle of an organism.

PATO:0002400.label: fusiform
PATO:0002400.definition: Having a spindle-like shape that is wide in the middle and tapers at both ends.

PATO:0002402.label: multifocal to coalescing
PATO:0002402.definition: Multiple lesions some interconnecting with each other.

PATO:0002403.label: generalized
PATO:0002403.definition: Affecting all regions without specificity of distribution.

PATO:0002405.label: friability
PATO:0002405.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to be reduced to smaller pieces with little effort.

PATO:0002406.label: friable
PATO:0002406.definition: Easily reduced to powder or easily fragmentable or crumbly.

PATO:0002407.label: indurated
PATO:0002407.definition: Having become firm or hard especially by increase of fibrous elements.

PATO:0002410.label: beige
PATO:0002410.definition: A colour that is very pale yellowish brown.

PATO:0002411.label: yellow brown
PATO:0002411.definition: A color consisting of yellow and brown hue.

PATO:0002412.label: dark yellow brown
PATO:0002412.definition: A color consisting of yellow and brown hue and low brightness.

PATO:0002413.label: light yellow brown
PATO:0002413.definition: A color consisting of yellow and brown hue and high brightness.

PATO:0002414.label: chronic-active
PATO:0002414.definition: A quality of duration having progressive course of indefinite duration with active, acute-like elements.

PATO:0002415.label: focally extensive
PATO:0002415.definition: Single lesion with expansion into surrounding tissue.

PATO:0002416.label: sunken
PATO:0002416.definition: Flattened from above downward; below the normal level or the level of the surrounding parts.

PATO:0002417.label: transmural
PATO:0002417.definition: Extending through or affecting the entire thickness of the wall of an organ or cavity or boundary.

PATO:0002418.label: acidophilic
PATO:0002418.definition: An affinity inhering in an anatomical structure by virtue of the bearer exhibiting a molecular interaction for acidic dyes under specific pH conditions.

PATO:0002419.label: obsolete eosinophilic
PATO:0002419.definition: OBSOLETE. An affinity inhering in an anatomical structure by virtue of the bearer exhibiting a molecular interaction for eosin dye.

PATO:0002420.label: amphiphilic
PATO:0002420.definition: Having both hydrophilic and hydrophobic (or lipophilic) groups.

PATO:0002421.label: cicatricial
PATO:0002421.definition: Having or resembling the characteristic of a cicatrix - a scar resulting from formation and contraction of fibrous tissue.

PATO:0002422.label: acinar
PATO:0002422.definition: Pertaining to the individual parts making up an aggregate fruit like a many-lobed "berry," such as a raspberry.

PATO:0002423.label: papillomatous
PATO:0002423.definition: A round or lobulated protruding form resembling a nipple.

PATO:0002424.label: divergent from
PATO:0002424.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two or more entities that extend from a common point in different directions.

PATO:0002425.label: exposed
PATO:0002425.definition: Open to view or not covered by another entity.

PATO:0002426.label: scaphoid
PATO:0002426.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a boat.

PATO:0002427.label: knobbled
PATO:0002427.definition: A surface feature shape having numerous very small circular rounded projections or protuberances.

PATO:0002428.label: tripodal
PATO:0002428.definition: A 3-D shape with three supports or legs.

PATO:0002429.label: x-shaped
PATO:0002429.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped in the form of the letter X.

PATO:0002430.label: strap-shaped
PATO:0002430.definition: A shape quality in which the bearer is shaped like a narrow band; ligulate.

PATO:0002431.label: waisted
PATO:0002431.definition: A shape quality in which the bearer possesses a gradual, yet distinct, thinning from a wide starting point.

PATO:0002432.label: spade-shaped
PATO:0002432.definition: A shape that is in the form of a spade.

PATO:0002433.label: sculpted surface
PATO:0002433.definition: A surface feature shape marked by large amounts of relief, often with multiple ridges and grooves in close association. Topographically complex.

PATO:0002434.label: perpendicular to
PATO:0002434.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located at a right angle relative to another entity.

PATO:0002435.label: abutting
PATO:0002435.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer touching another entity along a border or with a projecting part.

PATO:0002436.label: offset
PATO:0002436.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's position being displaced from a reference point.

PATO:0002437.label: interlocked with
PATO:0002437.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being locked together or interconnected to another entity.

PATO:0002438.label: subdermal
PATO:0002438.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located or placed beneath the skin.

PATO:0002439.label: w-shaped
PATO:0002439.definition: An angular shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two angles in its length giving the bearer the form of the letter W.

PATO:0002440.label: ornamentation
PATO:0002440.definition: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the degree of the bearer's highly topographical with ridges, pits, rugosity or other surface structures.

PATO:0002441.label: ornamented
PATO:0002441.definition: A surface feature shape in which the bearer's surface is highly topographical with ridges, pits, rugosity or other surface structures.

PATO:0002442.label: unornamented
PATO:0002442.definition: A surface feature shape in which the bearer's surface is lacking ridges, pits, rugosity or other surface structures.

PATO:0002443.label: level with
PATO:0002443.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located at the same level as another entity.

PATO:0002444.label: mineralized
PATO:0002444.definition: A composition quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being composed of or possessing inorganic material.

PATO:0002445.label: torsioned
PATO:0002445.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being twisted or turned.

PATO:0002446.label: anchor-shaped
PATO:0002446.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape resembling an anchor.

PATO:0002447.label: quadripartite
PATO:0002447.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being divided into four parts.

PATO:0002448.label: oriented towards
PATO:0002448.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being aligned or positioned towards another entity.

PATO:0002449.label: posteromedial to
PATO:0002449.definition: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the rear and mid-line surface of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0002450.label: firm
PATO:0002450.definition: A hardness quality of giving significant resistance to pressure.

PATO:0002451.label: sexually dimorphic
PATO:0002451.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a phenotypic difference between males and females of the same species.

PATO:0002452.label: decondensed
PATO:0002452.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being thinner or more loosely packed.

PATO:0002453.label: eroding
PATO:0002453.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer bring gradually worn away.

PATO:0002454.label: carpel-like
PATO:0002454.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a carpel.

PATO:0002455.label: corymb-like
PATO:0002455.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's architecture bearing resemblence to a corymb type of inflorescence.

PATO:0002456.label: inflorescence-like
PATO:0002456.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of an inflorescence.

PATO:0002457.label: leaf-like
PATO:0002457.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a leaf.

PATO:0002458.label: pin-like
PATO:0002458.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being thin and lacking outgrowths.

PATO:0002459.label: sepal-like
PATO:0002459.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a sepal,

PATO:0002460.label: shriveled
