PATO:0002460.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being smaller and contracted, especially due to loss of moisture.

PATO:0002461.label: wilty
PATO:0002461.definition: To bend or hang downwards due to loss of water

PATO:0002462.label: collagenous
PATO:0002462.definition: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of collagen.

PATO:0002463.label: extends to
PATO:0002463.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of some aspect of the bearer extending to the position of another entity.

PATO:0002464.label: extends beyond
PATO:0002464.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of some aspect of the bearer extending past the position of another entity.

PATO:0002465.label: prism shaped
PATO:0002465.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a prism.

PATO:0002466.label: keyhole shaped
PATO:0002466.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer resembling a keyhole.

PATO:0002467.label: lathlike
PATO:0002467.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer resembling a thin narrow strip.

PATO:0002468.label: distensible
PATO:0002468.definition: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable of swelling or stretching.

PATO:0002469.label: sutured to
PATO:0002469.definition: Structural quality inhering in a bearer in which a joint has apposed bony surfaces united by fibrous tissue, permitting no movement; found only between bones.

PATO:0002470.label: transformed to
PATO:0002470.definition: A morphological quality between two bearers inhering that one bearer is subject to change the nature, function, or condition of itself to become the other.

PATO:0002471.label: increased velocity
PATO:0002471.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's increased rate of change of the position.

PATO:0002472.label: decreased velocity
PATO:0002472.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's decreased rate of change of the position.

PATO:0002473.label: neoplastic, spontaneous
PATO:0002473.definition: A disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition to spontaneously arise.

PATO:0002474.label: bitter
PATO:0002474.definition: A flavor quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an acrid, sharp, or disagreeable flavor.

PATO:0002475.label: subterminal
PATO:0002475.definition: A position quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's existing near the end of another entity.

PATO:0002476.label: terminal
PATO:0002476.definition: A position quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's forming the end of another entity.

PATO:0002477.label: brittle
PATO:0002477.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to breaks without significant deformation (strain) when subjected to stress.

PATO:0002478.label: transversely striated
PATO:0002478.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by narrow lines or grooves, usually parallel, that are oriented transversely relative to the long axis of the bearer.

PATO:0002479.label: obliquely striated
PATO:0002479.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by narrow lines or grooves, usually parallel, that are oriented obliquely relative to the long axis of the bearer.

PATO:0002480.label: poorly ossified
PATO:0002480.definition: A quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's possessing only minor levels of ossification.

PATO:0002481.label: oblique orientation
PATO:0002481.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a slanting direction or position : neither perpendicular nor parallel.

PATO:0002482.label: slit-like
PATO:0002482.definition: Shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer exhibiting a narrow and elongate opening.

PATO:0002483.label: external to
PATO:0002483.definition: Positional quality in which an entity is located outside of another entity.

PATO:0002484.label: inverted-V shaped
PATO:0002484.definition: An angular shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a single angle in its length giving the bearer the form of an inverted letter V.

PATO:0002485.label: parallel-sided
PATO:0002485.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's possessing two sides that are at the same continuous distance relative to each other.

PATO:0002486.label: multi-organismal process quality
PATO:0002486.definition: A quality inhering in a process by virtue of that process having two or more organisms as participants.

PATO:0002487.label: single organismal process quality
PATO:0002487.definition: A quality inhering in a process by virtue of that process having exactly one organism as a participant.

PATO:0002488.label: overlapping
PATO:0002488.definition: Overlap with quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned over another entity so as to cover some portion of it.

PATO:0002489.label: overlapped by
PATO:0002489.definition: Overlap with quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned under another entity so as to be covered by some portion of it.

PATO:0002490.label: anterior orientation
PATO:0002490.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed anteriorly.

PATO:0002491.label: anterodorsal orientation
PATO:0002491.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed anterodorsally.

PATO:0002492.label: anterolateral orientation
PATO:0002492.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed anterolaterally.

PATO:0002493.label: anteroventral orientation
PATO:0002493.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed anteroventrally.

PATO:0002494.label: distal orientation
PATO:0002494.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed distally.

PATO:0002495.label: dorsal orientation
PATO:0002495.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed dorsally.

PATO:0002496.label: dorsolateral orientation
PATO:0002496.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed dorsolaterally.

PATO:0002497.label: lateral orientation
PATO:0002497.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed laterally.

PATO:0002498.label: medial orientation
PATO:0002498.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed medially.

PATO:0002499.label: posterior orientation
PATO:0002499.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed posteriorly.

PATO:0002500.label: ventrolaterally orientation
PATO:0002500.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed ventrolaterally.

PATO:0002501.label: ventral orientation
PATO:0002501.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed ventrally.

PATO:0002502.label: transverse orientation
PATO:0002502.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed transversely.

PATO:0002503.label: posterolateral orientation
PATO:0002503.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed posterolaterally.

PATO:0002504.label: posterodorsal orientation
PATO:0002504.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed posterodorsally.

PATO:0002505.label: nucleated
PATO:0002505.definition: A nucleate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having one or more nucleus.

PATO:0002506.label: alobate
PATO:0002506.definition: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not having undulating edges forming lobes.

PATO:0002507.label: keratinous
PATO:0002507.definition: A composition quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of keratin.

PATO:0002508.label: concealed
PATO:0002508.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being hidden from view.

PATO:0002509.label: hexagonal
PATO:0002509.definition: A 2-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having six angles and six sides.

PATO:0002510.label: multipartite
PATO:0002510.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being divided into multiple parts.

PATO:0002511.label: cane-like
PATO:0002511.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a cane.

PATO:0002512.label: confluent with
PATO:0002512.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer flowing or coming together with another entity.

PATO:0002513.label: oblique to
PATO:0002513.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a slanting direction (neither perpendicular nor parallel) relative to another entity.

PATO:0002514.label: anteromedial orientation
PATO:0002514.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed anteromedially.

PATO:0002515.label: increased elevation relative to
PATO:0002515.definition: An elevation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue the bearer's being in a high position relative to another entity.

PATO:0002516.label: concealed by
PATO:0002516.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being hidden from view or covered by another entity.

PATO:0002517.label: saddle-shaped
PATO:0002517.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a saddle.

PATO:0002518.label: flush
PATO:0002518.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being level or even with another surface.

PATO:0002519.label: cancellous
PATO:0002519.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an open, latticed, or porous structure; used especially of bone.

PATO:0002520.label: scute-like
PATO:0002520.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being shaped like a scute or an osteoderm.

PATO:0002521.label: funnel-shaped
PATO:0002521.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a funnel.

PATO:0002522.label: keel-shaped
PATO:0002522.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having an elongate structure, similar to a ridge, that extends longitudinally along an anatomical entity.

PATO:0002523.label: vertical to
PATO:0002523.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located at a right angle relative to another entity and to the horizon.

PATO:0002524.label: mesiolateral orientation
PATO:0002524.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed mesiolaterally.

PATO:0002525.label: separating
PATO:0002525.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being in a position that produces a separation in, or acting to separate, another entity.

PATO:0002526.label: anterodistal orientation
PATO:0002526.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed anterodistally.

PATO:0002527.label: posterodistal orientation
PATO:0002527.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed posterodistally.

PATO:0002533.label: bipartite
PATO:0002533.definition: A multipartite quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being divided into two parts.

PATO:0002534.label: plowshare shaped
PATO:0002534.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a plowshare.

PATO:0002535.label: peg-like
PATO:0002535.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a short and stout cylindrical shape.

PATO:0002536.label: boomerang shaped
PATO:0002536.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape like a boomerang, with two arms connected at an angle.

PATO:0002537.label: subovoid
PATO:0002537.definition: A spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a shape not quite ovoid. approximately ovoid.

PATO:0002538.label: concavo-convex
PATO:0002538.definition: A shape quality that obtains by virtue of the bearer being concave on one side and convex on the other.

PATO:0002539.label: ring shaped
PATO:0002539.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape like a ring (a circular shape enclosing a space).

PATO:0002540.label: spur shaped
PATO:0002540.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's possessing a small, spike-like shape.

PATO:0002541.label: homeostatic
PATO:0002541.definition: Pertaining to the ability or tendency of an organism or cell to maintain internal equilibrium by adjusting its physiological processes.

PATO:0002628.label: borderline intensity
PATO:0002628.definition: An intensity which is borderline in it its effect or force as compared to baseline or normal.

PATO:0002629.label: profound intensity
PATO:0002629.definition: An intensity which is characterized by being very severe.

PATO:0002630.label: episodic
PATO:0002630.definition: An occurrence quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a course that occurs occasionally.

PATO:0002631.label: refractory
PATO:0002631.definition: An occurrence of a process during which time there is an inability to change the course, extent, or repetition of the process.

PATO:0002632.label: secondary
PATO:0002632.definition: A characteristic in which the effect or outcome is not primary or the focus of the observation.

PATO:0005000.label: hemispheroid
PATO:0005000.definition: A 3-D shape that is half of a sphere.

PATO:0005001.label: variability of count
PATO:0005001.definition: A variability quality inhering in the bearer by virtue of the bearer having a variable number or count of an entity.

PATO:0005002.label: pear shaped
PATO:0005002.definition: Having the shape of a pear; tapering near the top and bulging toward the base or bottom. From thefreedictionary.com

PATO:0005003.label: paddle shaped
PATO:0005003.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling the form of a paddle.

PATO:0005004.label: subelliptical
PATO:0005004.definition: A shape that is almost an ellipse.

PATO:0005005.label: radiating
PATO:0005005.definition: Shape quality inhering in a bearer expanding outward, or having parts expanding outward, from a center point.

PATO:0005006.label: differentiated from
PATO:0005006.definition: A morphology quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being morphologically distinguishable from another entity.

PATO:0005007.label: hypsodont
PATO:0005007.definition: A 3-D shape inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having dentition characterized by high-crowned teeth and enamel which extends far past the gum line, which provides extra material for wear and tear.

PATO:0005008.label: brachydont
PATO:0005008.definition: A 3-D shape inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having dentition characterized by low-crowned teeth. Human teeth are brachydont.

PATO:0005009.label: molariform
PATO:0005009.definition: A 3-D shape inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an entity in the form of a molar tooth.

PATO:0005010.label: plumose
PATO:0005010.definition: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having many fine filaments or branches that give a feathery appearance: for example, resembling a feather.

PATO:0005011.label: continuous with
PATO:0005011.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer possessing an uninterrupted or unbroken connection or spatial distribution relative to the position of another entity.

PATO:0005012.label: complete structure
PATO:0005012.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being fully formed compared to entities lacking parts.

PATO:0005013.label: incomplete structure
PATO:0005013.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking parts or having a reduced form compared to fully formed entities.

PATO:0005014.label: subspherical
PATO:0005014.definition: A spheroid shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being nearly, but not perfectly, spherical.

PATO:0005015.label: tapered size
PATO:0005015.definition: A size quality inhering in an entity or set of entities in which size increases or decreases along the extent of the entity or set.

PATO:0005016.label: surrounded by
PATO:0005016.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being enclosed on all sides by another entity.

PATO:0005017.label: labiolingually compressed
PATO:0005017.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being compressed from the side facing the lips to the side facing the tongue.

PATO:0005018.label: mesiodistally compressed
PATO:0005018.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being compressed from the side facing the midline of the jaw to the side opposite the midline.

PATO:0005019.label: curved lingually
PATO:0005019.definition: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the tongue.

PATO:0005020.label: irregularly shaped
PATO:0005020.definition: A shape quality inhering on a bearer by virtue of a bearer's shape lacking in pattern or uniformity; for example, it may have sides of different lengths, different curvatures, or unequal angles.

PATO:0005021.label: unicuspidate
PATO:0005021.definition: Cuspidate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's possessing a single cusp.

PATO:0005022.label: uniform diameter
PATO:0005022.definition: A diameter that remains constant throughout the extent of an entity.

PATO:0005023.label: parasagittal orientation
PATO:0005023.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is in the parasagittal plane.

PATO:0005024.label: longitudinal orientation
PATO:0005024.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed along the longitudinal or anterior-posterior axis.

PATO:0010000.label: maximally connected
PATO:0010000.definition: A structural quality inhering in the bearer by virtue of the bearer consisting of a single, maximally connected structure.

PATO:0010001.label: disconnected
PATO:0010001.definition: A structural quality inhering in the bearer by virtue of the bearer consisting of multiple structures lacking any physical connection to each other.

PATO:0010002.label: propagation velocity
PATO:0010002.definition: The velocity of spatial propagation of a process. Examples include the velocity of propagation of an action potential along an axon.

PATO:0010003.label: increased propagation velocity
PATO:0010003.definition: A propagation velocity that is higher than normal.

PATO:0010004.label: decreased propagation velocity
PATO:0010004.definition: A propagation velocity that is lower than normal.

PATO:0010005.label: spatial distribution of a process
PATO:0010005.definition: A physical quality of a process that is its spatial distribution. For example, bone mineralization follows stereotypical spatial distribution patterns during development, which may be altered in some phenotypes.

PATO:0010006.label: cell morphology
PATO:0010006.definition: A characteristic of a single cell inhering in the bearer by virtue of the bearer's size or shape or structure.

PATO:0010007.label: multiciliated
PATO:0010007.definition: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having multiple cilia.

PATO:0010008.label: monociliated
PATO:0010008.definition: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having only one cilium.

PATO:0015001.label: absence due to degeneration
PATO:0015001.definition: Absence due to a degenerative process.

PATO:0015002.label: process efficacy
PATO:0015002.definition: The ability of a process to produce its output.

PATO:0015003.label: decreased efficacy
PATO:0015003.definition: A decrease in the ability of a process to produce its output.

PATO:0015004.label: increased efficacy
PATO:0015004.definition: A increase in the ability of a process to produce its output.

PATO:0015006.label: polymeric
PATO:0015006.definition: A quality inhering in a structure by virtue of it consisting of many of repeated, similar or identical subunits, arranged in some orderly array.

PATO:0015007.label: prominence
PATO:0015007.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the degree to which the bearers stands out or projects beyond a surface or line.

PATO:0015008.label: distensibility
PATO:0015008.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the extent to which the bearer is capable of being stretched or swollen.

PATO:0015009.label: humidity
PATO:0015009.definition: A quality inhering in air by virtue of the partial pressure exerted by the bearer's water vapour content.

PATO:0015012.label: quality of a plasma
PATO:0015012.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting the physical characteristics of an entity consisting of roughly equal proportions of positively and negatively charged particles, having neither a defined volume nor defined shape, having internal magnetic fields, and being electrically conductive.

PATO:0015013.label: degree of illumination
PATO:0015013.definition: The degree to which the bearer is exposed to visible light.

PATO:0015014.label: increased degree of illumination
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0015015 ! decreased degree of illumination

PATO:0015015.label: decreased degree of illumination
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0015014 ! increased degree of illumination

PATO:0015016.label: stepped
PATO:0015016.definition: Having a shape or form that resembles a step of a stairway (e.g., a ledge or offset margin).

PATO:0015017.label: quality of a colloid
PATO:0015017.definition: A physical quality inhering in an entity by virtue of a portion of the bearer's molecular or polymolecular constituents present in one phase being dispersed in a portion of the bearer's constituents present in another phase.

PATO:0015018.label: quality of an aerosol
PATO:0015018.definition: A physical quality inhering in an entity by virtue of the bearer's solid or liquid constituents being suspended in a gas.

PATO:0015019.label: C-shaped
PATO:0015019.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped in the form of the letter C.

PATO:0015020.label: J-shaped
PATO:0015020.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped in the form of the letter J.

PATO:0015021.label: combustibility
PATO:0015021.definition: The propensity of a material to undergo combustion. Combustion encompasses smouldering and flaming combustion. Combustibility is usually applied to solids.

PATO:0015026.label: stability
PATO:0015026.definition: quality, state, or degree of being stable.

PATO:0015029.label: quality of a suspension
PATO:0015029.definition: A physical quality inhering in an entity by virtue of the bearer's solid or liquid constituents being transiently dispersed in a solid, liquid, or gas before settling due to gravity or centrifugal forces.

PATO:0015030.label: plume-shaped
PATO:0015030.definition: A shape that ineres in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's mass being distributed in a feather-like fashion.

PATO:0015031.label: contamination
PATO:0015031.definition: The presence of a constituent, impurity, or some other undesirable element that spoils, corrupts, infects, makes unfit, or makes inferior a material, physical body, natural environment, place of human occupancy, or other material entity.

PATO:0020000.label: genotypic sex
PATO:0020000.definition: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual based upon genotypic composition of sex chromosomes.

PATO:0020001.label: male genotypic sex
PATO:0020001.definition: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual based upon genotypic composition that confers the capability for an organism to differentiate male gonads.

PATO:0020002.label: female genotypic sex
PATO:0020002.definition: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population based upon genotypic composition that confers the capability for an organism to differentiate female gonads.

PATO:0025000.label: potability
PATO:0025000.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being fit to be used as a safe means of hydration.

PATO:0025001.label: non-potable
PATO:0025001.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer not being suitable for use as a safe means of hydration.

PATO:0025002.label: potable
PATO:0025002.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being suitable for use as a safe means of hydration.

PATO:0030000.label: anteriorized
PATO:0030000.definition: A malformed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally anterior structures and missing some or all of what are normally posterior structures.

PATO:0030001.label: dorsalized
PATO:0030001.definition: A malformed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally dorsal structures and missing some or all of what are normally ventral structures.

PATO:0030002.label: posteriorized
PATO:0030002.definition: A malformed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally posterior structures and missing some or all of what are normally anterior structures.

PATO:0030003.label: ventralized
PATO:0030003.definition: A malformed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally ventral structures and missing some or all of what are normally dorsal structures.

PATO:0030004.label: partially anteriorized
PATO:0030004.definition: An anteriorized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally anterior structures and missing some but not all of what are normally posterior structures.

PATO:0030005.label: partially dorsalized
PATO:0030005.definition: A dorsalized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally dorsal structures and missing some but not all of what are normally ventral structures.

PATO:0030006.label: partially posteriorized
PATO:0030006.definition: A posteriorized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally posterior structures and missing some but not all of what are normally anterior structures.

PATO:0030007.label: partially ventralized
PATO:0030007.definition: A ventralized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally ventral structures and missing some but not all of what are normally dorsal structures.

PATO:0030008.label: dorso-anteriorized
PATO:0030008.definition: A malformed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally dorso-anterior structures and missing some or all of what are normally ventro-posterior structures.

PATO:0030009.label: partially dorso-anteriorized
PATO:0030009.definition: A dorso-anteriorized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally dorso-anterior structures and missing some but not all of what are normally ventro-posterior structures.

PATO:0030010.label: wholly dorso-anteriorized
PATO:0030010.definition: A dorso-anteriorized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing only what are normally dorso-anterior structures.

PATO:0030011.label: ventro-posteriorized
PATO:0030011.definition: A malformed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally ventro-posterior structures and missing some or all of what are normally dorso-anterior structures.

PATO:0030012.label: partially ventro-posteriorized
PATO:0030012.definition: A ventro-posteriorized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally ventro-posterior structures and missing some but not all of what are normally dorso-anterior structures.

PATO:0030013.label: wholly ventro-posteriorized
PATO:0030013.definition: A ventro-posteriorized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing only what are normally ventro-posterior structures.

PATO:0040000.label: heterotaxic
PATO:0040000.definition: An oriented quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being abnormally placed or arranged.

PATO:0040002.label: position originates from
PATO:0040002.definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of some aspect of that bearer beginning from a position on another entity.

PATO:0040003.label: pathogenicity
PATO:0040003.definition: The ability of a pathogen to produce an infectious disease or disorder in an another organism.

PATO:0040004.label: plush
PATO:0040004.definition: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being covered or partially covered with hair that has increased thickness and softness.

PATO:0040005.label: posteroventral orientation
PATO:0040005.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed posteroventrally.

PATO:0040006.label: crown like
PATO:0040006.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape like a crown.

PATO:0040007.label: shell shaped
PATO:0040007.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape like a shell.

PATO:0040008.label: fringed
PATO:0040008.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an ornamental border consisting of short straight or twisted threads or strips hanging from cut or raveled edges or from a separate band.

PATO:0040009.label: bowl shaped
PATO:0040009.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped in the form of a bowl.

PATO:0040010.label: mobile relative to
PATO:0040010.definition: Mobility relative to a second entity.

PATO:0040011.label: immobile relative to
PATO:0040011.definition: Immobility relative to a second entity.

PATO:0040012.label: plug shaped
PATO:0040012.definition: A shape that is in the form of a plug, being tube-like and expanded on one end.

PATO:0040013.label: dorsomedial orientation
PATO:0040013.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed dorsomedially.

PATO:0040014.label: band shaped
PATO:0040014.definition: A shape that is in the form of a narrow strip encircling an object.

PATO:0040015.label: trough shaped
PATO:0040015.definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape resembling that of a trough, being narrow, long, and boxlike in shape.

PATO:0040016.label: pentagonal
PATO:0040016.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having five angles and five sides.

PATO:0040017.label: dysplastic growth
PATO:0040017.definition: A growth quality of occurrent in which the growth of an organism, structure or group of organisms is abnormal.

PATO:0040019.label: fibrotic
PATO:0040019.definition: Fibrosis is the formation of excess fibrous connective tissue in an organ or tissue in a reparative or reactive process.

PATO:0040020.label: spayed female
PATO:0040020.definition: Female quality of being incapable to reproduce because of functional loss of the ovaries and/or uterus from surgical removal.

PATO:0040021.label: unpaired
PATO:0040021.definition: The bearer of this quality has_part n=1 of the indicated entity type, where n is bilaterally paired for a comparable organism..

PATO:0040022.label: flared
PATO:0040022.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being expanded laterally and or opened outward in shape.

PATO:0040023.label: distomedial orientation
PATO:0040023.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed distomedially, ie, pertaining to an inside aspect, but also farther away from the center of the body.

PATO:0040024.label: bilaterally paired
PATO:0040024.definition: The bearer of this quality has_part n=2 of the indicated entity type, where n is unpaired for a comparable organism.

PATO:0040025.label: lesioned
PATO:0040025.definition: A structural quality which is held by a bearer where a localized pathological or traumatic structural change, damage, deformity, or discontinuity of tissue, organ, or body part is present.

PATO:0040026.label: structurally discontinuous
PATO:0040026.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by interruptions or gaps.

PATO:0040027.label: doubled haploid
PATO:0040027.definition: A ploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's haploid cells undergo chromosome doubling.

PATO:0040028.label: parous
PATO:0040028.definition: An organismal quality of having successfully reproduced.

PATO:0040029.label: shaded
PATO:0040029.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of that bearer being shielded from visible light.

PATO:0040030.label: decreased width and length
PATO:0040030.definition: A width and length quality which is relatively small, where both width and length are decreased.
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0040031 ! increased width and length

PATO:0040031.label: increased width and length
PATO:0040031.definition: A width and length quality that is relatively large, where both width and length are increased.
relationships: is_opposite_of PATO:0040030 ! decreased width and length

PATO:0040032.label: increased linear velocity
PATO:0040032.definition: A distance traveled in a specific time that is relatively high.

PATO:0040033.label: decreased linear velocity
PATO:0040033.definition: A distance traveled in a specific time that is relatively low.

PATO:0040034.label: fractured
PATO:0040034.definition: A broken quality where an entity is cracked or broken, usually a bone.

PATO:0040035.label: transversely fractured
PATO:0040035.definition: A fractured quality where the fracture traverses the bone perpendicular to the axis of the bone.

PATO:0040036.label: impact-fractured
PATO:0040036.definition: A fractured quality in which one of the fragments is driven into another fragment.

PATO:0040037.label: linearly fractured
PATO:0040037.definition: A fractured quality where the fracture runs parallel to the long axis of a bone.

PATO:0040038.label: obliquely fractured
PATO:0040038.definition: A fractured quality where the fracture occurs at a plane oblique to the long axis of the bone.

PATO:0040039.label: spirally fractured
PATO:0040039.definition: A fractured quality that occurs when torque (a rotating force) is applied along the axis of a bone.

PATO:0040040.label: compression-fractured
PATO:0040040.definition: A fractured quality that is caused by a loss of bone mass (osteoporosis) that occurs as part of aging.

PATO:0040041.label: avulsion fractured
PATO:0040041.definition: A fractured quality in which the fragment of bone tears away from the main mass of bone as a result of physical trauma.

PATO:0040042.label: decreased ratio
PATO:0040042.definition: A decreased quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's decreased magnitude in proportion to the magnitude of another entity.

PATO:0040043.label: increased ratio
PATO:0040043.definition: An increased quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's increased magnitude in proportion to the magnitude of another entity.

PATO:0040044.label: ruptured
PATO:0040044.definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's components being torn, typically used for soft tissues or membranes.

PATO:0040045.label: population growth rate
PATO:0040045.definition: The rate or speed of the change in in number of a population.

PATO:0040046.label: single organismal growth rate
PATO:0040046.definition: The rate or speed of the change in size of an individual entity.

PATO:0040047.label: fragmented
PATO:0040047.definition: Existing or functioning as though broken into separate parts; disorganized; disunified.

PATO:0040048.label: erythematous
PATO:0040048.definition: Red due to increase blood circulation in a defined area.

PATO:0040049.label: male with DSD
PATO:0040049.definition: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population who are otherwise male of a non-hermaphroditic species who has ambiguous or atypical congenital development of the reproductive system.

synonyms.label: male with differences of sexual differentiation
male with disorder of sexual development

PATO:0040050.label: diandrous
PATO:0040050.definition: A phenotypic sex quality inhering in a  plant organism or a population of plants in which the flowers have two stamens.

PATO:0040051.label: monandrous
PATO:0040051.definition: A phenotypic sex quality inhering in a  plant organism or a population of plants in which the flowers have only one stamen.

PATO:0040052.label: protogynous
PATO:0040052.definition: A sequential hermaphroditic quality whereby organisms start out as female and change to male at a later life stage.

PATO:0040053.label: protandrous
PATO:0040053.definition: A sequential hermaphroditic quality whereby organisms start out as male and change to female at a later life stage.

PATO:0040054.label: protogynous hermaphroditism
PATO:0040054.definition: A protogynous quality whereby organisms start out as female and change to hermaphrodite at a later life stage.

PATO:0040055.label: protandrous hermaphroditism
PATO:0040055.definition: A protandrous quality whereby organisms start out as male and change to hermaphrodite at a later life stage.

PATO:0040056.label: female with DSD
PATO:0040056.definition: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population who are otherwise female of a non-hermaphroditic species who has ambiguous or atypical congenital development of the reproductive system.

synonyms.label: female with differences of sexual differentiation
female with disorder of sexual development

PATO:0040057.label: population process quality
PATO:0040057.definition: A quality inhering in a process by virtue of that process having a population or part of a population, where population is defined as a collection of individuals from the same taxonomic class distinguished by one or more characteristics, as participants.

PATO:0040058.label: absence of physical object
PATO:0040058.definition: A quality denoting the lack of a physical entity or object, such as a chemical.

PATO:0040059.label: absent process
PATO:0040059.definition: A quality denoting the lack of a process or function.

PATO:0040060.label: absence of anatomical entity
PATO:0040060.definition: A quality denoting the lack of an anatomical entity or cellular component.

PATO:0040070.label: thermoplastic
PATO:0040070.definition: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to deform by heating.

PATO:0040071.label: nuclear/cytoplasmic ratio
PATO:0040071.definition: A quality inhering in a cell by virtue of the ratio between the volume of its nucleus and the volume of its cytoplasm.

PATO:0040072.label: high nuclear/cytoplasmic ratio
PATO:0040072.definition: A quality inhering in a cell by virtue of the cell having a high nuclear/cytoplasmic ratio.

PATO:0045000.label: normal rate
PATO:0045000.definition: A rate which is relatively normal.

PATO:0045001.label: normal object quality
PATO:0045001.definition: A quality of an object that has a value that is normal or average.

PATO:0045002.label: normal acidity
PATO:0045002.definition: An acidity which is relatively normal.

PATO:0045003.label: normal adhesivity
PATO:0045003.definition: A adhesivity which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045004.label: normal affinity
PATO:0045004.definition: An affinity which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045005.label: normal age
PATO:0045005.definition: An age which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045006.label: normal avidity
PATO:0045006.definition: An avidity which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045007.label: normal behavioural activity
PATO:0045007.definition: A behavioural quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting normal or average activity.

PATO:0045008.label: normal cellular motility
PATO:0045008.definition: A cellular motility which is normal or average.

PATO:0045009.label: normal coiling
PATO:0045009.definition: A coiling which is normal or average.

PATO:0045010.definition: A concentration which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045011.definition: A contractility which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045012.definition: A coordination which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045013.definition: A curvature which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045014.label: normal distance
PATO:0045014.definition: A distance which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045015.label: normal efficiency
PATO:0045015.definition: An efficiency which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045016.label: normal elasticity
PATO:0045016.definition: An elasticity which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045017.label: normal fecundity
PATO:0045017.definition: A fecundity which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045018.label: normal female fertility
PATO:0045018.definition: A female fertility which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045019.label: normal female receptivity
PATO:0045019.definition: A female receptivity which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045020.label: normal fertility
PATO:0045020.definition: A fertility which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045021.label: normal flexibility
PATO:0045021.definition: A flexibility which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045022.label: normal fluid flow
PATO:0045022.definition: A fluid flow which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045023.label: normal fluorescence
PATO:0045023.definition: A fluorescence which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045024.label: normal force
PATO:0045024.definition: A force which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045025.label: normal fragility
PATO:0045025.definition: A fragility which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045026.label: normal life span
PATO:0045026.definition: A life span which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045027.label: normal magnetism
PATO:0045027.definition: A magnetism which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045028.label: normal male fertility

PATO:0045090.label: cardinal direction
PATO:0045090.definition: The four cardinal directions or cardinal points are the directions north, east, south, and west, commonly denoted by their initials, N, E, S, W. East and west are at right angles to north and south, with east being in the clockwise direction of rotation from north and west being directly opposite east.

PATO:0045091.label: north
PATO:0045091.definition: North is one of the four compass points or cardinal directions. It is the opposite of south and is perpendicular to east and west.

PATO:0045092.label: east
PATO:0045092.definition: East is one of the four cardinal directions or points of the compass. It is the opposite direction from west.

PATO:0045093.label: south
PATO:0045093.definition: South is one of the four cardinal directions or compass points. South is the polar opposite of north and is perpendicular to east and west.

PATO:0045094.label: west
PATO:0045094.definition: West is one of the four cardinal directions or points of the compass. It is the opposite direction from east.

PATO:0050000.label: rate of occurence
PATO:0050000.definition: The number of repeated events per unit time, occurring in a repeating series. (e.g. the number of heart beats occurring over 1 minute)

PATO:0050001.label: rate of continuous process
PATO:0050001.definition: The rate of output of a continuous process. Example include: growth rate, cell migration rate, enzyme reaction rate.

PATO:0055001.label: decreased spatial extent of a process
PATO:0055001.definition: A spatial distribution of a process in which the process occupies a smaller length, area, or volume than the reference process. For example, heterochromatin may form over a shorter length of a chromosome in a mutant than in wild type.

PATO:0055002.label: increased spatial extent of a process
PATO:0055002.definition: A spatial distribution of a process in which the process occupies a greater length, area, or volume than the reference process. For example, heterochromatin may form over a shorter length of a chromosome in a mutant than in wild type.

PATO:0055003.label: increased rate of occurrence
PATO:0055003.definition: A rate of occurrence that is relatively high.

PATO:0055004.label: decreased rate of occurrence
PATO:0055004.definition: A rate of occurrence that is relatively low.

PATO:0055005.label: increased rate of continuous process
PATO:0055005.definition: A rate of output of a continuous process that is relatively high.

PATO:0055006.label: decreased rate of continuous process
PATO:0055006.definition: A rate of output of a continuous process that is relatively low.

PATO:0060001.label: sex-specific
PATO:0060001.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being present in one sex and absent from the other in members of the same species.

PATO:0060002.label: male-specific
PATO:0060002.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being present in males and absent from females in members of the same species.

PATO:0060003.label: female-specific
PATO:0060003.definition: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being present in females and absent from males in members of the same species.

PATO:0065001.label: lysed
PATO:0065001.definition: The breakdown, disintegration, destruction of an entity due to the breaking of cell membranes by any means.

PATO:0065002.label: patchy pigmentation
PATO:0065002.definition: A degree of pigmentation quality that is diversified with patches, or irregularity.

PATO:0070000.label: sequential hermaphrodite
PATO:0070000.definition: A hermaphroditic quality that inheres in a population or organism where an organism changes is a different sexes during different life stages.

PATO:0070001.label: neurogliaform morphology
PATO:0070001.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have a small round soma, a large number of short, smooth, or slightly beaded primary dendrites that give rise to only a few secondary branches, and a branched axon that establishes a dense axonal mesh with thin shafts.

PATO:0070002.label: basket cell morphology
PATO:0070002.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in multipolar neurons with densely branched terminal axonal arborizations that form basket-like structures surrounding and synapsing to the somas of target cells.

PATO:0070003.label: small basket cell morphology
PATO:0070003.definition: A basket cell morphology that inheres in neurons with axonal arbors composed of frequent, short, curvy axonal branches that tend to be near their somata and within the same layer.

PATO:0070004.label: large basket cell morphology
PATO:0070004.definition: A basket cell morphology that inheres in neurons that are large, and typically ascend to give rise to many long horizontally and vertically projecting axon collaterals that traverse neighboring columns and can extend through all cortical layers.

PATO:0070005.label: nest basket cell morphology
PATO:0070005.definition: A basket cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have simpler dendritic arbors (compared to small or large basket cell morphology), and an axonal plexus of intermediate density, composed of a few long, smooth axonal branches.

PATO:0070006.label: cortical bipolar morphology
PATO:0070006.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have two principal dendrites that emerge from the soma and begin to branch some distance from it, have few spines, and branch in narrow fields. This is in contrast to bitufted morphology where branching occurs close to the soma.

PATO:0070007.label: Martinotti morphology
PATO:0070007.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which are large and non-spiny, with dendrites radiating in a multipolar or bitufted pattern, often favouring the descending side, and axons that ascend directly from the superficial side of the soma, and travel upward without branching.

PATO:0070008.label: T Martinotti morphology
PATO:0070008.definition: A Martinotti cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have axons that form a horizontal ramification, making it T-shaped.

PATO:0070009.label: fan Martinotti morphology
PATO:0070009.definition: A Martinotti cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have axons that form a fan-like plexus.

PATO:0070010.label: stellate morphology
PATO:0070010.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons that have dendritic processes radiating from the cell body forming a star-like shape.

PATO:0070011.label: chandelier cell morphology
PATO:0070011.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which are small and round, and make highly specialized synapses with the axon initial segments of pyramidal neurons, wrapping them with candle-shaped synaptic 'cartridges'.

PATO:0070012.label: bitufted cell morphology
PATO:0070012.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have two clusters of primary dendrites that originate directly and extend from opposite ends of the soma, and axons that form a plexus which spreads widely. Compared to the narrow vertical axonal projection of bipolar morphology, and the 'horse-tail' axonal cluster of double boquet cells, bitufted morphology has wide horizontal axonal spans, and branching that occur close to the soma. Their vertical projection is also less extensive and crosses mostly to neighboring layers.

PATO:0070013.label: spiny stellate cell morphology
PATO:0070013.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have spiny basal dendrites and resemble pyramidal cells but lose their apical dendrites as they mature. Their axons nearly always emerge from the descending side of the soma, but often recurve and ascend with arc-like collaterals.

PATO:0070015.label: pyramidal family morphology
PATO:0070015.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have a pyramidal shaped soma, a single axon, a large apical dendrite and multiple basal dendrites.

PATO:0070016.label: horizontal pyramidal morphology
PATO:0070016.definition: A pyramidal family morphology that inheres in neurons which have an apical tree which is oriented parallel to the pia.

PATO:0070017.label: standard pyramidal morphology
PATO:0070017.definition: A pyramidal family morphology that inheres in neurons which have a standard pyramidal shape with its apical dendrite aligned vertically.

PATO:0070018.label: tufted pyramidal morphology
PATO:0070018.definition: A pyramidal cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have a distinct tuft formation, distal from the soma.

PATO:0070019.label: untufted pyramidal morphology
PATO:0070019.definition: A pyramidal cell morphology that inheres in neurons which lack a clear tuft formation but extend to large radial distances.

PATO:0070020.label: stellate pyramidal morphology
PATO:0070020.definition: A pyramidal cell morphology that inheres in neurons which lack a tuft formation but extend to small radial distances forming a star-like shape.

PATO:0070021.label: inverted pyramidal morphology
PATO:0070021.definition: A pyramidal cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have an apical tree which is oriented towards the white matter.

PATO:0070025.label: unipolar neuron morphology
PATO:0070025.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons with only one process, a neurite, that extends from the cell body. The neurite then branches to form dendritic and axonal processes.

PATO:0070026.label: multipolar neuron morphology
PATO:0070026.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which possess three or more neurites, usually a single axon and many dendrites and dendritic branches.

PATO:0070027.label: bitufted dendrite cell morphology
PATO:0070027.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons with dendrites that are bidirectional, emerging from opposite ends of the soma, with the two arbors extending in radial or tangential directions.

PATO:0070028.label: extratelencephalic projecting
PATO:0070028.definition: A neuron projection quality that is a characteristic of neurons whose soma is located in the telencephalon and that project to structures outside the telencephalon

PATO:0070029.label: corticothalamic projecting
PATO:0070029.definition: A neuron projection quality that is a characteristic of neurons with soma in the cerebral cortex and projections to the thalamus.

PATO:0070030.label: near projecting
PATO:0070030.definition: A neuron projection quality that is a characteristic of neurons with projections that terminate locally rather than distantly.

PATO:0070031.label: corticomedulla projecting
PATO:0070031.definition: A neuron projection quality that is a characteristic of neurons that project to the medulla oblongata from other brain regions.

PATO:0070033.label: neuron projection quality
PATO:0070033.definition: A physical quality inhering in a neuron by virtue of the relative location of its soma and the regions to which it projects and makes synaptic contacts in.

PATO:0070034.label: intratelencephalic projecting
PATO:0070034.definition: A neuron projection quality that is a characteristic of neurons with both soma and projections entirely within the telencephalon.

PATO:0070036.label: dendrite quality
PATO:0070036.definition: A quality inhering in a neuron's dendrites by virtue of the bearer's physical composition.

PATO:0070038.label: spiny dendrite quality
PATO:0070038.definition: A dendrite quality inhering in a neuron by virtue of the bearer's dendrite having spines.

PATO:0070039.label: tufted dendrite quality
PATO:0070039.definition: A dendrite quality inhering in a neuron by virtue of the bearer's dendrite having a terminal tuft.

PATO:0070040.label: aspiny dendrite quality
PATO:0070040.definition: A dendrite quality inhering in a neuron by virtue of the bearer's dendrite having few or no recognizable dendritic spines.

PATO:0070041.label: varicose dendrite quality
PATO:0070041.definition: A dendrite quality inhering in a neuron by virtue of the bearer's dendrite having numerous swellings or varicosities along their length.

PATO:0070042.label: retinal bipolar morphology
PATO:0070042.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in retinal neurons which have two principal fibres, an axon and a dendrite, that emerge from opposite end the soma.

PATO:0070044.label: anatomical structure quality
PATO:0070044.definition: A quality of continuant that exist at the anatomical level of organisation and anything under it. This includes, but is not limited to, cells , tissues, and components.

PATO:0070045.label: anatomical histological quality
PATO:0070045.definition: A quality inhering in an anotomical structure by virtue of its capacity to be stained by specific histological dyes.

PATO:0070046.label: neutrophillic
PATO:0070046.definition: An affinity inhering in an anatomical structure by virtue of the bearer exhibiting a molecular interaction that stains and colors, pale-pink, with Wright-Giemsa stain.

PATO:0070047.label: polychromatophilic
PATO:0070047.definition: An affinity inhering in an anatomical structure by virtue of the bearer exhibiting a molecular interaction for both basic and acid stains under specific pH conditions.

PATO:0070059.label: rusty
PATO:0070059.definition: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being covered by iron oxide as a result of oxidation.

PATO:0070060.label: quality of interaction of a substance with electromagnetic radiation
PATO:0070060.definition: A quality of a substance on which or through which electromagnetic radiation impinges or traverses with respect to radiation. This substance quality changes the quality of the incident radiation with respect to any of: intensity, direction, scatter and wavelength.

PATO:0070061.label: double bouquet morphology
PATO:0070061.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons with bitufted dendritic morphology but with the special feature of a tight fascicular axonal cylinder that resembles a 'horse tail'.

PATO:0070062.label: bistratified dendrite cell morphology
PATO:0070062.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons with dendrites that stratify at two and only two locations.

PATO:0070063.label: monostratified dendrite cell morphology
PATO:0070063.definition: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons with dendrites that stratify at one and only one location.

PATO:0070064.label: dendritic field size
PATO:0070064.definition: A 3-D extent quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the spatial region that is defined by the maximal span of the bearer's dendritic arbor.

PATO:0080001.label: quality of a fluid
PATO:0080001.definition: A physical quality inhering in an entity exhibiting the physical charachteristics of a material that flows under applied force.

PATO:0085001.label: salinity
PATO:0085001.definition: An osmolarity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the total amount of ionic salts dissolved in the bearer.

PATO:0095001.label: organismal area to mass ratio
PATO:0095001.definition: Quotient (or ratio) of surface area of an organism divided by the mass of the same organism

PATO:0095002.label: cursorial
PATO:0095002.definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's morphological and physiological adaptation for running.

PATO:0095003.label: fossorial
PATO:0095003.definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's morphological and physiological adaptation for digging and living underground.

PATO:0095004.label: arboreal
PATO:0095004.definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's morphological and physiological adaptation for living in trees.

PATO:0095005.label: crepuscular
PATO:0095005.definition: A quality of a process that happens during dawn and dusk.

PATO:0095006.label: nocturnal
PATO:0095006.definition: A quality of a process that happens during the hours of darkness.

PATO:0095007.label: diurnal
PATO:0095007.definition: A quality of a process that happens during the hours of daylight.

PATO:0095008.label: migratory
PATO:0095008.definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's morphological and physiological adaptation for participating in long-distance movement of conspecifics, usually on a seasonal basis.

PATO:0095009.label: anecic
PATO:0095009.definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to burrow more than 20 cm deep into the soil and make permanent, vertical burrows.

PATO:0102001.label: modifier characteristic
PATO:0102001.definition: A characteristic used to describe another characteristic.

PATO:0102002.label: comparative modifier characteristic
PATO:0102002.definition: A modifier characteristic determined by comparison to a reference.

PATO:0102003.label: increased
PATO:0102003.definition: A comparative modifier characteristic indicating that the bearer characteristic has a value greater than a reference.

PATO:0102004.label: decreased
PATO:0102004.definition: A comparative modifier characteristic indicating that the bearer characteristic has a value less than a reference.

PATO:0103000.label: obsolete quantitative
PATO:0103000.definition: OBSOLETE. A quality of an entity that can be represented numerically, including anything that can be counted, measured, or given a numerical value.

PATO:0103001.label: total mass
PATO:0103001.definition: A quantitative quality that represents the sum of all 'mass' qualities of the component parts that constitute a whole entity. The total mass quality inheres in the whole entity and reflects the aggregate measure of mass across all its components, such that changes in the mass of individual components may not necessarily correspond to equivalent changes in the total mass of the whole.nnExample of usage: "total body mass" represents the sum of the masses of all tissues and organs in the body, while "liver mass" represents only the mass of the liver. An increase in liver mass does not necessarily mean an increase in total body mass, as the mass of other organs or tissues may decrease simultaneously.

PATO:0103002.label: increased total mass
PATO:0103002.definition: A total mass which is higher than normal or average.

PATO:0103003.label: decreased total mass
PATO:0103003.definition: A total mass which is lower than normal or average.

PATO:0103004.label: total amount
PATO:0103004.definition: A quantitative quality that represents the sum of all 'amount' qualities of the component parts that constitute a whole entity. The total amount quality inheres in the whole entity and reflects the aggregate measure across all its components, such that changes in the amount of individual components may not necessarily correspond to equivalent changes in the total amount of the whole.nnExample of usage: "blood total protein amount" represents the sum of the amounts of all protein types in blood, while "blood leptin amount" represents only the amount of leptin proteins. An increase in blood leptin amount does not necessarily mean an increase in blood total protein amount, as other protein levels may decrease simultaneously.

PATO:0103005.label: decreased total amount
PATO:0103005.definition: A total amount which is relatively low.

PATO:0103006.label: increased total amount
PATO:0103006.definition: A total amount which is relatively high.

PATO:0103301.label: octoploid
PATO:0103301.definition: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing eight homologous sets of chromosomes.

PATO:0103302.label: allotetraploid
PATO:0103302.definition: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing four sets of chromosomes derived from two or more different species.

PATO:0103303.label: allohexaploid
PATO:0103303.definition: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing six sets of chromosomes derived from two or more different species.

PATO:0103304.label: segmental allotetraploid
PATO:0103304.definition: An allotetraploid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's two parental subgenomes being only partially differentiated (partially homeologous).

PATO:0104005.label: deep yellow
PATO:0104005.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 85 (deep yellow), for which the published central prototype is 4.0Y 6.0/9.5.

PATO:0104007.label: greyish green
PATO:0104007.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 150 (grayish green), for which the published central prototype is 9.0G 4.5/1.8.

PATO:0104010.label: papyraceous
PATO:0104010.definition: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being thin and somewhat opaque, with the consistency of paper.

PATO:0104013.label: greenish yellow
PATO:0104013.definition: A color whose Munsell coordinates fall within the continuous ISCC-NBS greenish-yellow sector represented by color-name blocks 97 through 105; moderate greenish yellow (block 102, centroid 9.5Y 7.2/6.6) is a central prototype.

PATO:0104016.label: terete
PATO:0104016.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being long and slender, tapering toward the apex, and circular in transverse section.

PATO:0104019.label: succulent
PATO:0104019.definition: A composition quality inhering in a plant or plant organ by virtue of the bearer containing living water-storage tissue whose relative capacitance and volume enable stored water to support physiological function while external water is unavailable.

PATO:0104020.label: blue green
PATO:0104020.definition: A color whose Munsell coordinates fall within the continuous ISCC-NBS bluish-green sector represented by color-name blocks 158 through 166; moderate bluish green (block 164, centroid 4.5BG 4.5/5.0) is a central prototype.

PATO:0104031.label: cream
PATO:0104031.definition: A color for which RHS Colour Chart chip 158A or 158B in the fifth edition (2007) is the closest visual match when the specimen is compared against a white background under artificial daylight conforming to CIE D6500; those chips serve as physical prototypes for cream in a botanical description.

PATO:0104032.label: coriaceous
PATO:0104032.definition: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being thick, tough, and flexible, with the consistency of leather.

PATO:0104035.label: pendent
PATO:0104035.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer hanging downward under its own weight.

PATO:0104041.label: velutinous
PATO:0104041.definition: A hairy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being covered with long, dense, straight trichomes that produce a velvet-like surface.

PATO:0104051.label: pale greenish yellow
PATO:0104051.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 104 (pale greenish yellow), for which the published central prototype is 9.5Y 8.9/4.1.

PATO:0104054.label: orange yellow
PATO:0104054.definition: A color whose Munsell coordinates fall within the continuous ISCC-NBS orange-yellow sector represented by color-name blocks 66 through 73; moderate orange yellow (block 71, centroid 9.0YR 7.2/8.1) is a central prototype.

PATO:0104059.label: pinkish white
PATO:0104059.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 9 (pinkish white), for which the published central prototype is 7.6R 9.2/1.0.

PATO:0104064.label: deep blue
PATO:0104064.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 179 (deep blue), for which the published central prototype is 3.0PB 2.0/9.0.

PATO:0104067.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 153 (greenish white), for which the published central prototype is 7.0G 9.2/0.8.

PATO:0104073.label: deep orange
PATO:0104073.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 51 (deep orange), for which the published central prototype is 4.5YR 5.0/12.1.

PATO:0104077.label: very pale blue
PATO:0104077.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 184 (very pale blue), for which the published central prototype is 0.9PB 8.4/3.0.

PATO:0104079.label: reddish purple
PATO:0104079.definition: A color whose Munsell coordinates fall within the continuous ISCC-NBS reddish-purple sector represented by color-name blocks 236 through 245; moderate reddish purple (block 241, centroid 1.0RP 4.5/7.2) is a central prototype.

PATO:0104085.label: deep purple
PATO:0104085.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 219 (deep purple), for which the published central prototype is 6.0P 2.8/10.2.

PATO:0104087.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 256 (deep purplish red), for which the published central prototype is 7.0RP 2.8/11.0.

PATO:0104112.label: orange red
PATO:0104112.definition: A color assigned to UPOV color group 33 (orange red) by comparison with the RHS Colour Chart; RHS 33B in the 2015 edition is a physical prototype.

PATO:0104114.label: yellowish green
PATO:0104114.definition: A color whose Munsell coordinates fall within the continuous ISCC-NBS yellowish-green sector represented by color-name blocks 129 through 138; moderate yellowish green (block 136, centroid 0.5G 5.5/5.1) is a central prototype.

PATO:0104117.label: bristly
PATO:0104117.definition: A hairy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being covered with stiff, strong hairs or hairlike projections; in plants, these projections are trichomes.

PATO:0104123.label: deep green
PATO:0104123.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 142 (deep green), for which the published central prototype is 6.0G 2.3/9.1.

PATO:0104151.label: dark pink
PATO:0104151.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 6 (dark pink), for which the published central prototype is 2.5R 6.0/6.0.

PATO:0104157.label: purplish black
PATO:0104157.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 235 (purplish black), for which the published central prototype is 10.0P 1.0/0.7.

PATO:0104159.label: dark purplish red
PATO:0104159.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 259 (dark purplish red), for which the published central prototype is 7.0RP 2.7/6.3.

PATO:0104189.label: deep red
PATO:0104189.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 13 (deep red), for which the published central prototype is 5.0R 2.8/9.9.

PATO:0104223.label: very pale green
PATO:0104223.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 148 (very pale green), for which the published central prototype is 9.0G 8.7/1.8.

PATO:0104242.label: pannose
PATO:0104242.definition: A hairy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being densely covered with short, matted, intertwined hairs that produce a felt-like surface.

PATO:0104277.label: glaucous
PATO:0104277.definition: A waxy quality of a plant surface in which a whitish bloom, often removable by rubbing, produces a dull blue-green appearance.

PATO:0104294.label: deep violet
PATO:0104294.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 208 (deep violet), for which the published central prototype is 1.0P 1.4/10.3.

PATO:0104305.label: bluish grey
PATO:0104305.definition: A color whose Munsell hue, value, and chroma fall within ISCC-NBS color-name block 191 (bluish gray), for which the published central prototype is 9.5B 5.5/1.0.

PATO:0104307.label: tessellated
PATO:0104307.definition: A spatial pattern in which colors or structural elements are arranged in quadrilateral units that produce a chequered appearance.

PATO:0104311.label: purplish red
PATO:0104311.definition: A color whose Munsell coordinates fall within the continuous ISCC-NBS purplish-red sector represented by color-name blocks 254 through 262; moderate purplish red (block 258, centroid 7.0RP 4.5/9.0) is a central prototype.

PATO:0104350.label: campanulate
PATO:0104350.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having an inflated tubular basal portion that widens gradually toward a distal limb or lobes.

PATO:0104351.label: filiform
PATO:0104351.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being long, very slender, and circular or nearly circular in transverse section, thereby resembling a thread.

PATO:0104352.label: hastate
PATO:0104352.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being flat and having two approximately triangular basal lobes directed outward to either side of the main axis.

PATO:0104353.label: reflexed
PATO:0104353.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being abruptly bent backward or abaxially downward.

PATO:0104354.label: winged
PATO:0104354.definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having one or more conspicuous, thin, flattened extensions that project from its main body.

PATO:0104355.label: ascending
PATO:0104355.definition: An oblique orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being directed gradually upward at an oblique angle.

PATO:0104356.label: spreading
PATO:0104356.definition: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being directed outward and diverging from a principal axis.

PATO:0104357.label: lanate
PATO:0104357.definition: A pilosity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being covered with long, somewhat matted and tangled trichomes that give a wool-like appearance.

PATO:0104358.label: sericeous
PATO:0104358.definition: A pilosity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being covered with long, soft, slender, appressed trichomes that give a silk-like appearance.

PATO:0104359.label: entire
PATO:0104359.definition: An edge shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's edge being continuous and even, without teeth, lobes, or other incisions.

PATO:0104360.label: annual life span
PATO:0104360.definition: A life span quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's expected natural life span being no more than one year.

PATO:0104361.label: perennial life span
PATO:0104361.definition: A life span quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's expected natural life span being more than two years.

PATO:0104362.label: dissected
PATO:0104362.definition: A split quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being divided, at least partially, by incisions into visibly distinct segments that may remain connected.

PATO:0104363.label: clasping
PATO:0104363.definition: An attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer at least partially enclosing an axis to which it is attached.

PATO:0104364.label: mealy
PATO:0104364.definition: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being covered with a coarse, flour-like powder.

PATO:0104365.label: plicate
PATO:0104365.definition: A folded quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being folded back and forth longitudinally like a fan.

PATO:0104366.label: floccose
PATO:0104366.definition: A pilosity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having tufts of long, soft hairs that tend to rub off as small wool-like masses.

PATO:0104367.label: biennial life span
PATO:0104367.definition: A life span quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's expected natural life span being more than one year and no more than two years.
