PECO:0007030.label: Leptochloa fascicularis exposure
PECO:0007030.definition: An exposure of a reference or experimental plant to the monocot plant Leptochloa fascicularis, found in its growth environment. This plant may be growing as a weed or as part of normal farming practices.

PECO:0007031.label: Mammalia exposure
PECO:0007031.definition: An exposure of a plant to mammalian animals that may damage the plant due to grazing or feeding practices.

PECO:0007033.label: rabi season exposure
PECO:0007033.definition: An exposure involving growth during the rabi crop season (October-March) as practiced in South Asia.

PECO:0007034.label: kharif season exposure
PECO:0007034.definition: An exposure involving growth during the kharif crop season (May-October) as practised in South Asia.

PECO:0007035.label: winter season exposure
PECO:0007035.definition: An exposure involving growth during the winter season.

PECO:0007036.label: summer season exposure
PECO:0007036.definition: An exposure involving growth during the summer season.

PECO:0007037.label: spring season exposure
PECO:0007037.definition: An exposure involving growth during the spring season.

PECO:0007038.label: autumn season exposure
PECO:0007038.definition: An exposure involving growth during the autumn season.

PECO:0007041.label: antibiotic exposure
PECO:0007041.definition: A chemical exposure (PECO:0007189) involving the use of antibiotic for selection purposes.

PECO:0007043.label: non-mineral nutrient exposure
PECO:0007043.definition: An exposure involving growth in the presence of non-mineral nutrients to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007044.label: mineral exposure
PECO:0007044.definition: An inorganic chemical exposure (PECO:0001004) involving the application of a mineral or a combination of minerals.

PECO:0007045.label: OBSOLETE primary plant macronutrient exposure
PECO:0007045.definition: OBSOLETE A plant macronutrient exposure (PECO:0007240)  involving the use of the primary plant macronutrients nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), and potassium (K).

PECO:0007046.label: secondary macronutrient exposure
PECO:0007046.definition: An exposure involving the use of macronutrients (Ca, Mg, S) as supplement to study various types of responses. These macronutrients are used less often as fertilizers than the primary elements.

PECO:0007047.label: other nutrient exposure
PECO:0007047.definition: An exposure involving the exposure of plant to elemental forms of nutrients as supplement. These are not considered essential elements.

PECO:0007048.label: sodium chloride exposure
PECO:0007048.definition: An exposure involving the use of sodium chloride salt in the growth media.

PECO:0007049.label: soil environment exposure
PECO:0007049.definition: An exposure involving growing plants in soil growth media with varying contents.

PECO:0007050.label: soil texture exposure
PECO:0007050.definition: An exposure involving growing plants in varying textures of soil growth media.

PECO:0007051.label: sand content exposure
PECO:0007051.definition: An exposure involving growing plants in a sandy soil growth media.

PECO:0007052.label: organic matter content exposure
PECO:0007052.definition: An exposure involving growing plants in a growth media containing organic matter.

PECO:0007053.label: silt content exposure
PECO:0007053.definition: An exposure involving growing plants in a silty soil growth media.

PECO:0007054.label: clay content exposure
PECO:0007054.definition: An exposure involving growing plants in a clay soil growth media.

PECO:0007055.label: Cochliobolus spp. exposure
PECO:0007055.definition: An Ascomycota exposure (PECO:0007107) involving the exposure of a plant with the pathogen Cochliobolus spp.

PECO:0007056.label: OBSOLETE soil flora
PECO:0007056.definition: OBSOLETE: A treatment involving growing plants and  exposing them to varying types of flora in soil growth media.

PECO:0007057.label: OBSOLETE soil fauna
PECO:0007057.definition: OBSOLETE: A treatment involving growing plants and  exposing them to varying types of fauna in soil growth media.

PECO:0007058.label: soil pH exposure
PECO:0007058.definition: An exposure involving growing plants in soil growth media of varying pH levels.

PECO:0007059.label: acidic pH soil exposure
PECO:0007059.definition: An exposure involving growing plants in acidic (low pH) soil growth media.

PECO:0007060.label: Sphaerulina oryzina exposure
PECO:0007060.definition: An Ascomycota exposure (PECO:0007107) involving the exposure of plant to the pathogen Sphaerulina oryzina.

PECO:0007061.label: tropical region exposure
PECO:0007061.definition: An exposure involving growth of a plant in the geographical region of the Earth limited in latitude by the two tropics, the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn, and thus centered on the equator.

PECO:0007062.label: basic pH soil exposure
PECO:0007062.definition: An exposure involving growing plants in basic (high pH) soil growth media.

PECO:0007063.label: diuron exposure
PECO:0007063.definition: A herbicide exposure (PECO:0007183) involving the use of diuron (DCMU).

PECO:0007064.label: ecological environment exposure
PECO:0007064.definition: A plant exposure (PECO:0001001) involving exposure to the various factors that comprise a geographical/regional location.

PECO:0007065.label: Entyloma oryzae exposure
PECO:0007065.definition: An exposure involving the growth of a plant with the pathogen Entyloma oryzae. It is a causal agent for rice Leaf Smut disease.

PECO:0007066.label: cytokinin exposure
PECO:0007066.definition: A growth hormone exposure (PECO:0007165) involving the use of a cytokinin.

PECO:0007067.label: hydroponic plant culture media exposure
PECO:0007067.definition: A plant growth medium exposure (PECO:0007147) involving growing plants in liquid growth media.

PECO:0007068.label: ethylene exposure
PECO:0007068.definition: A growth hormone exposure (PECO:0007165) involving the use of ethylene (or its homolog) growth hormone.

PECO:0007069.label: gibberellic acid exposure
PECO:0007069.definition: A growth hormone exposure (PECO:0007165) involving the use of GA (or its homolog) growth hormone.

PECO:0007070.label: indole acetic acid exposure
PECO:0007070.definition: An auxin exposure (PECO:0007074) involving the use of indole acetic acid.

PECO:0007071.label: suspension cell culture medium exposure
PECO:0007071.definition: An exposure involving liquid growth medium for cell cultured samples.

PECO:0007072.label: Microdochium oryzae exposure
PECO:0007072.definition: An exposure involving the growth of a plant with the pathogen Microdochium oryzae. It is a causal agent for rice various forms of Leaf scald disease such as Brown Leaf Blight Disease , Leaf Sheath Browning Disease, Leaf Tip Blight Disease and Leaf Tip Dying Disease.

PECO:0007073.label: Basidiomycota exposure
PECO:0007073.definition: A fungal plant exposure (PECO:0007233) involving the exposure of plant to a fungal pathogen belonging to Basidiomycetes class.

PECO:0007074.label: auxin exposure
PECO:0007074.definition: A plant growth hormone exposure (PECO:0007165) involving the use of an auxin.

PECO:0007075.label: high light intensity exposure
PECO:0007075.definition: A light intensity exposure (PECO:0007224) where the intensity of the light for plant growth is between 500–1,000 foot-candles.

PECO:0007076.label: moderate light intensity exposure
PECO:0007076.definition: A light intensity exposure (PECO:0007224) where the intensity of the light for plant growth is between 200–1,000 foot-candles.

PECO:0007077.label: Tilletia barclayana exposure
PECO:0007077.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pathogen Tilletia barclayana. It is a causal agent for rice Kernel Smut disease.

PECO:0007078.label: light quantity exposure
PECO:0007078.definition: In biological experiments often it refer to the length of the exposure time. The treatment also includes the quantity of light falling on a per unit area. This may be expressed either in terms of hours for which teh radiation was available or in the units of luminous flux or the lumens.

PECO:0007079.label: OBSOLETE sulfate fertilizer exposure
PECO:0007079.definition: OBSOLETE Treatment involving the use of sulfate fertilizer and its components as supplements to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007080.label: jasmonic acid exposure
PECO:0007080.definition: A growth hormone exposure (PECO:0007165) involving the use of JA (or its homolog).

PECO:0007081.label: riverbank region exposure
PECO:0007081.definition: A flood-prone region exposure (PECO:0007396) in which a plant is growing on the side of a river where flooding can occur.

PECO:0007082.label: sea coast region exposure
PECO:0007082.definition: A flood-prone region exposure (PECO:0007396) in which a plant is growing near the edge of an ocean where flooding can occur.

PECO:0007083.label: Phoma sorghina exposure
PECO:0007083.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pathogen Phoma sorghina.

PECO:0007084.label: other animals exposure
PECO:0007084.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pests that do not falll under the well known classes of birds, mammals, insects, nematode and molluscs.

PECO:0007085.label: OBSOLETE fertilizer exposure
PECO:0007085.definition: OBSOLETE A plant nutrient exposure (PECO:0007241) involving the use of a fertilizer, a combination of plant nutrients.

PECO:0007086.label: OBSOLETE chemical fertilizer exposure
PECO:0007086.definition: OBSOLETE  Treatment involving the use of inorganic fertilizer and its components as supplements to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007087.label: natural fertilizer exposure
PECO:0007087.definition: Treatment involving the use of organic fertilizer and its component as supplements to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007088.label: Ceratobasidium oryzae-sativae exposure
PECO:0007088.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pathogen Ceratobasidium oryzae-sativae. It is a causal agent for rice Aggregate Sheath Spot disease, which is also known as Brown Sclerotial disease.

PECO:0007089.label: bone meal exposure
PECO:0007089.definition: A natural fertilizer exposure (PECO:0007087) which is the application of bone meal.

PECO:0007090.label: ammonium nitrate exposure
PECO:0007090.definition: Treatment involving the use of ammonium nitrate supplement to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007091.label: seaweed extract exposure
PECO:0007091.definition: A natural fertilizer exposure (PECO:0007087) which is the application of seaweed extract.

PECO:0007092.label: wood ash exposure
PECO:0007092.definition: A natural fertilizer exposure (PECO:0007087) which is the application of wood ash.

PECO:0007093.label: fish meal exposure
PECO:0007093.definition: A natural fertilizer exposure (PECO:0007087) which is the application of fish meal.

PECO:0007094.label: sodium nitrate exposure
PECO:0007094.definition: Treatment involving the use of sodium nitrate supplement to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007095.label: calcium nitrate exposure
PECO:0007095.definition: Treatment involving the use of calcium nitrate supplement to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007096.label: potassium nitrate exposure
PECO:0007096.definition: Treatment involving the use of potassiumium nitrate supplement to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007097.label: ammonium sulfate exposure
PECO:0007097.definition: Treatment involving the use of ammonium sulfate supplement to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007098.label: ferrous sulfate exposure
PECO:0007098.definition: Treatment involving the use of ferrous sulfate supplement to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007099.label: potassium sulfate exposure
PECO:0007099.definition: Treatment involving the use of potassium sulfate supplement to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007100.label: superphosphate exposure
PECO:0007100.definition: Treatment involving the use of super phosphate supplement to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007101.label: urea exposure
PECO:0007101.definition: Treatment involving the use of urea as source of nitrogen supplement to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007102.label: nitrogen exposure
PECO:0007102.definition: Treatment involving the use of nitrogen fertilizer and its components as supplements to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007103.label: OBSOLETE phosphate fertilizer exposure
PECO:0007103.definition: OBSOLETE  Treatment involving the use of phosphate fertilizer and its components as supplements to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007104.label: NPK fertilizer exposure
PECO:0007104.definition: Treatment involving the use of nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium supplements to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007105.label: abscisic acid exposure
PECO:0007105.definition: A plant growth hormone exposure (PECO:0007165) involving the use of abscisic acid.

PECO:0007106.label: Stramenopiles exposure
PECO:0007106.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the Stramenopiles (heterokonts) present in the growth environment.

PECO:0007107.label: Ascomycota exposure
PECO:0007107.definition: A fungal plant exposure (PECO:0007233) involving the exposure of plant to a fungal pathogen belonging to Ascomycetes class.

PECO:0007108.label: OBSOLETE Proteobacterial plant exposure
PECO:0007108.definition: OBSOLETE: A bacterial plant exposure (PECO:0007246) involving the exposure of bacteria of the Proteobacteria.

PECO:0007109.label: ssRNA positive-strand virus with no DNA stage exposure
PECO:0007109.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pathogenic single strand RNA positive stand virus.

synonyms.label: ssRNA positive-strand virus with no DNA stage treatment (narrow)

PECO:0007110.label: dsRNA virus exposure
PECO:0007110.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pathogenic double stranded RNA virus.

PECO:0007111.label: ssRNA negative-strand virus exposure
PECO:0007111.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pathogenic single strand RNA negative stand virus.

PECO:0007112.label: retroid virus exposure
PECO:0007112.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pathogenic retroid virus.

PECO:0007113.label: rice necrosis mosaic virus exposure
PECO:0007113.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the rice necrosis mosaic virus. It is a causal agent for rice necrosis mosaic disease.

PECO:0007114.label: Lepidoptera exposure
PECO:0007114.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pest of lepidoptera class.

PECO:0007115.label: Spodoptera spp. exposure
PECO:0007115.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pest Spodoptera spp.

PECO:0007116.label: Hemiptera insect plant exposure
PECO:0007116.definition: An insect plant exposure (PECO:0007333) involving the exposure of a plant to an insect(s) of the Hemiptera order.

PECO:0007117.label: Pseudaletia spp. exposure
PECO:0007117.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pest rice army worm.

PECO:0007118.label: Gibberella spp. exposure
PECO:0007118.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pathogen Gibberella spp.

PECO:0007119.label: Dipteran insect plant exposure
PECO:0007119.definition: An insect plant exposure (PECO:0007333) involving the exposure of a plant to an insect(s) of the Diptera order.

PECO:0007120.label: Coleoptera exposure
PECO:0007120.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pest commonly called as beetles or Coleoptera.

PECO:0007121.label: Thysanoptera exposure
PECO:0007121.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pest of Thysanoptera class.

PECO:0007122.label: Chilo exposure
PECO:0007122.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pest Chilo.

PECO:0007123.label: Eysarcoris trimaculatus exposure
PECO:0007123.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pest rice spotting bug.

PECO:0007124.label: OBSOLETE pest/pathogen/animal/plant environment
PECO:0007124.definition: OBSOLETE: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pest/pathogen/animal/plants present as part of its growth environment.

PECO:0007126.label: Hirschmaniella spp. exposure
PECO:0007126.definition: Treatment involving the exposure of plant to the pest Hirschmaniella spp. It is a causal agent for rice root nematode disease.

PECO:0007127.label: Meloidogyne spp. exposure
PECO:0007127.definition: A plant nematode exposure (PECO:0007337) which is the exposure of a plant structure (PO:0009011) to a Meloidogyne sp. nematode.

PECO:0007128.label: intermittent light exposure
PECO:0007128.definition: In biological experiments it refer to the intermittent exposure of plant to the cycles of light and dark or one light Vs the another type of light.

PECO:0007129.label: UV-C light exposure
PECO:0007129.definition: An ultraviolet light (PECO:0007222) exposure involving light in the wavelength range of 100-280 nm.

PECO:0007130.label: near infrared light exposure
PECO:0007130.definition: The treatment using infrared light that contains energy in the range of wavelengths 750-1300 nm, which is closest to visible light.

PECO:0007131.label: middle infrared light exposure
PECO:0007131.definition: The treatment using middle infrared light involving middle light that contains energy in the range of wavelengths 1300-3000 nm.

PECO:0007132.label: far infrared light exposure
PECO:0007132.definition: The treatment using far infrared light involving light that contains energy in the range of wavelengths 3000-14000 nm.

PECO:0007133.label: basic pH growth media environment exposure
PECO:0007133.definition: The treatment involving an exposure to basic pH levels of the growth media.

synonyms.label: basic pH growth media environment treatment (narrow)

PECO:0007134.label: acidic pH growth media environment exposure
PECO:0007134.definition: The treatment involving an exposure to acidic pH levels of the growth media.

synonyms.label: acidic pH growth media environment treatment (narrow)

PECO:0007135.label: Magnaporthe spp. exposure
PECO:0007135.definition: The treatment involving an exposure of plant to the pathogen Magnaporthe spp.

PECO:0007136.label: Achlya sp. exposure
PECO:0007136.definition: An Oomycota exposure (PECO:0001074) involving the exposure of a plant structure (PO:0009011) to an Achyla sp. organism.

PECO:0007137.label: Echinochloa spp. exposure
PECO:0007137.definition: The treatment involving an exposure of reference/experimental plant to monocot plant genus Echinochloa found in its growth environment. This plant may be growing as a weed or as part of normal farming practices.

PECO:0007138.label: Echinodorus spp. exposure
PECO:0007138.definition: The treatment involving an exposure of reference/experimental plant to monocot plant genus Echinodorus found in its growth environment. This plant may be growing as a weed or as part of normal farming practices.

PECO:0007139.label: Sagittaria spp. exposure
PECO:0007139.definition: The treatment involving an exposure of reference/experimental plant to monocot plant genus Sagittaria found in its growth environment. This plant may be growing as a weed or as part of normal farming practices.

PECO:0007140.label: Scirpus spp. exposure
PECO:0007140.definition: The treatment involving an exposure of reference/experimental plant to monocot plant genus Scirpus found in its growth environment. This plant may be growing as a weed or as part of normal farming practices.

PECO:0007141.label: Cyperus spp. exposure
PECO:0007141.definition: The treatment involving an exposure of reference/experimental plant to monocot plant genus Cyperus found in its growth environment. This plant may be growing as a weed or as part of normal farming practices.

PECO:0007142.label: Scirpophaga spp. exposure
PECO:0007142.definition: The treatment involving an exposure of plant to the pest Scirpophaga spp.

PECO:0007143.label: Erwinia plant exposure
PECO:0007143.definition: A bacterial plant exposure (PECO:0007246) involving the exposure to bacteria of the genus Erwinia.

PECO:0007144.label: Pseudomonas plant exposure
PECO:0007144.definition: A bacterial plant exposure (PECO:0007246) involving the exposure to bacteria of the genus Pseudomonas.

PECO:0007145.label: Xanthomonas plant exposure
PECO:0007145.definition: A bacterial plant exposure (PECO:0007246) involving the exposure to bacteria of the genus Xanthomonas.

PECO:0007146.label: gravity exposure
PECO:0007146.definition: A physical plant exposure (PECO:0007316) involving a treatment or exposure of a plant structure (PO:0009011) to different levels of gravity.

PECO:0007147.label: plant growth medium exposure
PECO:0007147.definition: An abiotic plant exposure (PECO:0007191) involving the use of a solid or liquid substrate for growing plants or tissue-cultured plant samples.

PECO:0007148.label: Xanthomonas oryzae exposure
PECO:0007148.definition: The treatment involving an exposure of plant to the pathogen Xanthomonas oryzae. It is a causal agent for rice bacterial blight disease.

PECO:0007149.label: chemical mutagen exposure
PECO:0007149.definition: A chemical exposure (PECO:0007189) involving use of mutagen for the mutagenesis process.

PECO:0007151.label: radiation exposure
PECO:0007151.definition: A physical plant exposure (PECO:0007316) involvinga treatment or exposure of a plant structure (PO:0009011) with a radiation type, intensity or quantity.

PECO:0007152.label: radiation intensity exposure
PECO:0007152.definition: The treatment involving amount of energy of any radiation incident upon (or flowing through) unit area, in unit time.

PECO:0007153.label: radiation quantity exposure
PECO:0007153.definition: In biological experiments it refer to the treatment involving radiation in terms of length of the exposure time. It also includes the quantity of radiation falling on a per unit area. This is expressed in the units of luminous flux or the lumens.

PECO:0007154.label: radiation quality exposure
PECO:0007154.definition: The treatment involving an exposure to a given type of radiation. Often it is in the form of electromagnetic and ionizing radiation such as light (infrared, visible or ultraviolet), x-rays, gamma rays, etc.

PECO:0007155.label: soil type exposure
PECO:0007155.definition: The treatment involving growing plants in different types of soil growth media.

PECO:0007156.label: clay soil exposure
PECO:0007156.definition: A soil type exposure (PECO:0007155) involving a treatment or exposure of a plant structure (PO:0009011) to clay soil.

PECO:0007157.label: loam soil exposure
PECO:0007157.definition: A soil type exposure (PECO:0007155) involving a treatment or exposure of a plant structure (PO:0009011) to loam soil.

PECO:0007158.label: sandy soil exposure
PECO:0007158.definition: A soil type exposure (PECO:0007155) involving a treatment or exposure of a plant structure (PO:0009011) to sandy soil.

PECO:0007159.label: sandy loam soil exposure
PECO:0007159.definition: A soil type exposure (PECO:0007155) involving a treatment or exposure of a plant structure (PO:0009011) to sandy loam soil.

PECO:0007160.label: OBSOLETE water temperature exposure
PECO:0007160.definition: OBSOLETE The treatment involving an exposure to water with varying degree of temperature, which may depend on regional environment.

PECO:0007161.label: OBSOLETE air temperature exposure
PECO:0007161.definition: OBSOLETE The treatment involving an exposure to wind with varying degree of temperature, which may depend on the study type or the regional environment.

PECO:0007162.label: continuous light exposure
PECO:0007162.definition: The treatment involving continuous exposure of light to the plant.

PECO:0007163.label: day light exposure
PECO:0007163.definition: The treatment involving an exposure of plant to the scheduled or natural exposure of day light and night cycles to the plant.

PECO:0007164.label: standing deep water exposure
PECO:0007164.definition: The treatment involving an exposure to standing water during whole life span of the plant. This also results in anaerobic soil conditions for a long period.

PECO:0007165.label: plant growth hormone exposure
PECO:0007165.definition: A chemical exposure (PECO:0007189) involving the application of one or more plant growth hormones.

PECO:0007166.label: Pythium spinosum exposure
PECO:0007166.definition: The treatment involving an exposure of plant to the Pythium spinosum. It is a causal agent for rice seedling blight (fungal) or feeder root necrosis or water mold dieases. Water mold diease is also called as seed rot or seedling damping-off disease.

PECO:0007167.label: pesticide exposure
PECO:0007167.definition: A chemical exposure (PECO:0007189) involving the application of a pesticide; a chemical entity or mixture of chemical entities.

PECO:0007168.label: hygromycin exposure
PECO:0007168.definition: An antibiotic exposure (PECO:0007041) involving use of hygromycin B antibiotic for selection purposes.

PECO:0007171.label: pH exposure
PECO:0007171.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plants to varying levels of pH of the growth media.

PECO:0007172.label: flood water exposure
PECO:0007172.definition: The treatment involving an exposure to standing water from flash floods for a small part of plant's life span. This also results in anaerobic soil conditions for a short period.

PECO:0007173.label: high temperature exposure
PECO:0007173.definition: The treatment involving an exposure to above optimal temperature.

PECO:0007174.label: cold temperature exposure
PECO:0007174.definition: The treatment involving an exposure to cold or sub-optimal temperature.

PECO:0007175.label: temperature exposure
PECO:0007175.definition: A physical plant exposure (PECO:0007316) involving a treatment or exposure of a plant structure (PO:0009011) to variations in temperature.

PECO:0007176.label: altitude exposure
PECO:0007176.definition: An ecological environment exposure (PECO:0007064) involving growth at a given elevation or height above sea level.

PECO:0007177.label: Pythium myriotylum exposure
PECO:0007177.definition: Suggests the exposure of plant to the Pythium myriotylum. It is a causal agent for rice feeder root necrosis disease.

PECO:0007178.label: atmospheric pressure exposure
PECO:0007178.definition: An ecological environment exposure (PECO:0007064) involving growth at a given air pressure.

PECO:0007179.label: Pythium irregulare exposure
PECO:0007179.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the Pythium irregulare. It is a causal agent for rice feeder root necrosis disease.

PECO:0007180.label: 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid exposure
PECO:0007180.definition: An auxin exposure (PECO:0007074) involving use of 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid.

PECO:0007181.label: rainfall exposure
PECO:0007181.definition: The treatment involving an exposure to a given amount of rainfall.

PECO:0007182.label: Pythium graminicola exposure
PECO:0007182.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the Pythium graminicola. It is a causal agent for rice feeder root necrosis disease.

PECO:0007183.label: herbicide exposure
PECO:0007183.definition: A pesticide exposure (PECO:0007167) involving the application of a herbicide; a chemical entity or mixture of chemical entities.

PECO:0007184.label: Pythium dissotocum exposure
PECO:0007184.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the Pythium dissotocum. It is a causal agent for rice seedling blight (fungal) or water mold dieases. Water mold diease is also called as seed rot or seedling damping-off disease.

PECO:0007185.label: OBSOLETE salt exposure
PECO:0007185.definition: A chemical exposure (PECO:0007189) involving use of salts as supplement to liquid and soil growth media to study various types of responses on their application.

PECO:0007186.label: Pythium catenulatum exposure
PECO:0007186.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the Pythium catenulatum. It is a causal agent for rice feeder root necrosis disease.

PECO:0007187.label: salicylic acid exposure
PECO:0007187.definition: An organic chemical exposure (PECO:0001003) involving the application of salicylic acid (CHEBI:16914).

PECO:0007188.label: Pythium arrhenomanes exposure
PECO:0007188.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the Pythium arrhenomanes. It is a causal agent for rice feeder root necrosis disease.

PECO:0007189.label: chemical exposure
PECO:0007189.definition: An abiotic plant exposure (PECO:0007191) involving the application of chemical(s).

PECO:0007190.label: Ustilaginoidea virens exposure
PECO:0007190.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the pathogen Ustilaginoidea virens. It is a causal agent for rice False Smut Disease also called as Green Smut disease.

PECO:0007191.label: abiotic plant exposure
PECO:0007191.definition: A plant exposure (PECO:0001001) involving the application of chemical or non-biological factors.

PECO:0007192.label: Drechslera gigantea exposure
PECO:0007192.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the pathogen Drechslera gigantea. It is a causal agent for rice Eyespot disease.

PECO:0007194.label: Sclerophthora macrospora exposure
PECO:0007194.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the pathogen Sclerophthora macrospora. It is a causal agent for rice Downy Mildew disease.

PECO:0007195.label: rice ragged stunt virus exposure
PECO:0007195.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the rice ragged stunt virus. It is a causal agent for rice ragged stunt disease.

PECO:0007196.label: OBSOLETE light exposure
PECO:0007196.definition: OBSOLETE The treatment involving day light as the light of the sun or the artificial light in a growth chamber.

PECO:0007197.label: humidity exposure
PECO:0007197.definition: The treatment involving an exposure to varying degree of humidity, which may depend on regional environment.

PECO:0007198.label: water environment exposure
PECO:0007198.definition: A physical plant exposure (PECO:0007316) involving an exposure of varying amounts of water and watering frequencies, which may depend on regional environment.

PECO:0007199.label: long day length exposure
PECO:0007199.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to long day light duration followed by a short night cycle.

PECO:0007200.label: short day length exposure
PECO:0007200.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to short day light duration followed by a long night cycle.

PECO:0007373.definition: A physical plant exposure (PECO:0007316) involving a treatment or exposure of a plant structure (PO:0009011) to mechanical damage.

PECO:0007374.label: Cylindrocladium scoparium exposure
PECO:0007374.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the pathogen Cylindrocladium scoparium. It is a causal agent for rice Sheath Net Blotch Disease.

PECO:0007375.label: Meloidogyne graminicola exposure
PECO:0007375.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the pest Meloidogyne graminicola.

PECO:0007376.label: Pyrenochaeta oryzae exposure
PECO:0007376.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the pathogen Pyrenochaeta oryzae. It is a causal agent for rice Sheath Blotch Disease.

PECO:0007377.label: Athelia rolfsii exposure
PECO:0007377.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the pathogen Athelia rolfsii. It is a causal agent for rice Seedling Blight (Fungal) disease.

PECO:0007378.label: Sarocladium oryzae exposure
PECO:0007378.definition: An Ascomycota exposure (PECO:0007107) involving exposure of plant to the pathogen Sarocladium oryzae. It is a causal agent for rice Seedling Blight (Fungal) disease and/or Sheath Rot disease.

PECO:0007379.label: Thanatephorus cucumeris exposure
PECO:0007379.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the pathogen Thanatephorus cucumeris.

PECO:0007382.label: wind environment exposure
PECO:0007382.definition: The treatment involving an exposure to wind, which may depend on regional environment.

PECO:0007383.label: watering exposure
PECO:0007383.definition: The treatment involving an exposure to watering frequencies.

PECO:0007384.label: freezing air temperature exposure
PECO:0007384.definition: The treatment involving an exposure to frost or freezing air temperature, which may depend on the study type or the regional environment. This temperature is either below or around 4C.

PECO:0007385.label: irrigated land region exposure
PECO:0007385.definition: The treatment to plants or the populations grown in the regions where the land is leveled, may have bunded fields with water control, shallow. For rice flooded with anaoerobic soil during crop growth.

PECO:0007386.label: Gerlachia oryzae exposure
PECO:0007386.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the pathogen Gerlachia oryzae. It is a causal agent for a form of rice Seedling Blight (Fungal) disease.

PECO:0007387.label: manganese nutrient exposure
PECO:0007387.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to micronutrient manganese as supplement to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007388.label: Alternaria padwickii exposure
PECO:0007388.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the pathogen Alternaria padwickii. It is a causal agent for rice seedling blight (fungal) disease and/or stackburn disease also called as Alternaria Leaf Spot Disease.

PECO:0007389.label: Gibberella zeae exposure
PECO:0007389.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to the pathogen Gibberella zeae. It is a causal agent for rice Scab disease.

PECO:0007391.label: lowland region exposure
PECO:0007391.definition: The treatment involving the plant or the populations grown in regions where the land level is slightly steep, noncontinuous flooding of variable depth and duration. Alternatingconditions of aerobic to anaerobic soil.

PECO:0007392.label: upland region exposure
PECO:0007392.definition: The treatment involving the plant or the populations grown in regions where the land level is steep, rarely flodded and has aerobic soil.

PECO:0007394.label: desert-like region exposure
PECO:0007394.definition: The treatment involving an exposure to the conditions found in a type of biome characterized by low moisture levels and infrequent and unpredictable precipitation or rainfall.

PECO:0007395.label: river delta region exposure
PECO:0007395.definition: A flood-prone region exposure (PECO:0007396) in which a plant is growing in the delta of a river where flooding can occur.

PECO:0007396.label: flood-prone region exposure
PECO:0007396.definition: An ecological environment exposure (PECO:0007064) involving a plant's exposure to growth conditions susceptible to inundation by water.

PECO:0007397.label: phosphorus nutrient exposure
PECO:0007397.definition: The treatment involving exposure of plant to macronutrient phosphorus as supplement to study various types of responses.

PECO:0007398.label: sub-tropical region exposure
PECO:0007398.definition: The treatment involving the plant or the populations grown in regions that are adjacent to the tropics, usually roughly defined as the ranges 25-40 N and 25-40 S latitude. These areas typically have hot tropical summers, but non-tropical winters.

PECO:0007399.label: freezing water temperature exposure
PECO:0007399.definition: The treatment involving an exposure to frost or  freezing water temperature, which may depend on the study type or the regional environment. This temperature is either below or around 4C.

PECO:0007400.label: arid region exposure
PECO:0007400.definition: The treatment involving the plant or the populations grown in regions where the land is excessively dry and receives insufficient rainfall to support agriculture.

PECO:0007401.label: semiarid region exposure
PECO:0007401.definition: The treatment involving the plant or the populations grown in regions where the total annual rainfall received in the range of 25-50cm (10-20 inches).

PECO:0007402.label: fungal elicitor exposure
PECO:0007402.definition: A chemical exposure (PECO:0007189) that involves the use of a fungal elicitor to study various types of plant responses.

PECO:0007403.label: OBSOLETE unknown exposure

PECO:0007404.label: drought exposure

PECO:0007406.label: nitrate exposure

PO:0000016.label: lateral root primordium
PO:0000016.definition: A root primordium (PO:0005029) that is part of a root (PO:0009005) and is committed to the development of a lateral root (PO:0020121).

PO:0000017.label: vascular leaf primordium
PO:0000017.definition: A phyllome primordium (PO:0025128) that develops from a vascular leaf anlagen (PO:0025431) and is part of a vegetative shoot apex (PO:0025223) and is committed to the development of a vascular leaf (PO:0009025).

PO:0000018.label: ovule primordium

PO:0000019.label: gynoecium primordium
PO:0000019.definition: A floral structure primordium (PO:0025477) that is committed to the development of a gynoecium (PO:0009062).

PO:0000035.definition: A vascular system (PO:0000034) that is part of a cotyledon (PO:0020030).

PO:0000036.label: leaf vascular system
PO:0000036.definition: A phyllome vascular system (PO:0025206) that includes the totality of the portions of vascular tissue in their specific arrangement in a vascular leaf (PO:0009025).

synonyms.label: sistema vascular de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0000037.label: shoot axis apex
PO:0000037.definition: A shoot axis (PO:0025029) that is the most distal part of a shoot system (PO:0009006) and has as parts a shoot apical meristem (PO:0020148) and the youngest primordia (PO:0025127).

PO:0000038.label: primary endosperm cell
PO:0000038.definition: Cell produced by the fusion of sperm cell nucleus and two polar nuclei of the central cell (or diploid secondary endosperm nucleus, in cases where two polar nuclei fuse together before double fertilization). The first cell of the endosperm, often triploid.

PO:0000039.label: shoot axis vascular system
PO:0000039.definition: A vascular system (PO:0000034) that includes the totality of the portions of vascular tissue in their specific arrangement in a shoot axis (PO:0025029).

synonyms.label: sistema vascular del eje del epiblasto (epiblastema) (Spanish, exact)
シュート軸維管系 (Japanese, exact)

relationships: part_of PO:0025205 ! shoot system vascular system

PO:0000040.label: adventitious root nodule
PO:0000040.definition: Enlargement or swelling at position of dormant adventitious root primordium (on the stem), inhabited by nitrogen-fixing bacteria.

synonyms.label: n&#243dulo de la ra&#237z adventicia (Spanish, exact)

PO:0000041.label: epidermal cork cell
PO:0000041.definition: One of the two types of short cells in the epidermis of grasses and bamboos. It is usually paired with silica cell.

PO:0000042.label: shoot-borne root
PO:0000042.definition: A root (PO:0009005) that develops from shoot axis (PO:0025029) tissue.

synonyms.label: epiblasto (epiblastema) que se origina en la ra&#237z (Spanish, exact)
シュート細胞由来の根  (Japanese, exact)

PO:0000043.label: crown root
PO:0000043.definition: A shoot-borne nodal root (PO:0003005) formed at a stem base (PO:0008039).

PO:0000044.label: prop root
PO:0000044.definition: A shoot-borne nodal root (PO:0003005) formed at a stem node (PO:0020141) above the ground and growing directly into the soil.

synonyms.label: 支柱根、支持根、支柱気根 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0000045.label: embryo root
PO:0000045.definition: A root (PO:0009005) that is initiated in a developing plant embryo (PO:0009009).

PO:0000046.label: seminal root
PO:0000046.definition: An embryo root (PO:0000045) formed within the scutellar node (PO:0004708) of the plant embryo (PO:0009009) in some monocotyledonous plants.

PO:0000047.label: leaf lamina epidermis
PO:0000047.definition: A portion of leaf epidermis (PO:0006016) that is part of a leaf lamina (PO:0020039).

synonyms.label: epidermis de la l&#225mina de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0000048.label: leaf lamina vascular system
PO:0000048.definition: A vascular system (PO:0000034) that includes the totality of the portions of vascular tissue in their specific arrangement in a leaf lamina (PO:0020039).

synonyms.label: sistema vascular de la l&#225mina de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0000049.label: leaf lamina abaxial epidermis
PO:0000049.definition: A portion of leaf lamina epidermis (PO:0000047) that covers the abaxial/lower surface of a leaf lamina (PO:0020039).

synonyms.label: epidermis abaxial de la l&#225mina de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0000050.label: leaf lamina adaxial epidermis
PO:0000050.definition: A portion of leaf lamina epidermis (PO:0000047) that covers the adaxial/upper surface of a leaf lamina (PO:0020039).

synonyms.label: epidermis adaxial de la l&#225mina de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0000051.label: petiole epidermis
PO:0000051.definition: A portion of leaf epidermis (PO:0006016) that is part of a petiole (PO:0020038).

PO:0000052.label: petiole vascular system
PO:0000052.definition: A vascular system (PO:0000034) that includes the totality of the portions of vascular tissue in their specific arrangement in a petiole (PO:0020038).

PO:0000053.label: petiole cortex
PO:0000053.definition: A portion of cortex (PO:0005708) that is part of a petiole (PO:0020038).

PO:0000054.label: petal vascular system
PO:0000054.definition: A phyllome vascular system (PO:0025206) that includes the totality of the portions of vascular tissue in their specific arrangement in a petal (PO:0025218).

PO:0000056.label: flower bud
PO:0000056.definition: A bud that develops into a flower.

PO:0000057.label: inflorescence bud
PO:0000057.definition: A bud that develops into an inflorescence.

PO:0000058.label: vegetative bud
PO:0000058.definition: A bud (PO:0000055) that develops into a vegetative shoot system (PO:0025607).

PO:0000059.label: root initial cell
PO:0000059.definition: An initial cell (PO:0004011) that is part of a root apical meristem (PO:0020147) and by division gives rise to two cells, one of which remains in the meristem, while the other is produces different root cells.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula inicial de la ra&#237z (Spanish, exact)

PO:0000060.label: root cortex-endodermis initial cell
PO:0000060.definition: A root initial cell (PO:0000059) that produces root cortex (PO:0000258) and root endodermis (PO:0005059). In direct contact with quiescent center (PO:0020149).

synonyms.label: c&#233lula inicial del cortex/endodermis de la ra&#237z (Spanish, exact)
根皮層内皮始原細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0000061.label: lateral root cap epidermal initial cell
PO:0000061.definition: A root initial cell (PO:0000059) that produces lateral root cap cells and root epidermis (PO:0006036).

synonyms.label: c&#233lula inicial del caliptra de la ra&#237z lateral (Spanish, exact)
側根冠表皮始原細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0000062.label: stomatal initial cell
PO:0000062.definition: An plant epidermal initial cell (PO:0000349) that undergoes several rounds of uneven division, each time giving rise to a larger daughter cell that differentiates into an epidermal ground cell and a smaller daughter cell that remains meristematic, until the meristematic cell (PO:0004010) differentiates into a guard mother cell (PO:0000351).

PO:0000063.label: leaf procambial cell
PO:0000063.definition: A procambial cell (PO:0025258) that is part of a leaf procambium (PO:0025259).

synonyms.label: c&#233lula procambial de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0000064.label: xylem pole pericycle cell
PO:0000064.definition: A pericycle cell that is adjacent to the protoxylem of a vascular bundle.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula del polo xilem&#225tico del periciclo (Spanish, exact)

PO:0000065.label: phloem pole pericycle cell
PO:0000065.definition: A pericycle cell that is adjacent to the protophloem of a vascular bundle.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula del polo floem&#225tico del periciclo (Spanish, exact)

PO:0000066.label: epithem cell
PO:0000066.definition: A parenchyma cell of the mesophyll of a hydathode found between the xylem endings and the epidermis.

PO:0000067.label: proteoid root
PO:0000067.definition: A root (PO:0009005) that forms one or more clusters of closely spaced lateral roots (PO:0020121) of limited growth along its length.

PO:0000071.label: companion cell
PO:0000071.definition: A parenchyma cell (PO:0000074) that is adjacent to a sieve tube element (PO:0000289) and arises from the same phloem mother cell (PO:0000400) as the sieve tube element.

PO:0000074.label: parenchyma cell
PO:0000074.definition: A relatively unspecialized ground tissue cell with a nucleate protoplast.

PO:0000075.label: collenchyma cell
PO:0000075.definition: An elongated plant cell with unevenly thickened non-lignified primary walls that is alive at maturity.

synonyms.label: 厚角組織 細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0000076.label: chlorenchyma cell
PO:0000076.definition: A parenchyma cell containing chloroplasts; a component of leaf mesophyll and other green parenchyma tissue.

synonyms.label: 同化組織、葉緑組織 細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0000077.label: sclerenchyma cell
PO:0000077.definition: A ground tissue cell (PO:0025030) with a lignified secondary cell wall.

synonyms.label: 厚膜組織 細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0000078.label: transfer cell
PO:0000078.definition: A cell with wall ingrowths (or invaginations) that increase the surface of the plasmalemma.

PO:0000079.label: fusiform initial cell
PO:0000079.definition: An elongated cambial initial cell (PO:0000295) with approximately wedge-shaped ends that is part of the vascular cambium (PO:0005598) and gives rise to axial cells.

PO:0000081.label: OBSOLETE axial cell
PO:0000081.definition: OBSOLETE. A vascular cell derived from the fusiform cambial initial and oriented with its longest diameter parallel with the main axis of stem or root.

PO:0000082.label: ray initial cell
PO:0000082.definition: A cambial initial cell (PO:0000295) that gives rise to ray cells of the secondary xylem (PO:0005848) and secondary phloem (PO:0005043).

synonyms.label: 放射組織始原細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0000084.label: plant sperm cell
PO:0000084.definition: A gamete (PO:0025006) produced by an antheridium (PO:0025125) or a microgametophyte (PO:0025280).

PO:0000112.label: shoot axis epidermis
PO:0000112.definition: A portion of shoot system epidermis (PO:0006035) that is part of a shoot axis (PO:0025029).

synonyms.label: epidermis del eje del tallo (Spanish, exact)

PO:0000115.label: socket cell
PO:0000115.definition: A shoot epidermal cell (PO:0025165) that surrounds a trichome (PO:0000282) and provides its support.

synonyms.label: cell located at the base of the trichome (related)

relationships: develops_from PO:0000349 ! plant epidermal initial cell

PO:0000146.label: abscission zone
PO:0000146.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that has as part a separation layer (PO:0006211) and a protective layer (PO:0006212), and is involved in the abscission (GO:0009838) of a fruit (PO:0009001), flower (PO:0009046), leaf (PO:0025034) or other plant structure (PO:0009011).

PO:0000191.label: synergid
PO:0000191.definition: Cell, usually two in number, in the micropylar end of the embryo sac of angiosperms associated with the egg in the egg apparatus.

PO:0000198.label: free nuclear endosperm
PO:0000198.definition: A portion of endosperm (PO:0009089) tissue in which at least the first karyokinesis is not followed by cytokinesis.

PO:0000199.label: cellular endosperm
PO:0000199.definition: A portion of endosperm (PO:0009089) in which the first karyokinesis event is accompanied by cytokinesis.

PO:0000200.label: micropylar endosperm
PO:0000200.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the region of the endosperm closest to the micropyle of the seed.

PO:0000201.label: chalazal cyst
PO:0000201.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the part of the endosperm (PO:0009089) nearest the chalazal region of the plant ovule (PO:0020003) and forming a cyst-like structure.

PO:0000207.label: nectary epidermis
PO:0000207.definition: A portion of shoot system epidermis (PO:0006035) that is part of a nectary (PO:0009035) .

PO:0000223.label: shoot axis cortex
PO:0000223.definition: A portion of cortex (PO:0005708) that is part of a shoot axis (PO:0025029).

synonyms.label: cortex del eje del epiblasto (epiblastema) del tallo (Spanish, exact)
portion of shoot axis cortex tissue (exact)

PO:0000224.label: central zone
PO:0000224.definition: An area of densely packed cells in the shoot apex that divide infrequently.

PO:0000225.label: peripheral zone
PO:0000225.definition: A portion of meristem tissue (PO:0009013) which is the organogenic region of the meristem, characterized by higher rates of cell division.

PO:0000226.label: rib zone
PO:0000226.definition: The region of the shoot apical meristem that lies below the central zone and is flanked by the peripheral zone.

PO:0000229.label: flower meristem
PO:0000229.definition: A portion of reproductive shoot apical meristem tissue (PO:0008028) that gives rise to the floral organs (PO:0025395).

PO:0000230.label: inflorescence meristem
PO:0000230.definition: A meristem that gives rise to an inflorescence.

PO:0000232.label: axillary bud meristem
PO:0000232.definition: A shoot system meristem (PO:0006079) formed in an axil (PO:0025224).

PO:0000244.label: functional megaspore
PO:0000244.definition: A megaspore(s) that forms an embryo sac.

PO:0000245.label: degenerate megaspore
PO:0000245.definition: In monosporic and bisporic megasporogenesis: the megaspore(s) that would not participate in megagametogenesis.

synonyms.label: 退化大胞子、胞子形成に寄与しない大胞子 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0000252.label: endodermis
PO:0000252.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) that is the inner most layer of a cortex (PO:0005708) and has a casparian strip in its anticlinal cell walls.

PO:0000256.label: root hair cell
PO:0000256.definition: A root epidermal cell (PO:0025164) that develops from a trichoblast (PO:0000262) and has as part a root hair (GO:0035618).

synonyms.label: c&#233lula del pelo de la ra&#237z (Spanish, exact)

PO:0000258.label: root cortex
PO:0000258.definition: A portion of cortex (PO:0005708) that is part of a root (PO:0009005).

PO:0000262.label: trichoblast
PO:0000262.definition: A root epidermal cell (PO:0025164) that is the smaller cell produced by the asymmetric division of an epidermal intial cell (PO:0000349) and gives rise to a root hair (GO:0035618).

synonyms.label: 根毛形成細胞、トリコブラスト (Japanese, exact)

relationships: develops_from PO:0000349 ! plant epidermal initial cell

PO:0000263.label: non-hair root epidermal cell
PO:0000263.definition: A root epidermal cell (PO:0025164) that develops from an epidermal initial (PO:0000349) and does not have as part a root hair (GO:0035618).

synonyms.label: 非毛根形成細胞、アトリコブラスト (Japanese, exact)

relationships: develops_from PO:0000349 ! plant epidermal initial cell

PO:0000272.label: protoxylem
PO:0000272.definition: A portion of primary xylem (PO:0000272) tissue that has as part one or more protoxylem tracheary elements (PO:0025575) embedded in parenchyma (PO:0005421) tissue.

PO:0000273.label: OBSOLETE xylem element
PO:0000273.definition: OBSOLETE. A cell making up xylem tissue.

PO:0000274.label: xylem fiber cell
PO:0000274.definition: A fiber cell (PO:0025407) that is part of a portion of xylem (PO:0005352) tissue.

PO:0000282.label: trichome
PO:0000282.definition: A unicellular or multicellular plant structure (PO:0009011) that forms a non-sclerified outgrowth from the epidermis (PO:0005679).
relationships: develops_from PO:0000349 ! plant epidermal initial cell

PO:0000283.label: idioblast
PO:0000283.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that markedly differs in form, size, or contents from other cells in the same tissue.

PO:0000284.label: subsidiary cell
PO:0000284.definition: A shoot epidermal cell (PO:0025165) associated with a stomatal pore (PO:0008032) and at least morphologically distinguishable from the other epidermal cells.

synonyms.label: 助細胞,副細胞（気孔）(auxiliary cell, synergid) (Japanese, exact)

PO:0000289.label: sieve tube element
PO:0000289.definition: A sieve element (PO:0025406) that is part of a sieve tube (PO:0025416) and has as parts sieve areas aggregated into sieve plates (GO:0097218).

PO:0000290.label: tracheary element
PO:0000290.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that has a lignified cell wall with secondary thickening and bordered pits.

PO:0000293.label: guard cell
PO:0000293.definition: A shoot epidermal cell (PO:0025165) that is one of a pair of cells flanking the stomatal pore (PO:0008032).

PO:0000295.label: cambial initial cell
PO:0000295.definition: An initial cell (PO:0004011) that is part of the vascular cambium (PO:0005598) or cork cambium (PO:0005599), and by periclinal divisions, produces cells to the outside or inside of the cambial axis.

PO:0000301.label: tracheid
PO:0000301.definition: A tracheary element (PO:0000290) that has no perforations in its cell wall.

PO:0000309.label: nectary parenchyma
PO:0000309.definition: A portion of parenchyma tissue (PO:0005421) that is part of a nectary (PO:0009035).

PO:0000332.label: shoot epidermal pavement cell
PO:0000332.definition: A shoot epidermal cell (PO:0025165) that is relatively unspecialized at maturity.
relationships: develops_from PO:0000349 ! plant epidermal initial cell

PO:0000349.label: plant epidermal initial cell
PO:0000349.definition: An initial cell (PO:0004011) that is part of an plant epidermis (PO:0005679) and gives rise to specialized cells.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula inicial de la epidermis (Spanish, exact)

PO:0000351.label: guard mother cell
PO:0000351.definition: A shoot epidermal cell (PO:0025165) that divides to produce the guard cells (PO:0000293).

synonyms.label: c&#233lula madre de la c&#233lula guardiana (Spanish, exact)

PO:0000352.label: myrosin cell
PO:0000352.definition: A cell containing glucosinolates ("mustard oil glucosides") and myrosinases, enzymes hydrolyzing the glucosinolates.

PO:0000353.label: passage cell
PO:0000353.definition: A ground tissue cell that is part of an exodermis or an endodermis and remains thin walled when the associated cells develop thick secondary walls.

PO:0000355.label: fiber tracheid
PO:0000355.definition: A xylem fiber cell (PO:0000274) with bordered pits with pit cavities.

PO:0000372.label: metaxylem
PO:0000372.definition: A portion of primary xylem (PO:0005849) tissue that has as part one or more metaxylem tracheary elements (PO:0025576) embedded in parenchyma (PO:0005421) tissue and may contain xylem fiber cells (PO:0000274).

PO:0000373.label: OBSOLETE mucilage cell
PO:0000373.definition: OBSOLETE. Cell containing mucilages or gums or similar carbohydrate material characterized by the property of swelling in water.

PO:0000400.label: phloem mother cell
PO:0000400.definition: A cambial initial cell (PO:0000295) which is destined to differentiate into secondary phloem.

PO:0000423.label: plant zygote
PO:0000423.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) which is a whole plant (PO:0000003) in the plant zygote stage (PO:0001097).

synonyms.label: 植物接合子、接合体 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0000431.label: megasporocyte
PO:0000431.definition: A sporocyte (PO:0006204) that produces four haploid (1n) megaspores (PO:0020019).

PO:0001000.label: OBSOLETE meristem elaboration
PO:0001000.definition: OBSOLETE. the root meristem gets organized

PO:0001002.label: fruit development stage
PO:0001002.definition: A multi-tissue plant structure development stage (PO:0025571) that has as primary participant a single fruit (PO:0009001).

PO:0001003.label: vascular leaf anlagen formation stage
PO:0001003.definition: A vascular leaf initiation stage (PO:0007040) during which the vascular leaf founder cells (PO:0025592) of the shoot apical meristem (PO:0020148) form a vascular leaf anlagen (PO:0025431).

synonyms.label: vascular leaf founder cell formation stage (exact)

PO:0001004.label: anther development stage
PO:0001004.definition: Stages of development of the anther defined by characteristic morphological, cytological, histological or other visible features.

PO:0001005.label: A archesporial cells visible stage
PO:0001005.definition: An initial stage during which archesporial cells arise in four corners of L2 layer. Change in shape of primordia to more oval.

PO:0001006.label: B enlarged microsporocyte stage
PO:0001006.definition: Stage during which the microsporocytes become conspicuous.

PO:0001007.label: pollen development stage
PO:0001007.definition: A microgametophyte development stage (PO:0025602) during which the pollen (PO:0025281) develops.

PO:0001008.label: C callose wall formation in pollen mother cells stage
PO:0001008.definition: Stage during which diploid pollen mother cells become separated from each other and from tapetum by a callose wall.

PO:0001009.label: D pollen mother cell meiosis stage
PO:0001009.definition: Stage during which pollen mother cells undergo meiosis to form tetrads of microspores.

PO:0001010.label: F microspore release stage
PO:0001010.definition: Stage of microgametophyte development during which the callose wall between the tetrads breaks down and haploid microspores are released and lie freely in locules.

PO:0001011.label: A microsporogenous mass stage
PO:0001011.definition: An initial stage during which the archesporial cells divide to give rise to primary parietal and sporogenous cells.

PO:0001012.label: G early unicellular microspore stage
PO:0001012.definition: Stage of microgametophyte development during which the microspores round up and small vacuoles appear in their cytoplasm. The microspore walls thicken due to the formation of the exine.

PO:0001013.label: H late unicellular microspore stage
PO:0001013.definition: Stage of microgametophyte development during which a large vacuole is formed in each microspore causing a rapid increase in size and a displacement of the nucleus to one side.

PO:0001014.label: I first mitotic division stage
PO:0001014.definition: Stage of microgametophyte development during which the asymmetric, first mitotic division of the microspores occurs producing a large vegetative cell and small generative cell, located near pollen wall.

PO:0001015.label: K second mitotic division stage
PO:0001015.definition: A pollen development stage (PO:0001007) during which the generative cell (PO:0020097) undergoes mitotic division to form two male gametes, the pollen sperm cells (PO:0025121).

PO:0001016.label: L mature pollen stage
PO:0001016.definition: Stage of microgametophyte development during which the pollen reaches mature stage and desiccates.

PO:0001017.label: M germinated pollen stage
PO:0001017.definition: The final stage in the life cycle of the male gametophyte. Upon rehydration, mature pollen grain forms a tubular outgrowth, the pollen tube, which carries the male gametes.

PO:0001018.label: B formation of primary parietal and sporogenous cells stage
PO:0001018.definition: Stage during which the primary parietal and primary sporogenous layers are derived from archesporial cells.

PO:0001019.label: vascular leaf primordium formation stage
PO:0001019.definition: A vascular leaf initiation stage (PO:0001051) during which a vascular leaf primordium (PO:0000017) forms in the peripheral zone (PO:0000225) of the vegetative shoot apical meristem (PO:0020148).
relationships: preceded_by PO:0001003 ! vascular leaf anlagen formation stage

PO:0001020.label: hood-shaped primordium stage
PO:0001020.definition: Stage of leaf development when a hood-shaped primordium is formed, partially enclosing P1 and SAM, as in Poaceae.

PO:0001021.label: formation of ligule primordium stage
PO:0001021.definition: A vascular leaf expansion stage (PO:0001052) when conical P3 leaf completely encloses SAM, and the ligule (PO:0020105) primordium is visible.

PO:0001023.label: rapid elongation of vascular leaf lamina stage
PO:0001023.definition: A vascular leaf expansion stage (PO:0001052) during which a rapid elongation of the leaf lamina (PO:0020039) occurs.

PO:0001024.label: rapid elongation of leaf sheath stage
PO:0001024.definition: A vascular leaf expansion stage (PO:0001052) during which a rapid elongation of the leaf sheath (PO:0020104) occurs.

PO:0001025.label: C four anther lobes formed stage
PO:0001025.definition: Stage during which the four-lobed anther pattern with two developing stomium regions (notch) are formed.

PO:0001026.label: D locules established stage
PO:0001026.definition: Stage during which the four clearly defined locules are established. All anther cell types present and microspore mother cells appear.

PO:0001027.label: OBSOLETE meristamtic zone formation
PO:0001027.definition: OBSOLETE. The meristematic zone is formed

PO:0001028.label: OBSOLETE elongation zone formation
PO:0001028.definition: OBSOLETE. The cells of root primordium undergo elonagtion

PO:0001029.label: E tetrad stage
PO:0001029.definition: Stage immediately following meiosis, during which the tetrads of microspores are still hold together, enclosed by the callose wall.

PO:0001030.label: OBSOLETE specialization zone formation
PO:0001030.definition: OBSOLETE. The cells develop their characteristic morphology.

PO:0001031.label: 4 root elongation stage
PO:0001031.definition: The stage at which a root is elongating.

PO:0001032.label: E anther wall tapetum degeneration initiated stage
PO:0001032.definition: An anther development stage (PO:0001004) during which degeneration of the anther wall tapetum (PO:0009071) is initiated, as the deposition on the surface of the microspore (PO:0020048) primexine proceeds.

PO:0001034.label: F bilocular anther stage
PO:0001034.definition: Stage during which anther becomes bilocular, after degeneration and breakage of septum below stomium.

PO:0001035.label: G anther dehiscence stage
PO:0001035.definition: Stage during which the dehiscence of anthers occurs. Anther breaks along stomium and pollen is released.

PO:0001036.label: H anther senescence stage
PO:0001036.definition: Stage during which the senescence of anther and stamen occurs. Shrinkage of cells and anther structure takes place.

PO:0001040.label: dry seed stage
PO:0001040.definition: A seed development stage (PO:0001170) during which the mature seed reaches a low moisture content.

PO:0001041.label: chalazal and micropylar domain establishment stage
PO:0001041.definition: The initial stage of endosperm development during which the chalazal and micropilar domains are established.

PO:0001042.label: functional specialization of the endosperm stage
PO:0001042.definition: Stage of endosperm development during which the functional specialization of the maturing endosperm occurs.

PO:0001044.label: sepal differentiation and expansion stage
PO:0001044.definition: Stage of calyx development defined by differentiation and expansion of sepal.

PO:0001045.label: fully expanded sepal stage
PO:0001045.definition: Stage of calyx development when sepal is fully expanded.

PO:0001047.label: lemma development stage
PO:0001047.definition: A phyllome development stage (PO:0025579) that has as a primary participant a lemma (PO:0009037).
relationships: part_of PO:0007600 ! floral organ differentiation stage

PO:0001048.label: palea development stage
PO:0001048.definition: A phyllome development stage (PO:0025579) that has as a primary participant a palea (PO:0009038).
relationships: part_of PO:0007600 ! floral organ differentiation stage

PO:0001049.label: lodicule development stage
PO:0001049.definition: A phyllome development stage (PO:0025579) that has as a primary participant a lodicule (PO:0009036).
relationships: part_of PO:0007600 ! floral organ differentiation stage

PO:0001050.label: leaf development stage
PO:0001050.definition: A phyllome development stage (PO:0025579) during which the development of vascular leaves (PO:0009025) and non-vascular leaves (PO:0025075) occurs.

PO:0001051.label: vascular leaf initiation stage
PO:0001051.definition: A vascular leaf development stage (PO:0025570) which begins with the onset of the vascular leaf anlagen formation stage (PO:0001003) and ends with the termination of the vascular leaf primordium polarity determination stage (PO:0001052).

PO:0001052.label: vascular leaf expansion stage
PO:0001052.definition: A vascular leaf development stage (PO:0025570) during which vascular leaf size increases primarily through cell expansion.
relationships: preceded_by PO:0025574 ! vascular leaf differentiation stage

PO:0001053.label: vascular leaf post-expansion stage
PO:0001053.definition: A vascular leaf development stage (PO:0025570) that begins when the vascular leaf (PO:0009025) is fully expanded and ends with the onset of the vascular leaf senescence stage (PO:0001054).

synonyms.label: fully expanded leaf stage in Arabidopsis (related)

relationships: preceded_by PO:0001052 ! vascular leaf expansion stage

PO:0001054.label: vascular leaf senescent stage
PO:0001054.definition: A vascular leaf development stage (PO:0025570) that begins with the formation of a abscission zone at the base of a vascular leaf (PO:0009025) and ends with leaf separation and death.
relationships: preceded_by PO:0001053 ! vascular leaf post-expansion stage

PO:0001055.label: lemma primordia visible stage
PO:0001055.definition: Stage of lemma development that begins when the lemma primordia arise.

PO:0001056.label: lemma differentiation and expansion stage
PO:0001056.definition: Stage of lemma development defined by differentiation and expansion of lemma.

PO:0001057.label: fully expanded lemma stage
PO:0001057.definition: Stage of lemma development when lemma is fully expanded.

PO:0001058.label: palea primordia visible stage
PO:0001058.definition: Stage of palea development that begins when the palea primordia arise.

PO:0001059.label: J bicellular pollen stage
PO:0001059.definition: Stage of microgametophyte development during which the small generative cell moves inward, becoming completely surrounded by the cytoplasm of the vegetative cell.

PO:0001070.label: palea differentiation and expansion stage
PO:0001070.definition: Stage of palea development defined by differentiation and expansion of palea.

PO:0001071.label: fully expanded palea stage
PO:0001071.definition: Stage of palea development when palea is fully expanded.

PO:0001072.label: lodicule primordia visible stage
PO:0001072.definition: Stage of lodicule development that begins when the lodicule primordia arise.

PO:0001074.label: N second mitotic division stage in germinating pollen
PO:0001074.definition: Stage of microgametophyte development during which the generative cell undergoes a mitotic division to form two male gametes, the sperm cells.

PO:0001077.label: lodicule differentiation and expansion stage
PO:0001077.definition: Stage of lodicule development defined by differentiation and expansion of lodicule.

PO:0001078.label: plant embryo cotyledonary stage
PO:0001078.definition: A plant embryo development stage (PO:0007631) that occurs during the interval between the beginning of rapid elongation of the plant embryo axis (PO:0019018) and plant embryo cotyledons (PO:0025470), and the onset of a plant embryo true leaf formation stage (PO:0001095), when present, or a mature plant embryo stage (PO:0001081).
relationships: preceded_by PO:0004507 ! plant embryo bilateral stage
precedes PO:0001081 ! mature plant embryo stage

PO:0001079.label: fully expanded lodicule stage
PO:0001079.definition: Stage of lodicule development when lodicule is fully expanded.

PO:0001081.label: mature plant embryo stage
PO:0001081.definition: A plant embryo development stage (PO:0007631) during the interval between when a plant embryo (PO:0009009) has stopped developmental growth involved in morphogenesis (GO:0060560) and one of the following: the beginning of the seed germination stage (PO:0007057) in seed plants, formation of the first vascular leaf (PO:0009025) in pteridophytes, the beginning of development of a sporangium (PO:0025094) in bryophytes, or the beginning of the formation of a plant organ (PO:0009008) such as a root (PO:0009005), shoot axis (PO:0025029), or vascular leaf (PO:0009025) in a cultured plant embryo (PO:0000010).

PO:0001083.label: inflorescence development stage
PO:0001083.definition: A reproductive shoot system development stage (PO:0025530) that has as primary participant a inflorescence (PO:0009049).

PO:0001094.label: plant embryo coleoptilar stage
PO:0001094.definition: A plant embryo development stage (PO:0007631) that occurs during the interval between the beginning of elongation of the plant embryo axis (PO:0019018), with the formation of a plant embryo coleoptile (PO:0025286), a plant embryo shoot apical meristem (PO:0006362) and root apical meristem (PO:0020147), and ends with the onset of a plant embryo true leaf formation stage (PO:0001095), when present, or a mature plant embryo stage (PO:0001081).
relationships: preceded_by PO:0004507 ! plant embryo bilateral stage
precedes PO:0001081 ! mature plant embryo stage

PO:0001095.label: plant embryo true leaf formation stage
PO:0001095.definition: A plant embryo development stage (PO:0007631) that occurs during the interval between the beginning of the formation of the first vascular leaf primordium (PO:0000017) in the plant embryo proper (PO:0000001), and the onset of a mature plant embryo stage (PO:0001081).
relationships: precedes PO:0001081 ! mature plant embryo stage

PO:0001096.label: primary endosperm cell stage
PO:0001096.definition: One cell stage that takes place following the fertilization, produced by the fusion of sperm cell nucleus and one or more polar nuclei.

PO:0001097.label: plant zygote stage
PO:0001097.definition: A sporophyte development stage (PO:0007134) that occurs during the interval between fertilization and the first cell division of the plant zygote (PO:0000423).

PO:0001098.label: OBSOLETE formation of starchy endosperm
PO:0001098.definition: OBSOLETE. Stage of endosperm development during wich the formation of starchy endosperm occurs.

PO:0001099.label: formation of aleurone and starchy layers stage
PO:0001099.definition: Differentiation of aleurone layer, the outermost endosperm tissue, and the internal starchy tissue.

PO:0001170.label: seed development stage
PO:0001170.definition: A multi-tissue plant structure development stage (PO:0025571) that has as primary participant a seed (PO:0009010).

PO:0001180.label: plant proembryo stage
PO:0001180.definition: A plant embryo development stage (PO:0007631) that occurs during the interval between the first cell division of a plant zygote (PO:0000423) and the onset of the plant globular embryo stage (PO:0001185).

PO:0001185.label: plant embryo globular stage
PO:0001185.definition: A plant embryo development stage (PO:0007631) that occurs during the interval between when a plant embryo proper (PO:0000001) increases in diameter through cell division, but retains radial symmetry (with the concomitant formation of a protoderm (PO:0006210)), and the onset of a plant embryo bilateral stage (PO:0004507).

PO:0001378.label: sepals enclosing meristem stage
PO:0001378.definition: Stage of calyx development that begins when the developing sepals enclose the floral meristem.

PO:0001380.label: sepals enclosing flower bud stage
PO:0001380.definition: Stage of calyx development that begins when the sepals enclose the floral bud.

PO:0002000.label: stomatal complex
PO:0002000.definition: A portion of shoot system epidermis (PO:0006035) that has as parts two guard cells (PO:0000293) and a stomatal pore (PO:0008032). May also contain subsidiary cells (PO:0000284).

PO:0002001.label: OBSOLETE papillae
PO:0002001.definition: OBSOLETE. A soft protuberance on an epidermal cell of the stigma.

PO:0002002.label: embryo basal cell
PO:0002002.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that is the lower-most cell formed after the first division of the plant zygote (PO:0000423) and is part of a plant embryo (PO:0009009).

PO:0002003.label: xylem vessel member
PO:0002003.definition: A tracheary element (PO:0000290) that is part of a xylem vessel (PO:0025417) and has as parts perforation plates.

synonyms.label: 木質部道管状要素 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0002004.label: silk scar
PO:0002004.definition: A cardinal part of multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025498) which is composed of the shriveled remains of the silk (PO:0006488), and the base of the style (PO:0009074), and is located on the distal end of a developing or mature kernel (caryopsis fruit; PO:0030104).

PO:0003000.label: transition zone
PO:0003000.definition: A region of the root between the meristem and the region of rapid elongation in which isodiametric growth (cell expansion) occurs.

synonyms.label: 移行領域、移行帯、移行域 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0003003.label: obsolete primary root elongation zone
PO:0003003.definition: OBSOLETE. A zone of small, densely cytoplasmic cells that are dividing and expanding in size located behind the zone of cell division in the primary root.

synonyms.label: zona de elongaci&#243n obsoleta de la ra&#237z primary (Spanish, exact)

PO:0003004.label: OBSOLETE haustorial root
PO:0003004.definition: OBSOLETE. The root of particular parasitic plants that becomes cemented to the host axis and intrudes into the tissues of the host.

synonyms.label: 吸器根（寄生植物の根） (Japanese, exact)

PO:0003005.label: shoot-borne nodal root
PO:0003005.definition: A shoot-borne root (PO:0000042) that forms at a shoot axis node (PO:0005004).

PO:0003011.label: root vascular system
PO:0003011.definition: A vascular system (PO:0000034) that includes the totality of the portions of vascular tissue in their specific arrangement in a root (PO:0009005).

synonyms.label: sistema vascular de la ra&#237z (Spanish, exact)

PO:0003014.label: obsolete lateral root elongation zone
PO:0003014.definition: OBSOLETE. The portion of the lateral root located behind the zone of cell division that includes small, densely cytoplasmic cells that are dividing and expanding in size.

synonyms.label: zona de elongaci&#243n obsoleta de la ra&#237z lateral (Spanish, exact)

PO:0003015.label: primary root differentiation zone
PO:0003015.definition: A root differentiation zone that is part of a primary root.

synonyms.label: zona de diferenciaci&#243n de la ra&#237z primary (Spanish, exact)

PO:0003016.label: lateral root differentiation zone
PO:0003016.definition: A root differentiation zone that is part of a lateral root.

synonyms.label: zona de diferenciaci&#243n de la ra&#237z lateral (Spanish, exact)

PO:0003017.label: root cap of primary root
PO:0003017.definition: A root cap that is part of a primary root tip.

synonyms.label: caliptra de la ra&#237z primary (Spanish, exact)

PO:0003018.label: root cap of lateral root
PO:0003018.definition: A root cap that is part of a lateral root tip.

synonyms.label: caliptra de la ra&#237z lateral (Spanish, exact)

PO:0003019.label: central root cap of lateral root
PO:0003019.definition: A central root cap that is part of a root cap of lateral root.

synonyms.label: caliptra de la ra&#237z central de la ra&#237z lateral (Spanish, exact)

relationships: part_of PO:0003018 ! root cap of lateral root

PO:0003020.label: lateral root cap of lateral root
PO:0003020.definition: A lateral root cap that is part of a root cap of lateral root.

synonyms.label: caliptra de la ra&#237z lateral de la ra&#237z lateral (Spanish, exact)

relationships: part_of PO:0003018 ! root cap of lateral root

PO:0003021.label: central root cap of primary root
PO:0003021.definition: A central root cap that is part of a root cap of primary root.

synonyms.label: caliptra de la ra&#237z central de la ra&#237z primaria (Spanish, exact)
一次根の中心根冠 (Japanese, exact)

relationships: part_of PO:0003017 ! root cap of primary root

PO:0003022.label: lateral root cap of primary root
PO:0003022.definition: A lateral root cap (PO:0020131) that is part of a root cap (PO:0020123) of a primary root (PO:0020127).

synonyms.label: caliptra de la ra&#237z lateral de la ra&#237z primaria (Spanish, exact)

relationships: part_of PO:0003017 ! root cap of primary root

PO:0003023.label: root nodule
PO:0003023.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is an outgrowth of a root (PO:0009005) and is inhabited by nitrogen-fixing bacteria.

PO:0003024.label: stolon
PO:0003024.definition: A branch (PO:0025073) that is prostrate or trailing, and produces  adventitious nodal roots (PO:0003005) and sometimes erect shoots.

synonyms.label: ストロン、ほふく茎 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0004000.label: OBSOLETE apical cell
PO:0004000.definition: OBSOLETE. An embryonic plant cell that is the uppermost cell formed after the first division of the zygote.

PO:0004001.label: bulliform cell
PO:0004001.definition: An enlarged more or less thin-walled leaf pavement cell, present, with other similar cells, in longitudinal rows in leaves of monocots.

PO:0004002.label: OBSOLETE contact cell
PO:0004002.definition: OBSOLETE. An axial parenchyma or a ray cell physiologically associated with a tracheary element. Also a cell next to a stoma.

PO:0004003.label: phellem
PO:0004003.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) centrifugally derived from cork cambium (PO:0005599), non-living at maturity, and having suberized walls.

PO:0004004.label: OBSOLETE epithelium cell
PO:0004004.definition: OBSOLETE. A compact layer of cells, often secretory in function, covering a free surface or lining a cavity.

PO:0004005.label: OBSOLETE laticiferous cell
PO:0004005.definition: OBSOLETE. A specialized cells or ducts resembling vessels; they form branched networks of latex-secreting cells in the phloem and other parts of plants.

PO:0004006.label: mesophyll cell
PO:0004006.definition: A chlorenchyma cell that is part of a mesophyll.

PO:0004007.label: OBSOLETE phelloid cell
PO:0004007.definition: OBSOLETE. A cell within the phellem (cork) but distinct from the cork cell in having no suberin in its walls.

synonyms.label: コルク様（スベリン無）細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0004008.label: OBSOLETE photosynthetic cell
PO:0004008.definition: OBSOLETE. A chloroplast-containing cell engaged in photosynthesis.

PO:0004009.label: silica cell
PO:0004009.definition: Cells with deposits of silica in them. One of the two types of short cells in the epidermis of grasses and bamboos. It is usually paired with epidermal cork cell.

synonyms.label: ケイ酸細胞、珪酸細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0004010.label: meristematic cell
PO:0004010.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) synthesizing protoplasm and producing new cells by division and with only a primary cell wall.

PO:0004011.label: initial cell
PO:0004011.definition: A meristematic cell (PO:0004010) that by division gives rise to two cells, one of which remains meristematic, while the other is added to the plant body.

PO:0004012.label: OBSOLETE secretory cell
PO:0004012.definition: OBSOLETE. Cell that produces secreted substances.

PO:0004013.label: plant epidermal cell
PO:0004013.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that is part of a portion of epidermis (PO:0005679).

PO:0004500.label: formation of vascular leaflet primordia stage
PO:0004500.definition: A vascular leaf expansion stage (PO:0001052) at which a leaflet primordium (PO:0025481) is initiated on the leaf rachis (PO:0020055) of a compound leaf (PO:0020043).

PO:0004501.label: gynoecium differentiation and expansion stage
PO:0004501.definition: Stage of gynoecium development defined by differentiation and expansion of carpels.

PO:0004502.label: closure of carpel(s) stage
PO:0004502.definition: Stage of gynoecium development defined by the closure of the carpel(s).

PO:0004503.label: stigma cell differentiation stage
PO:0004503.definition: Epidermal cells at the top of developing style differentiate stigma.
