PO:0004504.label: ovule differentiation and expansion stage
PO:0004504.definition: Stage of ovule development defined by differentiation and expansion of ovules.

PO:0004505.label: fertilized ovule stage
PO:0004505.definition: The earliest stage of seed development immediately following double fertilization.

PO:0004506.label: developing seed stage
PO:0004506.definition: Stage of seed development characterized by seed growth and differentiation.

PO:0004507.label: plant embryo bilateral stage
PO:0004507.definition: A plant embryo development stage (PO:0007631) that occurs during the interval between the transition from radial to bilateral symmetry in a plant embryo proper (PO:0000001) and the onset of either the plant embryo cotyledonary stage (PO:0001078) or the plant embryo coleoptilar stage (PO:0001094).
relationships: preceded_by PO:0001185 ! plant embryo globular stage

PO:0004509.label: glandular trichome
PO:0004509.definition: A trichome (PO:0000282) that secretes or sequesters a portion of plant substance (PO:0025161).

PO:0004511.label: seed trichome
PO:0004511.definition: A trichome that develops from seed coat epidermis.

synonyms.label: 種子毛（毛茸、糸状体、毛状突起体） (Japanese, exact)

PO:0004512.label: heartwood
PO:0004512.definition: A portion of secondary xylem (PO:0005848) that lacks living secondary xylem parenchyma cells (PO:0004525).

PO:0004513.label: sapwood
PO:0004513.definition: A portion of secondary xylem (PO:0005848) that has as parts living secondary xylem parenchyma cells (PO:0004525).

PO:0004514.label: growth ring
PO:0004514.definition: A portion of secondary xylem (PO:0005848) that has as parts a single layer of early wood (PO:0004515) and a single layer of late wood (PO:0004516) from the same growth season and is part of a shoot axis (PO:0025029) or root (PO:0009005).

PO:0004515.label: early wood
PO:0004515.definition: A portion of secondary xylem (PO:0005848) that is a part of a growth ring (PO:0004514) formed during the early part of a growing season, has lower density than late wood (PO:0004516) of the same growth ring, and has as parts early wood tracheary elements (PO:0025461) with generally larger lumens than the late wood tracheary elements (PO:0025462) of the same growth ring.

PO:0004516.label: late wood
PO:0004516.definition: A portion of secondary xylem (PO:0005848) that is a part of a growth ring (PO:0004514) formed during the later part of a growing season, has higher density than early wood (PO:0004515) of the same growth ring, and has as parts late wood tracheary elements (PO:0025462) with generally smaller lumens than the early wood tracheary elements (PO:0025461) of the same growth ring.

PO:0004517.label: growth ring boundary
PO:0004517.definition: A portion of secondary xylem (PO:0005848) that includes the last-formed late wood (PO:0004516) of one growth ring (PO:0004514) and the earliest-formed early wood (PO:0004515) of the next growth ring.

synonyms.label: l&#237mite del anillo de crecimiento (Spanish, exact)

PO:0004518.label: bark
PO:0004518.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) outside the vascular cambium (PO:0005598) or the xylem (PO:0005352); in older trees may be divided into dead outer bark and living inner bark, which consists of secondary phloem (PO:0005043).

PO:0004519.label: phloem fiber cell
PO:0004519.definition: A fiber cell (PO:0025407) that is part of a portion of phloem (PO:0005417) tissue.

PO:0004520.label: libriform fiber cell
PO:0004520.definition: A xylem fiber cell (PO:0000274) with simple pits.

PO:0004521.label: septate fiber cell
PO:0004521.definition: A plant fiber cell (PO:0025407) with thin transverse walls (septa), which are formed when mitosis occurs within the cell after development of a secondary cell wall (GO:0009531).

PO:0004522.label: outer vascular cambium
PO:0004522.definition: Cambium at the outer margin of the xylem cylinder.

synonyms.label: 外側維管 形成層 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0004524.label: included phloem
PO:0004524.definition: A portion of secondary phloem tissue produced by included vascular cambium.

PO:0004525.label: secondary xylem parenchyma cell
PO:0004525.definition: A parenchyma cell (PO:0000074) that is part of a portion of secondary xylem parenchyma (PO:0004532).

synonyms.label: c&#233lula parenquim&#225tica de la madera (Spanish, exact)
二次木部柔組織細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0004526.label: axial secondary xylem parenchyma cell
PO:0004526.definition: A secondary xylem parenchyma cell (PO:0004525) that is part of a portion of axial secondary xylem parenchyma (PO:0004533).

synonyms.label: c&#233lula parenquim&#225tica axial de la madera (Spanish, exact)
軸方向二次木部柔組織細胞 (Japanese, exact)

relationships: part_of PO:0004533 ! axial secondary xylem parenchyma

PO:0004527.label: ray secondary xylem parenchyma cell
PO:0004527.definition: A parenchyma cell (PO:0000074) that develops from a ray initial (PO:0000082) and is part of a portion of ray secondary xylem parenchyma (PO:0004534).

synonyms.label: c&#233lula parenquim&#225tica de rayo de la madera (Spanish, exact)
放射状二次木部柔組織細胞 (Japanese, exact)

relationships: part_of PO:0004534 ! ray secondary xylem parenchyma

PO:0004528.label: upright ray secondary xylem parenchyma cell
PO:0004528.definition: A ray secondary xylem parenchyma cell (PO:0004527) that is oriented with its longest dimension parallel to the plant axis (PO:0025004) in which it is found.

synonyms.label: rayo par&#233nquim&#225tico vertical de la madera (Spanish, exact)
直立放射状二次木部柔組織細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0004529.label: procumbent ray secondary xylem parenchyma cell
PO:0004529.definition: A ray secondary xylem parenchyma cell (PO:0004527) that is oriented with its longest dimension radial to the plant axis (PO:0025004) in which it is found.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula procumbente del rayo de la madera (Spanish, exact)
平伏放射二次木部柔組織細胞   (Japanese, exact)

PO:0004530.label: tile cell
PO:0004530.definition: Empty upright ray cell of approximately the same height as the procumbent ray cell and occurring in indeterminate horizontal series usually interspersed among the procumbent cells.

PO:0004531.label: sheath cell
PO:0004531.definition: Cell on the margin of, and tending to form a sheath around, the procumbent cells of a multi-seriate ray as seen in tangential section.

PO:0004532.label: secondary xylem parenchyma
PO:0004532.definition: A portion of parenchyma (PO:0005421) tissue that is part of a portion of secondary xylem (PO:0005848) and has as parts secondary xylem parenchyma cells (PO:0004525).

PO:0004533.label: axial secondary xylem parenchyma
PO:0004533.definition: A portion of secondary xylem parenchyma (PO:0004532) that is part of an axial system (PO:0025410) and has as parts axial secondary xylem parenchyma cells (PO:0004526).

synonyms.label: par&#233nquima axial de la madera (Spanish, exact)
軸方向二次木部柔組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0004534.label: ray secondary xylem parenchyma
PO:0004534.definition: A portion of secondary xylem parenchyma (PO:0004532) that is part of a ray system (PO:0025411) and has as parts ray secondary xylem parenchyma cells (PO:0004527).

synonyms.label: par&#233nquima de rayo de la madera (Spanish, exact)
放射状二次木質部柔組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0004535.label: fruit placenta
PO:0004535.definition: A portion of placenta tissue (PO:0025078) that is part of a fruit (PO:0009001) and to which seeds (PO:0009010) are attached.

PO:0004536.label: infructescence fruit pedicel
PO:0004536.definition: A fruit pedicel (PO:0030114) that bears a fruit (PO:0009001) in an infructescence (PO:0006342).

PO:0004537.label: nucellar plant embryo
PO:0004537.definition: A somatic plant embryo derived directly from nucellus cells.

synonyms.label: 珠心由来の不定胚 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0004538.label: indeterminate nodule
PO:0004538.definition: A root nodule characterized by a persistent meristem, presence of vascular transfer cells, and cell division in the inner cortex with non-dividing infected cells and bacteria.

PO:0004539.label: determinate nodule
PO:0004539.definition: A root nodule characterized by a dividing infected cells and bacteria, vascular transfer cells absent and cell division is in the outer cortex.

PO:0004540.label: fruit columella
PO:0004540.definition: A columella (PO:0025230) that forms the central axis of a fruit.

PO:0004542.label: rhizome
PO:0004542.definition: A swollen shoot axis (PO:0025029) that grows horizontally at or below the substrate surface and produces shoots above and roots or rhizoids below.

PO:0004543.label: shoot axis tuber
PO:0004543.definition: A shoot axis (PO:0025029) that develops from a branch (PO:0025073) and is radially enlarged for storage.

PO:0004544.label: root-borne shoot system
PO:0004544.definition: A shoot system that is initiated from a root.

synonyms.label: sistema de epiblasto (epiblastema) que nace en la ra&#237z (Spanish, exact)

PO:0004545.label: shoot-borne shoot system
PO:0004545.definition: A shoot system that is initiated from a shoot.

synonyms.label: sistema de epiblasto (epiblastema) que nace en el epiblasto (epiblastema) (Spanish, exact)
シュート由来苗条系 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0004546.label: epicormic shoot system
PO:0004546.definition: A shoot-borne shoot system (PO:0004546) developing from a stem (PO:0009047).

PO:0004547.label: subterranean shoot axis tuber
PO:0004547.definition: A shoot axis tuber (PO:0004543) that develops below ground.

PO:0004548.label: aerial tuber
PO:0004548.definition: A shoot axis tuber (PO:0004543) that develops above ground.

PO:0004700.label: anther wall middle layer
PO:0004700.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) directly internal to an anther wall endothecium (PO:0020002) that develops from an anther wall secondary parietal cell layer (PO:0006007).
relationships: develops_from PO:0006007 ! anther wall secondary parietal cell layer

PO:0004701.label: short shoot
PO:0004701.definition: Shoot system in which the internodes elongate little or at all, bearing reproductive structures and/or leaves.

PO:0004702.label: long shoot
PO:0004702.definition: Shoot system in which all or most of the internodes elongate.

PO:0004703.label: carpel primordium
PO:0004703.definition: A phyllome primordium (PO:0025128) that develops from a carpel anlagen (PO:0006005) and is committed to the development of a carpel (PO:0009030).

PO:0004704.label: sepal primordium
PO:0004704.definition: A phyllome primordium (PO:0025128) that develops from a sepal anlagen (PO:0025485) and is committed to the development of a sepal (PO:0009031).

synonyms.label: がく片原基（可視的）  (Japanese, exact)

PO:0004705.label: stamen primordium
PO:0004705.definition: A phyllome primordium (PO:0025128) that develops from a stamen anlagen (PO:0025486) and is committed to the development of a stamen (PO:0009029).

PO:0004706.label: OBSOLETE flower primordium
PO:0004706.definition: OBSOLETE. A primordium that will develop into a flower.

PO:0004707.label: fruit dehiscence zone
PO:0004707.definition: A dehiscence zone (PO:0025092) that is part of a fruit.

synonyms.label: zona de dehiscencia del fruto (Spanish, exact)

PO:0004708.label: scutellar node
PO:0004708.definition: A stem node (PO:0020141) that is part of a plant embryo axis (PO:0019018) where the scutellum (PO:0020110) is attached.

PO:0004709.label: axillary bud
PO:0004709.definition: A bud (PO:0000055) that develops from an axillary bud meristem (PO:0000232).

PO:0004710.label: axillary flower bud
PO:0004710.definition: An axillary bud that develops into a flower.

PO:0004711.label: axillary inflorescence bud
PO:0004711.definition: An axillary reproductive bud that develops into an inflorescence.

PO:0004712.label: axillary vegetative bud
PO:0004712.definition: An axillary bud (PO:0004712) that develops into a shoot system (PO:0009006) that has as organ parts only vegetative organs.

PO:0004713.label: terminal bud
PO:0004713.definition: A bud that develops from a shoot apical meristem.

PO:0004714.label: terminal flower bud
PO:0004714.definition: A terminal bud that develops into a flower.

PO:0004715.label: terminal inflorescence bud
PO:0004715.definition: A terminal reproductive bud develops into an inflorescence.

PO:0004716.label: terminal vegetative bud
PO:0004716.definition: A terminal bud (PO:0004713) that develops into a shoot system (PO:0009006) that has as organ parts only vegetative organs.

PO:0004717.label: long cell
PO:0004717.definition: A more or less rectangular leaf pavement cell in which the proximodistal dimension is several times longer than the transverse dimension.

PO:0004719.label: hilum groove
PO:0004719.definition: A canal (PO:0025132) that is a longitudinal groove in the testa through a prominent hilum (PO:0020063) of a seed (PO:0009010).

PO:0004721.label: paraclade cortex
PO:0004721.definition: A portion of cortex (PO:0005708) that is part of a higher order inflorescence axis (PO:0009081), also called a paraclade.
relationships: part_of PO:0009081 ! higher order inflorescence axis

PO:0004722.label: pedicel cortex
PO:0004722.definition: A portion of cortex (PO:0005708) that is part of a pedicel (PO:0030112).

PO:0004723.label: sepal vascular system
PO:0004723.definition: A phyllome vascular system (PO:0025206) that includes the totality of the portions of vascular tissue in their specific arrangement in a sepal (PO:0009031).

PO:0004724.label: hypocotyl-root junction
PO:0004724.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the part of a plant axis (PO:0025004) where a radicle (PO:0020031) joins a hypocotyl (PO:0020100).

synonyms.label: union del hipoc&#243tile con la ra&#237z (Spanish, exact)

PO:0004725.label: vascular leaf primordium abaxial side
PO:0004725.definition: A portion of vascular leaf primordium (PO:0000017) that is distal to the axis of the shoot apical meristem (PO:0020148) and develops into the abaxial side of the leaf lamina (PO:0020039).

synonyms.label: lado abaxial del primordio de hoja (Spanish, exact)
葉原基の裏側、背軸側 (Japanese, exact)  (exact)

PO:0004726.label: vascular leaf primordium adaxial side
PO:0004726.definition: A portion of vascular leaf primordium (PO:0000017) that is proximal to the axis of the shoot apical meristem (PO:0020148) and develops into the adaxial side of the leaf lamina (PO:0020039).

synonyms.label: lado adaxial del primordio de la hoja (Spanish, exact)
葉原基(可視的）の表側、向軸側 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0005001.label: basal axillary shoot system
PO:0005001.definition: An axillary shoot system (PO:0006343) that is part of a stem base (PO:0008039).

PO:0005002.label: cauline axillary shoot
PO:0005002.definition: An axillary branch that forms from a leaf above the very base of the shoot.

PO:0005003.label: shoot axis trichome
PO:0005003.definition: A trichome that is part of a shoot axis epidermis.

synonyms.label: eje de tricoma del epiblasto (epiblastema) (Spanish, exact)
シュート軸毛（毛茸、糸状体） (Japanese, exact)

PO:0005004.label: shoot axis node
PO:0005004.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a shoot axis (PO:0025029) where a bud (PO:0000055) may form and develop into a branch (PO:0025073), leaf (PO:0025034), flower (PO:0004541), inflorescence (PO:0009049) or nodal root (PO:0003005).

PO:0005005.label: shoot axis internode
PO:0005005.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a shoot axis (PO:0025029) that is between two shoot axis nodes (PO:0005004).

PO:0005006.label: articulated laticifer
PO:0005006.definition: A portion of secretory tissue (PO:0005656) that has as parts articulated laticifer cells (PO:0006221).

synonyms.label: 連合乳管（有節乳管） (Japanese, exact)

PO:0005007.label: OBSOLETE non-articulated laticifer
PO:0005007.definition: OBSOLETE. A structure consisting of long multinucleate tubes in which latex is found, having no cross walls.

PO:0005008.label: obsolete fruit septum
PO:0005008.definition: OBSOLETE. A thin partition or membrane that divides a cavity or a mass of tissue in the fruit that is derived from the carpel septum.

PO:0005009.label: OBSOLETE carpel septum
PO:0005009.definition: OBSOLETE. A thin partition or membrane that divides multilocular ovary. Often found in species with syncarpous (multiple carpels fused) pistil.

PO:0005010.label: anther septum
PO:0005010.definition: A septum (PO:0000030) that is part of an anther dehiscence zone (PO:0005011).

PO:0005011.label: anther dehiscence zone
PO:0005011.definition: A dehiscence zone (PO:0025092) that is part of an anther (PO:0009066).

synonyms.label: zona de dehiscencia de la antera (Spanish, exact)

PO:0005012.label: pedicel vascular system
PO:0005012.definition: A shoot axis vascular system (PO:0000039) that includes the totality of the portions of vascular tissue in their specific arrangement in a pedicel (PO:0030112).

PO:0005013.label: hypocotyl epidermis
PO:0005013.definition: A portion of stem epidermis (PO:0025178) which is the  outermost primary cell layer of the hypocotyl (PO:0020100).

PO:0005014.label: embryo cortex
PO:0005014.definition: A portion of cortex (PO:0005708) that is part of a plant embryo (PO:0009009).

PO:0005015.label: embryo endodermis
PO:0005015.definition: A portion of endodermis (PO:0000252) that is part of an plant embryo (PO:0009009).

PO:0005016.label: OBSOLETE replum
PO:0005016.definition: OBSOLETE. A false septum formed by the ingrowth from the placenta of an ovary rather than from the carpel walls. This is formed post fertilization.

PO:0005017.label: flower vascular system
PO:0005017.definition: A shoot system vascular system (PO:0025205) that includes the totality of the portions of vascular tissue in their specific arrangement in a flower (PO:0009046).

synonyms.label: sistema vascular de la flor (Spanish, exact)

PO:0005018.label: stamen vascular system
PO:0005018.definition: A phyllome vascular system (PO:0025206) that includes the totality of the portions of vascular tissue in their specific arrangement in a stamen (PO:0009029).

PO:0005019.label: carpel vascular system
PO:0005019.definition: A phyllome vascular system (PO:0025206) that includes the totality of the portions of vascular tissue in their specific arrangement in a carpel (PO:0009030).

PO:0005020.label: vascular bundle
PO:0005020.definition: A portion of vascular tissue (PO:0009015) that is a unit strand of the vascular system (PO:0000034) and has as part xylem (PO:0005352) or phloem (PO:0005417).

PO:0005021.label: sepal margin
PO:0005021.definition: A phyllome margin (PO:0025018) which is part of a sepal (PO:0009031).

PO:0005022.label: plant ovary wall
PO:0005022.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is composed of plant ovary outer epidermis (PO:0005023), plant ovary inner epidermis (PO:0005024), and a plant ovary wall middle layer (PO:0005025)

PO:0005023.label: plant ovary outer epidermis
PO:0005023.definition: A portion of plant ovary epidermis (PO:0006063) which is the outer surface of a plant ovary (PO:0009072).

synonyms.label: 子房の裏側 背軸側の表皮 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0005024.label: plant ovary inner epidermis
PO:0005024.definition: A portion of plant ovary epidermis (PO:0006063) which is the inner surface of a plant ovary (PO:0009072).

synonyms.label: 子房の表側、向軸側の表皮 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0005025.label: plant ovary wall middle layer
PO:0005025.definition: A portion of chlorenchyma tissue (PO:0005426) that is part of the plant ovary wall (PO:0005022) and is composed of mesophyll cells (PO:0004006).

synonyms.label: capa media de la pared del ovario (Spanish, exact)
middle layer of plant ovary wall (exact)

PO:0005026.label: root giant cell
PO:0005026.definition: Multinucleate cell developed by a series of events involving kayokinesis but not cytokinesis of the initial feeding cell. The events are induced by root knot nematodes (e.g., Meloidogyne sp. ) entering the feeding cells (any cells) of the root vascular system.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula gigante de la ra&#237z (Spanish, exact)

PO:0005027.label: root syncytium cell
PO:0005027.definition: Multinucleate cell developed by a series of events involving fusion with the neighboring dividing cells. The events are induced by cyst nematodes (e.g. Heterodera schachtii) entering the feeding cells (any cells) of the root vascular system.

PO:0005028.label: inflorescence vascular system
PO:0005028.definition: A shoot system vascular system  (PO:0025205) that includes the totality of the portions of vascular tissue in their specific arrangement in an inflorescence (PO:0009049).

PO:0005029.label: root primordium
PO:0005029.definition: A primordium (PO:0025127) that develops from a root anlagen (PO:0025433) and is committed to the development of a root (PO:0009005).

PO:0005030.label: lupulin gland
PO:0005030.definition: A glandular trichome (PO:0004509) that synthesizes terpenophenolic resins and prenylflavonoids.

PO:0005031.label: microsporangiate strobilus
PO:0005031.definition: A strobilus (PO:0025083) that bears only pollen (PO:0025281).

PO:0005032.label: megasporangiate strobilus
PO:0005032.definition: A strobilus (PO:0025083) that bears only plant ovules (PO:0020003).

PO:0005039.label: primary thickening meristem
PO:0005039.definition: A shoot lateral meristem (PO:0006344) that is part of a shoot axis (PO:0025029) and has a parts multiple layers of meristematic cells (PO:0004010) located near the shoot apical meristem (PO:0020148).

synonyms.label: 一次 肥厚（膜）分裂組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0005040.label: root pith
PO:0005040.definition: A portion of pith (PO:0006109) that is part of a root stele (PO:0020124).

PO:0005041.label: shoot axis pith
PO:0005041.definition: A portion of pith (PO:0006109) that is part of a shoot axis (PO:0025029).

synonyms.label: m&#233dula del eje del epiblasto (epiblastema) (Spanish, exact)

PO:0005043.label: secondary phloem
PO:0005043.definition: A portion of phloem (PO:0005417) tissue that develops from a vascular cambium (PO:0005598).

PO:0005046.label: periderm
PO:0005046.definition: A peripheral portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) in a plant axis (PO:0025004) that is composed of cork cambium (phellogen; PO:0005599), phellem (PO:0004003), and phelloderm (PO:0005050).

PO:0005047.label: root periderm
PO:0005047.definition: A portion of periderm tissue (PO:0005046) that is part of a root (PO:0009005).

PO:0005048.label: shoot axis periderm
PO:0005048.definition: A portion of periderm tissue (PO:0005046) that is part of a shoot axis (PO:0025029).

synonyms.label: peridermis del eje del epiblasto (epiblastema) (Spanish, exact)

PO:0005050.label: phelloderm
PO:0005050.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) often resembling cortical parenchyma produced centripetally by the cork cambium.

PO:0005051.label: hypodermis
PO:0005051.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) that is the outermost layer of a portion of cortex (PO:0005708).

PO:0005052.label: plant callus
PO:0005052.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that consists of mass of undifferentiated plant cells (PO:0009002).

PO:0005053.label: OBSOLETE laticifer
PO:0005053.definition: OBSOLETE. A secretory structure that produces latex.

PO:0005057.label: shoot axis hypodermis
PO:0005057.definition: A portion of shoot axis hypodermis (PO:0005057) that is part of a stem cortex (PO:0000223).

synonyms.label: hipodermis del eje del epiblasto (epiblastema) (Spanish, exact)

PO:0005058.label: shoot axis endodermis
PO:0005058.definition: A portion of endodermis (PO:0000252) that is part of a shoot axis cortex (PO:0000223).

synonyms.label: endodermis de eje del epiblasto (epiblastema) (Spanish, exact)
シュート軸内胚葉 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0005059.label: root endodermis
PO:0005059.definition: A portion of endodermis that is part of a root cortex.

PO:0005060.label: leaf endodermis
PO:0005060.definition: A portion of endodermis that is part of a vascular leaf.

PO:0005349.label: OBSOLETE schizo-lysigenous aerenchyma
PO:0005349.definition: OBSOLETE. Aerenchyma, originating by a combination of two processes, separation and degradation of cell walls.

PO:0005352.label: xylem
PO:0005352.definition: A portion of vascular tissue (PO:0009015) that has as part one or more tracheary elements (PO:0000290).

PO:0005360.label: aleurone layer
PO:0005360.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the outermost layer of endosperm (PO:0009089) in a seed (PO:0009010), its cells being characterized by presence of protein bodies (GO:0042735).

synonyms.label: 糊粉粒、アリューロン層 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0005415.label: endosperm parenchyma
PO:0005415.definition: A portion of seed storage parenchyma that is part of an endosperm.

synonyms.label: 内胚乳、胚乳柔組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0005417.label: phloem
PO:0005417.definition: A portion of vascular tissue (PO:0009015) that has as parts sieve elements (PO:0025406).

PO:0005421.label: parenchyma
PO:0005421.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) composed of polyhedral cells typically with thin, non-lignified cellulosic cell walls and nucleate, living protoplasts.

PO:0005423.label: collenchyma
PO:0005423.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) which comprises living tissue composed of more or less elongated cells with thick, non-lignified primary cell walls.

synonyms.label: 同化組織、葉緑組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0005427.label: sclerenchyma
PO:0005427.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) which comprises supporting tissue composed of plant fiber cells (PO:0025407) or sclereid cells (PO:0025418).

PO:0005597.label: cambium
PO:0005597.definition: A lateral meristem (PO:0020145) that has as part a single layer of cambial initial cells (PO:0000295) and their derivatives, arranged orderly in radial files.

PO:0005598.label: vascular cambium
PO:0005598.definition: A cambium (PO:0005597) that is located between and gives rise to secondary xylem (PO:0005848) and secondary phloem (PO:0005043).

PO:0005599.label: cork cambium
PO:0005599.definition: A cambium (PO:0005597) that is part of a periderm (PO:0005046) and produces phellem (PO:0004003) and phelloderm (PO:0005050).

PO:0005621.label: OBSOLETE angular collenchyma
PO:0005621.definition: OBSOLETE. A form of collenchyma in which the primary wall thickening is most prominent in the angles where three or more cells are joined.

PO:0005632.label: OBSOLETE lacunar collenchyma
PO:0005632.definition: OBSOLETE. A collenchyma characterized by intercellular spaces and cell wall thickenings facing the intercellular spaces.

PO:0005633.label: OBSOLETE lamellar collenchyma
PO:0005633.definition: OBSOLETE. A collenchyma in which cell wall thickenings are deposited mainly on tangential walls.

PO:0005645.label: leaf mesophyll
PO:0005645.definition: The chloroplast-containing, photosynthetic parenchymatous tissue situated between the two epidermal layers of the foliage leaf.

PO:0005647.label: spongy mesophyll
PO:0005647.definition: Leaf mesophyll parenchyma characterized by little elongated cells, that are not closely packed and have conspicuous intercellular spaces.

PO:0005648.label: palisade mesophyll
PO:0005648.definition: Parenchyma containing closely packed elongated chlorenchymatous cells oriented perpendicular to the leaf surface and which are active in photosynthesis.

PO:0005656.label: portion of secretory tissue
PO:0005656.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that form specialized structures producing a secretion.

PO:0005660.label: hydathode
PO:0005660.definition: A cardinal organ part that releases water through a hydathode pore.

PO:0005661.label: salt gland
PO:0005661.definition: A specialized tissue where excess salt absorbed in water from the soil is concentrated, being stores or excreted.

PO:0005665.label: resin canal
PO:0005665.definition: A canal (PO:0025132) of schizogenous origin, lined with secretory resin cells (PO:0025604) and containing plant resin (PO:0025603).

PO:0005669.label: oil gland
PO:0005669.definition: A gland or a cavity lined with cells that secrete oils.

PO:0005679.label: plant epidermis
PO:0005679.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) composed of plant epidermal cells (PO:0004013) that develops from the protoderm (PO:0006210) and covers the surface of a plant structure (PO:0009011).

PO:0005702.label: aerenchyma
PO:0005702.definition: A portion of parenchyma tissue containing particularly large intercellular spaces of schizogenous or lysigenous origin.

PO:0005704.label: OBSOLETE rhexigenous aerenchyma
PO:0005704.definition: OBSOLETE. Aerenchyma originating by rupture of cells.

PO:0005706.label: OBSOLETE lysigenous aerenchyma
PO:0005706.definition: OBSOLETE. Aerenchyma originating by dissolution of cells.

PO:0005708.label: cortex
PO:0005708.definition: A maximal portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) between the vascular system (PO:0000034) and the epidermis (PO:0005679) in a plant.

PO:0005752.label: OBSOLETE promeristem
PO:0005752.definition: OBSOLETE. Meristematic tissue consisting of apical initials, together with cells derived from them and which are still close to the initial.

PO:0005772.label: exodermis
PO:0005772.definition: The sub-epidermal layer or layers of cells of the root similar in structure and cytochemical characteristics of the endodermis, the outermost layer or layers of cells of the cortex.

PO:0005848.label: secondary xylem
PO:0005848.definition: A portion of xylem (PO:0005352) tissue that develops from a vascular cambium (PO:0005598).

PO:0005849.label: primary xylem
PO:0005849.definition: A portion of xylem (PO:0005352) tissue that develops from the procambium (PO:0025275).

PO:0006000.label: caryopsis hull
PO:0006000.definition: A collective phyllome structure that encloses a fruit of the Poaceae (caryopsis) and develops from a dried lemma and palea.

synonyms.label: イネ科植物 籾殻、外皮 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006001.label: phyllome
PO:0006001.definition: A lateral plant organ (PO:0009008) produced by a shoot apical meristem (PO:0020148).

synonyms.label: フィロム、葉(的）器官 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006002.label: lower glume
PO:0006002.definition: A glume that is the proximal/basal of the two glumes subtending a pair of florets.

PO:0006003.label: scale leaf
PO:0006003.definition: A phyllome that is reduced in size relative to a vascular leaf on the same plant and is often associated with a perennating or dormant bud or a vegetatively propagating organ such as a rhizome.

PO:0006004.label: upper glume
PO:0006004.definition: A glume that is the apical/distal of the two glumes subtending a pair of florets.

PO:0006005.label: carpel anlagen
PO:0006005.definition: A phyllome anlagen (PO:0025430) that will give rise to a carpel primordium (PO:0004703) and is part of a peripheral zone (PO:000225) of a flower meristem (PO:0000229).

PO:0006006.label: anther wall primary parietal cell layer
PO:0006006.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) that is part of an anther wall (PO:0000002) and has as parts a primary parietal cell (PO:0006010) and adjacent plant cells.

synonyms.label: capa primaria de c&#233lulas parietales (Spanish, exact)
pollen sac primary parietal cell layer (exact)
葯壁一次側膜細胞層、壁細胞層 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006007.label: anther wall secondary parietal cell layer
PO:0006007.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) that is part of an anther wall (PO:0000002) and develops from an anther wall primary parietal cell layer (PO:0006006).

synonyms.label: capa secundaria de c&#233lulas parietales (Spanish, exact)
pollen sac secondary parietal cell layer (exact)
葯壁二次側膜細胞層、壁細胞層 (Japanese, exact)

relationships: develops_from PO:0006006 ! anther wall primary parietal cell layer

PO:0006008.label: anther wall inner secondary parietal cell layer
PO:0006008.definition: An anther wall secondary parietal cell layer (PO:0006007) that is formed towards the inside, after the cells of an anther wall primary parietal cell layer (PO:0006006) undergo a periclinal division.

synonyms.label: capa interna secundaria de c&#233lulas parietales (Spanish, exact)
pollen sac inner secondary parietal cell layer (exact)
葯壁内二次側膜細胞層 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006009.label: anther wall outer secondary parietal cell layer
PO:0006009.definition: An anther wall secondary parietal cell layer (PO:0006007) formed towards the outside, after an anther wall primary parietal cell layer (An anther wall secondary parietal cell layer (PO:0006006) undergoes a periclinal division.

synonyms.label: capa externa secundaria de c&#233lulas parietales (Spanish, exact)
pollen sac outer secondary parietal cell layer (exact)
葯壁外二次側膜細胞層、壁細胞層 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006010.label: primary parietal cell
PO:0006010.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) which is formed by the division of a male archesporial cell (PO:0006014), and is part of the anther wall primary parietal cell layer (PO:0006006).

synonyms.label: 一次側膜細胞、壁細胞 (Japanese, exact)

relationships: part_of PO:0006006 ! anther wall primary parietal cell layer

PO:0006011.label: lateral leaf vein
PO:0006011.definition: An unbranched second order leaf vein (PO:0020140) that runs between two adjacent primary leaf veins (PO:0025413).

PO:0006012.label: leaf collar
PO:0006012.definition: A thin band of intercalary meristematic tissue at the junction of a leaf blade (lamina) and a leaf sheath found in grasses.

PO:0006013.label: juice sac tissue
PO:0006013.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) which is composed of highly vacuolated cells forming closely-packed, club-shaped sacs with long slender stalks and containing juice.

PO:0006014.label: male archesporial cell
PO:0006014.definition: An archesporial cell (PO:0030056) that is part of a microsporangium (PO:0025202) and divides to gives rise to a microsporocyte (PO:0020047).

PO:0006015.label: female archesporial cell
PO:0006015.definition: An archesporial cell (PO:0030056) that is part of a megasporangium (PO:0025201) and divides to give rise to a megasporocyte (PO:0000431).

PO:0006016.label: leaf epidermis
PO:0006016.definition: A portion of phyllome epidermis (PO:0025157) that is part of a leaf (PO:0025034).

PO:0006017.label: helobial endosperm
PO:0006017.definition: A portion of endosperm (PO:0009089) tissue in which the first karyokinetic event is accompanied by the formation of a horizontal wall which divides the embryo sac central cell (PO:0020090) into unequal regions. The larger one is the micropylar chamber in which cytokinesis does not occur and the smaller one is the chalazal chamber.

PO:0006018.label: leaf adaxial epidermis
PO:0006018.definition: A portion of leaf epidermis (PO:0006016) that covers the adaxial/upper surface of a leaf (PO:0025034).

synonyms.label: epidermis adaxial de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0006019.label: leaf abaxial epidermis
PO:0006019.definition: A portion of leaf epidermis (PO:0006016) that covers the abaxial/lower surface of a leaf (PO:0025034).

synonyms.label: epidermis abaxial de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0006020.label: lateral root apical meristem
PO:0006020.definition: A root apical meristem (PO:0020147) that gives rise to a lateral root (PO:0020121).

synonyms.label: meristema apical de la ra&#237z lateral (Spanish, exact)
側根頂端分裂組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006021.label: shoot-borne root apical meristem
PO:0006021.definition: A root apical meristem (PO:0020147) that gives rise to a shoot-borne root (PO:0000042).

synonyms.label: meristema de la ra&#237z adventicia (Spanish, exact)
不定根頂端分裂組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006022.label: bundle sheath extension
PO:0006022.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) which forms a strip along the leaf veins and extending from the bundle sheath (PO:0006023) to the epidermis. It may be present on one or both sides of the vein and may consist of parenchyma or sclerenchyma.

synonyms.label: extensi&#243n de la vaina vascular (Spanish, exact)

PO:0006023.label: bundle sheath
PO:0006023.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) which comprises a layer or layers of cells surrounding the vascular bundles (PO:0005020) of leaves. It may consist of parenchyma (PO:0005421) or sclerenchyma (PO:0005427).

PO:0006024.label: parenchyma sheath
PO:0006024.definition: A single layered, parenchymatous bundle sheath characterized by presence of large quantity of starch.

PO:0006025.label: mestome sheath
PO:0006025.definition: The inner endodermal sheath of a two layered bundle sheath. The cells are smaller in diameter compared to those in outer wall (starch sheath). The cell walls are thick and contain suberized lamellae. They are analogous to endodermis.

synonyms.label: メストム鞘、維管束鞘の内側、維管束鞘延長部 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006032.label: lemma awn
PO:0006032.definition: An awn that is part of a lemma.

PO:0006033.label: palea apiculus
PO:0006033.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) which is a short, abrupt, flexible point at the apex of the palea (PO:0009038).

PO:0006034.label: leaflet margin
PO:0006034.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the edge of a leaflet (PO:0020049) and the area immediately internally adjacent to it.

PO:0006035.label: shoot system epidermis
PO:0006035.definition: A portion of plant epidermis (PO:0005679) that is part of a shoot system (PO:0009006) and arises from the meristem L1 layer (PO:0009020).

PO:0006036.label: root epidermis
PO:0006036.definition: A portion of plant epidermis (PO:0005679) that is part of a root (PO:0009005).

PO:0006039.label: shoot-borne root epidermis
PO:0006039.definition: A portion of root epidermis (PO:0006036) that is part of a shoot-borne root (PO:0000042).

synonyms.label: epidermis de la ra&#237z adventicia (Spanish, exact)

PO:0006040.label: sepal epidermis
PO:0006040.definition: A portion of phyllome epidermis (PO:0025157) that is part of a sepal (PO:0009031).

PO:0006041.label: petal epidermis
PO:0006041.definition: A portion of phyllome epidermis (PO:0025157) that is part of a petal (PO:0009032).

PO:0006042.label: velamen
PO:0006042.definition: A  multiseriate portion of root epidermis (PO:0006036) found in aerial roots of some monocots. Most of its cells are dead and store water like a sponge.

PO:0006043.label: integument epidermis
PO:0006043.definition: A portion of plant epidermis (PO:0005679) that is part of an plant ovule integument (PO:0020021).

PO:0006044.label: inner integument epidermis
PO:0006044.definition: A portion of integument epidermis (PO:0006043) of the inner integument (PO:0020022) in a plant ovule (PO:0020003).
relationships: part_of PO:0020022 ! plant ovule inner integument

PO:0006045.label: outer integument epidermis
PO:0006045.definition: A portion of integument epidermis (PO:0006043) of the outer integument (PO:0020023) in a plant ovule (PO:0020003).
relationships: part_of PO:0020023 ! plant ovule outer integument

PO:0006048.label: seed coat epidermis
PO:0006048.definition: A portion of plant epidermis (PO:0005679) that is part of a seed coat (PO:0009088).

synonyms.label: epidermis de la cubierta de la semilla (Spanish, exact)

PO:0006049.label: scutellum epidermis
PO:0006049.definition: A portion of shoot system epidermis (PO:0006035) that is part of the scutellum (PO:0020110).

PO:0006050.label: exotesta
PO:0006050.definition: A portion of seed coat epidermis (PO:0006048) which is part of the seed coat (PO:0009088), and develops from the outer surface of the outer integument (PO:0020023).

synonyms.label: 外珠皮の外側の表皮から発生する外種皮 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006051.label: endotesta
PO:0006051.definition: A portion of seed coat epidermis (PO:0006048) which is part of a seed coat (PO:0009088) and develops from the inner epidermis of the outer integument (PO:0020023).

synonyms.label: 外珠皮の内側の表皮から発生する外種皮 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006052.label: petal abaxial epidermis
PO:0006052.definition: A portion of petal epidermis (PO:0006041) that covers the abaxial/lower surface of a petal (PO:0009032).

synonyms.label: 花弁背軸側 表皮 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006053.label: petal adaxial epidermis
PO:0006053.definition: A portion of petal epidermis (PO:0006041) that covers the adaxial/upper surface of a petal (PO:0009032).

synonyms.label: 花弁向軸側 表皮 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006054.label: sepal abaxial epidermis
PO:0006054.definition: A portion of sepal epidermis (PO:0006040) that covers the abaxial/lower surface of a sepal (PO:0009031).

synonyms.label: がく片背軸側 表皮 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006055.label: sepal adaxial epidermis
PO:0006055.definition: A portion of sepal epidermis (PO:0006040) that covers the adaxial/upper surface of a sepal (PO:0009031).

synonyms.label: がく片向軸側 表皮 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006056.label: cotyledon epidermis
PO:0006056.definition: A portion of leaf epidermis (PO:0006016) that is part of a cotyledon (PO:0020030).

PO:0006057.label: cotyledon abaxial epidermis
PO:0006057.definition: A portion of leaf epidermis (PO:0006016) which is the abaxial/lower epidermis of the cotyledon (PO:0020030).

synonyms.label: 子葉 背軸側 表皮 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006058.label: cotyledon adaxial epidermis
PO:0006058.definition: A portion of leaf epidermis (PO:0006016) which is the adaxial/upper epidermis of the cotyledon (PO:0020030).

synonyms.label: 子葉 向軸側 表皮 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006060.label: filament epidermis
PO:0006060.definition: A portion of stamen epidermis (PO:0025097) that is part of a filament (PO:0009067).

PO:0006061.label: stigma epidermis
PO:0006061.definition: A portion of carpel epidermis (PO:0025096) that is part of a stigma (PO:0009073).

PO:0006062.label: style epidermis
PO:0006062.definition: A portion of carpel epidermis (PO:0025096) that is part of a style (PO:0009074).

PO:0006063.label: plant ovary epidermis
PO:0006063.definition: A portion of plant epidermis (PO:0005679) that is part of an plant ovary wall (PO:0005022).

PO:0006065.label: hypocotyl endodermis
PO:0006065.definition: A portion of endodermis (PO:0000252) that is part of a hypocotyl (PO:0020100).

PO:0006066.label: petiole parenchyma
PO:0006066.definition: A portion of parenchyma tissue that is part of a petiole.

PO:0006067.label: OBSOLETE cambium-like transitional zone
PO:0006067.definition: OBSOLETE. A cup-shaped region in the shoot apical meristem found between the central mother cell and the rib and peripheral zone. The cells of this zone are derived from the corpus intials, but in some cases they arise also from tunica initials.

synonyms.label: zona transicional semejante al cambium (Spanish, exact)

PO:0006068.label: sepal parenchyma
PO:0006068.definition: A portion of parenchyma tissue that is part of a sepal.

PO:0006069.label: petal parenchyma
PO:0006069.definition: A portion of parenchyma (PO:0005421) tissue that is part of a petal (PO:0009032).

PO:0006070.label: mesophyll
PO:0006070.definition: The chloroplast-containing, photosynthetic parenchymatous tissue situated between the two epidermal layers of the leaf or leaf like organs.

PO:0006071.label: petal mesophyll
PO:0006071.definition: The chloroplast-containing, photosynthetic parenchymatous tissue situated between the two epidermal layers of the petal.

PO:0006072.label: sepal mesophyll
PO:0006072.definition: The chloroplast-containing, photosynthetic parenchymatous tissue situated between the two epidermal layers of the sepal.

PO:0006073.label: intercalary meristem
PO:0006073.definition: A shoot system meristem (PO:0006079) that is intercalated between two portions of non-meristematic tissue and results in an increase in length as part of primary growth.

synonyms.label: 節間分裂組織、介在分裂組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006074.label: obsolete procambium
PO:0006074.definition: OBSOLETE. A portion of primary cambium that undergoes differentiation to form the primary vascular tissue.

PO:0006075.label: primary phloem
PO:0006075.definition: A portion of phloem (PO:0005417) tissue that develops from the procambium (PO:0025275).

PO:0006076.label: metaphloem
PO:0006076.definition: A portion of primary phloem (PO:0006075) tissue that has as parts companion cells (PO:0000071, in angiosperms) or albuminous cells (PO:0025412, in gymnosperms) associated with the sieve elements (PO:0025406) and that develops after the protophloem (PO:0006077).

PO:0006077.label: protophloem
PO:0006077.definition: A portion of primary phloem (PO:0006075) tissue has as parts the first-formed sieve elements (PO:0025406) at a particular location and does not have companion cells (PO:0000071, in angiosperms) or albuminous cells (PO:0025412, in gymnosperms) associated with the sieve elements.

PO:0006078.label: obsolete primary vascular tissue
PO:0006078.definition: OBSOLETE. The vascular tissue of the primary plant body at the embryonic stage.

PO:0006079.label: shoot system meristem
PO:0006079.definition: A portion of meristem tissue (PO:0009013) that is part of a shoot system (PO:0009006).

synonyms.label: シュート分裂組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006080.label: obsolete secondary vascular tissue
PO:0006080.definition: OBSOLETE. The vascular tissue derived from the vascular cambium because of the secondary growth.

PO:0006081.label: primary root apical meristem
PO:0006081.definition: A root apical meristem (PO:0020147) that gives rise to a primary root (PO:0020127).

synonyms.label: meristema apical de la ra&#237z primaria (Spanish, exact)
一次根頂端分裂組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006082.label: abaxial protoderm
PO:0006082.definition: A portion of protoderm (PO:0006210) tissue that is the outermost layer of the shoot apical meristem (PO:0020148), and gives rise to the leaf abaxial epidermis (PO:0006019).

PO:0006083.label: adaxial protoderm
PO:0006083.definition: A portion of protoderm (PO:0006210) tissue that is the outermost layer of the shoot apical meristem (PO:0020148), and gives rise to the leaf adaxial epidermis (PO:0006018).

PO:0006084.label: portion of transfusion tissue
PO:0006084.definition: Tissue consisting of tracheids and parenchyma cells, associated with the vascular bundle.

synonyms.label: porci&#243n del tejido de transfusi&#243n (Spanish, exact)

PO:0006085.label: root meristem
PO:0006085.definition: A portion of meristem tissue (PO:0009013) that gives rise to a root (PO:0009005).

PO:0006086.label: OBSOLETE accessory transfusion tissue
PO:0006086.definition: OBSOLETE. The accessory tissue extending laterally into the mesophyll rather than remaining associated with the vascular bundles.

PO:0006087.label: OBSOLETE proliferation tissue
PO:0006087.definition: OBSOLETE. Tissue that develops from phloem parenchyma in the outer portion of the inner bark accommodating the expansion in circumference.

PO:0006088.label: primary sporogenous cell
PO:0006088.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) is formed by the division of the male archesporial initial. After several mitotic divisions these cells differentiate into pollen mother cells.

synonyms.label: 一次胞子形成細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006089.label: anther primordium
PO:0006089.definition: A floral structure primordium (PO:0025477) that is committed to the development of an anther (PO:0009066).

PO:0006090.label: organogenic callus
PO:0006090.definition: A cultured plant callus that is capable of forming plant organs.

PO:0006091.label: embryogenic callus
PO:0006091.definition: A cultured plant callus (PO:0000009) that is capable of forming somatic embryos.

PO:0006109.label: pith
PO:0006109.definition: A maximal portion of parenchyma (PO:0005421) in the center of a shoot axis (PO:0025029) or root (PO:0009005).

PO:0006200.label: fascicular cambium
PO:0006200.definition: A portion of vascular cambium (PO:0005598) that develops from a procambium (PO:0025275) in a vascular bundle (PO:0005020) that is part of a shoot system (PO:0009006).

PO:0006201.label: interfascicular cambium
PO:0006201.definition: A portion of vascular cambium (PO:00055980) that develops from cells in an interfascicular region (PO:0006202) that is part of a shoot system (PO:0009006).

PO:0006202.label: interfascicular region
PO:0006202.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) located between vascular bundles in a shoot axis.

PO:0006203.label: pericycle
PO:0006203.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) that is part of a root stele located between the phloem and endodermis.

PO:0006204.label: sporocyte
PO:0006204.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) which is diploid (2n), and undergoes meiosis (GO:0007126) to produce four haploid (1n) plant spores (PO:0025017).

PO:0006205.label: spongy mesophyll cell
PO:0006205.definition: Irregularly-shaped, chlorenchymatous cell, separated by large air spaces.

PO:0006206.label: palisade mesophyll cell
PO:0006206.definition: Elongated chlorenchymatous cell oriented perpendicular to the leaf surface and which is active in photosynthesis.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula del mes&#243filo en empalizada (Spanish, exact)

PO:0006207.label: exodermal passage cell
PO:0006207.definition: A short cell in the dimorphic type of exodermis with cell wall that remains non-thickened.

PO:0006208.label: endodermal passage cell
PO:0006208.definition: Cell in the endodermal layer of the root with cell wall that remains non-thickened.

PO:0006209.label: OBSOLETE lateral root epidermis
PO:0006209.definition: OBSOLETE. The outer most cell layer of the lateral roots.

synonyms.label: epidermis de la ra&#237z lateral (Spanish, exact)

PO:0006210.label: protoderm
PO:0006210.definition: A portion of meristem tissue (PO:0009013) that is the outer layer of an apical meristem (PO:0020144), or the outer layer of a plant embryo proper (PO:0000001), and gives rise to a portion of epidermis (PO:0005679).

PO:0006211.label: separation layer
PO:0006211.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is part of an abscission zone (PO:0000146) and contains cells that develop an abnormal wall chemistry and swelling resulting in their easily being pulled apart along the pectin-rich middle lamella (GO:0009519).

PO:0006212.label: protective layer
PO:0006212.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) composed of a layer of cells that is part of the abscission zone (PO:0000146) that have lignin and suberin depositions and are found on the axial side of the break or exposed surface of abscission.

PO:0006213.label: root aerenchyma
PO:0006213.definition: Parenchyma tissue containing particularly large intercellular spaces in the tissue of roots.

PO:0006214.label: stem aerenchyma
PO:0006214.definition: A portion of aerenchyma that is part of a stem.

PO:0006215.label: leaf aerenchyma
PO:0006215.definition: A portion of parenchyma tissue containing particularly large intercellular spaces in the leaf mesophyll.

PO:0006216.label: internal phloem
PO:0006216.definition: A portion of primary phloem tissue positioned internal to the primary xylem.

PO:0006218.label: exotegmen
PO:0006218.definition: A portion of seed coat epidermis (PO:0006048) which is part of the seed coat (PO:0009088) and develops from the outer surface of the inner integument (PO:0020022).

synonyms.label: 内珠皮の外側の表皮から発生する内種皮 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006219.label: endotegmen
PO:0006219.definition: A portion of seed coat epidermis (PO:0006048) which is part of the seed coat (PO:0009088) and develops from the inner epidermis of the inner integument (PO:0020022).

synonyms.label: 内珠皮の内側の表皮から発生する内種皮 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006220.label: central endosperm
PO:0006220.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the central region of an endosperm (PO:0009089), composed of cells that are significantly larger than those at the periphery, especially the aleurone and sub-aleurone layers.

PO:0006221.label: articulated laticifer cell
PO:0006221.definition: A laticifer cell (PO:0025031) that is joined longitudinally to other articulated laticifer cells to form a tube.

synonyms.label: 連合乳管（有節乳管）細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006222.label: non-articulated laticifer cell
PO:0006222.definition: A laticifer cell (PO:0025031) that is not joined longitudinally to other laticifer cells to form a tube.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula del latic&#237fero no articulado (Spanish, exact)
無節乳管細胞、単乳管細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006300.label: obsolete plant structure
PO:0006300.definition: OBSOLETE. The instances of this parent term are those anatomical terms which have become obsolete.

PO:0006301.label: OBSOLETE corpus
PO:0006301.definition: OBSOLETE. Group of cells located beneath anticlinally dividing peripheral layers (tunica) and dividing in many planes. In apical shoot meristem. Such division cause the increase in the volume of shoot.

PO:0006302.label: OBSOLETE tunica
PO:0006302.definition: OBSOLETE. The outermost layer or layers in the shoot apical meristem of the Angiosperms in which the plane of division is almost anticlinal. This layer contributes to surface growth.

PO:0006303.label: OBSOLETE L1
PO:0006303.definition: OBSOLETE. The outer layer of the tunica.

PO:0006304.label: OBSOLETE L2
PO:0006304.definition: OBSOLETE. The second layer of the tunica.

PO:0006305.label: OBSOLETE L3
PO:0006305.definition: OBSOLETE. The innermost layer of the tunica.

PO:0006306.label: obsolete shoot procambium
PO:0006306.definition: OBSOLETE. A derivative of the apical meristem which undergoes differentiation to form the primary vascular tissue of a shoot.

PO:0006307.label: root procambium
PO:0006307.definition: A portion of procambium (PO:0025275) tissue that undergoes differentiation to form the primary vascular tissue (PO:0025408) of a root (PO:0009005).

PO:0006308.label: root lateral meristem
PO:0006308.definition: A lateral meristem (PO:0020145) that is part of a root (PO:0009005).

synonyms.label: meristema lateral de la ra&#237z (Spanish, exact)

PO:0006309.label: tassel spikelet
PO:0006309.definition: A spikelet (PO:0009051) that is part of the tassel inflorescence (PO:0020126) and bears tassel florets (PO:0006310) at maturity.
relationships: develops_from PO:0006358 ! tassel spikelet pair meristem

PO:0006310.label: tassel floret
PO:0006310.definition: A small staminate flower (PO:0025600) that is part of a tassel spikelet (PO:0006309).

PO:0006311.label: tassel sessile spikelet
PO:0006311.definition: A tassel spikelet (PO:0006309) which is the ultimate, sessile, higher order inflorescence axis (PO:0009081) of the maize tassel inflorescence (PO:0020126).

synonyms.label: 雄穂（花）の無柄小穂 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006312.label: tassel pedicellate spikelet
PO:0006312.definition: A tassel spikelet (PO:0006309) which is the ultimate, pedicellate, higher order inflorescence axis (PO:0009081) of the maize tassel inflorescence (PO:0020126).

synonyms.label: 雄穂（花）の有柄小穂 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006313.label: lower floret of pedicellate spikelet of tassel
PO:0006313.definition: A tassel floret that is the lower of the two florets of a pedicellate spikelet of a tassel inflorescence.

synonyms.label: florete inferior de la espiguilla pedicelada (Spanish, exact)
雄穂（花）の有柄小穂の下位小花 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006314.label: upper floret of pedicellate spikelet of tassel
PO:0006314.definition: A tassel floret that is one of the two florets placed above the lower floret on a pedicellate spikelet rachilla of a tassel inflorescence.

synonyms.label: florete superior de la espiguilla pedicelada (Spanish, exact)
雄穂（花）の有柄小穂の上位小花 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006315.label: lower floret of sessile spikelet of tassel
PO:0006315.definition: A tassel floret that is the lower of the two florets of a sessile spikelet of a tassel inflorescence.

synonyms.label: florete inferior de la espiguilla s&#233sil (Spanish, exact)
雄穂（花）の無柄小穂の下位小花 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006316.label: upper floret of sessile spikelet of tassel
PO:0006316.definition: A tassel floret that is one of the two florets placed above the lower floret on a sessile spikelet rachilla of a tassel inflorescence.

synonyms.label: florete superior de la espiguilla s&#233sil (Spanish, exact)
雄穂（花）の無柄小穂の上位小花 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006319.label: spikelet pedicel
PO:0006319.definition: Inflorescence branch that terminates in a spikelet.

PO:0006320.label: ear spikelet
PO:0006320.definition: A spikelet (PO:0009051) that is part of the ear inflorescence (PO:0020136) and bears a single ear floret (PO:0006354) at maturity.

PO:0006321.label: second order inflorescence axis
PO:0006321.definition: A higher order inflorescence axis (PO:0009081) that develops from an inflorescence axillary meristem (PO:0009105) of a first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104).

synonyms.label: eje de segundo orden de la inflorescencia (Spanish, exact)

PO:0006322.label: third order inflorescence axis
PO:0006322.definition: A higher order inflorescence axis (PO:0009081) that develops from an inflorescence axillary meristem (PO:0009105) of a second order inflorescence axis (PO:0006322).

synonyms.label: eje de tercero orden de la inflorescencia  (Spanish, exact)

PO:0006323.label: tassel inflorescence branch
PO:0006323.definition: An inflorescence branch (PO:0009081) arising on a first order tassel inflorescence axis (PO:0006324) or from a higher order inflorescence branch (PO:0009081) that is part of a tassel inflorescence (PO:0020126).

PO:0006324.label: first order tassel inflorescence axis
PO:0006324.definition: A first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104) that is the primary axis of a tassel inflorescence (PO:0020126).

synonyms.label: espiga central del penacho (borla) de la inflorescencia (Spanish, exact)

PO:0006325.label: inflorescence axis node
PO:0006325.definition: A shoot axis node (PO:0005004) that is part of an inflorescence axis (PO:0020122).

PO:0006326.label: inflorescence axis internode
PO:0006326.definition: A shoot axis internode (PO:0005005) that is part of an inflorescence axis (PO:0020122).

PO:0006327.label: spikelet meristem
PO:0006327.definition: An inflorescence apical meristem that gives rise to the two or more florets of a grass inflorescence.

PO:0006328.label: spikelet pair meristem
PO:0006328.definition: The meristem that produces two spikelet meristems, each of which produces two floral meristems.

synonyms.label: par de meristemas de la espiguilla (Spanish, exact)

PO:0006330.label: gynophore
PO:0006330.definition: A shoot axis (PO:0025029) that is an elongation of the floral axis that supports the carpel (PO:0009030).

synonyms.label: 花被間柱、子房柄、雌蕊柄 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006331.label: seed raphe
PO:0006331.definition: A cardinal part of multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025498) that is a ridge on a seed (PO:0009010) that develops from a raphe (PO:0020027).

PO:0006332.label: seed funicle
PO:0006332.definition: A cardinal part of multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025498) that is attached to a seed (PO:0009010) and is the remnants of a funicle (PO:0020006).

PO:0006333.label: seed chalaza
PO:0006333.definition: A remnant of the ovular chalaza that is part of the seed.

PO:0006334.label: seed micropyle
PO:0006334.definition: A plant anatomical space that is enclosed by and forms an opening in a seed coat at the apex of a seed and is the remnant of a micropyle.

PO:0006336.label: seed obturator
PO:0006336.definition: An outgrowth of the seed funicle, that forms a bridge between the seed micropyle and other tissues. It is also a remnant form of the obturator found in the ovular funicle.

PO:0006338.label: embryo leaf
PO:0006338.definition: A vascular leaf that is part of a plant embryo and is one of the first few leaves to develop from the embryonic shoot apical meristem.

PO:0006339.label: juvenile vascular leaf
PO:0006339.definition: A vascular leaf that is distinct from adult leaves, being characterized by particular anatomical traits namely, wax and trichome distribution, presence or absence of epidermal cell types, cell wall shape and biochemistry.

PO:0006340.label: adult vascular leaf
PO:0006340.definition: A vascular leaf characterized by particular anatomical traits namely, wax and trichome distribution, presence or absence of epidermal cell types, cell wall shape and biochemistry.

PO:0006341.label: primary shoot system
PO:0006341.definition: A shoot system (PO:0009006) that develops from an embryo shoot apical meristem (PO:0006362).

PO:0006342.label: infructescence
PO:0006342.definition: A reproductive shoot system (PO:0025082) that develops from an inflorescence (PO:0009049) and has as parts each infructescence axis (PO:0025242) and all of the fruits (PO:0009001) borne by those axes.

PO:0006343.label: axillary shoot system
PO:0006343.definition: A shoot-borne shoot system (PO:0004545) that develops from an axillary bud (PO:0004709).

PO:0006344.label: shoot lateral meristem
PO:0006344.definition: A lateral meristem (PO:0020145) that is part of a shoot axis (PO:0025029).

PO:0006345.label: OBSOLETE pollen tube
PO:0006345.definition: OBSOLETE. A tubular cell extension formed by the germinating pollen grain; carries the male gametes into the ovule.

PO:0006346.label: leaf intercalary meristem
PO:0006346.definition: An intercalary meristem (PO:0006073) that is part of a leaf (PO:0006346) and is intercalated between two portions of non-meristematic tissue between a leaf apex (PO:0020137) and a leaf base (PO:0020040).

synonyms.label: meristema intercalar de la hoja (Spanish, exact)
葉 介在 分裂組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006347.label: stem intercalary meristem
PO:0006347.definition: An intercalary meristem (PO:0006073) that is part of a stem internode (PO:0020142) and is intercalated between two portions of non-meristematic tissue.

PO:0006348.label: ear pedicellate spikelet
PO:0006348.definition: An ear spikelet (PO:0006320) which is the ultimate, pedicellate, higher order inflorescence axis (PO:0009081) of the maize ear inflorescence (PO:0020136).

synonyms.label: espiga pedicelada de la espiguilla (Spanish, exact)
雌穂（花）の有柄小穂 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006349.label: ear sessile spikelet
PO:0006349.definition: An ear spikelet (PO:0006320) which is the ultimate, sessile, higher order inflorescence axis (PO:0009081) of the maize ear inflorescence (PO:0020136).

synonyms.label: espiga s&#233sil de la espiguilla (Spanish, exact)

PO:0006350.label: upper floret of pedicellate spikelet of ear
PO:0006350.definition: An ear floret that is the upper of the two florets of a pedicellate spikelet rachilla of an ear inflorescence.

synonyms.label: florete superior de la espiguilla pedicelada de la espiga (Spanish, exact)
雌穂（花）の有柄小穂の上位小花 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0006351.label: lower floret of sessile spikelet of ear
PO:0006351.definition: An ear floret that is the lower of the two florets on a sessile spikelet of an ear inflorescence.
