PO:0008007.label: nucellar projection
PO:0008007.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the morphologically distinct portion of the nucellus overlying the vascular strands in the grass caryopsis.

PO:0008008.label: modified aleurone
PO:0008008.definition: A portion of aleurone layer (PO:0005360) which is morphologically distinct and is located adjacent to the nucellar projection (PO:0008007).

synonyms.label: 特殊化した糊粉、修飾アリューロン (Japanese, exact)

PO:0008009.label: abaxial nucellar projection
PO:0008009.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the abaxial/lower portion of the nucellus (PO:0020020) overlying vascular strands in a caryopsis fruit (PO:0030104).

PO:0008010.label: adaxial nucellar projection
PO:0008010.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the adaxial/upper portion of the nucellus (PO:0020020) overlying vascular strands in a caryopsis fruit (PO:0030104).

PO:0008011.label: plant embryo vascular system
PO:0008011.definition: A vascular system (PO:0000034) that is part of a plant embryo (PO:0009009) .

PO:0008012.label: stigma vascular system
PO:0008012.definition: A vascular system (PO:0000034) that includes the totality of the portions of vascular tissue in their specific arrangement in a stigma (PO:0009073).

PO:0008013.label: anther vascular system
PO:0008013.definition: A phyllome vascular system (PO:0025206) that includes the totality of the portions of vascular tissue in their specific arrangement in an anther (PO:0009066).

synonyms.label: sistema vascular de la antera (Spanish, exact)

PO:0008014.label: filament vascular system
PO:0008014.definition: A vascular system (PO:0000034) that includes the totality of the portions of vascular tissue (PO:0009015) in their specific arrangement in a filament (PO:0009067).

PO:0008015.label: hypocotyl vascular system
PO:0008015.definition: A vascular system (PO:0000034) that is part of a hypocotyl (PO:0020100).
relationships: part_of PO:0008011 ! plant embryo vascular system

PO:0008016.label: vegetative shoot apical meristem
PO:0008016.definition: A shoot apical meristem (PO:0020148) that gives rise to the apical growth of vegetative tissues and organs.

synonyms.label: meristema vegetativo apical del epiblasto (epiblastema) (Spanish, exact)
栄養シュート頂端分裂組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0008017.label: leaf sheath pulvinus
PO:0008017.definition: A more or less abrupt swelling, especially at the apex or base of a leaf sheath.

synonyms.label: vaina del pulv&#237nulo de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0008018.label: transition vascular leaf
PO:0008018.definition: A vascular leaf that is part of an heteroblastic series, and is characterized by anatomical features that are intermediate between juvenile and adult leaves.

synonyms.label: 維管束植物の幼葉と成熟葉の移行期の葉 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0008019.label: leaf lamina base
PO:0008019.definition: The region of the leaf lamina proximal to the stem and usually connected to it by means of a petiole.

synonyms.label: base de la l&#225mina de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0008020.label: central zone of the leaf lamina
PO:0008020.definition: Region that includes the widest or majority portion of leaf lamina and that does not include leaf apex and leaf lamina base.

synonyms.label: zona central de la l&#225mina de la hoja (Spanish, exact)
葉身(葉片)の中央帯 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0008021.label: tertiary leaf vein
PO:0008021.definition: A leaf lamina vein (PO:0020138) arising from a secondary leaf vein (PO:0020140).

PO:0008022.label: quaternary leaf vein
PO:0008022.definition: A leaf lamina vein (PO:0020138) arising from a tertiary leaf vein (PO:0008021).

PO:0008023.label: higher order leaf vein
PO:0008023.definition: A leaf lamina vein (PO:0020138) arising from a quaternary (PO:0008022) or other higher order leaf vein.

synonyms.label: fifth and higher order leaf vein (related)

PO:0008024.label: petiole proximal end
PO:0008024.definition: The region of the petiole proximal to its stem attachment site.

PO:0008025.label: central zone of the petiole
PO:0008025.definition: Regions of the petiole that does not include petiole distal end and petiole proximal end.

PO:0008026.label: petiole distal end
PO:0008026.definition: The region of the petiole distal to its stem attachment site or proximal to the leaf lamina.

PO:0008027.label: petiole adaxial epidermis
PO:0008027.definition: A portion of petiole epidermis (PO:0000051) that covers the adaxial/upper surface of a petiole (PO:0020038).

synonyms.label: 葉柄向軸側 表皮 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0008028.label: reproductive shoot apical meristem
PO:0008028.definition: A shoot apical meristem (PO:0020148) that gives rise to the apical growth of reproductive tissues and organs.

synonyms.label: meristema apical reproductivo del epiblasto (epiblastema) (Spanish, exact)
生殖シュート頂端 分裂組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0008029.label: petiole abaxial epidermis
PO:0008029.definition: A portion of petiole epidermis (PO:0000051) that covers the abaxial/lower surface of a petiole (PO:0020038).

synonyms.label: 葉柄背軸側 表皮 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0008030.label: trichome cell
PO:0008030.definition: A plant cell (PO:0009002) that is part of a multicellular trichome (PO:0000282).

synonyms.label: 毛（毛茸、糸状体）細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0008031.label: OBSOLETE trichome branch
PO:0008031.definition: OBSOLETE. The branch on a trichome.

PO:0008032.label: stomatal pore
PO:0008032.definition: A plant anatomical space that forms an opening in an epidermis, flanked by two guard cells.

PO:0008034.label: OBSOLETE leaf whorl
PO:0008034.definition: OBSOLETE. A cluster of leaves in crowded circles or spirals arising basally from a crown.

PO:0008035.label: plerome
PO:0008035.definition: A meristem forming the core of the axis composed of the primary vascular tissues and associated ground tissue, such as pith and interfascicular regions.

PO:0008036.label: periblem
PO:0008036.definition: A portion of meristem tissue that forms the cortex.

PO:0008037.label: seedling
PO:0008037.definition: A whole plant (PO:0000003) in the seedling development stage (PO:0007131).

PO:0008038.label: OBSOLETE adventitious root primordium
PO:0008038.definition: OBSOLETE: A root primordium that will develop into an adventitious root.

synonyms.label: primordio de la ra&#237z adventicia (Spanish, exact)
不定根根原基（可視的） (Japanese, exact)

PO:0008040.label: lodicule primordium
PO:0008040.definition: A phyllome primordium (PO:0025128)that develops from a lodicule anlagen (PO:0025483) and is committed to the development of a lodicule (PO:0009036).

PO:0008041.label: stem internode elongation zone
PO:0008041.definition: A shoot axis internode elongation zone  (PO:0025100) that is part of a stem internode (PO:0009047).

synonyms.label: zona de elongaci&#243n del internodo del tallo (Spanish, exact)

PO:0008042.label: stem internode differentiation zone
PO:0008042.definition: A shoot internode differentiation zone that is part of a stem internode.

synonyms.label: zona de diferenciaci&#243n del internodo del tallo (Spanish, exact)

PO:0008043.label: OBSOLETE floral epidermis
PO:0008043.definition: OBSOLETE. A portion of shoot epidermis that is part of the floral organs.

PO:0008044.label: OBSOLETE floral stomatal complex
PO:0008044.definition: OBSOLETE. An opening pore on the epidermis of floral organs bordered by two guard cells and serving in gas exchange.

PO:0008045.label: OBSOLETE floral guard cell
PO:0008045.definition: OBSOLETE. One of a pair of cells flanking the stomatal pore of floral organs.

PO:0008046.label: OBSOLETE floral stomatal pore
PO:0008046.definition: OBSOLETE. A stomatal pore that is part of a floral stomatal complex.

PO:0008047.label: scutellum vascular system
PO:0008047.definition: A vascular system (PO:0000034) that is part of a scutellum (PO:0020110).
relationships: part_of PO:0008011 ! plant embryo vascular system

PO:0008048.label: scutellar epithelium
PO:0008048.definition: A continuous layer of cylindrical cells covering the endosperm side of the scutellum. Thought to act as a secretory and absorptive organ.

PO:0009000.label: pulvinus
PO:0009000.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) at the apex or base of a petiole, petiolule, leaf sheath, or branch that is differentiated from the remaining organ parts by its enlarged cross section.

PO:0009001.label: fruit
PO:0009001.definition: A multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025496) that develops from a gynoecium (PO:0009062), or a single carpel (PO:0009030), and at maturity may have as parts one or more seeds (PO:0009010).

PO:0009002.label: plant cell
PO:0009002.definition: A cell which is a plant structure (PO:0009011).

PO:0009003.label: OBSOLETE sporophyte
PO:0009003.definition: OBSOLETE. A plant structure that is a product of fertilization and produces spores through meiosis.

PO:0009004.label: OBSOLETE gametophyte
PO:0009004.definition: OBSOLETE. A plant structure that arises through meiosis and may produce gametes by mitosis.

PO:0009005.label: root
PO:0009005.definition: A plant axis (PO:0025004) that lacks shoot axis nodes (PO:0005004) and usually grows indeterminately.

PO:0009006.label: shoot system
PO:0009006.definition: A collective plant organ structure (PO:0025007) that produces shoot-borne portions of meristem tissue (PO:0009013) and the plant structures (PO:0009011) that arise from them.

synonyms.label: シュート系、苗条系 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0009007.label: portion of plant tissue
PO:0009007.definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that consists predominantly of similarly specialized plant cells (PO:0009002) of one or more types.

synonyms.label: porci&#243n de un tejido vegetal (Spanish, exact)

PO:0009008.label: plant organ
PO:0009008.definition: A multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025496) that is a functional unit, is a proper part of a whole plant (PO:0000003), and includes portions of plant tissue (PO:0009007) of at least two different types that derive from a common developmental path.

PO:0009009.label: plant embryo
PO:0009009.definition: A whole plant (PO:0000003) that participates in the plant embryo stage (PO:0007631).

PO:0009010.label: seed
PO:0009010.definition: A multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025496) that develops from a plant ovule (PO:0020003) and has as parts a plant embryo (PO:0009009) enclosed in a seed coat (PO:0009088).

PO:0009011.label: plant structure
PO:0009011.definition: A plant anatomical entity (PO:0025131) that is, or was, part of a plant, or was derived from a part of a plant.

PO:0009012.label: plant structure development stage
PO:0009012.definition: A stage in the life of a plant structure (PO:0009011) during which the plant structure undergoes developmental processes.

synonyms.label: etapa de desarrollo de estructura vegetal (Spanish, exact)

PO:0009013.label: portion of meristem tissue
PO:0009013.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) in which plant cells (PO:0009002) have retained their embryonic characteristics, or have reverted to them secondarily, and that divide to produce new cells that can undergo differentiation to form mature tissues, i.e. they have a capacity for morphogenesis and growth.

PO:0009014.label: OBSOLETE dermal tissue
PO:0009014.definition: OBSOLETE. A portion of plant tissue that covers the surface of the plant.

PO:0009015.label: portion of vascular tissue
PO:0009015.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that has as part one or more tracheary elements (PO:0000290) or sieve elements (PO:0025406).

synonyms.label: 維管束細胞の一部 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0009016.label: OBSOLETE ground tissue
PO:0009016.definition: OBSOLETE. Tissues other than the vascular tissues, epidermis and the periderm.

PO:0009017.label: inflorescence branch pulvinus
PO:0009017.definition: A pulvinus (PO:0009000) of an inflorescence branch (PO:0009081).

synonyms.label: pulv&#237nulo ramificado de una inflorescencia (Spanish, exact)

relationships: part_of PO:0009081 ! higher order inflorescence axis

PO:0009018.label: basal endosperm transfer cell
PO:0009018.definition: A transfer cell that is part of a basal endosperm transfer layer.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula de transferencia del endosperma basal (Spanish, exact)
基底胚乳転送細胞 (Japanese, exact)

relationships: part_of PO:0025196 ! basal endosperm transfer layer

PO:0009019.label: obsolete basal endosperm transfer layer
PO:0009019.definition: OBSOLETE. A cell layer found in basal endosperm transfer cell.

synonyms.label: capa de transferencia del endosperma basal obsoleto (Spanish, exact)

PO:0009020.label: meristem L1 layer
PO:0009020.definition: A portion of meristem tissue (PO:0009013) that is the outermost layer of a shoot apical meristem (PO:0020148) and gives rise to a shoot system epidermis (PO:0006035).

PO:0009021.label: meristem L2 layer
PO:0009021.definition: A portion of meristem tissue (PO:0009013) directly beneath a meristem L1 layer (PO:0009020) in a shoot apical meristem (PO:0020148) which gives rise to ground tissue (PO:0025059).
relationships: part_of PO:0025595 ! shoot system ground meristem

PO:0009022.label: meristem L3 layer
PO:0009022.definition: A portion of meristem tissue (PO:0009013) beneath a meristem L2 layer (PO:0009021) in a shoot apical meristem (PO:0020148) which gives rise to internal tissues of leaf and stem.
relationships: part_of PO:0025595 ! shoot system ground meristem

PO:0009023.label: leaf axil
PO:0009023.definition: An axil that is the space between a shoot axis and a leaf that branches from the shoot axis.

PO:0009025.label: vascular leaf
PO:0009025.definition: A leaf (PO:0025034) in a vascular plant.

synonyms.label: 維管束のある葉, または維管束植物の葉 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0009026.label: sporophyll
PO:0009026.definition: A leaf-like organ on which one or more sporangia are borne.

PO:0009027.label: megasporophyll
PO:0009027.definition: A structure upon which (or in the axil of which) one or more megasporangia are borne; in flowering plants, a carpel.

PO:0009028.label: microsporophyll
PO:0009028.definition: A structure on which one or more microsporangia are borne; in flowering plants, the stamen.

PO:0009029.label: stamen
PO:0009029.definition: A microsporophyll bearing one or more microsporangia.

PO:0009030.label: carpel
PO:0009030.definition: A megasporophyll, almost always at the center of a flower, its margins more or less fused together or with other carpels to enclose the ovule(s).

PO:0009031.label: sepal
PO:0009031.definition: A phyllome (PO:0006001) that is usually green, and is part of the calyx (PO:0009060).

PO:0009032.label: petal
PO:0009032.definition: A phyllome (PO:0006001) that is part of the corolla (PO:0009059), and is usually colored (not green).

PO:0009033.label: tepal
PO:0009033.definition: A phyllome (PO:0006001) that is part of a perianth (PO:0009058) where it is not possible to distinguish between the petals (PO:0009032) and sepals (PO:0009031).

PO:0009034.label: flower bract
PO:0009034.definition: A bract (PO:0009055) that subtends a perianth (PO:0009058) that is part of a flower (PO:0009046).

PO:0009035.label: nectary
PO:0009035.definition: A portion of secretory tissue (PO:0005656) which is a multicellular glandular structure secreting a liquid containing organic substances, including sugars.

PO:0009036.label: lodicule
PO:0009036.definition: A phyllome that is part of a grass floret and is one of two or three tiny scales or flaps of tissue outside the stamens.

PO:0009037.label: lemma
PO:0009037.definition: The lower, usually larger, of the pair of flower bracts (PO:0009034) enclosing a (PO:0009082) spikelet floret.

synonyms.label: lemma del florete del penacho (borla) o de la espiga (Spanish, exact)
lemma of lower floret of pedicellate spikelet of ear (narrow)
lemma of lower floret of pedicellate spikelet of tassel (narrow)
lemma of lower floret of sessile spikelet of ear (narrow)
lemma of lower floret of sessile spikelet of tassel (narrow)
lemma of upper floret of pedicellate spikelet of ear (narrow)
lemma of upper floret of pedicellate spikelet of tassel (narrow)
lemma of upper floret of sessile spikelet of ear (narrow)
lemma of upper floret of sessile spikelet of tassel (narrow)

PO:0009038.label: palea
PO:0009038.definition: The upper (distal), usually smaller, of the pair of flower bracts (PO:0009034) enclosing a (PO:0009082) spikelet floret.

synonyms.label: palea of lower floret of pedicellate spikelet of ear (narrow)
palea of lower floret of pedicellate spikelet of tassel (narrow)
palea of lower floret of sessile spikelet of ear (exact)
palea of lower floret of sessile spikelet of tassel (narrow)
palea of upper floret of pedicellate spikelet of ear (narrow)
palea of upper floret of pedicellate spikelet of tassel (narrow)
palea of upper floret of sessile spikelet of ear (narrow)
palea of upper floret of sessile spikelet of tassel (narrow)

PO:0009039.label: glume
PO:0009039.definition: One of a pair of inflorescence bracts that is part of a spikelet and subtends the two florets.

PO:0009040.label: sterile lemma
PO:0009040.definition: A flower bract in the position of a lemma, but not enclosing floral organs.

PO:0009041.label: fertile lemma
PO:0009041.definition: A lemma that encloses a functional flower, with androecium, gynoecium or both.

PO:0009042.label: prophyll
PO:0009042.definition: A phyllome that is the first organ or one of the first two organs formed at the base of an axillary shoot, often smaller and/or in a distinctively different position from leaves formed subsequently.

PO:0009043.label: bracteole
PO:0009043.definition: A prophyll (PO:0009042) which is borne singly or in pairs on a pedicel (PO:0030112).

PO:0009044.label: perigynium
PO:0009044.definition: Sac-like bract subtending the pistillate flower, as in Carex.

synonyms.label: ペリギニウム、果胞、造卵器群やそれから発生した胞子体の周辺の組織が発達し肉厚で筒状となった構造 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0009045.label: involucral bract
PO:0009045.definition: An inflorescence bract (PO:0009054) of an involucre (PO:0009100).

PO:0009046.label: flower
PO:0009046.definition: A determinate reproductive shoot system (PO:0025082) that has as part at least one carpel (PO:0009030) or at least one stamen (PO:0009029) and does not contain any other determinate shoot system (PO:0009006) as a part.

PO:0009047.label: stem
PO:0009047.definition: A shoot axis (PO:0025029) that is the primary axis of a plant.

PO:0009049.label: inflorescence
PO:0009049.definition: A reproductive shoot system (PO:0025082) that has as parts all of the shoot axes (PO:0025029) and flowers (PO:0009046; must have two or more) distal to the most distal leaf (PO:0009025).

PO:0009051.label: spikelet
PO:0009051.definition: A reproductive shoot system (PO:0025082) that is the ultimate and congested, higher order inflorescence axis (PO:0009081) of the grasses.

PO:0009052.label: inflorescence flower pedicel
PO:0009052.definition: A flower pedicel (PO:0030113) that bears a flower (PO:0009046) in an inflorescence (PO:0009049).

PO:0009053.label: peduncle
PO:0009053.definition: A shoot axis that extends from the last foliage leaf on a stem or branch until the next distal node.
relationships: part_of PO:0025104 ! first order inflorescence axis

PO:0009054.label: inflorescence bract
PO:0009054.definition: A bract (PO:0009055) subtending a branch of the inflorescence (PO:0009049) or borne on the inflorescence axis (PO:0020122) below any branch (PO:0025073) or flower (PO:0009046).

PO:0009055.label: bract
PO:0009055.definition: A phyllome that subtends a reproductive structure.

PO:0009056.label: flower nectary
PO:0009056.definition: A nectary (PO:0009035) occurring on a floral organ (PO:0025395) or other part of a flower (PO:0009046).

PO:0009057.label: extrafloral nectary
PO:0009057.definition: A nectary (PO:0009035), not occurring on a floral organ (PO:0025395) or other part of a flower (PO:0009046).

PO:0009058.label: perianth
PO:0009058.definition: A collective phyllome structure (PO:0025023) that includes as parts the corolla (PO:0009059) and/or the calyx (PO:0009060); or one or more tepals (PO:0009033).

PO:0009059.label: corolla
PO:0009059.definition: A collective phyllome structure (PO:0025023) that is composed of one or more petals (PO:0009032), comprising the inner whorl of non-reproductive floral organs (PO:0025395) and surrounds the androecium (PO:0009061) and the gynoecium (PO:0009062).

PO:0009060.label: calyx
PO:0009060.definition: A collective phyllome structure (PO:0025023) that is composed of one or more sepals (PO:0009031), and comprises the outer whorl of non-reproductive floral organs (PO:0025395).

PO:0009061.label: androecium
PO:0009061.definition: A collective phyllome structure (PO:0025023) composed all of the stamens (PO:0009029) in a flower (PO:0009046).

synonyms.label: androecium of lower floret of pedicellate spikelet of ear (narrow)
androecium of lower floret of sessile spikelet of ear (narrow)
androecium of lower floret of sessile spikelet of tassel (narrow)
androecium of upper floret of pedicellate spikelet of ear (narrow)
androecium of upper floret of pedicellate spikelet of tassel (exact)
androecium of upper floret of sessile spikelet of ear (narrow)
androecium of upper floret of sessile spikelet of tassel (narrow)

PO:0009062.label: gynoecium
PO:0009062.definition: A collective phyllome structure (PO:0025023) composed all of the carpels (PO:0009030) in a flower (PO:0009046).

synonyms.label: gynoecium of lower floret of pedicellate spikelet of ear (narrow)
gynoecium of lower floret of pedicellate spikelet of tassel (narrow)
gynoecium of lower floret of sessile spikelet of ear (narrow)
gynoecium of lower floret of sessile spikelet of tassel (narrow)
gynoecium of upper floret of pedicellate spikelet of ear (narrow)
gynoecium of upper floret of pedicellate spikelet of tassel (narrow)
gynoecium of upper floret of sessile spikelet of ear (narrow)
gynoecium of upper floret of sessile spikelet of tassel (narrow)

PO:0009063.label: epicalyx
PO:0009063.definition: A collective phyllome structure (PO:0025023) composed of two or more phyllomes immediately outside the calyx (PO:0009060).

PO:0009064.label: receptacle
PO:0009064.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the region at the distal end of either a peduncle or a pedicel where the floral appendages (e.g.: sepals, petals, stamens and pistils) are attached.

PO:0009065.label: hypanthium
PO:0009065.definition: A cup- or tube-shaped cardinal organ part, bearing perianth and stamens on its rim, so these arise above the base, and often above the top, of the ovary.

synonyms.label: 花床筒 、いちじく状花序 i.e.hypanthodium (Japanese, exact)

PO:0009066.label: anther
PO:0009066.definition: A collective plant organ structure (PO:0025007) that is the pollen-bearing part of a stamen (PO:0009029).

PO:0009067.label: filament
PO:0009067.definition: A stalk  (PO:0025066) that is part of a stamen (PO:0009029).

PO:0009068.label: connective
PO:0009068.definition: The part of the stamen that connects the microsporangia/pollen sacs.

PO:0009069.label: anther theca
PO:0009069.definition: A collective plant organ structure (PO:0025007) that is part of an anther (PO:0009066) and consists of a pair of sporangia (PO:0025094) that dehisce down a common slit.

PO:0009070.label: obsolete pollen sac
PO:0009070.definition: OBSOLETE. A microsporangium in an angiosperm that is a cavity in an anther that contains pollen grains.

PO:0009071.label: anther wall tapetum
PO:0009071.definition: A microsporangium tapetum (PO:0025314) that is part of an anther wall (PO:0000002).

synonyms.label: portion of anther wall tapetal tissue (exact)
葯壁タペート組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0009072.label: plant ovary
PO:0009072.definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is the basal portion of a carpel (PO:0009030) or group of fused carpels (gynoecium; PO:0009062) and encloses the plant ovule(s) (PO:0020003).

PO:0009073.label: stigma
PO:0009073.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001), usually apical, that is part of a carpel (PO:0009030) or group of fused carpels on which the pollen (PO:0025281) germinates.

PO:0009074.label: style
PO:0009074.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) which is an elongated part of a carpel (PO:0009030) or gynoecium (PO:0009062) between the plant ovary (PO:0009072) and the stigma (PO:0009073), and through which the pollen tube (GO:0090406) grows.

PO:0009075.label: OBSOLETE plant ontology
PO:0009075.definition: OBSOLETE. A controlled vocabulary to describe the various plant parts and the growth and developmental stages.

synonyms.label: 植物オントロジー (Japanese, exact)
不稔の雌蕊、退化雌蕊 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0009080.label: spikelet rachilla
PO:0009080.definition: The axis of the spikelet, above the glumes.

PO:0009081.label: higher order inflorescence axis
PO:0009081.definition: An inflorescence axis (PO:0020122) that develops from an inflorescence axillary meristem (PO:0009105) of an inflorescence axis (PO:0020122).

PO:0009082.label: spikelet floret
PO:0009082.definition: A small flower (PO:0009046) that is part of a spikelet (PO:0009051).

PO:0009083.label: OBSOLETE reproductive structures
PO:0009083.definition: OBSOLETE. Aggregation of gamete producing structures.

PO:0009084.label: pericarp
PO:0009084.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the outer layer (wall) of a fruit (PO:0009001), and develops from a plant ovary (PO:0009072) or a carpel (PO:0009030) wall.

PO:0009085.label: exocarp
PO:0009085.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the outer layer of a pericarp (PO:0009084).

PO:0009086.label: endocarp
PO:0009086.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the innermost differentiated layer of a pericarp (PO:0009084).

PO:0009087.label: mesocarp
PO:0009087.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the middle layer of a pericarp (PO:0009084).

PO:0009088.label: seed coat
PO:0009088.definition: A portion of plant tissue that is the covering of a seed derived from ovular - mainly integumentary - tissue.

PO:0009089.label: endosperm
PO:0009089.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) which is a maximal portion of nutritive plant tissue in a seed (PO:0009010).

PO:0009090.label: aril
PO:0009090.definition: An arilloid that is an outgrowth of a seed from a seed funicle.

PO:0009100.label: involucre
PO:0009100.definition: A collective phyllome structure composed of two or more involucral bracts at the base of a cluster of flowers, as found in Asteraceae or Compositae.

PO:0009101.label: long lateral tassel branch
PO:0009101.definition: The long branch that arise from the central spike of tassel in maize.

synonyms.label: ramificaci&#243n lateral larga del penacho (borla) (Spanish, exact)

relationships: develops_from PO:0009104 ! long lateral tassel branch meristem

PO:0009102.label: short tassel branch
PO:0009102.definition: The very short branch that may arise from either or both the long lateral branch and the central spike of tassel in maize.
relationships: develops_from PO:0009103 ! short tassel branch meristem

PO:0009103.label: short tassel branch meristem
PO:0009103.definition: The meristem present on either or both the long lateral branch and central spike of a maize tassel that gives rise to short tassel branch.

synonyms.label: meristema de la ramificaci&#243n corta del penacho (borla) (Spanish, exact)
雄穂短枝分裂組織 (Japanese, exact)

relationships: part_of PO:0006324 ! first order tassel inflorescence axis
part_of PO:0009101 ! long lateral tassel branch

PO:0009104.label: long lateral tassel branch meristem
PO:0009104.definition: The meristem that gives rise to the long lateral branch in the maize tassel.

synonyms.label: meristema de la ramificaci&#243n larga del penacho (borla) (Spanish, exact)
雄穂の長側枝の分裂組織 (Japanese, exact)

relationships: part_of PO:0006324 ! first order tassel inflorescence axis

PO:0009105.label: inflorescence axillary meristem
PO:0009105.definition: An inflorescence meristem (PO:0009108) that gives rise to a higher order inflorescence axis (PO:0009081).

synonyms.label: meristema lateral de la inflorescencia (Spanish, exact)
花序側部（側方）分裂組織 (Japanese, related)

PO:0009106.label: tassel meristem
PO:0009106.definition: Meristem that gives rise to the apical and lateral structures of the tassel inflorescence in maize.

PO:0009107.label: tassel inflorescence axillary meristem
PO:0009107.definition: An inflorescence axillary meristem (PO:0009105) that gives rise to the long lateral tassel branch (PO:0009101), short tassel branch (PO:0009102), and tassel spikelets (PO:0006309) in a tassel inflorescence (PO:0020126).

PO:0009108.label: inflorescence apical meristem
PO:0009108.definition: A reproductive shoot apical meristem that gives rise to the apical growth of the inflorescence. It develops from the shoot apical meristem (SAM) after it undergoes transition from vegetative to reproductive phase.

synonyms.label: meristema apical de la inflorescencia (Spanish, exact)
花序頂端分裂組織 (Japanese, exact)

relationships: develops_from PO:0008016 ! vegetative shoot apical meristem

PO:0009109.label: ear meristem
PO:0009109.definition: The meristem which gives rise to the female inflorescence or ear in maize.

PO:0009110.label: ear inflorescence axillary meristem
PO:0009110.definition: An inflorescence axillary meristem (PO:0009105) that gives rise to a higher order inflorescence axis (PO:0009081) of an ear inflorescence (PO:0020136).

synonyms.label: meristema de la espiga lateral (Spanish, exact)

PO:0019018.label: plant embryo axis
PO:0019018.definition: A plant axis (PO:0025004) that is the axial part of a plant embryo (PO:0009009).

PO:0019022.label: arilloid
PO:0019022.definition: A cardinal part of multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025498) that is a fleshy outgrowth of a seed (PO:0009010).

synonyms.label: 種皮附属物,　アリロイド (Japanese, exact)

PO:0019023.label: strophiole
PO:0019023.definition: An arilloid that is an outgrowth of a seed on a raphe.

synonyms.label: ストロフィオール (Japanese, exact)

PO:0019024.label: seed operculum
PO:0019024.definition: A plug-like structure formed in the micropylar region of the seed coat.

PO:0019026.label: tracheid bar
PO:0019026.definition: A portion of xylem (PO:0005352) tissue that is a distinct ring-like structure composed of tracheids (PO:0000301), that is part of a seed (PO:0009010) and surrounds the hilum (PO:0020063) and forms a groove in the surface of the pericarp (PO:0009084) immediately adjacent to the hilum.

PO:0020001.label: plant ovary placenta
PO:0020001.definition: A portion of placenta tissue (PO:0025078) which is part of a plant ovary (PO:0009072), and to which plant ovary ovules (PO:0025490) are attached.

PO:0020002.label: anther wall endothecium
PO:0020002.definition: An microsporangium endothecium (PO:0025309) that part of an anther wall (PO:0000002).

synonyms.label: endotecio de la pared the la antera (Spanish, exact)

PO:0020003.label: plant ovule
PO:0020003.definition: A plant organ (PO:0009008) that has as parts a nucellus (PO:0020020) in which a female gametophyte (PO:0025279) is located, one or two integuments (PO:0020021), and a funicle (PO:0020006).

PO:0020004.label: anther wall exothecium
PO:0020004.definition: An microsporangium exothecium (PO:0025311) that is part of an anther wall (PO:0000002).

synonyms.label: exotecio de la pared de la antera (Spanish, exact)

PO:0020005.label: placentoid
PO:0020005.definition: A portion of parenchyma tissue that is part of a connective and projects into a pollen sac.

PO:0020006.label: funicle
PO:0020006.definition: A stalk (PO:0025066) that attaches a plant ovule (PO:0020003) to a placenta (PO:0025078).

PO:0020008.label: OBSOLETE exine
PO:0020008.definition: OBSOLETE. The outer layer of the pollen grain wall, highly resistant to strong acids and bases, and composed primarily of sporopollenin.

synonyms.label: 外皮、外壁、エキシン、外膜 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0020009.label: OBSOLETE ectexine
PO:0020009.definition: OBSOLETE. The outer part of the exine, which stains positively with basic fuchsin in optical microscopy and has higher electron density in conventionally prepared TEM sections.

PO:0020010.label: OBSOLETE endexine
PO:0020010.definition: OBSOLETE. The inner part of the exine, which stains.

synonyms.label: エンデキシン、内層 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0020011.label: OBSOLETE nexine
PO:0020011.definition: OBSOLETE. The inner, non-sculptured part of the exine which lies below the sexine.

PO:0020012.label: OBSOLETE sexine
PO:0020012.definition: OBSOLETE. The outer, sculptured layer of the exine, which lies above the nexine.

PO:0020013.label: OBSOLETE tectum
PO:0020013.definition: OBSOLETE. The layer of sexine, which forms a roof over the columellae, granules or other infratectal elements.

PO:0020014.label: OBSOLETE pollen wall columella
PO:0020014.definition: OBSOLETE. A rod-like element of the sexine/ectexine, either supporting the tectum or a caput.

PO:0020016.label: OBSOLETE foot layer
PO:0020016.definition: OBSOLETE. The inner layer of the ectexine.

synonyms.label: capa basal del grano de polen (Spanish, exact)

PO:0020017.label: OBSOLETE intine
PO:0020017.definition: OBSOLETE. The innermost of the major layers of the pollen grain wall, underlies the exine and borders the cytoplasm, not acetolysis resistant and is therefore absent in conventionally prepared palynological material.

PO:0020018.label: OBSOLETE germination pore
PO:0020018.definition: OBSOLETE. Area through which the pollen imports the nutrition during its development, at the time of pollen germination, the pollen tube emerges through it.

PO:0020019.label: megaspore
PO:0020019.definition: The larger, in general, of the two kinds of spores produced after meiosis in the life cycle of a heterosporous plant, and on germination giving rise to the female gametophyte (embryo sac).

PO:0020020.label: nucellus
PO:0020020.definition: A megasporangium (PO:0025201) in a seed plant, composed of fleshy subepidermal tissue that is part of a plant ovule (PO:0020003) and surrounds a megasporocyte (PO:0000431).

PO:0020021.label: plant ovule integument
PO:0020021.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that covers a plant ovule (PO:0020003), enveloping a nucellus (PO:0020020) and forming a micropyle (PO:0020025) at the apex.

PO:0020022.label: plant ovule inner integument
PO:0020022.definition: A plant ovule integument (PO:0020021) which is the innermost of the two layers of tissue that usually cover the plant ovule (PO:0020003), contiguous to the nucellus (PO:0020020) and usually contributing to the formation of the plant ovule micropyle (PO:0020025) at the apex.

PO:0020023.label: plant ovule outer integument
PO:0020023.definition: A plant ovule integument (PO:0020021) which is the outermost the two layers of tissue that usually cover the plant ovule (PO:0020003), contiguous to the nucellus (PO:0020020) and usually contributing to the formation of the plant ovule micropyle (PO:0020025) at the apex.

PO:0020024.label: endothelium
PO:0020024.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) which is composed of cells of the inner epidermis of the inner (or only) integument of the ovule that are radially elongated and metabolically very active.
relationships: part_of PO:0020022 ! plant ovule inner integument

PO:0020025.label: plant ovule micropyle
PO:0020025.definition: A plant anatomical space (PO:0025117) that is enclosed by and forms an opening in an integument at the apex of a plant ovule (PO:0020003).

PO:0020026.label: chalaza
PO:0020026.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the region in a plant ovule (PO:0020003) where the integuments (PO:0020021) and the nucellus (PO:0020020) join with the funicule (PO:0020006).

synonyms.label: カラザ（合点）=珠心と珠皮が珠柄につながるところ、珠孔の反対側 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0020027.label: raphe
PO:0020027.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is a ridge on a plant ovule (PO:0020003) where a funicle (PO:0020006) is or was fused to the ovule.

PO:0020028.label: antiraphe
PO:0020028.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the part of a plant ovule (PO:0020003) on the opposite side from a raphe (PO:0020027).

synonyms.label: 胚珠の縫線と反対側にある組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0020029.label: obturator
PO:0020029.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) which is an outgrowth of the funicle, that forms a bridge between the micropyle and other tissues.

PO:0020030.label: cotyledon
PO:0020030.definition: A vascular leaf (PO:0009025) formed at the first shoot node (PO:0005004) of a plant embryo (PO:0009009) or a seedling (PO:0000003).

PO:0020031.label: radicle
PO:0020031.definition: An embryo root (PO:0000045) that is the basal continuation of a hypocotyl (PO:0020100) in a plant embryo (PO:0009009) or a seedling (PO:0000003).

PO:0020032.label: plumule
PO:0020032.definition: The shoot apex (PO:0000037) of the plant embryo (PO:0009009), above the cotyledonary node (PO:0025321).

PO:0020033.label: coleoptile
PO:0020033.definition: A sheath-like plant organ (PO:0009008) that surrounds the plumule (PO:0020032) of a plant embryo (PO:0009009) or the emerging shoot apex (PO:0000037) of a seedling.

PO:0020034.label: coleorhiza
PO:0020034.definition: A sheath-like plant organ (PO:0009008) that surrounds the radicle (PO:0020031) of a plant embryo (PO:0009009) or the emerging root (PO:0009005) of a seedling (PO:0000003).

PO:0020035.label: epicotyl
PO:0020035.definition: The first stem internode (PO:0020142) above the cotyledonary node (PO:0025321) of a plant embryo (PO:0009009) or a seedling (PO:0000003).

PO:0020036.label: epiblast
PO:0020036.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is a flap-like projection of the coleorhiza (PO:0020034), inserted opposite the scutellum (PO:0020110).

PO:0020037.label: mesocotyl
PO:0020037.definition: A stem internode (PO:0020142) that is the part of a plant embryo axis (PO:0019018) or a seedling stem (PO:0009047) above the scutellum (PO:0020110) and below the coleoptile (PO:0020033).

PO:0020038.label: petiole
PO:0020038.definition: A stalk (PO:0025066) of a vascular leaf (PO:0009025).

PO:0020039.label: leaf lamina
PO:0020039.definition: A phyllome lamina (PO:0025396) that is the part of a leaf (PO:0025034) exclusive of the petiole (PO:0020038) or leaf sheath (PO:0020104), if either is present.

PO:0020040.label: leaf base
PO:0020040.definition: A phyllome base (PO:0025140) that is part of a leaf (PO:0025034).

synonyms.label: 葉脚、葉底、葉身基部 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0020041.label: stipule
PO:0020041.definition: A cardinal organ part that is an appendage at the base of a vascular leaf.

PO:0020042.label: simple leaf
PO:0020042.definition: A leaf in which the lamina is undivided.

PO:0020043.label: compound leaf
PO:0020043.definition: A leaf having two or more distinct leaflets that are evident as such from early in development.

PO:0020044.label: hyperphyll
PO:0020044.definition: The unifacial terete apical portion of a monocot cotyledon, sometimes also visible on other leaves.

synonyms.label: 単子葉の単面円柱形先端 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0020045.label: pinnate leaf
PO:0020045.definition: A once-compound leaf with leaflets borne along a rachis.

PO:0020046.label: palmate leaf
PO:0020046.definition: A once-compound leaf divided into several leaflets which arise at the same point, there being no rachis.

PO:0020047.label: microsporocyte
PO:0020047.definition: A sporocyte (PO:0006204) that produces four haploid (1n) microspores (PO:0020048).

PO:0020048.label: microspore
PO:0020048.definition: The smaller, in general, of the two kinds of spores produced after meiosis in the life cycle of a heterosporous plant, and on germination giving rise to the male gametophyte.

PO:0020049.label: leaflet
PO:0020049.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is one of the ultimate segments of a compound leaf (PO:0020043).

PO:0020051.label: stipel
PO:0020051.definition: Stipule-like appendage(s) at the base of a leaflet (in unifoliolate or simple leaves, found at the top of the petiole).

PO:0020052.label: OBSOLETE megaphyll
PO:0020052.definition: OBSOLETE. Literally a large leaf, a leaf of any size whose vascular supply leaves one or more gaps as it departs from the stem vascular tissue.

PO:0020053.label: OBSOLETE microphyll
PO:0020053.definition: OBSOLETE. Literally a small leaf, a leaf of any size in which any vascular trace supplying it does not interrupt the central vascular cylinder when it departs, i.e. there are no leaf gaps.

PO:0020054.label: bud scale leaf
PO:0020054.definition: A scale leaf that surrounds a dormant or perennating bud.

PO:0020055.label: leaf rachis
PO:0020055.definition: A stalk (PO:0025066) that is the main axis of a pinnate or more highly compound leaf, that bears leaflets or divisions of the axis.

PO:0020056.label: tegmen
PO:0020056.definition: That part of the seed coat that develops from the inner integument.

synonyms.label: 内種子(internal seed coat, inner seed coat, secundine) (Japanese, exact)

PO:0020057.label: testa
PO:0020057.definition: That part of the seed coat that develops from the outer integument, or from the single integument when there is only one.

PO:0020058.label: perisperm
PO:0020058.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) which is diploid nutritive tissue in an angiosperm seed derived from nucellar tissue.

PO:0020059.label: OBSOLETE pollen wall
PO:0020059.definition: OBSOLETE. Complex wall surrounding the micrsopore.

synonyms.label: pared del grano de polen (Spanish, exact)

PO:0020060.label: caruncle
PO:0020060.definition: An arilloid that is an outgrowth of a seed next to the micropyle.

PO:0020061.label: coma
PO:0020061.definition: A portion of seed coat epidermis (PO:0006048) that consists of multiple seed trichomes (PO:0004511) at the seed micropyle (PO:0006334).

PO:0020062.label: elaiosome
PO:0020062.definition: A cardinal organ part that is an oil-secreting outgrowth of a seed or fruit.

PO:0020063.label: hilum
PO:0020063.definition: A cardinal part of multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025498) that is a scar on a seed (PO:0009010) at the place where it was attached to a funicle (PO:0020006).

synonyms.label: 核（デンプン粒）、へそ（種子） (Japanese, exact)

PO:0020064.label: OBSOLETE dehiscent fruit
PO:0020064.definition: OBSOLETE. Fruit that breaks open at maturity to release the contents.

PO:0020065.label: OBSOLETE indehiscent fruit
PO:0020065.definition: OBSOLETE. Fruit that does not open at maturity.

PO:0020066.label: OBSOLETE fleshy fruit
PO:0020066.definition: OBSOLETE. The fruit may be derived from monocarpellate or multicarpellate gynoecia. Their walls may consist of the pericarp or of pericarp fused with extracarpellary tissue. The outer part of the fruit wall or the entire fruit wall may become fleshy by differentiating into soft, succulent parenchyma. Parts other than the wall such as placentae and partitions in multilocular ovaries may become fleshy.

PO:0020075.label: mericarp
PO:0020075.definition: A cardinal part of multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025498) which is one carpellate unit of a schizocarp fruit (PO:0030098) consisting of pericarp (PO:0009084) and one or more seeds (PO:0009010).

synonyms.label: 分散ユニットとしての種子 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0020084.label: OBSOLETE pyrene
PO:0020084.definition: OBSOLETE. The 'stone' or 'pit' (endocarp plus seed) of a succulent fruit.

PO:0020085.label: OBSOLETE seed and fruit wall as dispersal unit

synonyms.label: pared de la semilla y fruto como unidad dispersante (Spanish, exact)
分散ユニットとしての種子と果壁 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0020086.label: OBSOLETE multiple fruit
PO:0020086.definition: OBSOLETE. Fruit on a common axis derived from the ovaries of several flowers.

PO:0020090.label: embryo sac central cell
PO:0020090.definition: An embryo sac cell (PO:0025026) that is largest cell in a mature embryo sac (PO:0025074).

PO:0020091.label: obsolete microgametophyte
PO:0020091.definition: OBSOLETE. A gametophyte that produces pollen sperm cells.

PO:0020092.label: obsolete megagametophyte
PO:0020092.definition: OBSOLETE. A gametophyte that produces female gametes.

PO:0020093.label: antipodal cell
PO:0020093.definition: Cell, commonly three in number as in the eight-nucleate embryo sac, located at the other end of the embryo sac from the egg cell.

PO:0020094.label: plant egg cell
PO:0020094.definition: A gamete (PO:0025006) produced by an archegonium (PO:0025126) or an embryo sac (PO:0025074).

PO:0020095.label: OBSOLETE polar nucleus
PO:0020095.definition: OBSOLETE. Usually two nuclei in the center of the eight-nucleate embryo sac that fuse, and subsequently fuse with one of the male gametes to produce the endosperm.

PO:0020096.label: egg apparatus
PO:0020096.definition: A cardinal organ part that has as parts an egg cell and two synergids and is located at the micropylar end of the embryo sac.

PO:0020097.label: generative cell
PO:0020097.definition: A spermatogenous cell (PO:0025525) of the microgametophyte (PO:0025280) that divides to produce two pollen sperm cells (PO:0025121).

synonyms.label: 雄原細胞、生殖系列細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0020099.label: microgametophyte vegetative cell
PO:0020099.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that is the larger cell of a microgametophyte (PO:0025280) in seed plants. It does not divide further and develops into a pollen tube cell (PO:0025195).

PO:0020100.label: hypocotyl
PO:0020100.definition: A stem internode (PO:0020142) below the cotyledonary node (PO:0025321) and transitional to a root (PO:0009005) of a plant embryo (PO:0009009) or a seedling (PO:0000003).

PO:0020101.label: stomium
PO:0020101.definition: A plant anatomical space that is a slit in an anther lobe formed from when a dehiscence zone dehisces.

PO:0020102.label: portion of transmitting tissue
PO:0020102.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) in the style of a carpel through which a pollen tube grows; it connects a stigma and the inside of an ovary.

synonyms.label: porci&#243n del tejido de transmisi&#243n (Spanish, exact)

PO:0020103.label: flag leaf
PO:0020103.definition: The last mature leaf before the inflorescence in a cereal crop plant.

PO:0020104.label: leaf sheath
PO:0020104.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the lower part of a vascular leaf (PO:0009025), and which more or less encases the stem (PO:0009047).

PO:0020105.label: ligule
PO:0020105.definition: A membranous or hairy appendage on the adaxial/upper surface of a leaf, at the junction between sheath and blade, especially in grasses.

PO:0020106.label: leaf sheath auricle
PO:0020106.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is an ear-shaped outgrowth of the distal part of a leaf sheath (PO:0020104).

synonyms.label: aur&#237cula de la vaina de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0020108.label: suspensor
PO:0020108.definition: An embryonic plant structure at the base of a plant embryo that develops from an embryonic basal cell and connects an embryo proper to the wall of a megagametophyte.

PO:0020109.label: embryo hypophysis
PO:0020109.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that is the uppermost cell of a suspensor (PO:0020108) and from which part of the root (PO:0009005) and root cap (PO:0020123) in a plant embryo (PO:0009009) of angiosperms are derived.

PO:0020110.label: scutellum
PO:0020110.definition: An embryonic plant structure that is a more or less shield-shaped and absorptive portion of a plant embryo of Poaceae.

PO:0020121.label: lateral root
PO:0020121.definition: A root (PO:0009005) that develops from a lateral root primordium (PO:0000016) that is part of another root on the same plant.

PO:0020122.label: inflorescence axis
PO:0020122.definition: A shoot axis (PO:0025029) that is part of an inflorescence (PO:0009049).

PO:0020123.label: root cap
PO:0020123.definition: A portion of root parenchyma (PO:0025095) tissue that is part of the root tip (PO:0000025) and covers the root apical meristem (PO:0020147).

PO:0020124.label: root stele
PO:0020124.definition: A stele (PO:0025197) that is part of a root (PO:0009005).

PO:0020125.label: OBSOLETE elongation zone
PO:0020125.definition: OBSOLETE. The portion of the root that includes small, densely cytoplasmic cells that are dividing and expanding in size.

PO:0020126.label: tassel inflorescence
PO:0020126.definition: A staminate inflorescence (PO:0025601) in Zea species that bears the tassel spikelet (PO:0006309) on a terminal inflorescence axis (PO:0020122).

PO:0020127.label: primary root
PO:0020127.definition: A root (PO:0009005) that develops directly from a seedling radicle (PO:0020127).

PO:0020128.label: leaf margin
PO:0020128.definition: A phyllome margin (PO:0025018) that is part of a leaf (PO:0025034).

PO:0020130.label: central root cap
PO:0020130.definition: A portion of root parenchyma tissue that is the central part of a root cap in which the cells are arranged in longitudinal files.

synonyms.label: caliptra de la ra&#237z central (Spanish, exact)

PO:0020131.label: lateral root cap
PO:0020131.definition: A portion of root parenchyma tissue that is part of a root cap and is parallel to the sides of a root axis.

synonyms.label: caliptra lateral de la ra&#237z (Spanish, exact)

PO:0020132.label: columella root cap cell
PO:0020132.definition: Cell that constitutes the central part of the root cap, arranged in longitudinal files.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula de la columela del caliptra de la ra&#237z (Spanish, exact)

relationships: develops_from PO:0020133 ! columella root cap initial cell

PO:0020133.label: columella root cap initial cell
PO:0020133.definition: A root initial cell (PO:0000059) that produces columella cells in the root cap (PO:0020123). In direct contact with quiescent center (PO:0020149).

synonyms.label: c&#233lula inicial de la columela del caliptra de la ra&#237z (Spanish, exact)
柱軸根冠始原細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0020134.label: OBSOLETE statolith

synonyms.label: 植物胚性組織 の一部   (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025234.label: phyllome stomatal pore
PO:0025234.definition: A stomatal pore that is part of a phyllome stomatal complex.

synonyms.label: フィロム 気孔開口部 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025235.label: leaf stomatal pore
PO:0025235.definition: A phyllome stomatal pore that is part of a leaf stomatal complex.

synonyms.label: poro estom&#225tico de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025236.label: phyllome guard cell
PO:0025236.definition: A guard cell that is part of a phyllome stomatal complex.

synonyms.label: フィロム孔辺細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025237.label: leaf guard cell
PO:0025237.definition: A phyllome guard cell that is part of a leaf stomatal complex.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula guardiana de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025238.label: abaxial petiole canal
PO:0025238.definition: A petiole canal on the abaxial surface of a petiole.

PO:0025239.label: adaxial petiole canal
PO:0025239.definition: A petiole canal on the adaxial surface of a petiole.

PO:0025240.label: second order inflorescence
PO:0025240.definition: A reproductive shoot system (PO:0025082) that is part of an inflorescence (PO:0009049) and has as parts a second order inflorescence axis (PO:0006321) and any shoot axes (PO:0025029) and flowers (PO:0009046) that arise from it.
relationships: has_part PO:0006321 ! second order inflorescence axis

PO:0025241.label: second order infructescence
PO:0025241.definition: A reproductive shoot system that is part of an infructescence and has as parts a second order infructescence axis and any infructescence axes and fruits that arise from it.
relationships: has_part PO:0025112 ! second order infructescence axis

PO:0025242.label: infructescence axis
PO:0025242.definition: A shoot axis (PO:0025029) that is part of an infructescence (PO:0006342).

PO:0025243.label: higher order infructescence axis
PO:0025243.definition: An infructescence axis (PO:0025242), which is a branch (PO:0025073) in an infructescence (PO:0006342), that develops from a higher order inflorescence axis (PO:0009081).

PO:0025244.label: first order infructescence axis
PO:0025244.definition: An infructescence axis (PO:0025242), which is the primary or main axis of an infructescence (PO:0006342), that develops from a first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104).

synonyms.label: eje de la infructescencia de primer orden (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025245.label: persistent sepal
PO:0025245.definition: A phyllome that develops from a sepal and remains attached to a fruit at maturity.

PO:0025246.label: persistent tepal
PO:0025246.definition: A phyllome (PO:0006001) that develops from a tepal (PO:0009033) and remains attached to a fruit (PO:0009001) at maturity.

PO:0025247.label: persistent stamen
PO:0025247.definition: A phyllome that develops from a stamen and remains attached to a fruit at maturity.

PO:0025248.label: pseudostem
PO:0025248.definition: A collective organ part structure that forms a cylindrical false stem composed of concentric leaf sheaths.

PO:0025249.label: leaf sheath epidermis
PO:0025249.definition: A portion of leaf epidermis (PO:0006016) that is part of a leaf sheath (PO:0020104).

synonyms.label: epidermis de la vaina de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025250.label: leaf sheath abaxial epidermis
PO:0025250.definition: A portion of leaf sheath epidermis (PO:0025249) that covers the abaxial/lower surface of a leaf sheath (PO:0020104).

synonyms.label: epidermis abaxial de la vaina de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025251.label: leaf sheath adaxial epidermis
PO:0025251.definition: A portion of leaf sheath epidermis (PO:0025249) that covers the adaxial/upper surface of a leaf sheath (PO:0020104).

synonyms.label: epidermis adaxial de la vaina de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025252.label: seventh order infructescence axis
PO:0025252.definition: A higher order infructescence axis (PO:0025243) which arises from a sixth order infructescence axis (PO:0025116) and develops from a seventh order inflorescence axis (PO:0025108).

synonyms.label: eje de séptimo orden de la infructescencia (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025253.label: eighth order infructescence axis
PO:0025253.definition: A higher order infructescence axis (PO:0025243) which arises from a seventh order infructescence axis (PO:0025252) and develops from an eighth order inflorescence axis (PO:0025109).

synonyms.label: eje de octavo orden de la infructescencia (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025254.label: ninth order infructescence axis
PO:0025254.definition: A higher order infructescence axis (PO:0025243) which arises from an eighth order infructescence axis (PO:0025253) and develops from a ninth order inflorescence axis (PO:0025110).

synonyms.label: eje de noveno orden de la infructescencia (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025255.label: tenth order infructescence axis
PO:0025255.definition: A higher order infructescence axis (PO:0025243) which arises from a ninth order infructescence axis (PO:0025254) and develops from a tenth order inflorescence axis (PO:0025111).

synonyms.label: eje de decimo orden de la infructescencia (Spanish, exact)
ninth or higher order infructescence branch (exact)
第十以上の果序軸 (Japanese, related)

PO:0025256.label: lateral root elongation zone
PO:0025256.definition: A root elongation zone that is part of a lateral root tip.

synonyms.label: zona de elongaci&#243n de la ra&#237z lateral (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025257.label: primary root elongation zone
PO:0025257.definition: A root elongation zone (PO:0025181) that is part of a primary root tip (PO:0000026).

synonyms.label: zona de elongaci&#243n de la ra&#237z primaria (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025258.label: procambial cell
PO:0025258.definition: A meristematic cell (PO:0004010) that is part of a portion of procambium (PO:0025275).

PO:0025259.label: leaf procambium
PO:0025259.definition: A portion of shoot procambium (PO:0025276) tissue that is part of a vascular leaf (PO:0009025).

PO:0025260.label: shoot axis procambium
PO:0025260.definition: A portion of shoot procambium that is part of a shoot apical meristem and gives rise to the primary vascular tissue of a shoot axis.

synonyms.label: procambio del eje del epiblasto (Spanish, exact)
シュート軸前形成層 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025261.label: pericycle cell
PO:0025261.definition: A ground tissue cell that is part of a portion of pericycle.

PO:0025262.label: plant ovary septum
PO:0025262.definition: A septum (PO:0000030) that divides a multilocular plant ovary (PO:0009072).

PO:0025263.label: locule
PO:0025263.definition: A plant anatomical space (PO:0025117) that is a cavity a reproductive structure.

PO:0025264.label: anther locule
PO:0025264.definition: A sporangium locule that is part of an anther and is a cavity within a single pollen sac or two or more fused pollen sacs.

PO:0025265.label: sporangium locule
PO:0025265.definition: A locule (PO:0025263) that is a cavity in a sporangium (PO:0025094) or several fused sporangia.

PO:0025266.label: plant ovary locule
PO:0025266.definition: A locule (PO:0025263) that is a cavity in a plant ovary (PO:0009072).

PO:0025267.label: fruit replum
PO:0025267.definition: A portion of fruit placenta tissue  (PO:0004535) that divides a fruit (PO:0009001) into two or more chambers and develops from a plant ovary replum (PO:0025272).

PO:0025268.label: fruit septum
PO:0025268.definition: A septum that divides a cavity or mass of tissue in a fruit and develops from an ovary septum.

PO:0025269.label: collective organ part structure
PO:0025269.definition: A collective plant structure (PO:0025497) composed of two or more cardinal organ parts (PO:0025001) that are part of adjacent plant organs (PO:0009008) and any associated portions of plant tissue (PO:0009007).

synonyms.label: &#243rgano colectivo de una parte de la estructura (Spanish, exact)
集合的器官の部分構造 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025270.label: fruit locule
PO:0025270.definition: A locule (PO:0025263) that is a cavity in a fruit (PO:0009001) and develops from a plant ovary locule (PO:0025266).

PO:0025272.label: plant ovary replum
PO:0025272.definition: A portion of ovary placenta tissue (PO:0020001) which divides a plant ovary (PO:0009072) into two or more chambers, and develops from contact of the placental tissue from opposite sides of the plant ovary early in gynoecium development (GO:0048467).

PO:0025273.label: stem procambium
PO:0025273.definition: A portion of shoot axis procambium gives rise to the primary vascular tissue of a stem.

PO:0025274.label: branch procambium
PO:0025274.definition: A portion of shoot axis procambium gives rise to the primary vascular tissue of a branch.

PO:0025275.label: procambium
PO:0025275.definition: A portion of meristem tissue (PO:0009013) that undergoes differentiation to form the primary vascular tissue (PO:0025408).

PO:0025276.label: shoot procambium
PO:0025276.definition: A portion of procambium (PO:0025275) tissue that is part of a shoot system (PO:0009006).

synonyms.label: シュート前形成層 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025277.label: pollen sac
PO:0025277.definition: A microsporangium that is part of a sporophyll and where the pollen grains develop and are located after they develop.

PO:0025278.label: rhizome scale leaf
PO:0025278.definition: A scale leaf that grows from a rhizome.

PO:0025279.label: megagametophyte
PO:0025279.definition: A whole plant in the gametophyte development stage (PO:0028003) that produces only plant egg cells (PO:0020094).

PO:0025280.label: microgametophyte
PO:0025280.definition: A whole plant (PO:0000003) in the gametophyte development stage (PO:0028003) that produces plant sperm cells (PO:0000084).

PO:0025281.label: pollen
PO:0025281.definition: A microgametophyte (PO:0025280) that develops from a microspore (PO:0020048) is located in a pollen sac (PO:0025277).

PO:0025282.label: archegonium megagametophyte
PO:0025282.definition: A megagametophyte (PO:0025279) that has as parts one or more archegonia (PO:0025126).

PO:0025283.label: antheridium microgametophyte
PO:0025283.definition: A microgametophyte (PO:0025280) that has as parts one or more antheridia (PO:0025125).

synonyms.label: 造精器小胞子体（小配偶体） (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025284.label: embryo apical cell
PO:0025284.definition: A sporophyte meristematic apical cell that is part of a plant embryo and is the uppermost cell formed after the first division of a zygote.

PO:0025285.label: callus parenchyma cell
PO:0025285.definition: A parenchyma cell that is part of a plant callus.

synonyms.label: カルス柔組織細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025286.label: plant embryo coleoptile
PO:0025286.definition: A coleoptile (PO:0020033) that is part of a plant embryo (PO:0009009).

PO:0025287.label: seedling coleoptile
PO:0025287.definition: A coleoptile (PO:0020033) that is part of a seedling (PO:0008037).

PO:0025288.label: embryo coleorhiza
PO:0025288.definition: A coleorhiza (PO:0020034) that is part of a plant embryo (PO:0009009).

PO:0025289.label: seedling coleorhiza
PO:0025289.definition: A coleorhiza (PO:0020034) that is part of a seedling (PO:0008037).

PO:0025290.label: embryo hypocotyl
PO:0025290.definition: A hypocotyl (PO:0020100) that is part of a plant embryo axis (PO:0019018).

PO:0025291.label: seedling hypocotyl
PO:0025291.definition: A hypocotyl (PO:0020100) that is part of a seedling (PO:0008037).

PO:0025292.label: embryo epicotyl
PO:0025292.definition: An epicotyl (PO:0020035) that is part of a plant embryo (PO:0009009).

PO:0025293.label: seedling epicotyl
PO:0025293.definition: An epicotyl (PO:0020035) that is part of a seedling (PO:0008037).

PO:0025294.label: embryo mesocotyl
PO:0025294.definition: A mesocotyl (PO:0020037) that is part of a plant embryo (PO:0009009).

PO:0025295.label: seedling mesocotyl
PO:0025295.definition: A mesocotyl (PO:0020037) that develops from an embryo mesocotyl (PO:0025294) and is part of a seedling (PO:0008037).

PO:0025296.label: plant embryo radicle
PO:0025296.definition: A radicle (PO:0020031) that is part of a plant embryo (PO:0009009).

PO:0025297.label: seedling radicle
PO:0025297.definition: A radicle (PO:0020031) that is part of a seedling (PO:0008037).

PO:0025298.label: fruit operculum
PO:0025298.definition: A collective organ part structure that is the apical part of a circumsessile capsular fruit that separates from the rest of the capsule during dehiscence.

PO:0025299.label: OBSOLETE calyptra perianth
PO:0025299.definition: OBSOLETE. A fused perianth that is composed of fused sepals or petals and located on top of a gynoecium that contains an inferior ovary.

PO:0025300.label: embryo hypocotyl-root junction
PO:0025300.definition: A hypocotyl-root junction (PO:0004724) that is part of an plant embryo axis (PO:0019018).

synonyms.label: conjunci&#243n del hipoc&#243tile-ra&#237z en el embri&#243n (Spanish, exact)
胚下胚軸-根合流点 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025301.label: seedling hypocotyl-root junction
PO:0025301.definition: A hypocotyl-root junction (PO:0004724) that develops from an embryo hypocotyl-root junction (PO:0025300) and is part of a seedling (PO:0008037).

synonyms.label: conjunci&#243n del hipoc&#243tile-ra&#237z en la pl&#225ntula (Spanish, exact)
実生胚軸-根合流点 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025302.label: somatic plant embryo
PO:0025302.definition: A plant embryo (PO:0009009) that arises from previously differentiated somatic cells, rather than from fused gametes, i.e. the plant zygote (PO:0000423).

PO:0025303.label: zygotic plant embryo
PO:0025303.definition: A plant embryo (PO:0009009) that forms as a result of the fusion of gametes.

PO:0025304.label: cultured zygote-derived plant embryo
PO:0025304.definition: A zygotic plant embryo that is grown or maintained in vitro.

synonyms.label: embri&#243n cultivado derivado del cigoto vegetal (Spanish, exact)
培養接合子由来植物胚 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025305.label: microspore-derived cultured plant embryo
PO:0025305.definition: A cultured somatic plant embryo that develops from isolated microspores.

synonyms.label: embri&#243n cultivado derivado de la microspora vegetal (Spanish, exact)
小胞子由来培養植物胚 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025306.label: sporangium wall
PO:0025306.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is composed of the outer layers of a sporangium (PO:0025094) and bounds the archesporium (PO:0030074) or plant spores (PO:0025017).

PO:0025307.label: microsporangium wall
PO:0025307.definition: A sporangium wall (PO:0025306) that is part of a microsporangium (PO:0025202).

PO:0025308.label: megasporangium wall
PO:0025308.definition: A sporangium wall that is part of a megasporangium.

PO:0025309.label: microsporangium endothecium
PO:0025309.definition: A sporangium wall endothecium (PO:0030049) that is part of a microsporangium wall (PO:0025307).

PO:0025310.label: megasporangium endothecium
PO:0025310.definition: A sporangium wall endothecium (PO:0030049) that is part of a megasporangium wall.

PO:0025311.label: microsporangium exothecium
PO:0025311.definition: A portion of exothecium (PO:0030073) that is part of a microsporangium wall (PO:0025307).

PO:0025312.label: megasporangium exothecium
PO:0025312.definition: A portion of exothecium (PO:0030073) that is part of a megasporangium wall (PO:0025308).

PO:0025313.label: tapetum
PO:0025313.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) that is the inner-most layer of a sporangium wall (PO:0025306).

synonyms.label: 絨毯組織、タペート組織 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025314.label: microsporangium tapetum
PO:0025314.definition: An tapetum (PO:0025313) that is part of a microsporangium wall (PO:0025307).

synonyms.label: 小胞子嚢絨毯組織（タペート組織） (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025315.label: megasporangium tapetum
PO:0025315.definition: A tapetum (PO:0025313) that is part of a megasporangium wall (PO:0025308).

synonyms.label: 大胞子嚢嚢絨毯組織（タペート組織） (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025316.label: axillary hair
PO:0025316.definition: A multicellular trichome (PO:0025162) that has as parts a long terminal cell atop a basal stalk and grows in a leaf axil (PO:0009023).

PO:0025317.label: axillary hair terminal cell
PO:0025317.definition: A trichome cell (PO:0008030) that is the long terminal cell of an axillary hair (PO:0008030).

synonyms.label: c&#233lula terminal del pelo axilar (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025318.label: axillary hair base
PO:0025318.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the basal part of an axillary hair (PO:0025316), below the axillary hair terminal cell (PO:0025317).

PO:0025319.label: axillary hair basal cell
PO:0025319.definition: A trichome cell (PO:0008030) that is part of a base of an axillary hair (PO:0025316).

synonyms.label: c&#233lula basal del pelo axilar (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025320.label: cotyledonary node rhizoid
PO:0025320.definition: An epidermal rhizoid that grows form a cotyledonary node.

synonyms.label: rizoide del nodo del cotiled&#243n (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025321.label: cotyledonary node
PO:0025321.definition: A stem node (PO:0020141) from which cotyledons (PO:0020030) may develop.

PO:0025322.label: hydathode pore
PO:0025322.definition: A plant anatomical space that is an opening in a hydathode.

PO:0025323.label: flower fascicle
PO:0025323.definition: A reproductive shoot system (PO:0025082) that is a second order inflorescence (PO:0025240), or higher, in which the inflorescence branch (PO:0009081) bears two or more flowers (PO:0009046), but is not elongated.

PO:0025324.label: banner petal
PO:0025324.definition: A petal (PO:0009032) that is the top-most petal of a papilionaceous corolla (PO:0009059).

PO:0025325.label: wing petal
PO:0025325.definition: One of two lateral petals (PO:0009032) that is adjacent to the banner petal of a papilionaceous corolla (PO:0009059).

PO:0025326.label: keel petal
PO:0025326.definition: A petal (PO:0009032) that is one of the two lowest petals of a papilionaceous corolla (PO:0025324).

PO:0025327.label: keel
PO:0025327.definition: A boat-shaped collective phyllome structure (PO:0025023) that consists of the two lowest petals (PO:0009032) of a papilionaceous corolla (PO:0009059).

synonyms.label: 竜骨（イネ科）、舟弁（マメ科） (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025328.label: unifacial vascular leaf
PO:0025328.definition: A vascular leaf that has increased activity of either the adaxial or abaxial meristem early in development, leading to absence of the opposite surface on the mature leaf.

PO:0025329.label: calyptra calyx
PO:0025329.definition: A fused calyx (PO:0025582) that is composed of fused sepals (PO:0025584).

PO:0025330.label: calyptra corolla
PO:0025330.definition: A fused corolla (PO:0025581) that is composed of fused petals (PO:0025583).

PO:0025331.label: ray flower
PO:0025331.definition: A small pistillate flower (PO:0025599) on the margin of a head-type (capitulum) inflorescence  (PO:0009049).

PO:0025332.label: disk flower
PO:0025332.definition: A small flower (PO:0009046) in the center of a head-type (capitulum) inflorescence (PO:0009049).

PO:0025333.label: ensiform vascular leaf
PO:0025333.definition: A unifacial leaf that is flat in cross section due to a lamina that develops in a median plane (perpendicular to the axis), rather a transverse plane (tangent to the axis) throughout all of part of the length of the leaf.

PO:0025334.label: terete vascular leaf
PO:0025334.definition: A unifacial leaf that is round in cross section throughout all of part of the length of the leaf.

synonyms.label: 維管束系円柱形葉 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025335.label: phyllode leaf
PO:0025335.definition: An adult ensiform leaf with a lamina that develops in a median plane, rather a transverse plane, throughout the length of the leaf and is a result of increased activity of the adaxial meristem early in development.

PO:0025336.label: transition phyllode leaf
PO:0025336.definition: A transition vascular leaf in which the basal portion of the leaf has unifacial lamina development in a median plane, similar to a phyllode, and the apical portion of the leaf develops leaflets similar to a juvenile leaf.

PO:0025337.label: life of whole plant stage
PO:0025337.definition: A maximal whole plant development stage.

synonyms.label: vida de la planta entera (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025338.label: collective plant organ structure development stage
PO:0025338.definition: A plant structure development stage (PO:0009012) that has as primary participant a collective plant structure (PO:0025497).

synonyms.label: etapa de desarrollo de una estructura colectiva de la planta (Spanish, exact)
集合的植物構造の発生過程 (Japanese, exact)

relationships: has_participant PO:0025007 ! collective plant organ structure

PO:0025339.label: plant organ development stage
PO:0025339.definition: A multi-tissue plant structure development stage (PO:0025571) that has as primary participant a plant organ (PO:0009008) .

synonyms.label: etapa de desarrollo de un &#243rgano (Spanish, exact)
植物器官発生過程 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025340.label: gametophyte vegetative stage
PO:0025340.definition: A gametophyte development stage (PO:0028003) that occurs during the interval between spore germination and the formation of a gametangium.

PO:0025341.label: gametophyte reproductive stage
PO:0025341.definition: A gametophyte development stage (PO:0028003) that occurs during the interval between the initiation of either a multicellular plant gametangium (PO:0025124) or a unicellular plant gametangium (PO:0025521) and the onset of senescence.

PO:0025342.label: gametophyte dormant stage
PO:0025342.definition: A gametophyte development stage (PO:0028003) during which a gametophyte participates in a dormancy process.

PO:0025343.label: gametophyte senescent stage
PO:0025343.definition: A gametophyte development stage (PO:0028003) during which a gametophyte participates in multicellular organism senescence.

synonyms.label: etapa de senescencia del gametofito (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025344.label: gametophore reproductive whole plant development stage
PO:0025344.definition: A gametophyte reproductive stage (PO:0025341) in which a gametophore (PO:0030018) and gametangium is being produced.

synonyms.label: etapa de desarrollo del gamet&#243foro reproductivo de la planta entera (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025345.label: gametophore vegetative whole plant development stage
PO:0025345.definition: A gametophyte vegetative whole plant development stage during which a gametophore is being produced but no gametangia are being produced.

synonyms.label: etapa de desarrollo del gamet&#243foro vegetativo de la planta entera (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025346.label: thallus reproductive whole plant development stage
PO:0025346.definition: A gametophyte reproductive development stage in which a thallus and gametangium is being produced.

synonyms.label: etapa de desarrollo del talo reproductivo de la planta entera (Spanish, exact)
葉状体生殖生長期 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025347.label: thallus vegetative whole plant development stage
PO:0025347.definition: A gametophyte vegetative whole plant development stage during which a thallus is being produced but no gametangia are being produced.

synonyms.label: etapa de desarrollo del talo vegetativo de la plant entera (Spanish, exact)
葉状体栄養生長期 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025348.label: phyllome lamina vein
PO:0025348.definition: A vascular bundle (PO:0005020) that is part of a phyllome lamina (PO:0025396).

PO:0025349.label: awn
PO:0025349.definition: A cardinal organ part that is a slender, more or less straight and stiff, fine-pointed, terminal or subterminal appendage of a glume, lemma, or palea.

PO:0025350.label: palea awn
PO:0025350.definition: An awn that is part of a palea.

PO:0025351.label: glume awn
PO:0025351.definition: An awn that is part of a glume.

PO:0025352.label: tubercle
PO:0025352.definition: An enlarged leaf base (PO:0020040) that is fused with adjacent shoot axis (PO:0025029) tissue.

PO:0025353.label: areole bud
PO:0025353.definition: An axillary vegetative bud (PO:0004712) that is not elongated, in which the vascular leaves (PO:0009025) develop as spine leaves (PO:0025173).

PO:0025354.label: cladode
PO:0025354.definition: A shoot axis that is flattened and expanded.

synonyms.label: 扁茎、仮葉枝、葉状茎 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025355.label: corm
PO:0025355.definition: A shoot system (PO:0009006) that has as parts a short, enlarged stem (PO:0009047) in which the shoot internodes (PO:0005005) do not elongate, and one or more buds (PO:0000055).

PO:0025356.label: bulb
PO:0025356.definition: A short, enlarged shoot system (PO:0009006) that has as parts a short stem (PO:0009047) in which the shoot internodes (PO:0005005) do not elongate, and one or more buds (PO:0000055) enclosed by fleshy leaves (PO:0009025) or leaf bases (PO:0020040).

PO:0025357.label: pneumatophore
PO:0025357.definition: A lateral root (PO:0020121) that is erect and protrudes above the surface of the soil or water.

PO:0025358.label: pneumatorhiza
PO:0025358.definition: A small lateral root that grows from a prop root and has a mealy surface texture.

synonyms.label: 支持根から出る側根 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025359.label: sorus
PO:0025359.definition: A collective plant organ structure (PO:0025007) on the surface of a vascular leaf (PO:0009025) that has as part a cluster of two or more adjacent sporangia (PO:0025094).

PO:0025460.definition: A companion cell (PO:0000400) that has dense cytoplasm, a small vacuole, proplastids rather than chloroplasts, and abundant and highly branched plasmodesmata linking it to adjacent mesophyll cells.

PO:0025461.label: early wood tracheary element
PO:0025461.definition: A secondary xylem tracheary element (PO:0025445) that is part of a portion of early wood (PO:0004515).

PO:0025462.label: late wood tracheary element
PO:0025462.definition: A secondary xylem tracheary element (PO:0025445) that is part of a portion of late wood (PO:0004516).

synonyms.label: elemento de tr&#225quea de madera temprana (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025463.label: cell division stage of secondary xylem
PO:0025463.definition: A secondary xylem development stage (PO:0025427) that occurs during the interval between the first and last cell division in a portion of secondary xylem tissue (PO:0005848), during which cells are produced by divisions of cambial initials (PO:0000295) or xylem mother cells.

synonyms.label: elemento de tr&#225quea de madera tard&#237a (Spanish, exact)
二次木部の細胞分裂期 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025464.label: cell expansion stage of secondary xylem
PO:0025464.definition: A cell differentiation stage of secondary xylem (PO:0025469) that occurs during the interval between the end of a cell division stage of secondary xylem (PO:0025463) and the onset of a secondary cell wall formation stage of secondary xylem (PO:0025465), during which the cells undergo cell growth (GO:0016049).

synonyms.label: etapa de expansi&#243n celular del xilema secundario (Spanish, exact)
二次木部の細胞伸長期 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025465.label: secondary cell wall formation stage of secondary xylem
PO:0025465.definition: A cell differentiation stage of secondary xylem (PO:0025469) that occurs during the interval between the onset of secondary wall biogenesis (GO:0009834) of the cells in a portion of secondary xylem (PO:0005848) and the beginning of a cell death stage of secondary xylem (PO:0025466).

synonyms.label: estapa de formaci&#243n de la pared secundaria celular del xilema secundario (Spanish, exact)
二次木部の細胞壁二次壁形成段階 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025466.label: cell death stage of secondary xylem
PO:0025466.definition: A cell differentiation stage of secondary xylem (PO:0025469) that occurs during the interval between the first cell death of a tracheary element (PO:0000290) or non-septate xylem fiber cell (PO:0000274) and the death of the last secondary xylem parenchyma cell (PO:0004525) or septate fiber cell (PO:0004521) in a portion of secondary xylem (PO:0005848).

synonyms.label: etapa de muerte celular del xilema secundario (Spanish, exact)
二次木部の細胞死段階 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025467.label: tracheary element death stage of secondary xylem
PO:0025467.definition: A cell death stage of secondary xylem (PO:0025466) that occurs during the interval between the first and last cell death of a tracheary element (PO:0000290) or non-septate xylem fiber cell (PO:0000274).

synonyms.label: etapa de muerte del elemento de tr&#225a del xilema secundario (Spanish, exact)
二次木部管状要素枯死期 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025468.label: secondary xylem parenchyma cell death stage of secondary xylem
PO:0025468.definition: A cell death stage of secondary xylem (PO:0025466) that occurs during the interval between the last cell death of a tracheary element (PO:0000290) or non-septate xylem fiber cell (PO:0000274) and the last cell death in a portion of secondary xylem (PO:0005848).

synonyms.label: etapa de muerte de las c&#233lulas parenquim&#225ticas del xilema secundario (Spanish, exact)
二次木部柔組織細胞死期 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025469.label: cell differentiation stage of secondary xylem
PO:0025469.definition: A secondary xylem development stage (PO:0025427) that occurs during the interval between the end of a cell division stage of secondary xylem (PO:0025463) and the death of the last living cell in the secondary xylem.

synonyms.label: etapa de diferenciaci&#243 celular del xilema secundario (Spanish, exact)
二次木部の細胞分化期 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025470.label: plant embryo cotyledon
PO:0025470.definition: A cotyledon (PO:0020030) that is part of a plant embryo (PO:0009009).

PO:0025471.label: seedling cotyledon
PO:0025471.definition: A cotyledon (PO:0020030) that is part of a seedling (PO:0008037).

PO:0025472.label: reaction wood
PO:0025472.definition: A portion of secondary xylem (PO:0005848) found on either the upper or lower side of a shoot axis (PO:0025029) that is or was angled away from vertical, with anatomical characteristics that depend on whether it is compression wood (PO:0025473) or tension wood (PO:0025474).

PO:0025473.label: compression wood
PO:0025473.definition: A portion of reaction wood (PO:0025472) found on the lower side of a shoot axis (PO:0025029) that is or was angled away from vertical and that has as parts heavily lignified tracheids (PO:0000301) with a specialized S2 layer that contains more lignin and has a larger (more horizontal) microfibril angle.

PO:0025474.label: tension wood
