PO:0025474.definition: A portion of reaction wood (PO:0025472) found on the upper side of a shoot axis (PO:0025029) that is or was angled away from vertical and that has as parts gelatinous fiber cells (PO:0025422).

PO:0025475.label: coleorhiza emergence stage
PO:0025475.definition: A root development stage (PO:0007520) during which a coleorhiza (PO:0020034) emerges from the seed coat (PO:0009088).

PO:0025476.label: tuberous root tuber
PO:0025476.definition: A root (PO:0009005) that develops from a tuberous root (PO:0025523) and is further radially enlarged for storage.

PO:0025477.label: floral organ primordium
PO:0025477.definition: A primordium (PO:0025127) that is committed to the development of a floral organ (PO:0025395) and is part of a reproductive shoot apex (PO:0025222).

synonyms.label: portion of floral structure primordium tissue (exact)

PO:0025478.label: androecium primordium
PO:0025478.definition: A floral structure primordium (PO:0025477) that is committed to the development of an androecium (PO:0009061).

synonyms.label: 雄蕊群原基(可視的） (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025479.label: basal root primordium
PO:0025479.definition: A root primordium (PO:0005029) that is committed to the development of a basal root (PO:0025002).

synonyms.label: portion of basal root primordium tissue (exact)
primordio basal de la ra&#237z (Spanish, exact)
下胚軸由来の根の原基(可視的）、不定根原基(可視的）  (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025480.label: shoot-borne root primordium
PO:0025480.definition: A root primordium (PO:0005029) that is committed to the development of a shoot-borne root (PO:0000042).

synonyms.label: portion of shoot-borne root primordium tissue (exact)
primordio del eje  del epiblasto de la ra&#237z (Spanish, exact)
シュート細胞由来の根原基（可視的） (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025481.label: leaflet primordium
PO:0025481.definition: A primordium (PO:0025127) that develops as part of a leaf primordium (PO:0000017) of a compound leaf (PO:0020043) and is committed to the development of a leaflet (PO:0020049).

PO:0025482.label: bract anlagen
PO:0025482.definition: A phyllome anlagen (PO:0025430) that will give rise to a bract primordium (PO:0025487) and is part of a peripheral zone (PO:000225) of a reproductive shoot apical meristem (PO:0008028).

PO:0025483.label: lodicule anlagen
PO:0025483.definition: A phyllome anlagen (PO:0025430) that will give rise to a lodicule primordium (PO:0008040) and is part of a peripheral zone (PO:000225) of a flower meristem (PO:0000229).

PO:0025484.label: petal anlagen
PO:0025484.definition: A phyllome anlagen (PO:0025430) that will give rise to a petal primordium (PO:0000021) and is part of a peripheral zone (PO:000225) of a flower meristem (PO:0000229).

PO:0025485.label: sepal anlagen
PO:0025485.definition: A phyllome anlagen (PO:0025430) that will give rise to a sepal primordium (PO:0004704) and is part of a peripheral zone (PO:000225) of a flower meristem (PO:0000229).

PO:0025486.label: stamen anlagen
PO:0025486.definition: A phyllome anlagen (PO:0025430) that will give rise to a stamen primordium (PO:0004705) and is part of a peripheral zone (PO:000225) of a flower meristem (PO:0000229).

PO:0025487.label: bract primordium
PO:0025487.definition: A phyllome primordium (PO:0025487) that is committed to the development of a flower bract (PO:0009055).

PO:0025488.label: flower bract primordium
PO:0025488.definition: A bract primordium (PO:0025128) is committed to the development of a flower bract (PO:0009034).

synonyms.label: portion of flower bract primordium tissue (exact)
primordio de la br&#225ctea floral (Spanish, exact)
花苞（葉）原基（可視的） (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025489.label: inflorescence bract primordium
PO:0025489.definition: A bract primordium (PO:0025128) is committed to the development of an inflorescence bract (PO:0009054).

synonyms.label: portion of inflorescence bract primordium tissue (related)
primordio de la br&#225ctea de la inflorescencia (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025490.label: plant ovary ovule
PO:0025490.definition: A plant ovule (PO:0020006) that is part of a plant ovary (PO:0009072).

PO:0025491.label: ovuliferous scale ovule
PO:0025491.definition: A plant ovule (PO:0020006) that is part of an ovuliferous scale (add).

PO:0025492.label: pericyclic lateral root primordium
PO:0025492.definition: A lateral root primordium (PO:0000016) that develops from a portion of pericycle tissue (PO:0006203) and is committed to the development of a pericyclic lateral root (PO:0025494).

synonyms.label: primordio de ra&#237z lateral peric�clica (Spanish, exact)
内鞘由来分枝根始原体 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025493.label: non-pericyclic lateral root primordium
PO:0025493.definition: A lateral root primordium (PO:0000016) that develops from a portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) other than a pericycle (PO:0006203) and is committed to the development of a non-pericyclic lateral root (PO:0025495).

synonyms.label: primordio de ra&#237z lateral no peric�clica (Spanish, exact)
内鞘以外の組織から発生する分枝根始原体 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025494.label: pericyclic lateral root
PO:0025494.definition: A lateral root (PO:0025495) that develops from a pericyclic lateral root primordium (PO:0025492).
relationships: develops_from PO:0025492 ! pericyclic lateral root primordium

PO:0025495.label: non-pericyclic lateral root
PO:0025495.definition: A lateral root (PO:0025495) that develops from a non-pericyclic lateral root primordium (PO:0025493).

synonyms.label: 内鞘以外の組織から発生する分枝根 (Japanese, exact)

relationships: develops_from PO:0025493 ! non-pericyclic lateral root primordium

PO:0025496.label: multi-tissue plant structure
PO:0025496.definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that has as parts two or more portions of plant tissue (PO:0009007) of at least two different types and which through specific morphogenetic processes forms a single structural unit demarcated by primarily bona-fide boundaries from other structural units of different types.

synonyms.label: estructura vegetal con m&#250ltiples tejidos (Spanish, exact)
複数の組織からなる植物構造 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025497.label: collective plant structure
PO:0025497.definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is a proper part of a whole plant (PO:0000003) and includes two or more adjacent plant organs (PO:0009008) or adjacent cardinal organ parts (PO:0025001), along with any associated portions of plant tissue (PO:0009007).

PO:0025498.label: cardinal part of multi-tissue plant structure
PO:0025498.definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is a proper part of a multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025496) and includes portions of plant tissues (PO:0009007) of at least two different types.

synonyms.label: parte cardinal de estructura vegetal con m&#250ltiples tejidos (Spanish, exact)
複数の組織からなる植物構造の基本（主要）部分 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025499.label: sepal epidermis giant cell
PO:0025499.definition: An shoot epidermal pavement cell (PO:0000332) that is part of sepal epidermis (PO:0006040) and is approximately one fifth the length of a sepal (PO:0009031).

synonyms.label: がく片表皮巨大細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025500.label: whole plant fruit development stage
PO:0025500.definition: A sporophyte reproductive stage that begins when a fruit (PO:0009001) on a whole plant (PO:0000003) that is not currently participating in a whole plant fruit development stage begins a fruit initiation stage (PO:0025503), and ends with the earliest of the following: (1) the whole plant begins a sporophyte senescent stage (PO:0007017), (2) the whole plant begins a sporophyte dormant stage (PO:0007132), or (3) all fruits on the whole plant are finished ripening.

PO:0025501.label: fruit formation stage
PO:0025501.definition: A fruit development stage (PO:0001002) that begins with the formation of a plant zygote (PO:0000423) that is contained in the fruit (PO:0009001) being studied and ends when that fruit's fruit ripening stage (PO:0025502) begins.

PO:0025502.label: fruit ripening stage
PO:0025502.definition: A fruit development stage (PO:0001002) during which a single fruit (PO:0009001) participates in the process of fruit ripening (GO:0009835).

PO:0025503.label: fruit initiation stage
PO:0025503.definition: A fruit formation stage (PO:0025501) that begins with the formation of a plant zygote (PO:0000423) that is contained in the fruit (PO:0009001) being studied and ends when the plant cells (PO:0009002) in the fruit begin to divide or expand.

PO:0025504.label: fruit size up to 10% stage
PO:0025504.definition: A fruit formation stage (PO:0025501) that begins when the plant cells (PO:0009002) in a fruit (PO:0009001) begin to divide or expand, and ends when the fruit has reached 10% of its final size.

PO:0025505.label: fruit size 10 to 30% stage
PO:0025505.definition: A fruit formation stage (PO:0025501) that spans the interval when a fruit (PO:0009001) has reached 10% to 30% of its final size.

PO:0025506.label: fruit size 30 to 50% stage
PO:0025506.definition: A fruit formation stage (PO:0025501) that spans the interval when a fruit (PO:0009001) has reached 30 to 50% of its final size.

PO:0025507.label: fruit size 50 to 70% stage
PO:0025507.definition: A fruit formation stage (PO:0025501) that spans the interval when a fruit (PO:0009001) has reached 50 to 70% of its final size.

PO:0025508.label: fruit size 70% to final size stage
PO:0025508.definition: A fruit formation stage (PO:0025501) that spans begins when a fruit (PO:0009001) has reached 70% of its final size and ends when a fruit has reached its final size and a fruit ripening stage (PO:0025502) begins.

PO:0025509.label: archegonium central cell
PO:0025509.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that is the larger, distal cell arising from the first division of an archegonium initial cell (PO:0025510).

PO:0025510.label: archegonium initial cell
PO:0025510.definition: An initial cell (PO:0004011) that divides asymmetrically to form an archegonium central cell (PO:0025509) and a smaller archegonium neck canal cell (PO:0030035).

PO:0025511.label: petal spur
PO:0025511.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is a slender, hollow extension of a petal (PO:0009032).

PO:0025512.label: corolla spur
PO:0025512.definition: A collective organ part structure (PO:0025269) that is a slender, hollow extension of a corolla and has as parts segments of two more fused petals.

PO:0025513.label: plant organ lamina
PO:0025513.definition: A lamina (PO:0025060) that is part of a plant organ (PO:0009008).

PO:0025514.label: phyllome lamina lobe
PO:0025514.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is a projection on a phyllome margin (PO:0025018) for which the corresponding phyllome sinus (PO:0025383) extends one quarter or more of the distance to the center of the long axis of the phyllome lamina (PO:0025396).

synonyms.label: フィロム葉身裂片 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025515.label: phyllome lamina tooth
PO:0025515.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is an angular projection on a phyllome margin (PO:0025018) for which the corresponding phyllome sinus (PO:0025383) extends less than one quarter of the distance to the center of the long axis of the phyllome lamina (PO:0025396).

PO:0025516.label: phyllome lamina crena
PO:0025516.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is a rounded projection on a phyllome margin (PO:0025018) for which the corresponding phyllome sinus (PO:0025383) extends less than one quarter of the distance to the center of the long axis of the phyllome lamina (PO:0025396).

synonyms.label: フィロム葉身鈍鋸歯状 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025517.label: leaf lamina lobe
PO:0025517.definition: A phyllome lobe (PO:0025514) that is a projection on a leaf lamina margin (PO:0025009) for which the corresponding leaf sinus (PO:0025384) extends one quarter or more of the distance to the center of the long axis of the leaf lamina (PO:0020039).

synonyms.label: lóbulo de la lámina de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025518.label: leaf lamina tooth
PO:0025518.definition: A phyllome lamina tooth (PO:0025515) that is an angular projection on a leaf margin (PO:0020128) for which the corresponding leaf sinus (PO:0025384) extends less than one quarter of the distance to the center of the long axis of the leaf lamina (PO:0020039).

synonyms.label: diente de la lámina de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025519.label: leaf lamina crena
PO:0025519.definition: A phyllome lamina crena (PO:0025516) that is a rounded projection on a leaf margin (PO:0020128) for which the corresponding leaf sinus (PO:0025384) extends less than one quarter of the distance to the center of the long axis of the leaf lamina (PO:0020039).

synonyms.label: crena de la lámina de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025520.label: leaf lamina intramarginal vein
PO:0025520.definition: A leaf lamina vein (PO:0020138) that is just inside the leaf lamina margin (PO:0025009) and extends from the leaf lamina base (PO:0008019) to the leaf apex (PO:0020137).

synonyms.label: vena intramarginal de la lámina de la hoja (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025521.label: unicellular plant gametangium
PO:0025521.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that produces one or more gametes (PO:0025006) and participates in the gametophyte development stage (PO:0028003).

synonyms.label: 単細胞植物配偶子嚢 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025522.label: tuber
PO:0025522.definition: A plant axis (PO:0025004) that is radially enlarged.

PO:0025523.label: tuberous root
PO:0025523.definition: A root (PO:0009005) that is radially enlarged relative to other lateral roots (PO:0020121) or shoot-borne roots (PO:0000042) on the same plant, but not as enlarged as a tuberous root tuber (PO:0025476).

PO:0025524.label: ventral canal cell
PO:0025524.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that develops from the archegonium central cell (PO:0025509), and lies at the base of the archegonium neck (PO:0030039), above the archegonium egg cell (PO:0025122) in the venter (PO:0030038).

PO:0025525.label: spermatogenous cell
PO:0025525.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that gives rise to one or more plant sperm cells (PO:0000084).

PO:0025526.label: body cell
PO:0025526.definition: A spermatogenous cell (PO:0025525) of the microgametophyte (PO:0025280) that divides to produce a vegetative cell (PO:0020099) and the pollen sperm cell (PO:0025121).

PO:0025527.label: shoot system development stage
PO:0025527.definition: A collective plant organ structure development stage (PO:0025338) that begins with the onset of the plant organ development stage (PO:0025339) and ends with either gametophyte senescent stage (PO:0025343) or sporophyte senescent stage (PO:0007017) or death.

PO:0025528.label: bud development stage
PO:0025528.definition: A shoot system development stage (PO:0025527) that has as primary participant a bud (PO:0009006).

PO:0025529.label: bud dormancy stage
PO:0025529.definition: A bud development stage (PO:0025528) during which a bud (PO:0009006) participates in a bud dormancy process (GO:0097207).

PO:0025530.label: reproductive shoot system development stage
PO:0025530.definition: A shoot system development stage (PO:0025527) that has as primary participant a reproductive shoot system (PO:0025082).

PO:0025531.label: bud swell stage
PO:0025531.definition: A bud development stage (PO:0025528) during which a bud (PO:0009006) enlarges due to growth of the shoot system (PO:0009006).

PO:0025532.label: bud burst stage
PO:0025532.definition: A shoot system development stage (PO:0025527) during which a shoot system (PO:0009006) emerges from the bud (PO:0009006).

PO:0025533.label: prothallial cell
PO:0025533.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) which is vegetative and develops from the division of the microspore (PO:0020048) of vascular plants other than angiosperms.

PO:0025534.label: adventitious shoot axis
PO:0025534.definition: A shoot axis (PO:00025029) that develops in an unusual place.

PO:0025535.label: multicellular trichome tip
PO:0025535.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the apical most portion of a multicellular trichome apex (PO:0025551).

synonyms.label: 多細胞トリコーム（毛茸、糸状体）先端 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025536.label: plant cuticle ridge
PO:0025536.definition: A portion of plant cuticle (PO:000022) that forms a ridge, may be overlayed with epicuticular wax (PO:0025388).

synonyms.label: cresta de la cuticula vegetal (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025537.label: unicellular trichome
PO:0025537.definition: A trichome (PO:0000282) that is a single plant cell (PO:0009002).

synonyms.label: 単細胞トリコーム（毛茸、糸状体) (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025538.label: plant sap
PO:0025538.definition: A portion of plant substance (PO:0025161) that is an aqueous solution that can be transported through the apoplast (GO:0048046) or symplast (GO:0055044).

PO:0025539.label: xylem sap
PO:0025539.definition: A plant sap (PO:0025538) that is an aqueous solution which may contain mineral elements, nutrients, and plant hormones, and is transported from the root system (PO:0025025) toward the leaves through the tracheary elements (PO:0000290) of the xylem.

PO:0025540.label: phloem sap
PO:0025540.definition: A plant sap (PO:0025538) that is an aqueous solution which may contain sugars, mineral elements, and plant hormones, and is transported through the phloem sieve elements (PO:0025406).

PO:0025541.label: bundle sheath cell
PO:0025541.definition: A ground tissue cell (PO:0000076) that is part of a bundle sheath (PO:0006023).

synonyms.label: celula de la vaina del haz vascular (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025542.label: bundle sheath chlorenchyma cell
PO:0025542.definition: A chlorenchyma cell (PO:0000076) that is part of a bundle sheath (PO:0006023).

synonyms.label: celula clorenquimatica de la vaina del haz vascular (Spanish, exact)  (exact)
維管束鞘同化組織、葉緑組織細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025543.label: tapetum cell
PO:0025543.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that is part of the tapetum (PO:0025313).

PO:0025544.label: microsporangium tapetum cell
PO:0025544.definition: A tapetum cell (PO:0025543) that is part of a microsporangium tapetum (PO:0025314).

synonyms.label: c&#233lula del tapete del microsporangio (Spanish, exact)
小胞子嚢タペート細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025545.label: anther wall tapetum cell
PO:0025545.definition: A microsporangium tapetum cell (PO:0025544) that is part of the anther wall tapetum (PO:0009071).

synonyms.label: célula de la pared del tapete de la antera (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025546.label: accessory paraclade
PO:0025546.definition: A second order inflorescence axis (PO:0006321) borne in the same axil (PO:0025224) as an existing second order inflorescence axis.

PO:0025547.label: cauline paraclade
PO:0025547.definition: A second order inflorescence axis (PO:0006321) borne on an elongated first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104).

PO:0025548.label: rosette paraclade
PO:0025548.definition: A second order inflorescence axis (PO:0006321) borne on a compacted first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104), forming the rosette.

synonyms.label: ロゼット側生分枝 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025549.label: trichome tip
PO:0025549.definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is the apical most portion of a trichome apex (PO:0025550).

synonyms.label: トリコーム（毛茸、糸状体）先端 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025550.label: trichome apex
PO:0025550.definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is the apical most portion of a trichome (PO:0000282).

synonyms.label: トリコーム（毛茸、糸状体）頂端 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025551.label: multicellular trichome apex
PO:0025551.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the apical most portion of a multicellular trichome (PO:0025162).

PO:0025552.label: centarch protoxylem
PO:0025552.definition: A portion of protoxylem (PO:0000272) tissue in which the maturation of primary xylem of the shoot system progresses centrifugally with the oldest elements (protoxylem) in the center of the axis.

PO:0025553.label: mesarch protoxylem
PO:0025553.definition: A portion of protoxylem (PO:0000272) tissue in which the maturation of primary xylem (PO:0005849) of the shoot system (PO:0009006) progresses both centripetally and centrifugally from the center.

PO:0025554.label: exarch protoxylem
PO:0025554.definition: A portion of protoxylem (PO:0000272) tissue in which the maturation of primary xylem (PO:0005849) progresses centripetally, the oldest elements (protoxylem) are farthest from the center of the plant axis (PO:0025004).

PO:0025555.label: root system exarch protoxylem
PO:0025555.definition: A portion of exarch protoxylem (PO:002554) tissue in which the maturation of primary xylem (PO:0005849) of the root system (PO:0025025) progresses centripedally, with the oldest elements (protoxylem) farthest from the center of the plant axis (PO:0025004).

synonyms.label: protoxilema exarco de la raiz (Spanish, exact)  (exact)
根外原型原生木部 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025556.label: shoot system exarch protoxylem
PO:0025556.definition: A portion of exarch protoxylem (PO:002554) tissue in which the maturation of primary xylem (PO:0005849) of the shoot system (PO:0009006) progresses centripetally, with the oldest elements (protoxylem) farthest from the center of the plant axis (PO:0025004).

synonyms.label: protoxilema exarco del sistema del epiblasto (Spanish, exact)
シュート組織外原型原生木部 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025557.label: endarch protoxylem
PO:0025557.definition: A portion of protoxylem (PO:0000272) tissue in which the maturation of primary xylem (PO:0005849) of the shoot system (PO:0009006) progresses centrifugally, with the oldest elements (protoxylem) towards the center of the plant axis (PO:0025004).

PO:0025558.label: monarch protoxylem
PO:0025558.definition: A portion of root exarch protoxylem (PO:0025555) tissue in which the primary xylem (PO:0005849) of the root system (PO:0025025) has only one protoxylem strand or pole, and differentiation progresses centripetally, with the oldest element (protoxylem) farthest from the center of the plant axis (PO:0025004).

PO:0025559.label: diarch protoxylem
PO:0025559.definition: A portion of root exarch protoxylem (PO:0025555) tissue in which the primary xylem (PO:0005849) of the root system (PO:0025025) has two protoxylem strands or poles, and differentiation progresses centripetally, with the oldest elements (protoxylem) farthest from the center of the plant axis (PO:0025004).

PO:0025560.label: triarch protoxylem
PO:0025560.definition: A portion of root exarch protoxylem (PO:0025555) tissue in which the primary xylem (PO:0005849) of the root system (PO:0025025) has three protoxylem strands or poles, and differentiation progresses centripetally, with the oldest elements (protoxylem) farthest from the center of the plant axis (PO:0025004).

PO:0025561.label: tetrarch protoxylem
PO:0025561.definition: A portion of root exarch protoxylem (PO:0025555) tissue in which the primary xylem (PO:0005849) of the root system (PO:0025025) has four protoxylem strands or poles, and differentiation progresses centripetally, with the oldest elements (protoxylem) farthest from the center of the plant axis (PO:0025004).

PO:0025562.label: pentarch protoxylem
PO:0025562.definition: A portion of root exarch protoxylem (PO:0025555) tissue in which the primary xylem (PO:0005849) of the root system (PO:0025025) has five protoxylem strands or poles, and differentiation progresses centripetally, with the oldest elements (protoxylem) farthest from the center of the plant axis (PO:0025004).

PO:0025563.label: polyarch protoxylem
PO:0025563.definition: A portion of root exarch protoxylem (PO:0025555) tissue in which the primary xylem (PO:0005849) of the root system (PO:0025025) has more than five protoxylem strands or poles, and differentiation progresses centripetally, with the oldest elements (protoxylem) farthest from the center of the plant axis (PO:0025004).

PO:0025564.label: megasporangium tapetum cell
PO:0025564.definition: A tapetum cell (PO:0025543) that is part of a megasporangium tapetum (PO:0025315).

synonyms.label: c&#233lula del tapete de megasporangio (Spanish, exact)
大胞子嚢絨毯組織（タペート組織）細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025565.label: shoot system xylem sap
PO:0025565.definition: A xylem sap (PO:0025539) that is located in the shoot system (PO:0009006).

synonyms.label: savia del floema del epiblasto (Spanish, exact)  (exact)
シュート組織木部樹液 (Japanese, exact)  (exact)

PO:0025566.label: shoot system phloem sap
PO:0025566.definition: A phloem sap (PO:0025540) that is located in the shoot system (PO:0009006).

synonyms.label: savia del floema del sistema del epiblasto (Spanish, exact)
シュート組織師管液 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025567.label: root system phloem sap
PO:0025567.definition: A phloem sap (PO:0025540) that is located in the root system (PO:0025025).

synonyms.label: savia del floema del sistema de la raiz (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025568.label: root system xylem sap
PO:0025568.definition: A xylem sap (PO:0025539) that is located in the root system (PO:0025025).

synonyms.label: savia del xilema del sistema de la raiz (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025569.label: free petal
PO:0025569.definition: A petal (PO:0009032) that is part of a perianth (PO:0009058) that contains fused sepals (PO:0025584) and/or fused petals (PO:0025583), but is separate from the other sepals (PO:0009031) and petals (PO:0009032).

PO:0025570.label: vascular leaf development stage
PO:0025570.definition: A leaf development stage (PO:0001050) that occurs during the interval between the onset of the vascular leaf initiation stage (PO:0001051) and the termination of the vascular leaf senescent stage (PO:0001054).

PO:0025571.label: multi-tissue plant structure development stage
PO:0025571.definition: A plant structure development stage (PO:0009012) that has as primary participant a multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025496).

PO:0025572.label: vascular leaf primordium polarity determination stage
PO:0025572.definition: A vascular leaf initiation stage (PO:0001051) during which the vascular leaf primordium (PO:0004725) develops an adaxial side (PO:0004726) and an abaxial side (PO:0004725).
relationships: preceded_by PO:0001019 ! vascular leaf primordium formation stage

PO:0025573.label: non-vascular leaf development stage
PO:0025573.definition: A leaf development stage (PO:0001050) that has as a primary participant a non-vascular leaf (PO:0025075).

PO:0025574.label: vascular leaf differentiation stage
PO:0025574.definition: A vascular leaf development stage (PO:0025570) that begins with the formation of procambium (PO:0025275) and protoderm (PO:0006210) and ends with the formation and differentiation of the leaf epidermis (PO:0006016) and leaf vascular system (PO:0000036) and all the specialized cells of the vascular leaf.
relationships: preceded_by PO:0001051 ! vascular leaf initiation stage

PO:0025575.label: protoxylem tracheary element
PO:0025575.definition: A primary xylem tracheary element (PO:0025444) with predominately annular or helical secondary wall thickening that are the first formed tracheary elements (PO:0000290) at a particular location.

synonyms.label: elemento de traqueida del protoxilema (Spanish, exact)
原生木部仮導管要素 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025576.label: metaxylem tracheary element
PO:0025576.definition: A primary xylem tracheary element (PO:0025444) that may have helical, scalariform, reticulate and/or pitted secondary wall thickening.

synonyms.label: elemento de traqueida del metaxilema (Spanish, exact)
後生木部仮導管要素 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025577.label: epicalyx bract
PO:0025577.definition: A flower bract (PO:0009034) that is part of the epicalyx (PO:0009063).

synonyms.label: がく状総苞 苞葉 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0025578.label: collective phyllome structure development stage
PO:0025578.definition: A collective plant organ stucture development stage (PO:0025338) that has as primary participant collective phyllome structure (PO:0025023).

synonyms.label: estado de desarrollo de la estructura colectiva del filoma (Spanish, exact)

PO:0025579.label: phyllome development stage
PO:0025579.definition: A plant organ development stage (PO:0025339) that has a primary participant a phyllome (PO:0025023).

synonyms.label: estado de desarrollo del filoma (Spanish, exact)

relationships: part_of PO:0025527 ! shoot system development stage

PO:0025580.label: fused perianth
PO:0025580.definition: A perianth (PO:0009058) in which one or more of the petals (PO:0009032), sepals (PO:0009031), and/or tepals (PO:0009033) are fused (PATO:0000642).

PO:0025581.label: fused corolla
PO:0025581.definition: A corolla (PO:0009059) that is composed of fused petals (PO:0025583).

PO:0025582.label: fused calyx
PO:0025582.definition: A calyx (PO:0009060) that is composed of fused sepals (PO:0025584).

PO:0025583.label: fused petal
PO:0025583.definition: A petal (PO:0009032) that is part of a fused corolla (PO:0025581) or a fused perianth (PO:0025580).

PO:0025584.label: fused sepal
PO:0025584.definition: A sepal (PO:0009031) that is part of the fused calyx (PO:0025582) or a fused perianth (PO:0025580).

PO:0025585.label: floral organ formation stage
PO:0025585.definition: A flower development stage (PO:0007615) that occurs in an individual flower (PO:000904) during the interval between the onset of a floral organ meristem development stage (PO:0007601) and the onset of a flowering stage (PO:0007616).
relationships: preceded_by PO:0025588 ! flower meristem transition stage

PO:0025586.label: phyllome founder cell
PO:0025586.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that is part of the phyllome anlagen (PO:0025430).

PO:0025587.label: free sepal
PO:0025587.definition: A sepal (PO:0009031) that is part of a perianth (PO:0009058) that contains fused sepals (PO:0025584) and/or fused petals (PO:0025583), but is separate from the other sepals (PO:0009031) and petals (PO:0009032).

PO:0025588.label: flower meristem transition stage
PO:0025588.definition: A flower development stage (PO:0007615) which begins with the transition of a portion of meristem tissue (PO:0009013) to a flower meristem (PO:0000229) and ends with the onset of the floral organ formation stage (PO:0025585).

PO:0025589.label: leaf lamina tip
PO:0025589.definition: A leaf tip (PO:0025142) that is the distal portion of the leaf lamina (PO:0020039).

PO:0025590.label: receptacle pith
PO:0025590.definition: A portion of pith (PO:0006109) that is part of a receptacle (PO:0009064).

PO:0025591.label: receptacle cortex
PO:0025591.definition: A portion of cortex (PO:0005708) that is part of a receptacle (PO:0009064).

PO:0025592.label: vascular leaf founder cell
PO:0025592.definition: A phyllome founder cell (PO:0025586) that is part of a vascular leaf anlagen (PO:0025431).

PO:0025593.label: shoot-borne internode root
PO:0025593.definition: A shoot-borne root (PO:0000042) that arises from a shoot axis internode (PO:0005005).

PO:0025594.label: ground meristem
PO:0025594.definition: A portion of meristem tissue (PO:0009013) that gives rise to a portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059).

PO:0025595.label: shoot system ground meristem
PO:0025595.definition: A ground meristem (PO:0025594) that gives rise to a portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) in the shoot system (PO:0009006).

PO:0025596.label: root system ground meristem
PO:0025596.definition: A ground meristem (PO:0025594) that gives rise to a portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) in the root system (PO:0025025).

PO:0025597.label: ear infructescence
PO:0025597.definition: An infructescence (PO:0006342) in Zea species that bears kernels (i.e. caryopsis fruit; PO:0030104) on a compact ear infructescence axis (PO:0025623) and develops from the ear inflorescence (PO:0020136).

PO:0025598.label: pistillate inflorescence
PO:0025598.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) that includes as part only pistillate flowers (PO:0025599).

PO:0025599.label: pistillate flower
PO:0025599.definition: A flower (PO:0009046) that includes as part a single carpel (PO:0009030) or a gynoecium (PO:0009062), but the androecium (PO:0009061) is absent or has aborted during development.

PO:0025600.label: staminate flower
PO:0025600.definition: A flower (PO:0009046) that includes as part an androecium (PO:0009061), and the gynoecium (PO:0009062) is absent or has aborted during development.

PO:0025601.label: staminate inflorescence
PO:0025601.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) that includes as part only staminate flowers (PO:0025600).

PO:0025602.label: microgametophyte development stage
PO:0025602.definition: A gametophyte development stage (PO:0028003) during which a microgametophyte (PO:0025280) develops.

PO:0025603.label: plant resin
PO:0025603.definition: A portion of plant substance (PO:0025161) that consists of a complex mixture of organic aromatic compounds such as mono-, sesqui-, and diterpenoids.

PO:0025604.label: resin cell
PO:0025604.definition: A plant epidermal cell (PO:0004013) that secretes plant resin (PO:0025603), and may line resin canals (PO:0005665) and/or be associated with resin blisters (or cysts).

PO:0025605.label: fruit pedicel abscission zone
PO:0025605.definition: An abscission zone (PO:0000146) that forms as a swelling or joint on a fruit pedicel (PO:0030114).
relationships: develops_from PO:0025608 ! flower pedicel abscission zone

PO:0025606.label: native plant cell
PO:0025606.definition: A plant cell (PO:0009002) that is either part of a multicellular whole plant (PO:0000003) 'in vivo' or a unicellular organism 'in natura' (i.e. part of a natural environment).

PO:0025607.label: vegetative shoot system
PO:0025607.definition: A shoot system (PO:0009006) that has as parts only vegetative tissues and organs.

PO:0025608.label: flower pedicel abscission zone
PO:0025608.definition: An abscission zone (PO:0000146) that forms as a swelling or joint on a flower pedicel (PO:0030113).

PO:0025609.label: shoot axis tegument layer
PO:0025609.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that forms a tough, protective outer layer on a shoot axis and includes as parts a shoot axis hypodermis (PO:0005057) and a shoot axis epidermis (PO:0000112).

PO:0025610.label: stem hypodermis
PO:0025610.definition: A portion of hypodermis (PO:0005051) that is part of a stem cortex (PO:0025612).

PO:0025611.label: stem tegument layer
PO:0025611.definition: A portion of shoot axis tegument layer (PO:0025609) that a tough, protective outer layer on a stem (PO:0009047) and includes as parts a stem hypodermis (PO:0025610) and a stem epidermis (PO:0025178).

PO:0025612.label: stem cortex
PO:0025612.definition: A portion of shoot axis cortex (PO:0000223) that is part of a stem (PO:0009047).

PO:0025613.label: spine petiole
PO:0025613.definition: A petiole (PO:0020038) that is sclerified and persistent.

PO:0025614.label: gemma
PO:0025614.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) which is a small ball of cells born on a thallus (PO:0030027) and is involved in asexual reproduction.

PO:0025615.label: rosette
PO:0025615.definition: A collective leaf structure (PO:0025022) consisting of a group of rosette leaves (PO:0000014), generally borne at the base of the plant, that are separated by very short stem internodes (PO:0020142).

PO:0025616.label: lemma apiculus
PO:0025616.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) which is a short, abrupt, flexible point at the apex of the lemma (PO:0009037).

PO:0025617.label: carpel abaxial epidermis
PO:0025617.definition: A portion of carpel epidermis (PO:0025096) that covers the abaxial surface of a carpel (PO:0009030).

PO:0025618.label: carpel adaxial epidermis
PO:0025618.definition: A portion of carpel epidermis (PO:0025096) that covers the adaxial surface of a carpel (PO:0009030).

PO:0025619.label: leaf sheath margin
PO:0025619.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the edge of a laminar portion of a leaf sheath (PO:0020104) and the area immediately internally adjacent to it.

PO:0025620.label: metaxylem vessel
PO:0025620.definition: A primary xylem vessel (PO:0025450) which is part of the metaxylem (PO:0000372).

PO:0025621.label: metaxylem tracheid
PO:0025621.definition: A primary xylem tracheid (PO:0025446) that is part of the metaxylem (PO:0000372).

PO:0025622.label: metaxylem vessel member
PO:0025622.definition: A primary xylem vessel member (PO:0025448) that is part of the metaxylem (PO:0000372).

PO:0025623.label: ear infructescence axis
PO:0025623.definition: A first order infructescence axis (PO:0025244) in an ear infructescence (PO:0025597) that bears kernels (i.e. caryopsis fruit; PO:0030104).

PO:0025624.label: endodermis cell
PO:0025624.definition: A ground tissue cell (PO:0025030) that is part of a portion of endodermis (PO:0000252).

PO:0025625.label: cortex-endodermis initial cell
PO:0025625.definition: An initial cell (PO:0004011) that produces cortex (PO:0005708) and endodermis (PO:0000252).

PO:0025626.label: plant gall
PO:0025626.definition: A multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025496) that develops in response to a biotic stress (PSO:0000011).

PO:0025627.label: phloem parenchyma cell
PO:0025627.definition: A parenchyma cell (PO:0000074) that is associated with a sieve tube element (PO:0000289) and stores photosynthate.

PO:0025628.label: aggregate fruit
PO:0025628.definition: A fruit (PO:0009001) that develops from the merger of several plant ovaries (PO:0009072) that were separated in a single flower (PO:0009046).

PO:0028001.label: OBSOLETE plant life cycle phase
PO:0028001.definition: OBSOLETE. A plant growth and development phase that begins with either meiosis or fertilization.

synonyms.label: fase del ciclo de vida de la plant (Spanish, exact)

PO:0028002.label: sporophyte development stage
PO:0028002.definition: A whole plant development stage (PO:0007033) that has as primary participant a whole plant (PO:0000003) during the interval between fertilization (or apogamy) and death.
relationships: part_of PO:0025337 ! life of whole plant stage

PO:0028003.label: gametophyte development stage
PO:0028003.definition: A whole plant development stage (PO:0007033) that has as primary participant a whole plant (PO:0000003) during the interval between meiosis or apospory and the time that the whole plant ceases to exist.
relationships: part_of PO:0025337 ! life of whole plant stage

PO:0028004.label: branch apex
PO:0028004.definition: A shoot axis apex (PO:0000037) that is part of a branch (PO:0025073).

PO:0028005.label: gametophyte coma
PO:0028005.definition: A collective plant organ structure (PO:0025007) which is a cluster of gametophore branches (PO:0030021) or non-vascular leaves (PO:0025075) at the top of the gametophore axis (PO:0030020), forming a tuft.

PO:0030001.label: chloronema cell
PO:0030001.definition: A chlorenchyma cell that is part of a chloronema and has cross walls of adjacent cells that are perpendicular to the protonema axis.

PO:0030002.label: caulonema cell
PO:0030002.definition: A chlorenchyma cell that is part of a caulonema and has cross walls of adjacent cells that are oblique to the protonema axis.

PO:0030003.label: protonema
PO:0030003.definition: A portion of chlorenchyma tissue that develops directly from a spore and grows by division of an apical cell to form filaments that are one cell wide and dichotomously branching.

PO:0030004.label: chloronema
PO:0030004.definition: A portion of protonema tissue that consists of only chloronema cells.

PO:0030005.label: caulonema
PO:0030005.definition: A portion of protonema tissue that consists of only caulonema cells.

PO:0030006.label: protonema whole plant development stage
PO:0030006.definition: A gametophyte development stage during which a gametophyte undergoes filamentous growth and that succeeds spore germination and precedes a thalloid development stage (planar growth) or gametophore development stage.

synonyms.label: 原糸体を形成する植物発生段階 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030007.label: meristematic apical cell
PO:0030007.definition: A single meristematic cell (PO:0004010) at the tip of a plant structure where apical growth occurs.

synonyms.label: 分裂組織の頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030008.label: root meristematic apical cell
PO:0030008.definition: A sporophyte meristematic apical cell that is part of a root tip.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula apical de la ra&#237z (Spanish, exact)
根分裂組織の頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030009.label: shoot meristematic apical cell
PO:0030009.definition: A meristematic apical cell that is part of a shoot system.

synonyms.label: シュート分裂組織の頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030010.label: shoot axis meristematic apical cell
PO:0030010.definition: A shoot meristematic apical cell that is part of a shoot apex.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula apical del eje del epiblasto (Spanish, exact)
シュート軸分裂組織の頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030011.label: leaf meristematic apical cell
PO:0030011.definition: A shoot meristematic apical cell that is part of a leaf apex.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula apical de la hoja (Spanish, exact)
葉分裂組織の頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030012.label: vascular leaf meristematic apical cell
PO:0030012.definition: A leaf meristematic apical cell that is part of the leaf apex of a vascular leaf.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula apical de la hoja vascular (Spanish, exact)
維管束を持つ葉の分裂組織の頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030013.label: non-vascular leaf meristematic apical cell
PO:0030013.definition: A leaf meristematic apical cell (PO:0030011) that is part of a leaf apex of a non-vascular leaf.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula apical de la hoja no vascular (Spanish, exact)
維管束を持たない葉の分裂組織の頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

relationships: develops_from PO:0030087 ! non-vascular leaf initial cell

PO:0030014.label: gametophyte meristematic apical cell
PO:0030014.definition: An apical cell that is part of a whole plant in the gametophytic phase.

synonyms.label: 配偶体分裂組織の頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030015.label: sporophyte meristematic apical cell
PO:0030015.definition: A meristematic apical cell that is part of a whole plant in the sporophytic phase.

synonyms.label: 胞子体分裂組織の頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030016.label: seta meristematic apical cell
PO:0030016.definition: A shoot axis meristematic apical cell at the tip of a seta.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula apical de la seta (Spanish, exact)
柄分裂組織の頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030017.label: spore capsule mouth
PO:0030017.definition: A plant anatomical space that is the opening on the apical end of a spore capsule.

synonyms.label: boca de la c&#225psula productora de esporas (Spanish, exact)

PO:0030018.label: gametophore
PO:0030018.definition: A shoot system (PO:0009006) that consists of the shoot axes (PO:0025029) and non-vascular leaves (PO:0025075) of a plant in the gametophyte development stage (PO:0028003) .

synonyms.label: 茎葉体, 蘚苔類の配偶体 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030019.label: gametophore meristematic apical cell
PO:0030019.definition: A shoot meristematic apical cell that is part of a gametophore.

synonyms.label: 茎葉体分裂組織の頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030020.label: gametophore axis
PO:0030020.definition: A shoot axis (PO:0025029) that is part of a gametophore (PO:0030018).

PO:0030021.label: gametophore branch
PO:0030021.definition: A branch that is part of a gametophore.

PO:0030022.label: gametophore stem
PO:0030022.definition: A stem that is part of a gametophore.

PO:0030023.label: gametophore axis meristematic apical cell
PO:0030023.definition: A shoot axis meristematic apical cell at the tip of a gametophore axis.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula apical del eje del gamet&#243foro (Spanish, exact)
茎葉体軸分裂組織の頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030024.label: vascular shoot axis meristematic apical cell
PO:0030024.definition: A shoot axis meristematic apical cell at the tip of a shoot apex in a shoot system that has as part vascular tissue.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula apical del eje del epiblasto vascualr (Spanish, exact)
維管束を持つシュート軸分裂組織の頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030025.label: thallus meristematic apical cell
PO:0030025.definition: A gametophyte apical cell that is part of a thallus.

synonyms.label: 葉状体分裂組織の頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030026.label: gametophore bud
PO:0030026.definition: A vegetative bud that develops into a gametophore.
relationships: develops_from PO:0030083 ! gametophore bud initial cell

PO:0030027.label: thallus
PO:0030027.definition: A whole plant in the gametophytic phase that has a flat growth form and no distinct organs.

PO:0030028.label: perigonial bract
PO:0030028.definition: A bract (PO:0009055) that subtends an antheridium (PO:0025125).

PO:0030029.label: sporophyte foot
PO:0030029.definition: A plant organ that is the base of a whole plant in the sporophytic phase and attaches it to the gametophore.

PO:0030030.label: perichaetal bract
PO:0030030.definition: A bract (PO:0009055) that subtends an archegonium (PO:0025126).

PO:0030031.label: gametophyte perianth
PO:0030031.definition: A collective phyllome structure that consists of two or more of the most distal perichaetal bracts on a gametophore axis and surround a capsule.

PO:0030032.label: seta
PO:0030032.definition: A stalk (PO:0025066) that supports a spore capsule, the sporangium (PO:0025094).

synonyms.label: とげ、剛毛、コケの柄 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030033.label: antheridiophore
PO:0030033.definition: A stalk (PO:0025066) that supports an antheridium head (PO:0030075).

PO:0030034.label: archegoniophore
PO:0030034.definition: A stalk (PO:0025066) that supports an archegonium head (PO:0030034).

PO:0030035.label: antheridium stalk
PO:0030035.definition: A stalk (PO:0025066) that is the basal part of an antheridium (PO:0025125).

PO:0030036.label: archegonium stalk
PO:0030036.definition: A stalk (PO:0025066) that the basal part of an archegonium (PO:0025126).

PO:0030037.label: spore capsule calyptra
PO:0030037.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that develops from an archegonium (PO:0025126) and is a cap or hood enclosing the sporangium (syn: spore capsule; PO:0025094).

synonyms.label: caliptra de la c&#225psula productora de esporas (Spanish, exact)

PO:0030038.label: venter
PO:0030038.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the enlarged basal part of an archegonium (PO:0025126) and has an archegonium egg cell (PO:0025122) located in it.

PO:0030039.label: archegonium neck
PO:0030039.definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the elongated, apical part of an archegonium (PO:0025126).

PO:0030040.label: sporangium base
PO:0030040.definition: A cardinal organ part that is the basal (distal) part of a sporangium.

PO:0030041.label: sporangium theca
PO:0030041.definition: A cardinal organ part that is the main body of a sporangium and has spores located in it.

PO:0030042.label: peristome
PO:0030042.definition: A single or double circle of peristome teeth inside a sporangium mouth.

PO:0030043.label: peristome tooth
PO:0030043.definition: A cardinal organ part that is a single lobe of a peristome.

synonyms.label: 蒴歯歯片、縁歯歯片,　歯環を構成する個々の歯(Japanese, exact)

PO:0030044.label: spore capsule operculum
PO:0030044.definition: A cardinal organ part that is the apical part of a spore capsule that separates from the rest of the capsule during dehiscence.

synonyms.label: op&#233rculo de la c&#225psula productora de esporas (Spanish, exact)

PO:0030045.label: stereid
PO:0030045.definition: A ground tissue cell with thickened cell walls.

PO:0030046.label: protonema meristematic apical cell
PO:0030046.definition: A gametophyte meristematic apical cell that is part of a protonema.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula meristem&#225tica apical del protonema (Spanish, exact)
原糸体、糸状体の分裂組織の頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030047.label: hydrome
PO:0030047.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that has as parts hydroid (PO:0025032) cells and cells of no other types.

PO:0030048.label: leptome
PO:0030048.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that has as parts leptoid (PO:0025033) cells and cells of no other types.

PO:0030049.label: sporangium wall endothecium
PO:0030049.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) that is the sub-epidermal layer of a sporangium wall (PO:0025306).

synonyms.label: endotecio de la pared del esporangio (Spanish, exact)

PO:0030050.label: stereome
PO:0030050.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059)  that has as parts stereid cells (PO:0030045) and no other cell types.

PO:0030051.label: central strand
PO:0030051.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is an axial strand in the center of a gametophore axis (PO:0030020) or seta (PO:0030032) and has as part a hydrome (PO:0030047) or a leptome (PO:0030048).

PO:0030052.label: antheridium jacket layer cell
PO:0030052.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that is part of an antheridium jacket layer (PO:0030053).

synonyms.label: capa c&#233lular de la cubierta del anteridio (Spanish, exact)
造精器被覆層細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030053.label: antheridium jacket layer
PO:0030053.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is a single layer of cells on the outside of an antheridium (PO:0025125).

synonyms.label: capa de la cubierta del anteridio (Spanish, exact)

PO:0030054.label: epiphragm
PO:0030054.definition: A portion of parenchyma tissue that forms a circular membrane extending from a spore capsule columella and attached to the ends of the peristome teeth that covers a spore capsule mouth.

PO:0030055.label: pseudopodium
PO:0030055.definition: A gametophore axis that is a leafless extension of a gametophore stem or branch on which a sporophyte is borne.

PO:0030056.label: archesporial cell
PO:0030056.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that divides to gives rise to a sporocyte (PO:0006204) and is part of a sporangium (PO:0025094).

PO:0030057.label: alar cell
PO:0030057.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) located at the base of a non-vascular leaf (PO:0025075) adjacent to where the leaf attaches to the stem (PO:0009047).

PO:0030058.label: brachycyte
PO:0030058.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that develops from a cell in a protonema (PO:0030003) and has a thick cell wall.

synonyms.label: 原糸体細胞の細胞壁を厚くした細胞、耐性細胞(brood cell?) (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030059.label: tmema cell
PO:0030059.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) at the base of a gemma (PO:0025614) or adjacent to a brachycyte (PO:0030058) that breaks down to allow abscission of the gemma or brachycyte.

PO:0030060.label: gametophore axillary hair
PO:0030060.definition: An axillary hair that grows in a leaf axil of a non-vascular leaf.

PO:0030061.label: tmema
PO:0030061.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that has as parts tmema cells (PO:0030059).

PO:0030062.label: gametophore axillary hair terminal cell
PO:0030062.definition: An axillary hair terminal cell that is the long terminal cell of a gametophore axillary hair.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula terminal de pelo axilar del gamet&#243foro (Spanish, exact)
茎葉体腋毛終端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030063.label: gametophore axillary hair base
PO:0030063.definition: A axillary hair base that is the basal part of a gametophore axillary hair, below the gametophore axillary hair terminal cell.

synonyms.label: base del pelo axilar del gamet&#243foro (Spanish, exact)

PO:0030064.label: gametophore axillary hair basal cell
PO:0030064.definition: An axillary hair basal cell that is part of a gametophore axillary hair base.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula basal del pelo axilar del gamet&#243foro (Spanish, exact)
茎葉体腋毛基底細胞 (Japanese, exact)

relationships: part_of PO:0030063 ! gametophore axillary hair base

PO:0030065.label: archegonium neck canal cell
PO:0030065.definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) that is one of the axial row of cells in an immature archegonium neck (PO:0030039).

synonyms.label: c&#233lula del canal del cuello del arquegonio (Spanish, exact)

PO:0030066.label: archegonium neck canal
PO:0030066.definition: A canal (PO:0025132) in the center of an archegonium neck (PO:0030039).

synonyms.label: canal del cuello del arquegonio (Spanish, exact)

PO:0030067.label: protonema side branch initial cell
PO:0030067.definition: An protonema sub-apical initial that gives rise to a branch of a protonema.

synonyms.label: rama lateral inicial del protonema (Spanish, exact)
原糸体側枝始原細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030068.label: epidermal rhizoid initial cell
PO:0030068.definition: A plant epidermal initial cell (PO:0000349) that gives rise to an epidermal rhizoid (PO:0030071).

synonyms.label: 表皮仮根始原細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030069.label: paraphyllium
PO:0030069.definition: A portion of plant epidermis (PO:0005679) tissue that is an outgrowth from the epidermis between the leaves of a gametophore axis (PO:0030020).

PO:0030070.label: paraphysis
PO:0030070.definition: A slender, usually uniseriate multicellular trichome (PO:0025162) that grows intermixed with the gametangia.

PO:0030071.label: epidermal rhizoid
PO:0030071.definition: A rhizoid (PO:0030078) that develops from an epidermal rhizoid initial cell (PO:0030068).
relationships: develops_from PO:0030068 ! epidermal rhizoid initial cell

PO:0030072.label: costa
PO:0030072.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is a single or double strand in the center of a non-vascular leaf (PO:0025075) and has as part hydrome (PO:0030047) or leptome (PO:0030048).

PO:0030073.label: exothecium
PO:0030073.definition: A portion of plant epidermis (PO:0005679) that is the outermost layer of a sporangium wall (PO:0025306).

PO:0030074.label: archesporium
PO:0030074.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the internal part of a sporangium (PO:0025094), bounded by the sporangium wall (PO:0025306), and has as parts archesporial cells (PO:0030056).

PO:0030075.label: antheridium head
PO:0030075.definition: A disk-shaped cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is the apical portion of an antheridiophore (PO:0030033) and bears antheridia (PO:0025125).

PO:0030076.label: archegonium head
PO:0030076.definition: An umbrella-shaped cardinal organ part that is the apical portion of an archegoniophore and bears archegonia.

PO:0030077.label: protonemal side branch rhizoid initial cell
PO:0030077.definition: A protonema side branch initial that gives rise to a protonemal rhizoid.

synonyms.label: rama lateral inicial del rizoide proton&#233mico (Spanish, exact)
原糸体側枝仮根始原細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030078.label: rhizoid
PO:0030078.definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is a uniseriate filament with positive geotropism that grows from an epidermis (PO:0005679) or protonema (PO:0030003).

PO:0030079.label: protonemal rhizoid
PO:0030079.definition: A rhizoid that is part of a protonema and develops from a protonemal side branch rhizoid initial.
relationships: develops_from PO:0030077 ! protonemal side branch rhizoid initial cell

PO:0030080.label: rhizoid meristematic apical cell
PO:0030080.definition: A gametophyte meristematic apical cell that is part of a rhizoid.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula apical meristem&#225tica del rizoide (Spanish, exact)
仮根分裂頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030081.label: caulonema meristematic apical cell
PO:0030081.definition: A protonema meristematic apical cell that is part of a caulonema.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula apical meristem&#225tica del caulonema (Spanish, exact)
カウロネマ分裂頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030082.label: chloronema meristematic apical cell
PO:0030082.definition: A protonema meristematic apical cell that is part of a chloronema.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula apical meristem&#225tica del cloronema (Spanish, exact)
クロロネマ分裂頂端細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030083.label: gametophore bud initial cell
PO:0030083.definition: A protonema sub-apical initial hat gives rise to a gametophore bud.

synonyms.label: 茎葉体芽始原細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030084.label: amphithecium
PO:0030084.definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) that is the outer layer or layers of a sporangium (PO:0025094) early in sporangium development (GO:0043582).

synonyms.label: アンフィテシウム細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030085.label: protosporangium endothecium
PO:0030085.definition: A portion of ground tissue (PO:0025059) that is the tissue internal to an amphithecium early in sporangium development.

PO:0030086.label: protonema sub-apical initial cell
PO:0030086.definition: An initial cell that is produced by longitudinal division of a sub-apical cell of a protonema.

synonyms.label: c&#233lula subapical inicial del protonema (Spanish, exact)
原糸体次頂端始原細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030087.label: non-vascular leaf initial cell
PO:0030087.definition: An initial cell (PO:0004011) that is part of a gametophore (PO:0030018) and gives rise to a non-vascular leaf (PO:0025075).

synonyms.label: c&#233lula inicial de la hoja no vascular (Spanish, exact)
非維管束葉の始原細胞 (Japanese, exact)

PO:0030088.label: lateral root spine
PO:0030088.definition: A lateral root (PO:0020121) that is sclerified and pointed.

PO:0030089.label: shoot-borne root spine
PO:0030089.definition: A shoot-borne root (PO:0000042) that is sclerified and pointed.

PO:0030090.label: root periderm scar
PO:0030090.definition: A portion of root periderm (PO:0005047) formed in response to a disruption of the root epidermis (PO:0006036).

PO:0030091.label: capsule fruit
PO:0030091.definition: A fruit (PO:0009001) which develops from a gynoecium (PO:0009062) and at maturity comprises a dry exocarp (PO:0009085), dry mesocarp (PO:0009087), and dry endocarp (PO:0009086) that usually dehisce.

PO:0030092.label: loculicidal capsule fruit
PO:0030092.definition: A capsule fruit (PO:0030091) which at maturity dehisces through fruit locules (PO:0025270).

PO:0030093.label: septicidal capsule fruit
PO:0030093.definition: A capsule fruit (PO:0030091) which dehisces through a fruit septa (PO:0025268).

PO:0030094.label: coccarium capsule fruit
PO:0030094.definition: A capsule fruit (PO:0030091) which at maturity dehisces through both the fruit septa (PO:0025268) and the fruit locules (PO:0025270).

PO:0030095.label: poricidal capsule fruit
PO:0030095.definition: A capsule fruit (PO:0030091) which at maturity dehisces through pores on a pericarp (PO:0009084).

PO:0030096.label: circumscissile capsule fruit
PO:0030096.definition: A capsule fruit (PO:0030091) which at maturity dehisces through the release of a fruit operculum (PO:0025298).

PO:0030097.label: utricle capsule fruit
PO:0030097.definition: A circumscissile capsule fruit (PO:0030096) which at maturity contains one seed (PO:0009010) that is not attached to a pericarp (PO:0009084).

PO:0030098.label: schizocarp fruit
PO:0030098.definition: A fruit (PO:0009001) which develops from a gynoecium (PO:0009062) and at maturity comprises a dry exocarp (PO:0009085), dry mesocarp (PO:0009087), and dry endocarp (PO:0009086) that separate into mericarps (PO:0020075).

PO:0030099.label: samara fruit
PO:0030099.definition: A fruit (PO:0009001) which develops from a carpel (PO:0009030) and at maturity comprises a dry exocarp (PO:0009085), dry mesocarp (PO:0009087), and dry endocarp (PO:0009086) that are elongated into a wing-like structure.

PO:0030100.label: legume fruit
PO:0030100.definition: A fruit (PO:0009001) which develops from a carpel (PO:0009030) and at maturity comprises a dry exocarp (PO:0009085), dry mesocarp (PO:0009087), and dry endocarp (PO:0009086) that dehisce along two fruit valves (PO:0000033).

PO:0030101.label: loment fruit
PO:0030101.definition: A legume fruit (PO:0030100) which at maturity separates into indehiscent, one-seeded segments.

PO:0030102.label: nut fruit
PO:0030102.definition: A fruit (PO:0009001) which develops from a gynoecium (PO:0009062) and at maturity comprises a dry exocarp (PO:0009085), dry mesocarp (PO:0009087), and dry endocarp (PO:0009086) that are not fused to a seed coat (PO:0009088).

PO:0030103.label: drupe fruit
PO:0030103.definition: A fruit (PO:0009001) which develops from a carpel (PO:0009030) and at maturity comprises a fleshy exocarp (PO:0009085), fleshy mesocarp (PO:0009087), and a stony endocarp (PO:0009086).

PO:0030104.label: caryopsis fruit
PO:0030104.definition: A fruit (PO:0009001) which develops from a gynoecium (PO:0009062) and at maturity comprises a dry exocarp (PO:0009085), dry mesocarp (PO:0009087), and dry endocarp (PO:0009086) that are fused to a seed coat (PO:0009088).

PO:0030105.label: follicle fruit
PO:0030105.definition: A fruit (PO:0009001) which develops from a carpel (PO:0009030) and at maturity comprises a dry exocarp (PO:0009085), dry mesocarp (PO:0009087), and dry endocarp (PO:0009086) that dehisce along a single fruit valve (PO:0000033).

PO:0030106.label: silique fruit
PO:0030106.definition: A fruit (PO:0009001) which develops from a gynoecium (PO:0009062) and at maturity comprises a dry exocarp (PO:0009085), dry mesocarp (PO:0009087), and dry endocarp (PO:0009086), that dehisce along two fruit valves (PO:0000033) and separate from a persistent fruit replum (PO:0025267).

PO:0030107.label: achene fruit
PO:0030107.definition: A fruit (PO:0009001) which develops from a carpel (PO:0009030) or gyneocium (PO:0009062) and at maturity comprises a dry exocarp (PO:0009085), a dry mesocarp (PO:0009087), and a dry endocarp (PO:0009086) that are connected to a seed coat (PO:0009088) by a funicle (PO:0020006).

PO:0030108.label: berry fruit
PO:0030108.definition: A fruit (PO:0009001) which at maturity comprises a fleshy endocarp (PO:0009086), fleshy mesocarp (PO:0009087), and fleshy exocarp (PO:0009085).

PO:0030109.label: hesperidium fruit
PO:0030109.definition: A berry fruit (PO:0030108) which develops from a superior gynoecium (PO:0009062) and at maturity comprises a thickened exocarp (PO:0009085), thickened mesocarp (PO:0009087), and endocarp (PO:0009086), and has as parts juice sacs (PO:0006013) on a carpel adaxial epidermis (PO:0025618).

PO:0030110.label: pome fruit
PO:0030110.definition: A berry fruit (PO:0030108) which develops from an inferior gynoecium (PO:0009062) and at maturity comprises a fleshy exocarp (PO:0009085), fleshy mesocarp (PO:0009087), and hardened endocarp (PO:0009086) and has as a part a fleshy hypanthium (PO:0009065) which is indistinct from the exocarp (PO:0009085).

PO:0030111.label: pepo fruit
PO:0030111.definition: A berry fruit (PO:0030108) which develops from an inferior carpel (PO:0009030) and at maturity comprises a fleshy exocarp (PO:0009085), fleshy mesocarp (PO:0009087), and fleshy endocarp (PO:0009086), and has as a part a hard receptacle (PO:0009064) which surrounds, and is indistinct from, the exocarp (PO:0009085).

PO:0030112.label: pedicel
PO:0030112.definition: A shoot axis (PO:0025029) that bears only a flower (PO:0009046) or a fruit (PO:0009001).

PO:0030113.label: flower pedicel
PO:0030113.definition: A pedicel (PO:0030112) that bears a flower (PO:0009046).

PO:0030114.label: fruit pedicel
PO:0030114.definition: A pedicel (PO:0030112) that bears a fruit (PO:0009001).

PO:0030115.label: raceme inflorescence
PO:0030115.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with a monopodial growth habit, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616), is composed of pedicellate flowers (PO:0009046) on an indeterminate, first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104).

PO:0030116.label: compound raceme inflorescence
PO:0030116.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with a monopodial growth habit, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616), is composed of an indeterminate, first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104) and pedicellate flowers (PO:0009046) on indeterminate higher order inflorescence axes (PO:0009081).

PO:0030117.label: spike inflorescence
PO:0030117.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with a monopodial growth habit, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616), is composed of sessile flowers (PO:0009046) on an indeterminate, first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104).

PO:0030118.label: compound spike inflorescence
PO:0030118.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049), with a monopodial growth habit, which at anthesis is composed of an indeterminate first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104) and sessile (PATO:0001436) flowers (PO:0009046), or spikelets (PO:0009051), on indeterminate higher order inflorescence axes (PO:0009081).

PO:0030119.label: catkin inflorescence
PO:0030119.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with a monopodial growth habit, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616) is composed of indeterminate, first order inflorescence axes (PO:0025104) and sessile, unisexual flowers (PO:0009046) that are each subtended by conspicuous inflorescence bracts (PO:0009054).

PO:0030120.label: spadix inflorescence
PO:0030120.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with a monopodial growth habit, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616), is composed of sessile flowers (PO:0009046) on a radially-enlarged, indeterminate, first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104), and a basal, enveloping inflorescence bract (PO:0009054).

PO:0030121.label: capitulum inflorescence
PO:0030121.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with a monopodial growth habit, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616) is composed of a radially-enlarged, determinate, first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104) with sessile flowers (PO:0009046).

PO:0030122.label: compound capitulum inflorescence
PO:0030122.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with a monopodial growth habit, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616) is composed of a radially-enlarged inflorescence axis (PO:0020122), and sessile flowers (PO:0009046) on determinate higher order inflorescence axes (PO:0009081) with basal involucral bracts (PO:0009045).

PO:0030123.label: panicle inflorescence
PO:0030123.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with a monopodial growth habit, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616) is composed of pedicellate flowers (PO:0009046) or spikelets (PO:0009051) on determinate inflorescence axes (PO:0020122).,

PO:0030124.label: corymb inflorescence
PO:0030124.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with both monopodial and sympodial growth habits, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616), is composed of a determinate, first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104), and determinate higher order inflorescence axes (PO:0020122) with pedicellate flowers (PO:0009046) that collectively form a convex plane of flowers.

PO:0030125.label: anthela inflorescence
PO:0030125.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with both monopodial and sympodial growth habits, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616), is composed of a determinate, first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104) and determinate, higher order inflorescence axes (PO:0020122) with pedicellate flowers (PO:0009046) that collectively form a concave plane of flowers.

PO:0030126.label: cyme inflorescence
PO:0030126.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with a monopodial growth habit, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616), is composed of a determinate, first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104) and pedicellate flowers (PO:0009046) on paired, determinate higher order inflorescence axes (PO:0009081).

PO:0030127.label: indeterminate thyrse inflorescence
PO:0030127.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) which at flowering stage (PO:0007616), is composed of an indeterminate, first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104) and dichasial second order inflorescences (PO:0025240) with pedicellate  flowers (PO:0009046), and determinate higher order inflorescence axes (PO:0009081).

PO:0030128.label: determinate thyrse inflorescence
PO:0030128.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) which at flowering stage (PO:0007616) is composed of a determinate, first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104) and dichasial second order inflorescences with pedicellate flowers (PO:0009046) and determinate, higher order inflorescence axes (PO:0009081).

PO:0030129.label: umbel inflorescence
PO:0030129.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with a monopodial growth habit, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616), is composed of pedicellate flowers (PO:0009046) on a first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104) with compressed inflorescence axis internodes (PO:0006326).

PO:0030130.label: compound umbel inflorescence
PO:0030130.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with a monopodial growth habit, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616), is composed of a first order inflorescence axis (PO:0025104) with compressed inflorescence axis internodes (PO:0006326), and pedicellate flowers (PO:0009046) on higher order inflorescence axes, with compressed inflorescence axis internodes (PO:0006326).

PO:0030131.label: rhipidium inflorescence
PO:0030131.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with a sympodial growth habit, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616), is composed of determinate inflorescence axes (PO:0020122) that bear pedicellate flowers (PO:0009046) in a single plane, with the latest-developing flowers on the highest order inflorescence axis, found at the center of the inflorescence.

PO:0030132.label: cincinnus inflorescence
PO:0030132.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with a sympodial growth habit, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616), is composed of determinate inflorescence axes (PO:0020122) with pedicellate flowers (PO:0009046), with the latest-developing flowers on the highest order inflorescence axis.

PO:0030133.label: compound cincinnus inflorescence
PO:0030133.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with sympodial and monopodial growth habits, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616), is composed of determinate inflorescence axes (PO:0020122) with pedicellate flowers (PO:0009046), with the latest-developing flowers on the highest order inflorescence axes of the second order inflorescences (PO:0025240).

PO:0030134.label: bostryx inflorescence
PO:0030134.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with a sympodial growth habit, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616), is composed of pedicellate flowers (PO:0009046) on determinate inflorescence axes (PO:0020122), each of which develop at a branch angle of approximately 90 degrees from each higher inflorescence axis (PO:0009081).

PO:0030135.label: drepanium inflorescence
PO:0030135.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with a sympodial growth habit, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616), is composed of pedicellate flowers (PO:0009046) on determinate inflorescence axes (PO:0020122), each of which develops at progressively more acute angles from each higher inflorescence axis (PO:0009081).

PO:0030136.label: compound drepanium inflorescence
PO:0030136.definition: An inflorescence (PO:0009049) with both sympodial and monopodial growth habits, which at flowering stage (PO:0007616) is composed of pedicellate flowers (PO:0009046) on determinate inflorescence axes (PO:0020122), each of which develops at progressively more acute angles from each higher inflorescence axis (PO:0009081).

UO:0000000.label: unit
UO:0000000.definition: A unit of measurement is a standardized quantity of a physical quality.

UO:0000001.label: length unit
UO:0000001.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the distance between two points.

UO:0000002.label: mass unit
UO:0000002.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the amount of matter/energy of a physical object.

UO:0000003.label: time unit
UO:0000003.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the dimension in which events occur in sequence.

UO:0000004.label: electric current unit
UO:0000004.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the flow of electric charge.

UO:0000005.label: temperature unit
UO:0000005.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the average kinetic energy of the particles in a sample of matter.

UO:0000006.label: substance unit
UO:0000006.definition: A unit which is a standardised quantity of an element or compound with uniform composition.

UO:0000007.label: luminous intensity unit
UO:0000007.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the wavelength-weighted power emitted by a light source in a particular direction.

UO:0000008.label: meter
UO:0000008.definition: A length unit which is equal to the length of the path traveled by light in vacuum during a time interval of 1/299 792 458 of a second.

UO:0000009.label: kilogram
UO:0000009.definition: A mass unit which is equal to the mass of the International Prototype Kilogram kept by the BIPM at Svres, France.

UO:0000010.label: second
UO:0000010.definition: A time unit which is equal to the duration of 9 192 631 770 periods of the radiation corresponding to the transition between the two hyperfine levels of the ground state of the caesium 133 atom.

UO:0000011.label: ampere
UO:0000011.definition: An electric current unit which is equal to the constant current which, if maintained in two straight parallel conductors of infinite length, of negligible circular cross-section, and placed 1 m apart in vacuum, would produce between these conductors a force equal to 2 x 10^[-7] newton per meter of length.

UO:0000012.label: kelvin
UO:0000012.definition: A thermodynamic temperature unit which is equal to the fraction 1/273.16 of the thermodynamic temperature of the triple point of water.

UO:0000013.label: mole
UO:0000013.definition: A substance unit which is equal to the amount of substance of a molecular system which contains as many elementary entities as there are atoms in 0.012 kilogram of carbon 12.

UO:0000014.label: candela
UO:0000014.definition: A luminous intensity unit which equal to the luminous intensity, in a given direction, of a source that emits monochromatic radiation of frequency 540 x 1012 hertz and that has a radiant intensity in that direction of 1/683 watt per steradian.

UO:0000015.label: centimeter
UO:0000015.definition: A length unit which is equal to one hundredth of a meter or 10^[-2] m.

UO:0000016.label: millimeter
UO:0000016.definition: A length unit which is equal to one thousandth of a meter or 10^[-3] m.

UO:0000017.label: micrometer
UO:0000017.definition: A length unit which is equal to one millionth of a meter or 10^[-6] m.

UO:0000018.label: nanometer
UO:0000018.definition: A length unit which is equal to one thousandth of one millionth of a meter or 10^[-9] m.

UO:0000019.label: angstrom
UO:0000019.definition: A length unit which is equal to 10 [-10] m.

UO:0000020.label: picometer
UO:0000020.definition: A length unit which is equal to 10^[-12] m.

UO:0000021.label: gram
UO:0000021.definition: A mass unit which is equal to one thousandth of a kilogram or 10^[-3] kg.

UO:0000022.label: milligram
UO:0000022.definition: A mass unit which is equal to one thousandth of a gram or 10^[-3] g.

UO:0000023.label: microgram
UO:0000023.definition: A mass unit which is equal to one millionth of a gram or 10^[-6] g.

UO:0000024.label: nanogram
UO:0000024.definition: A mass unit which is equal to one thousandth of one millionth of a gram or 10^[-9] g.

UO:0000025.label: picogram
UO:0000025.definition: A mass unit which is equal to 10^[-12] g.

UO:0000026.label: femtogram
UO:0000026.definition: A mass unit which is equal to 10^[-15] g.

UO:0000027.label: degree Celsius
UO:0000027.definition: A temperature unit which is equal to one kelvin degree. However, they have their zeros at different points. The centigrade scale has its zero at 273.15 K.

UO:0000028.label: millisecond
UO:0000028.definition: A time unit which is equal to one thousandth of a second or 10^[-3] s.

UO:0000029.label: microsecond
UO:0000029.definition: A time unit which is equal to one millionth of a second or 10^[-6] s.

UO:0000030.label: picosecond
UO:0000030.definition: A time unit which is equal to 10^[-12] s.

UO:0000031.label: minute
UO:0000031.definition: A time unit which is equal to 60 seconds.

UO:0000032.label: hour
UO:0000032.definition: A time unit which is equal to 3600 seconds or 60 minutes.

UO:0000033.label: day
UO:0000033.definition: A time unit which is equal to 24 hours.

UO:0000034.label: week
UO:0000034.definition: A time unit which is equal to 7 days.

UO:0000035.label: month
UO:0000035.definition: A time unit which is approximately equal to the length of time of one of cycle of the moon's phases which in science is taken to be equal to 30 days.

UO:0000036.label: year
UO:0000036.definition: A time unit which is equal to 12 months which in science is taken to be equal to 365.25 days.

UO:0000037.label: milliampere
UO:0000037.definition: An electric current unit current which is equal to one thousandth of an ampere or 10^[-3] A.

UO:0000038.label: microampere
UO:0000038.definition: An electric current unit current which is equal to one millionth of an ampere or 10^[-6] A.

UO:0000039.label: micromole
UO:0000039.definition: A substance unit equal to a millionth of a mol or 10^[-6] mol.

UO:0000040.label: millimole
UO:0000040.definition: A substance unit equal to a thousandth of a mol or 10^[-3] mol.

UO:0000041.label: nanomole
UO:0000041.definition: A substance unit equal to one thousandth of one millionth of a mole or 10^[-9] mol.

UO:0000042.label: picomole
UO:0000042.definition: A substance unit equal to 10^[-12] mol.

UO:0000043.label: femtomole
UO:0000043.definition: A substance unit equal to 10^[-15] mol.

UO:0000044.label: attomole
UO:0000044.definition: A substance unit equal to 10^[-18] mol.

UO:0000045.label: base unit
UO:0000045.definition: A unit which is one of a particular measure to which all measures of that type can be related.

UO:0000047.label: area unit
UO:0000047.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the amount of a 2-dimensional flat surface.

UO:0000048.label: acceleration unit
UO:0000048.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the rate of change of velocity in either speed or direction.

UO:0000049.label: angular velocity unit
UO:0000049.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the rate of angular movement about an axis; the angle rotated in a given time.

UO:0000050.label: angular acceleration unit
UO:0000050.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the rate of change of angular velocity.

UO:0000051.label: concentration unit
UO:0000051.definition: A unit which represents a standard measurement of how much of a given substance there is mixed with another substance.

UO:0000052.label: mass density unit
UO:0000052.definition: A density unit which is a standard measure of the mass of a substance in a given volume.

UO:0000053.label: luminance unit
UO:0000053.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the luminous intensity impinging on a given area.

UO:0000054.label: area density unit
UO:0000054.definition: A density unit which is a standard measure of the mass exerting an influence on a given area.

UO:0000055.label: molar mass unit
UO:0000055.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the mass of a homogeneous substance containing 6.02 x 1023 atoms or molecules.

UO:0000056.label: molar volume unit
UO:0000056.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the volume of a homogeneous substance containing 6.02 x 1023 atoms or molecules.

UO:0000057.label: momentum unit
UO:0000057.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the quantity of motion measured by the product of mass and velocity.

UO:0000058.label: rotational frequency unit
UO:0000058.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the number of rotations in a given time.

UO:0000059.label: specific volume unit
UO:0000059.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the volume of a given mass of substance (the reciprocal of density).

UO:0000060.label: speed/velocity unit
UO:0000060.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the rate of movement. Speed is measured in the same physical units of measurement as velocity, but does not contain the element of direction that velocity has. Speed is thus the magnitude component of velocity.

UO:0000061.label: unit of molarity
UO:0000061.definition: A concentration unit which is a standard measure of the number of moles of a given substance per liter of solution.

UO:0000062.label: molar
UO:0000062.definition: A unit of concentration which expresses a concentration of 1 mole of solute per liter of solution (mol/L).

UO:0000063.label: millimolar
UO:0000063.definition: A unit of molarity which is equal to one thousandth of a molar or 10^[-3] M.
