UO:0000064.label: micromolar
UO:0000064.definition: A unit of molarity which is equal to one millionth of a molar or 10^[-6] M.

UO:0000065.label: nanomolar
UO:0000065.definition: A unit of molarity which is equal to one thousandth of one millionth of a molar or 10^[-9] M.

UO:0000066.label: picomolar
UO:0000066.definition: A unit of molarity which is equal to 10^[-12] M.

UO:0000067.label: unit of molality
UO:0000067.definition: A concentration unit which is a standard measure of the number of moles of a given substance per kilogram of solvent.

UO:0000068.label: molal
UO:0000068.definition: A unit of concentration which expresses a concentration of a solution of 1 mole per kilogram of solvent (mol/kg).

UO:0000069.label: millimolal
UO:0000069.definition: A molality unit which is equal to one thousandth of a molal or 10^[-3] m.

UO:0000070.label: micromolal
UO:0000070.definition: A molality unit which is equal to one millionth of a molal or 10^[-6] m.

UO:0000071.label: nanomolal
UO:0000071.definition: A molality unit which is equal to one thousandth of one millionth of a molal or 10^[-9] m.

UO:0000072.label: picomolal
UO:0000072.definition: A molality unit which is equal to 10^[-12] m.

UO:0000073.label: femtomolar
UO:0000073.definition: A unit of molarity which is equal to 10^[-15] M.

UO:0000074.label: unit of normality
UO:0000074.definition: A unit of concentration which highlights the chemical nature of salts.

UO:0000075.label: normal
UO:0000075.definition: A unit of concentration which is one gram equivalent of a solute per liter of solution. A gram equivalent weight or equivalent is a measure of the reactive capacity of a given molecule.

UO:0000076.label: mole fraction
UO:0000076.definition: A concentration unit which denotes the number of moles of solute as a proportion of the total number of moles in a solution.

UO:0000077.label: meter per second per second
UO:0000077.definition: An acceleration unit which is equal to the acceleration an object changing its velocity by 1meter/s over a time period that equals one second.

UO:0000078.label: radian per second per second
UO:0000078.definition: An angular unit acceleration which is equal to the angular acceleration of an object changing its angular velocity by 1rad/s over a time period that equals one second.

UO:0000079.label: radian per second
UO:0000079.definition: An angular unit velocity which is equal to about 9.54930 rpm (revolutions per minute).

UO:0000080.label: square meter
UO:0000080.definition: An area unit which is equal to an area enclosed by a square with sides each 1 meter long.

UO:0000081.label: square centimeter
UO:0000081.definition: An area unit which is equal to one ten thousandth of a square meter or 10^[-4] m^[2].

UO:0000082.label: square millimeter
UO:0000082.definition: An area unit which is equal to one millionth of a square meter or 10^[-6] m^[2].

UO:0000083.label: kilogram per cubic meter
UO:0000083.definition: A mass unit density which is equal to mass of an object in kilograms divided by the volume in cubic meters.

UO:0000084.label: gram per cubic centimeter
UO:0000084.definition: A mass unit density which is equal to mass of an object in grams divided by the volume in cubic centimeters.

UO:0000085.label: candela per square meter
UO:0000085.definition: A luminance unit which is equal to a luminous intensity of one candela radiating from a surface whose area is one square meter.

UO:0000086.label: kilogram per square meter
UO:0000086.definition: An area density unit which is equal to the mass of an object in kilograms divided by the surface area in meters squared.

UO:0000087.label: kilogram per mole
UO:0000087.definition: A molar mass unit which is equal to one kilogram of mass of one mole of chemical element or chemical compound.

UO:0000088.label: gram per mole
UO:0000088.definition: A molar mass unit which is equal to one gram of mass of one mole of chemical element or chemical compound.

UO:0000089.label: cubic meter per mole
UO:0000089.definition: A molar volume unit which is equal to 1 cubic meter occupied by one mole of a substance in the form of a solid, liquid, or gas.

UO:0000090.label: cubic centimeter per mole
UO:0000090.definition: A molar volume unit which is equal to 1 cubic centimeter occupied by one mole of a substance in the form of a solid, liquid, or gas.

UO:0000091.label: kilogram meter per second
UO:0000091.definition: A momentum unit which is equal to the momentum of a one kilogram mass object with a speed of one meter per second.

UO:0000092.label: turns per second
UO:0000092.definition: A rotational frequency unit which is equal to the number complete turn in a period of time that equals to 1 second.

UO:0000093.label: cubic meter per kilogram
UO:0000093.definition: A specific volume unit which is equal to one cubic meter volume occupied by one kilogram of a particular substance.

UO:0000094.label: meter per second
UO:0000094.definition: A speed/velocity unit which is equal to the speed of an object traveling 1 meter distance in one second.

UO:0000095.label: volume unit
UO:0000095.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the amount of space occupied by any substance, whether solid, liquid, or gas.

UO:0000096.label: cubic meter
UO:0000096.definition: A volume unit which is equal to the volume of a cube with edges one meter in length. One cubic meter equals to 1000 liters.

UO:0000097.label: cubic centimeter
UO:0000097.definition: A volume unit which is equal to one millionth of a cubic meter or 10^[-9] m^[3], or to 1 ml.

UO:0000098.label: milliliter
UO:0000098.definition: A volume unit which is equal to one thousandth of a liter or 10^[-3] L, or to 1 cubic centimeter.

UO:0000099.label: liter
UO:0000099.definition: A volume unit which is equal to one thousandth of a cubic meter or 10^[-3] m^[3], or to 1 decimeter.

UO:0000100.label: cubic decimeter
UO:0000100.definition: A volume unit which is equal to one thousand of a cubic meter or 10^[-3] m^[3], or to 1 L.

UO:0000101.label: microliter
UO:0000101.definition: A volume unit which is equal to one millionth of a liter or 10^[-6] L.

UO:0000102.label: nanoliter
UO:0000102.definition: A volume unit which is equal to one thousandth of one millionth of a liter or 10^[-9] L.

UO:0000103.label: picoliter
UO:0000103.definition: A volume unit which is equal to 10^[-12] L.

UO:0000104.label: femtoliter
UO:0000104.definition: A volume unit which is equal to 10^[-15] L.

UO:0000105.label: frequency unit
UO:0000105.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the number of repetitive actions in a particular time.

UO:0000106.label: hertz
UO:0000106.definition: A frequency unit which is equal to 1 complete cycle of a recurring phenomenon in 1 second.

UO:0000107.label: force unit
UO:0000107.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the force is applied when a mass is accelerated.

UO:0000108.label: newton
UO:0000108.definition: A force unit which is equal to the force required to cause an acceleration of 1m/s2 of a mass of 1 Kg in the direction of the force.

UO:0000109.label: pressure unit
UO:0000109.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the force applied to a given area.

UO:0000110.label: pascal
UO:0000110.definition: A pressure unit which is equal to the pressure or stress on a surface caused by a force of 1 newton spread over a surface of 1 m^[2].

UO:0000111.label: energy unit
UO:0000111.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the work done by a certain force (gravitational, electric, magnetic, force of inertia, etc).

UO:0000112.label: joule
UO:0000112.definition: An energy unit which is equal to the energy required when a force of 1 newton moves an object 1 meter in the direction of the force.

UO:0000113.label: power unit
UO:0000113.definition: A unit which is a standard measure power or the rate of doing work.

UO:0000114.label: watt
UO:0000114.definition: A power unit which is equal to the power used when work is done at the rate of 1 joule per second.

UO:0000115.label: illuminance unit
UO:0000115.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the luminous flux incident on a unit area.

UO:0000116.label: lux
UO:0000116.definition: An illuminance unit which is equal to the illuminance produced by 1 lumen evenly spread over an area 1 m^[2].

UO:0000117.label: luminous flux unit
UO:0000117.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the flow of radiant energy.

UO:0000118.label: lumen
UO:0000118.definition: A luminous flux unit which is equal to the luminous flux emitted into 1 steradian by a point source of 1 candela.

UO:0000119.label: catalytic activity unit
UO:0000119.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the amount of the action of a catalyst.

UO:0000120.label: katal
UO:0000120.definition: A catalytic unit activity which is equal to the activity of a catalyst in moles per second, such as the amount of an enzyme needed to transform one mole of substrate per second.

UO:0000121.label: angle unit
UO:0000121.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the figure or space formed by the junction of two lines or planes.

UO:0000122.label: plane angle unit
UO:0000122.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the angle formed by two straight lines in the same plane.

UO:0000123.label: radian
UO:0000123.definition: A plane angle unit which is equal to the angle subtended at the center of a circle by an arc equal in length to the radius of the circle, approximately 57 degrees 17 minutes and 44.6 seconds.

UO:0000124.label: solid angle unit
UO:0000124.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the angle formed by three or more planes intersecting at a common point.

UO:0000125.label: steradian
UO:0000125.definition: A solid angle unit which is equal to the solid angle subtended at the center of a sphere by an area on the surface of the sphere that is equal to the radius squared.

UO:0000127.label: radiation unit
UO:0000127.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the amount of radiation emitted by a given radiation source as well as the amount of radiation absorbed or deposited in a specific material by a radiation source.

UO:0000128.label: activity (of a radionuclide) unit
UO:0000128.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the transformation (disintegration) rate of a radioactive substance.

UO:0000129.label: absorbed dose unit
UO:0000129.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the energy imparted by ionizing radiation to unit mass of matter such as tissue.

UO:0000130.label: dose equivalent unit
UO:0000130.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the expression of dose in terms of its biological effect.

UO:0000131.label: exposure unit
UO:0000131.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the quantity that expresses the ability of radiation to ionize air and thereby create electric charges which can be collected and measured.

UO:0000132.label: becquerel
UO:0000132.definition: An activity (of a radionuclide) unit which is equal to the activity of a quantity of radioactive material in which one nucleus decays per second or there is one atom disintegration per second (dps).

UO:0000133.label: curie
UO:0000133.definition: An activity (of a radionuclide) unit which is equal to the activity of a quantity of radioactive material in which there are 3.7 x 10^[10] atom disintegration per second (dps).

UO:0000134.label: gray
UO:0000134.definition: An absorbed dose unit which is equal to the absorption of one joule of radiation energy by one kilogram of matter.

UO:0000135.label: rad
UO:0000135.definition: An absorbed dose unit which is equal to 0.01 gray (Gy).

UO:0000136.label: roentgen
UO:0000136.definition: An exposure unit which is equal to the amount of radiation required to liberate positive and negative charges of one electrostatic unit of charge in 1 cm^[3] of air at standard temperature and pressure (STP). This corresponds to the generation of approximately 2.0810^[9] ion pairs.

UO:0000137.label: sievert
UO:0000137.definition: A dose equivalent unit which is equal to the absorption of one joule of radiation energy by one kilogram of matter.

UO:0000138.label: millisievert
UO:0000138.definition: A dose equivalent unit which is equal to one thousandth of a sievert or 10^[-3] Sv.

UO:0000139.label: microsievert
UO:0000139.definition: A dose equivalent unit which is equal to one millionth of a sievert or 10^[-6] Sv.

UO:0000140.label: Roentgen equivalent man
UO:0000140.definition: A dose equivalent unit which when multiplied by hundred is equal to one sievert or 1 Sv. 1 Sv is equal to 100 rem.

UO:0000141.label: microgray
UO:0000141.definition: An absorbed dose unit which is equal to one millionth of a gray or 10^[-6] Gy.

UO:0000142.label: milligray
UO:0000142.definition: An absorbed dose unit which is equal to one thousandth of a gray or 10^[-3] Gy.

UO:0000143.label: nanogray
UO:0000143.definition: An absorbed dose unit which is equal to one thousandth of a millionth of a gray or 10^[-9] Gy.

UO:0000144.label: nanosievert
UO:0000144.definition: A dose equivalent unit which is equal to one thousandth of a millionth of a sievert or 10^[-9] Sv.

UO:0000145.label: millicurie
UO:0000145.definition: An activity (of a radionuclide) unit which is equal to one thousandth of a curie or 10^[-3] Ci.

UO:0000146.label: microcurie
UO:0000146.definition: An activity (of a radionuclide) unit which is equal to one millionth of a curie or 10^[-6] Ci.

UO:0000147.label: disintegrations per minute
UO:0000147.definition: An activity (of a radionuclide) unit which is equal to the activity of a quantity of radioactive material in which one nucleus decays per minute or there is one atom disintegration per minute.

UO:0000148.label: counts per minute
UO:0000148.definition: An activity (of a radionuclide) unit which is equal to the number of light emissions produced by ionizing radiation in one minute.

UO:0000150.label: nanosecond
UO:0000150.definition: A time unit which is equal to one thousandth of one millionth of a second or 10^[-9] s.

UO:0000151.label: century
UO:0000151.definition: A time unit which is equal to 100 years.

UO:0000152.label: half life
UO:0000152.definition: A time unit which represents the period over which the activity or concentration of a specified chemical or element falls to half its original activity or concentration.

UO:0000153.label: foot candle
UO:0000153.definition: An illuminance unit which is equal to the illuminance produced by 1 lumen evenly spread over an area 1 foot^[2]. One footcandle is equal to 10.76 lux.

UO:0000154.label: irradiance unit
UO:0000154.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the power of electromagnetic radiation at a surface, per unit area.

UO:0000155.label: watt per square meter
UO:0000155.definition: An irradiance unit which is equal to 1 watt of radiant power incident per one square meter surface area.

UO:0000156.label: einstein per square meter per second
UO:0000156.definition: An irradiance unit which is equal to one einstein per square meter per second. One einstein is one mole of photons, regardless of their frequency. Therefore, the number of photons in an einstein is Avogadro's number.

synonyms.label: einstein per square metre per second
mole per second and square meter mol/sm^2

UO:0000157.label: light unit
UO:0000157.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the intensity of light.

UO:0000158.label: watt per steradian per square meter
UO:0000158.definition: A radiance unit which is equal to one watt of radiant power incident per steradian solid angle per one square meter projected area of the source, as viewed from the given direction.

synonyms.label: watt per steradian per square metre

UO:0000159.label: radiant intensity unit
UO:0000159.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the intensity of electromagnetic radiation.

UO:0000160.label: microeinstein per square meter per second
UO:0000160.definition: An irradiance unit which is equal to one microeinstein per square meter per second or 10^[-6] microeinstein/sm^[2].

synonyms.label: microeinstein per square metre per second
micromole per second and square meter mmol/sm^2

UO:0000161.label: radiance unit
UO:0000161.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the power of electromagnetic radiation through space or through a material medium in the form of electromagnetic waves.

UO:0000162.label: watt per steradian
UO:0000162.definition: A radiant intensity unit which is equal to one kilogram meter squared per second cubed per steradian.

UO:0000163.label: mass percentage
UO:0000163.definition: A dimensionless concentration unit which denotes the mass of a substance in a mixture as a percentage of the mass of the entire mixture.

UO:0000164.label: mass volume percentage
UO:0000164.definition: A dimensionless concentration unit which denotes the mass of the substance in a mixture as a percentage of the volume of the entire mixture.

UO:0000165.label: volume percentage
UO:0000165.definition: A dimensionless concentration unit which denotes the volume of the solute in mL per 100 mL of the resulting solution.

UO:0000166.label: parts per notation unit
UO:0000166.definition: A dimensionless concentration notation which describes the amount of one substance in another. It is the ratio of the amount of the substance of interest to the amount of that substance plus the amount of the substance.

UO:0000167.label: parts per hundred
UO:0000167.definition: A dimensionless concentration notation which denotes the amount of a given substance in a total amount of 100 regardless of the units of measure as long as they are the same.

UO:0000168.label: parts per thousand
UO:0000168.definition: A dimensionless concentration notation which denotes the amount of a given substance in a total amount of 1000 regardless of the units of measure as long as they are the same.

UO:0000169.label: parts per million
UO:0000169.definition: A dimensionless concentration notation which denotes the amount of a given substance in a total amount of 1,000,000 regardless of the units of measure used as long as they are the same or 1 part in 10^[6].

UO:0000170.label: parts per billion
UO:0000170.definition: A dimensionless concentration notation which denotes the amount of a given substance in a total amount of 1,000,000,000 regardless of the units of measure as long as they are the same or 1 part in 10^[9].

UO:0000171.label: parts per trillion
UO:0000171.definition: A dimensionless concentration notation which denotes the amount of a given substance in a total amount of 1,000,000,000 regardless of the units of measure used as long as they are the same or 1 part in 10^[12].

UO:0000172.label: parts per quadrillion
UO:0000172.definition: A dimensionless concentration notation which denotes the amount of a given substance in a total amount of 1,000,000,000,000 regardless of the units of measure used as long as they are the same or 1 part in 10^[15].

UO:0000173.label: gram per milliliter
UO:0000173.definition: A mass unit density which is equal to mass of an object in grams divided by the volume in milliliter.

UO:0000174.label: kilogram per liter
UO:0000174.definition: A mass unit density which is equal to mass of an object in kilograms divided by the volume in liters.

UO:0000175.label: gram per liter
UO:0000175.definition: A mass unit density which is equal to mass of an object in grams divided by the volume in liters.

UO:0000176.label: milligram per milliliter
UO:0000176.definition: A mass unit density which is equal to mass of an object in milligrams divided by the volume in milliliters.

UO:0000177.label: unit per volume unit
UO:0000177.definition: A concentration unit which is a standard measure of the number of units, as an agreed arbitrary amount, of a given substance per a specific volume of solution.

UO:0000178.label: unit per milliliter
UO:0000178.definition: A unit per milliliter unit which is equal to one unit of an agreed arbitrary amount per one milliliter.

UO:0000179.label: unit per liter
UO:0000179.definition: A unit per milliliter unit which is equal to one unit of an agreed arbitrary amount per one liter.

UO:0000180.label: mass per unit volume
UO:0000180.definition: A concentration unit which is a standard measure of the mass of a substance in a given volume (density).

UO:0000181.label: enzyme unit
UO:0000181.definition: A catalytic unit activity which is equal to the amount of the enzyme that catalyzes the conversion of 1 micro mole of substrate per minute.

UO:0000182.label: density unit
UO:0000182.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the influence exerted by some mass.

UO:0000183.label: linear density unit
UO:0000183.definition: A density unit which is a standard measure of the mass exerting an influence on a one-dimensional object.

UO:0000184.label: kilogram per meter
UO:0000184.definition: An area density unit which is equal to the mass of an object in kilograms divided by one meter.

UO:0000185.label: degree
UO:0000185.definition: A plane angle unit which is equal to 1/360 of a full rotation or 1.7453310^[-2] rad.

UO:0000186.label: dimensionless unit
UO:0000186.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of physical quantity consisting of only a numerical number without any units.

UO:0000187.label: percent
UO:0000187.definition: A dimensionless ratio unit which denotes numbers as fractions of 100.

UO:0000188.label: pi
UO:0000188.definition: A dimensionless unit which denoted an irrational real number, approximately equal to 3.14159 which is the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter in Euclidean geometry.

UO:0000189.label: count unit
UO:0000189.definition: A dimensionless unit which denotes a simple count of things.

UO:0000190.label: ratio unit
UO:0000190.definition: A dimensionless unit which denotes an amount or magnitude of one quantity relative to another.

UO:0000191.label: fraction
UO:0000191.definition: A dimensionless ratio unit which relates the part (the numerator) to the whole (the denominator).

UO:0000192.label: molecule count
UO:0000192.definition: A dimensionless count unit which denotes the number of molecules.

UO:0000193.label: purity percentage
UO:0000193.definition: A dimensionless percent unit which denotes the homogeneity of a biomaterial.

UO:0000194.label: confluence percentage
UO:0000194.definition: A dimensionless percent unit which denotes the density of an attached or monolayer culture (e.g., cell culture).

UO:0000195.label: degree Fahrenheit
UO:0000195.definition: A temperature unit which is equal to 5/9ths of a kelvin. Negative 40 degrees Fahrenheit is equal to negative 40 degrees Celsius.

UO:0000196.label: pH
UO:0000196.definition: A dimensionless concentration notation which denotes the acidity of a solution in terms of activity of hydrogen ions (H+).

UO:0000197.label: liter per kilogram
UO:0000197.definition: A specific volume unit which is equal to one liter volume occupied by one kilogram of a particular substance.

UO:0000198.label: milliliter per kilogram
UO:0000198.definition: A specific volume unit which is equal to a thousandth of a liter per kilogram or 10^[-3] l/kg.

UO:0000199.label: microliter per kilogram
UO:0000199.definition: A specific volume unit which is equal to one millionth of a liter per kilogram or 10^[-6] l/kg.

UO:0000200.label: cell concentration unit
UO:0000200.definition: A concentration unit which denotes the average cell number in a given volume.

UO:0000201.label: cells per milliliter
UO:0000201.definition: A unit of cell concentration which is equal to one cell in a volume of 1 milliliter.

UO:0000202.label: catalytic (activity) concentration unit
UO:0000202.definition: A concentration unit which is a standard measure of the amount of the action of a catalyst in a given volume.

UO:0000203.label: katal per cubic meter
UO:0000203.definition: A catalytic (activity) concentration unit which is equal to 1 katal activity of a catalyst in a given volume of one cubic meter.

UO:0000204.label: katal per liter
UO:0000204.definition: A catalytic (activity) concentration unit which is equal to 1 katal activity of a catalyst in a given volume of one thousandth of a cubic meter.

UO:0000205.label: volume per unit volume
UO:0000205.definition: A dimensionless concentration unit which denotes the given volume of the solute in the total volume of the resulting solution.

UO:0000206.label: milliliter per cubic meter
UO:0000206.definition: A volume per unit volume unit which is equal to one millionth of a liter of solute in one cubic meter of solution.

UO:0000207.label: milliliter per liter
UO:0000207.definition: A volume per unit volume unit which is equal to one millionth of a liter of solute in one liter of solution.

UO:0000208.label: gram per deciliter
UO:0000208.definition: A mass density unit which is equal to mass of an object in grams divided by the volume in deciliters.

UO:0000209.label: deciliter
UO:0000209.definition: A volume unit which is equal to one tenth of a liter or 10^[-1] L.

UO:0000210.label: colony forming unit
UO:0000210.definition: A dimensionless count unit which a measure of viable bacterial numbers.

UO:0000211.label: plaque forming unit
UO:0000211.definition: A dimensionless count unit which a measure of plaque forming units in a given volume.

UO:0000212.label: colony forming unit per volume
UO:0000212.definition: A concentration unit which a measure of viable bacterial numbers in a given volume.

UO:0000213.label: colony forming unit per milliliter
UO:0000213.definition: A colony forming unit which a measure of viable bacterial numbers in one milliliter.

UO:0000214.label: plaque forming unit per volume
UO:0000214.definition: A concentration unit which a measure of plaque forming units in a given volume.

UO:0000215.label: plaque forming unit per milliliter
UO:0000215.definition: A concentration unit which a measure of plaque forming units in one milliliter.

UO:0000216.label: disintegrations per second
UO:0000216.definition: An activity (of a radionuclide) unit which is equal to the activity of a quantity of radioactive material in which one nucleus decays per second or there is one atom disintegration per second.

UO:0000217.label: electric potential difference unit
UO:0000217.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the work done per unit charge as a charge is moved between two points in an electric field.

UO:0000218.label: volt
UO:0000218.definition: An electric potential difference unit which is equal to the work per unit charge. One volt is the potential difference required to move one coulomb of charge between two points in a circuit while using one joule of energy.

UO:0000219.label: electric charge
UO:0000219.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the quantity of unbalanced electricity in a body (either positive or negative) and construed as an excess or deficiency of electrons.

UO:0000220.label: coulomb
UO:0000220.definition: An electrical charge unit which is equal to the amount of charge transferred by a current of 1 ampere in 1 second.

UO:0000221.label: dalton
UO:0000221.definition: An independently to the base SI units defined mass unit which is equal to one twelfth of the mass of an unbound atom of the carbon-12 nuclide, at rest and in its ground state.

UO:0000222.label: kilodalton
UO:0000222.definition: A mass unit which is equal to one thousand daltons.

UO:0000223.label: watt-hour
UO:0000223.definition: An energy unit which is equal to the amount of electrical energy equivalent to a one-watt load drawing power for one hour.

UO:0000224.label: kilowatt-hour
UO:0000224.definition: An energy unit which is equal to 1,000 watt-hours.

UO:0000225.label: magnetic flux unit
UO:0000225.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of quantity of magnetism, taking account of the strength and the extent of a magnetic field.

UO:0000226.label: weber
UO:0000226.definition: A magnetic flux unit which is equal to the amount of flux that when linked with a single turn of wire for an interval of one second will induce an electromotive force of one volt.

UO:0000227.label: magnetic flux density unit
UO:0000227.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the strength of a magnetic field.

UO:0000228.label: tesla
UO:0000228.definition: A magnetic flux density unit which is equal to one weber per square meter.

UO:0000229.label: volt-hour
UO:0000229.definition: A magnetic flux unit which is equal to 3600 Wb.

UO:0000230.label: kilovolt-hour
UO:0000230.definition: A magnetic flux unit which is equal to one thousand volt-hours.

UO:0000231.label: information unit
UO:0000231.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the amount of information.

UO:0000232.label: bit
UO:0000232.definition: An information unit which refers to a digit in the binary numeral system, which consists of base 2 digits (ie there are only 2 possible values: 0 or 1).

UO:0000233.label: byte
UO:0000233.definition: An information unit which is equal to 8 bits.

UO:0000234.label: kilobyte
UO:0000234.definition: An information unit which is equal to 1000 bytes.

UO:0000235.label: megabyte
UO:0000235.definition: An information unit which is equal to 1000 kB.

UO:0000236.label: image resolution unit
UO:0000236.definition: An information unit which is a standard measure of the detail an image holds.

UO:0000237.label: chroma sampling unit
UO:0000237.definition: An image resolution unit which is a standard measure of the amount of spatial detail in an image.

UO:0000238.label: dynamic range unit
UO:0000238.definition: An image resolution unit which is a standard measure of the amount of contrast available in a pixel.

UO:0000239.label: spatial resolution unit
UO:0000239.definition: An image resolution unit which is a standard measure of the way luminance and chrominance may be sampled at different levels.

UO:0000240.label: dots per inch
UO:0000240.definition: A spatial resolution unit which is a standard measure of the printing resolution, in particular the number of individual dots of ink a printer or toner can produce within a linear one-inch space.

UO:0000241.label: micron pixel
UO:0000241.definition: A spatial resolution unit which is equal to a pixel size of one micrometer.

UO:0000242.label: pixels per inch
UO:0000242.definition: A spatial resolution unit which is a standard measure of the resolution of a computer display, related to the size of the display in inches and the total number of pixels in the horizontal and vertical directions.

UO:0000243.label: pixels per millimeter
UO:0000243.definition: A spatial resolution unit which is a standard measure of the number of pixels in one millimeter length or width of a digital image divided by the physical length or width of a printed image.

UO:0000244.label: base pair
UO:0000244.definition: A count unit which contains one nucleotide.

UO:0000245.label: kibibyte
UO:0000245.definition: An information unit which is equal to 1024 B.

UO:0000246.label: mebibyte
UO:0000246.definition: An information unit which is equal to 1024 KiB.

UO:0000247.label: millivolt
UO:0000247.definition: An electric potential difference unit which is equal to one thousandth of a volt or 10^[-3] V.

UO:0000248.label: kilovolt
UO:0000248.definition: An electric potential difference unit which is equal to one thousand volts or 10^[3] V.

UO:0000249.label: microvolt
UO:0000249.definition: An electric potential difference unit which is equal to one millionth of a volt or 10^[-6] V.

UO:0000250.label: nanovolt
UO:0000250.definition: An electric potential difference unit which is equal to one billionth of a volt or 10^[-12] V.

UO:0000251.label: picovolt
UO:0000251.definition: An electric potential difference unit which is equal to one trillionth of a volt or 10^[-12] V.

UO:0000252.label: megavolt
UO:0000252.definition: An electric potential difference unit which is equal to one million volts or 10^[6] V.

UO:0000253.label: surface tension unit
UO:0000253.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the ability of a liguid to attraction of molecules at its surface as a result of unbalanced molecular cohesive forces.

UO:0000254.label: newton per meter
UO:0000254.definition: A surface tension unit which is equal to one newton per meter.

UO:0000255.label: dyne per cm
UO:0000255.definition: A surface tension unit which is equal to one dyne per centimeter.

UO:0000256.label: viscosity unit
UO:0000256.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the internal resistance of fluids to flow.

UO:0000257.label: pascal second
UO:0000257.definition: A viscosity unit which is equal to one pascale per second.

UO:0000258.label: poise
UO:0000258.definition: A viscosity unit which is equal to one dyne second per square centimeter.

UO:0000259.label: decibel
UO:0000259.definition: A ratio unit which is an indicator of sound power per unit area.

UO:0000260.label: effective dose unit
UO:0000260.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the estimate of the stochastic effect that a non-uniform radiation dose has on a human.

UO:0000261.label: conduction unit
UO:0000261.definition: A unit which represents a standard measurement of the transmission of an entity through a medium.

UO:0000262.label: electrical conduction unit
UO:0000262.definition: A unit which represents a standard measurement of the movement of electrically charged particles through a transmission medium (electrical conductor).

UO:0000263.label: heat conduction unit
UO:0000263.definition: A unit which represents a standard measurement of the spontaneous transfer of thermal energy through matter, from a region of higher temperature to a region of lower temperature.

UO:0000264.label: siemens
UO:0000264.definition: An electrical conduction unit which is equal to A/V.

UO:0000265.label: watt per meter kelvin
UO:0000265.definition: An heat conduction unit which is equal to one watt divided by meter kelvin.

UO:0000266.label: electronvolt
UO:0000266.definition: A non-SI unit of energy (eV) defined as the energy acquired by a single unbound electron when it passes through an electrostatic potential difference of one volt. An electronvolt is equal to 1.602 176 53(14) x 10^-19 J.

UO:0000267.label: electric field strength unit
UO:0000267.definition: The electric field strength is a unit which is a measure of the potential difference between two points some distance apart.

UO:0000268.label: volt per meter
UO:0000268.definition: The volt per meter is a unit of electric field strength equal to the a potential difference of 1 volt existing between two points that are 1 meter apart.

UO:0000269.label: absorbance unit
UO:0000269.definition: A dimensionless logarithmic unit assigned to a measure of absorbance of light through a partially absorbing substance, defined as -log10(I/I_0) where I = transmitted light and I_0 = incident light.

UO:0000270.label: volumetric flow rate unit
UO:0000270.definition: A unit which is a standard measure of the volume of fluid which passes through a given surface per unit time .

UO:0000271.label: microliters per minute
UO:0000271.definition: A volumetric flow rate unit which is equal to one microliter volume through a given surface in one minute.

UO:0000272.label: millimetres of mercury
UO:0000272.definition: A unit of pressure equal to the amount of fluid pressure one millimeter deep in mercury at zero degrees centigrade on Earth.

UO:0000273.label: milligram per liter
UO:0000273.definition: A mass unit density which is equal to mass of an object in milligrams divided by the volume in liters.

UO:0000274.label: microgram per milliliter
UO:0000274.definition: A mass unit density which is equal to mass of an object in micrograms divided by the volume in millliters.

UO:0000275.label: nanogram per milliliter
UO:0000275.definition: A mass unit density which is equal to mass of an object in nanograms divided by the volume in milliliters.

UO:0000276.label: amount per container
UO:0000276.definition: A concentration unit which is a standard measure of the amount of a substance in a given container.

UO:0000277.label: ug/disk
UO:0000277.definition: A unit which is equal to one microgram per disk, where a disk is some physical surface/container upon which the substance is deposited.

UO:0000278.label: nmole/disk
UO:0000278.definition: A unit which is equal to one nanomole per disk, where a disk is some physical surface/container upon which the substance is deposited.

UO:0000279.label: milliunits per milliliter
UO:0000279.definition: A unit per milliliter unit which is equal to one thousandth of a unit of an agreed arbitrary amount per one milliliter.

UO:0000280.label: rate unit
UO:0000280.definition: A unit which represents a standard measurement occurrence of a process per unit time.

UO:0000281.label: count per nanomolar second
UO:0000281.definition: A rate unit which is equal to one over one nanomolar second.

UO:0000282.label: count per molar second
UO:0000282.definition: A rate unit which is equal to one over one molar second.

UO:0000283.label: kilogram per hectare
UO:0000283.definition: An area density unit which is equal to the mass of an object in kilograms divided by the surface area in hectares.

UO:0000284.label: count per nanomolar
UO:0000284.definition: A rate unit which is equal to one over one nanomolar.

UO:0000285.label: count per molar
UO:0000285.definition: A rate unit which is equal to one over one molar.

UO:0000286.label: yotta
UO:0000286.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of ten to the power of 24.

UO:0000287.label: hecto
UO:0000287.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of one hundred.

UO:0000288.label: zetta
UO:0000288.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of ten to the power of 21.

UO:0000289.label: exa
UO:0000289.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of ten to the power of 18.

UO:0000290.label: peta
UO:0000290.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of ten to the power of 15.

UO:0000291.label: tera
UO:0000291.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of ten to the power of 12.

UO:0000292.label: giga
UO:0000292.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of ten to the power of 9.

UO:0000293.label: mega
UO:0000293.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of million.

UO:0000294.label: kilo
UO:0000294.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of one thousand.

UO:0000295.label: deca
UO:0000295.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of ten.

UO:0000296.label: deci
UO:0000296.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of one tenth.

UO:0000297.label: milli
UO:0000297.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of one thousandth.

UO:0000298.label: centi
UO:0000298.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of one hundredth.

UO:0000299.label: micro
UO:0000299.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of 10 to the power of -6.

UO:0000300.label: nano
UO:0000300.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of 10 to the power of -9.

UO:0000301.label: microgram per liter
UO:0000301.definition: A mass unit density which is equal to mass of an object in micrograms divided by the volume in liters.

UO:0000302.label: pico
UO:0000302.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of 10 to the power of -12.

UO:0000303.label: femto
UO:0000303.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of 10 to the power of -15.

UO:0000304.label: atto
UO:0000304.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of 10 to the power of -18.

UO:0000305.label: zepto
UO:0000305.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of 10 to the power of -21.

UO:0000306.label: yocto
UO:0000306.definition: A prefix in the metric system denoting a factor of 10 to the power of -24.

UO:0000307.label: dose unit
UO:0000307.definition: A concentration unit which is a standard measure of the amount of a toxic or pharmaceutical substance administered to a recipient subject, expressed in terms of the size of the subject.

UO:0000308.label: milligram per kilogram
UO:0000308.definition: A dose unit which is equal to 1 milligram of a toxic or pharmaceutical substance per kilogram body weight of the recipient subject.

UO:0000309.label: milligram per square meter
UO:0000309.definition: A dose unit which is equal to 1 milligram of a toxic or pharmaceutical substance per square meter of surface area of the recipient subject.

UO:0000310.label: dosage unit
UO:0000310.definition: A concentration unit which is a standard measure of the amount of a toxic or pharmaceutical substance administered over time to a recipient subject, expressed in terms of the size of the subject.

UO:0000311.label: milligram per kilogram per day
UO:0000311.definition: A dosage unit which is equal to 1 milligram per day of a toxic or pharmaceutical substance per kilogram body weight of the recipient subject.

UO:0000312.label: relative light unit
UO:0000312.definition: A derived unit which is a measure of relative light intensity, as typically measured by a luminometer, spectrophotometer, or fluorimeter in biological research applications.

UO:0000313.label: relative luminescence unit
UO:0000313.definition: A relative light unit which is a measure of relative luminescence intensity.

UO:0000314.label: relative fluorescence unit
UO:0000314.definition: A relative light unit which is a measure of relative fluorescence intensity.

UO:0000315.label: turbidity unit
UO:0000315.definition: A unit used to indicate the clarity of water or other solutions or suspensions, as measured by the ability of the solution or suspension to scatter light of a defined wavelength range.

UO:0000316.label: cells per microliter
UO:0000316.definition: A unit of cell concentration which is equal to one cell in a volume of 1 microliter.

UO:0000317.label: cells per well
UO:0000317.definition: A unit of cell concentration which is equal to 1 cell in a well or discrete container of arbitrary volume.

UO:0000318.label: formazin nephelometric unit
UO:0000318.definition: 1000 formazin turbidity units (FNU) on the empirical formazin turbidity scale represents reflectance of insol. reaction products of 0.0725 g hydrazine sulfate with 0.7250 g hexamethylenetetramine diluted to 1 L.

UO:0000319.label: radioactivity concentration
UO:0000319.definition: A concentration unit which is a standard measure of the amount of radioactivity in a given volume.

UO:0000320.label: curie per liter
UO:0000320.definition: A unit of radioactivity concentration which is equal to one curie in a volume of 1 liter.

UO:0000321.label: microcurie per milliliter
UO:0000321.definition: A unit of radioactivity concentration which is equal to one micro curie in a volume of 1 liter.

UO:0000322.label: fold dilution
UO:0000322.definition: A unit that is the ratio of concentration of two solutions of interest, typically with one solution derived from the other by the addition of solvent.

UO:0000323.label: ton per hectare
UO:0000323.definition: An area density unit which is equal to the mass of an object in tons divided by the surface area in hectares.

UO:0000324.label: square angstrom
UO:0000324.definition: An area unit which is equal to an area enclosed by a square with sides each 1 angstrom long.

UO:0000325.label: megaHertz
UO:0000325.definition: A frequency unit which is equal to one million hertz or 10^[6] V.

UO:0000326.label: centiMorgan
UO:0000326.definition: A unit used to express distances on a genetic map. In genetic mapping, distances between markers are determined by measuring the rate of meiotic recombination between them, which increases proportionately with the distance separating them. A cM is defined as the length of an interval in which there is a 1% probability of recombination. On the average, 1 cM is roughly equivalent to 1 megabase (Mb) of DNA, although this can vary widely due to hot and cold spots of recombination.

UO:0000327.label: centiRay
UO:0000327.definition: A unit of genetic map distance defined corresponding to an interval in which there is a 1% probability of X-irradiation induced breakage. To be completely specified, the unit must be qualified by the radiation in dosage in rads (e.g. cR8000), because this determines the actual breakage probability.

UO:0000328.label: kilo base pair
UO:0000328.definition: A unit equal to one thousand base pairs.

UO:0000329.label: mega base pair
UO:0000329.definition: A unit equal to one million base pairs

UO:0000330.label: giga base pair
UO:0000330.definition: A unit equal to one billion base pairs.

UO:0000331.label: gigabyte
UO:0000331.definition: An information unit which is equal to 1000000000 bytes.

UO:0000332.label: terabyte
UO:0000332.definition: An information unit which is equal to 1000 gigabytes.

UO:0010001.label: square micrometer
UO:0010001.definition: An area unit which is equal to an area enclosed by a square with sides each 1 micrometer long.

UO:0010002.label: millisiemens
UO:0010002.definition: An electrical conduction unit which is equal to one thousandth of a siemen or 10^[-3] siemens.

UO:0010003.label: micromole per litre
UO:0010003.definition: A specific concentration unit which is equal to 1 micromole in a given volume of one thousandth of a cubic meter.

UO:0010004.label: micromole per kilogram
UO:0010004.definition: A specific concentration unit which is equal to 1 micromole of a given substance per kilogram of solvent.

UO:0010005.label: millimeters per day
UO:0010005.definition: A speed/velocity unit which is equal to the speed of an object traveling 1 millimeter distance in one day.

UO:0010006.label: ratio
UO:0010006.definition: A dimensionless ratio unit which, given a pair of quantities a and b, for which b is a multiple of a, denotes b by giving the multiplier (coefficient) c for a to result in b.

UO:0010007.label: volt-second per square centimeter
UO:0010007.definition: An electrical mobility unit which is equal to one volt second per square centimeter.

UO:0010008.label: kilometer per hour
UO:0010008.definition: A speed/velocity unit which is equal to the speed of an object traveling 1 kilometer distance in one hour.

UO:0010009.label: millidalton
UO:0010009.definition: A mass unit which is equal to one thousandth of a dalton, i.e. 1/12000 the mass of 12C

UO:0010010.label: hectare
UO:0010010.definition: An area unit which is equal to an area of 10,000 square meters. Equivalent to 2.471 acres.

UO:0010011.label: inch
UO:0010011.definition: A length unit which is equal to 0.0254 metres.

UO:0010012.label: thou
UO:0010012.definition: A length unit which is equal to 0.0254 millimetres.

UO:0010013.label: foot
UO:0010013.definition: A length unit which is equal to 0.3048 metres, or 12 inches.

UO:0010014.label: yard
UO:0010014.definition: A length unit which is equal to 0.9144 metres, or 3 feet.

UO:0010015.label: chain
UO:0010015.definition: A length unit which is equal to 20.1168 metres, 66 feet, or 22 yards.

UO:0010016.label: furlong
UO:0010016.definition: A length unit which is equal to 20,116.8 metres, 660 feet, or 10 chains.

UO:0010017.label: mile
UO:0010017.definition: A length unit which is equal to 1,609.344 metres, or 8 furlongs.

UO:0010018.label: league
UO:0010018.definition: A length unit which is equal to 3 miles, or 4,828.032 metres

UO:0010019.label: maritime length unit
UO:0010019.definition: A maritime length unit is one used primarily at sea.

UO:0010020.label: fathom
UO:0010020.definition: A maritime length unit which is equal to 6.08 feet, or 1.853184 metres

UO:0010021.label: cable
UO:0010021.definition: A maritime length unit which is equal to 608 feet, 100 fathoms, or 185.3184 metres

UO:0010022.label: nautical mile
UO:0010022.definition: A maritime length unit which is equal to 6,080 feet, 10 cables, or 1,853.184 metres

UO:0010023.label: perch
UO:0010023.definition: An area unit which is equal to an area of 25.292,852,64 square meters, or 1 square rod.

UO:0010024.label: rood
UO:0010024.definition: An area unit which is equivalent to 1 furlong x 1 rod. This is equal to an area of 1,011.714,1056 square meters, or 40 square rods.

UO:0010025.label: acre
UO:0010025.definition: An area unit which is equivalent to 1 furlong x 1 chain. This is equal to an area of 4,046.856,4224 square meters, or 43,500 square feet.

UO:0010026.label: fluid ounce
UO:0010026.definition: An imperial volume unit which is equivalent to 28.413,0625 millilitres.

UO:0010027.label: gill
UO:0010027.definition: An imperial volume unit which is equivalent to 142.065,3125 millilitres.

UO:0010028.label: pint
UO:0010028.definition: An imperial volume unit which is equivalent to 568.261,25 millilitres.

UO:0010029.label: quart
UO:0010029.definition: An imperial volume unit which is equivalent to 1,136.5225 millilitres, or two pints.

UO:0010030.label: gallon
UO:0010030.definition: An imperial volume unit which is equivalent to 4,546.09 millilitres, or 8 pints.

UO:0010031.label: grain
UO:0010031.definition: An imperial mass unit which is equivalent to 64.798,91 milligrams.

UO:0010032.label: drachm
UO:0010032.definition: An imperial mass unit which is equivalent to 1.771,845,195,3125 grams, or 1/256 of 1 pound.

UO:0010033.label: ounce
UO:0010033.definition: An imperial mass unit which is equivalent to 28.349,523,125 grams, or 1/16 of 1 pound.

UO:0010034.label: pound
UO:0010034.definition: An imperial mass unit which is equivalent to 453.592,37 grams.

UO:0010035.label: stone
UO:0010035.definition: An imperial mass unit which is equivalent to 6,350.293,18 grams, or 14 pounds.

UO:0010036.label: quarter
UO:0010036.definition: An imperial mass unit which is equivalent to 12.700,586,36 kilograms, or 28 pounds.

UO:0010037.label: hundredweight
UO:0010037.definition: An imperial mass unit which is equivalent to 50.802,345,44 kilograms, 112 pounds, or 8 stone.

UO:0010038.label: ton
UO:0010038.definition: An imperial mass unit which is equivalent to 1,016.046,9088 kilograms, or 2,240 pounds.

UO:0010039.label: slug
UO:0010039.definition: An imperial gravitational unit which is equivalent to a mass that accelerates by 1ft/s² when a force of one pound (lbf) is exerted on it.

UO:0010040.label: teaspoon
UO:0010040.definition: A metric teaspoon is a unit of measurement of volume widely used in cooking recipes and pharmaceutic prescriptions. It equals a 5mL volume.

UO:0010041.label: united states customary teaspoon
UO:0010041.definition: A United States customary units teaspoon is a unit of measurement of volume widely used in cooking recipes and pharmaceutic prescriptions in America. It equals a 4.93 mL volume.

UO:0010042.label: tablespoon
UO:0010042.definition: A metric tablespoon is a unit of measurement of volume widely used in cooking recipes and pharmaceutic prescriptions. It equals a 15mL volume.

UO:0010043.label: australian metric tablespoon
UO:0010043.definition: An Australian metric tablespoon is a unit of measurement of volume used in Australia for cooking recipes and pharmaceutic prescriptions. It equals a 20mL volume.

UO:0010044.label: united states customary tablespoon
UO:0010044.definition: A United States customary units tablespoon is a unit of measurement of volume widely used in cooking recipes and pharmaceutic prescriptions in America. It equals a 14.79 mL volume.

UO:0010045.label: metric cup
UO:0010045.definition: A metric cup is a unit of measurement of volume widely used in cooking recipes and pharmaceutic prescriptions. It equals a 250mL volume.

UO:0010046.label: united states customary cup
UO:0010046.definition: A United States customary units cup is a unit of measurement of volume widely used in cooking recipes and pharmaceutic prescriptions in America. It equals a 236.59 mL volume.

UO:0010047.label: united states fda cup
UO:0010047.definition: A United States FDA cup is a unit of measurement of volume used by the US Federal Department of Agriculture as a nutritional serving measure. It equals a 240 mL volume.

UO:0010048.label: obsolete micromole
UO:0010048.definition: DEPRECATED: Duplicate of http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UO_0000039. A substance unit which is equal to one millionth of a mole.

UO:0010049.label: gram per square meter
UO:0010049.definition: An area density unit which is equal to the mass of an object in grams divided by the surface area in meters squared.

UO:0010050.label: nanogram per microliter
UO:0010050.definition: A mass unit density which is equal to mass of an object in nanograms divided by the volume in microliters.

UO:0010051.label: large calorie
UO:0010051.definition: A unit of energy widely used in nutrition, equivalent to the amount of heat needed to cause one kilogram of water to rise in temperature by one degree Celsius.

UO:0010052.label: pounds per square inch
UO:0010052.definition: A pressure unit which is equal to 6894.757 pascal.

UO:0010053.label: micrograms per wheaton bottle
UO:0010053.definition: A unit of mass concentration defined as the number of micrograms of a substance per 250 ml Wheaton bottle.

UO:0010054.label: picoampere
UO:0010054.definition: An electric current unit current which is equal to one trillionth of an ampere or 10^[-12] A.

UO:0010055.label: centigray
UO:0010055.definition: An absorbed dose unit which is equal to 0.01 gray (Gy)

UO:0010056.label: gigaelectronvolt
UO:0010056.definition: A unit of energy that is equal to one thousand million electronvolts.

UO:0010057.label: gigaelectronvolt per nucleon
UO:0010057.definition: Derived unit which is equal to the total kinetic energy of an atomic nucleus in GeV divided by the number of nucleons in the nucleus

UO:0010058.label: megaelectronvolt per nucleon
UO:0010058.definition: Derived unit which is equal to the total kinetic energy of an atomic nucleus in MeV divided by the number of nucleons in the nucleus

UO:0010059.label: kiloelectronvolt per micron
UO:0010059.definition: A derived unit equal to the energy deposited by ionizing radiation per micron of path length in matter

UO:0010060.label: gray per minute
UO:0010060.definition: A derived absorbed dose unit which is equal to one gray absorbed per minute.

UO:0010061.label: centigray per minute
UO:0010061.definition: A derived absorbed dose unit which is equal to one centigray absorbed per minute.

UO:0010062.label: milligray per minute
UO:0010062.definition: A derived absorbed dose unit which is equal to one milligray absorbed per minute.

UO:0010063.label: milligray per day
UO:0010063.definition: A derived absorbed dose unit which is equal to one milligray absorbed per day.

UO:0010064.label: milligray per hour
UO:0010064.definition: A derived absorbed dose unit which is equal to one milligray absorbed per hour.

UO:0010065.label: milligray per second
UO:0010065.definition: A derived absorbed dose unit which is equal to one milligray absorbed per second.

UO:0010066.label: kilometer
UO:0010066.definition: A length unit which is equal to one thousand meters.

UO:0010067.label: milligram per deciliter
UO:0010067.definition: A mass unit density which is equal to mass of an object in milligrams divided by the volume in deciliters.

UO:0010068.label: microgram per deciliter
UO:0010068.definition: A mass unit density which is equal to mass of an object in micrograms divided by the volume in deciliters.

UO:0010069.label: bar
UO:0010069.definition: A pressure unit which is equal to 100,000 pascal or the pressure or stress on a surface caused by a force of 100,000 newtons spread over a surface of 1 m^[2].

UO:0010070.label: picogram per milliliter
UO:0010070.definition: A gram per milliliter unit which is equal to one picogram per one milliliter.

UO:0010071.label: microgram per square centimeter
UO:0010071.definition: An area density unit which is equal to the mass of an object in micrograms divided by the surface area in square centimeters.

UO:0010072.label: microgram per microliter
UO:0010072.definition: A mass unit density which is equal to mass of an object in nanograms divided by the volume in microliters.

UO:0010073.label: cell count
UO:0010073.definition: A count unit that denotes a count of cells.

UO:0010074.label: heartbeats per minute
UO:0010074.definition: A rate unit which represents a measurement of the number of an organism's heartbeats per one minute.

UO:0010075.label: multiplicity of infection
UO:0010075.definition: A ratio unit which denotes the quantity of infectious agents to infection targets.

UO:0010076.label: breaths per minute
UO:0010076.definition: A rate unit which represents a measurement of the number of breaths taken by an organism per one minute.

UO:0010077.label: PCR quantification cycle
UO:0010077.definition: A count unit of how many Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) cycles it took to detect a real signal from a sample. Equivalent to the PCR cycle number at which a sample's reaction curve intersects the threshold line.

UO:0010080.label: titer
UO:0010080.definition: A concentration unit which denotes the minimum amount of a substance in a solution that still yields a positive reading, as determined by serial dilution.

UO:1000077.label: meter per second per second based unit

UO:1000078.label: radian per second per second based unit

UO:1000084.label: gram per cubic centimeter based unit

UO:1000085.label: candela per square meter based unit

UO:1000089.label: cubic meter per mole based unit

UO:1000090.label: cubic centimeter per mole based unit

UO:1000093.label: cubic meter per kilogram based unit

UO:1000155.label: watt per square meter based unit

UO:1000156.label: einstein per square meter per second based unit

UO:1000158.label: watt per steradian per square meter based unit

UO:1000180.label: mass per unit volume based unit

UO:1000203.label: katal per cubic meter based unit

UO:1000213.label: colony forming unit per milliliter based unit

UO:1000215.label: plaque forming unit per milliliter based unit

UO:1000265.label: watt per meter kelvin based unit

UO:1000281.label: count per nanomolar second based unit

UO:1000282.label: count per molar second based unit
